verses.hebrew: אַשְׁרֵי־הָאִישׁ אֲשֶׁר לֹא הָלַךְ בַּעֲצַת רְשָׁעִים וּבְדֶרֶךְ חַטָּאִים לֹא עָמָד וּבְמוֹשַׁב לֵצִים לֹא יָשָׁב׃
verses.english: Blessed is the man who does not walk in the counsel of the wicked, nor stands in the way of sinners, nor sits in the seat of scorners.

verses.hebrew: כִּי אִם בְּתוֹרַת יְהוָה חֶפְצוֹ וּבְתוֹרָתוֹ יֶהְגֶּה יוֹמָם וָלָיְלָה׃
verses.english: But his delight is in the Tora of the Lord; and in his Tora he meditates day and night.

verses.hebrew: וְהָיָה כְּעֵץ שָׁתוּל עַל־פַּלְגֵי מָיִם אֲשֶׁר פִּרְיוֹ יִתֵּן בְּעִתּוֹ וְעָלֵהוּ לֹא־יִבּוֹל וְכֹל אֲשֶׁר־יַעֲשֶׂה יַצְלִיחַ׃
verses.english: And he shall be like a tree planted by streams of water, that brings forth its fruit in its season; its leaf also shall not wither; and in whatever he does he shall prosper.

verses.hebrew: לֹא־כֵן הָרְשָׁעִים כִּי אִם־כַּמֹּץ אֲ‍שֶׁר־תִּדְּפֶנּוּ רוּחַ׃
verses.english: Not so the wicked: but they are like the chaff which the wind drives away.

verses.hebrew: עַל־כֵּן לֹא־יָקֻמוּ רְשָׁעִים בַּמִּשְׁפָּט וְחַטָּאִים בַּעֲדַת צַדִּיקִים׃
verses.english: Therefore the wicked shall not stand in the judgment, nor sinners in the congregation of the righteous.

verses.hebrew: כִּי־יוֹדֵעַ יְהוָה דֶּרֶךְ צַדִּיקִים וְדֶרֶךְ רְשָׁעִים תֹּאבֵד׃
verses.english: For the Lord knows the way of the righteous: but the way of the wicked shall perish.

verses.hebrew: לָמָּה רָגְשׁוּ גוֹיִם וּלְאֻמִּים יֶהְגּוּ־רִיק׃
verses.english: Why are the nations in uproar, and the people mutter a vain thing?

verses.hebrew: יִתְיַצְּבוּ מַלְכֵי־אֶרֶץ וְרוֹזְנִים נוֹסְדוּ־יָחַד עַל־יְהוָה וְעַל־מְשִׁיחוֹ׃
verses.english: The kings of the earth set themselves, and the rulers take counsel together, against the Lord, and against his anointed, saying,

verses.hebrew: נְנַתְּקָה אֶת־מוֹסְרוֹתֵימוֹ וְנַשְׁלִיכָה מִמֶּנּוּ עֲבֹתֵימוֹ׃
verses.english: Let us break their bonds asunder, and cast away their cords from us.

verses.hebrew: יוֹשֵׁב בַּשָּׁמַיִם יִשְׂחָק אֲדֹנָי יִלְעַג־לָמוֹ׃
verses.english: He who sits in the heavens laughs: the Lord has them in derision.

verses.hebrew: אָז יְדַבֵּר אֵלֵימוֹ בְאַפּוֹ וּבַחֲרוֹנוֹ יְבַהֲלֵמוֹ׃
verses.english: Then shall he speak to them in his wrath, and terrify them in his burning anger.

verses.hebrew: וַאֲנִי נָסַכְתִּי מַלְכִּי עַל־צִיּוֹן הַר־קָדְשִׁי׃
verses.english: But I have set my king upon Żiyyon, my holy hill.

verses.hebrew: אֲסַפְּרָה אֶל חֹק יְהוָה אָמַר אֵלַי בְּנִי אַתָּה אֲנִי הַיּוֹם יְלִדְתִּיךָ׃
verses.english: I will tell of the decree: the Lord has said to me, Thou art my son; this day have I begotten thee.

verses.hebrew: שְׁאַל מִמֶּנִּי וְאֶתְּנָה גוֹיִם נַחֲלָתֶךָ וַאֲחֻזָּתְךָ אַפְסֵי־אָרֶץ׃
verses.english: Ask of me, and I shall give thee nations for thy inheritance, and the uttermost parts of the earth for thy possession.

verses.hebrew: תְּרֹעֵם בְּשֵׁבֶט בַּרְזֶל כִּכְלִי יוֹצֵר תְּנַפְּצֵם׃
verses.english: Thou shalt break them with a rod of iron; thou shalt dash them in pieces like a potter’s vessel.

verses.hebrew: וְעַתָּה מְלָכִים הַשְׂכִּילוּ הִוָּסְרוּ שֹׁפְטֵי אָרֶץ׃
verses.english: Be wise now therefore, O kings: be warned, O judges of the earth.

verses.hebrew: עִבְדוּ אֶת־יְהוָה בְּיִרְאָה וְגִילוּ בִּרְעָדָה׃
verses.english: Serve the Lord with fear, and rejoice with trembling.

verses.hebrew: נַשְּׁקוּ־בַר פֶּן־יֶאֱנַף וְתֹאבְדוּ דֶרֶךְ כִּי־יִבְעַר כִּמְעַט אַפּוֹ אַשְׁרֵי כָּל־חוֹסֵי בוֹ׃
verses.english: Worship in purity, lest he be angry, and you perish from the way, for in a little while his anger will blaze. Blessed are all who put their trust in him.

verses.hebrew: מִזְמוֹר לְדָוִד בְּבָרְחוֹ מִפְּנֵי אַבְשָׁלוֹם בְּנוֹ׃
verses.english: A Psalm of David, when he fled from Avshalom his son.

verses.hebrew: יְהוָה מָה־רַבּוּ צָרָי רַבִּים קָמִים עָלָי׃
verses.english: Lord, how many are my enemies become! many are they who rise up against me:

verses.hebrew: רַבִּים אֹמְרִים לְנַפְשִׁי אֵין יְשׁוּעָתָה לּוֹ בֵאלֹהִים סֶלָה׃
verses.english: many there be who say of my soul, There is no help for him in God. (Sela.)

verses.hebrew: וְאַתָּה יְהוָה מָגֵן בַּעֲדִי כְּבוֹדִי וּמֵרִים רֹאשִׁי׃
verses.english: But Thou, O Lord, art a shield for me; my glory, and the lifter up of my head.

verses.hebrew: קוֹלִי אֶל־יְהוָה אֶקְרָא וַיַּעֲנֵנִי מֵהַר קָדְשׁוֹ סֶלָה׃
verses.english: I cried to the Lord with my voice, and he heard me out of his holy hill. (Sela.)

verses.hebrew: אֲנִי שָׁכַבְתִּי וָאִישָׁנָה הֱקִיצוֹתִי כִּי יְהוָה יִסְמְכֵנִי׃
verses.english: I lie me down and sleep; I awake; for the Lord sustains me.

verses.hebrew: לֹא־אִירָא מֵרִבְבוֹת עָם אֲשֶׁר סָבִיב שָׁתוּ עָלָי׃
verses.english: I will not be afraid of ten thousands of people, that have set themselves against me round about.

verses.hebrew: קוּמָה יְהוָה הוֹשִׁיעֵנִי אֱלֹהַי כִּי־הִכִּיתָ אֶת־כָּל־אֹיְבַי לֶחִי שִׁנֵּי רְשָׁעִים שִׁבַּרְתָּ׃
verses.english: Arise, O Lord; save me, O my God: for Thou hast smitten all my enemies upon the cheek; Thou hast broken the teeth of the wicked.

verses.hebrew: לַיהוָה הַיְשׁוּעָה עַל־עַמְּךָ בִרְכָתֶךָ סֶּלָה׃
verses.english: Salvation belongs to the Lord: Thy blessing be upon Thy people. (Sela.)

verses.hebrew: לַמְנַצֵּחַ בִּנְגִינוֹת מִזְמוֹר לְדָוִד׃
verses.english: For the chief Musician on strings, A Psalm of David.

verses.hebrew: בְּקָרְאִי עֲנֵנִי אֱלֹהֵי צִדְקִי בַּצָּר הִרְחַבְתָּ לִּי חָנֵּנִי וּשְׁמַע תְּפִלָּתִי׃
verses.english: Hear me when I call, O God of my righteousness: Thou hast enlarged me when I was in distress; have mercy upon me, and hear my prayer.

verses.hebrew: בְּנֵי אִישׁ עַד־מֶה כְבוֹדִי לִכְלִמָּה תֶּאֱהָבוּן רִיק תְּבַקְשׁוּ כָזָב סֶלָה׃
verses.english: O sons of men, how long will you turn my glory into shame? you love vanity, and seek after falsehood. (Sela.)

verses.hebrew: וּדְעוּ כִּי־הִפְלָה יְהוָה חָסִיד לוֹ יְהוָה יִשְׁמַע בְּקָרְאִי אֵלָיו׃
verses.english: But know that the Lord has set apart the godly man as his own: the Lord will hear when I call to him.

verses.hebrew: רִגְזוּ וְאַל־תֶּחֱטָאוּ אִמְרוּ בִלְבַבְכֶם עַל־מִשְׁכַּבְכֶם וְדֹמּוּ סֶלָה׃
verses.english: Tremble, and sin not: commune with your own heart upon your bed, and be still. (Sela.)

verses.hebrew: זִבְחוּ זִבְחֵי־צֶדֶק וּבִטְחוּ אֶל־יְהוָה׃
verses.english: Offer the sacrifices of righteousness, and put your trust in the Lord.

verses.hebrew: רַבִּים אֹמְרִים מִי־יַרְאֵנוּ טוֹב נְסָה־עָלֵינוּ אוֹר פָּנֶיךָ יְהוָה׃
verses.english: There are many who say, Who will show us good? Lord, lift Thou up the light of Thy countenance upon us.

verses.hebrew: נָתַתָּה שִׂמְחָה בְלִבִּי מֵעֵת דְּגָנָם וְתִירוֹשָׁם רָבּוּ׃
verses.english: Thou hast put more gladness in my heart than they have whose corn and wine are increased.

verses.hebrew: בְּשָׁלוֹם יַחְדָּו אֶשְׁכְּבָה וְאִישָׁן כִּי־אַתָּה יְהוָה לְבָדָד לָבֶטַח תּוֹשִׁיבֵנִי׃
verses.english: I will both lie down and sleep, in peace: for Thou, Lord, alone, makest me to dwell in safety.

verses.hebrew: לַמְנַצֵּחַ אֶל־הַנְּחִילוֹת מִזְמוֹר לְדָוִד׃
verses.english: To the chief Musician for flutes, A Psalm of David.

verses.hebrew: אֲמָרַי הַאֲזִינָה יְהוָה בִּינָה הֲגִיגִי׃
verses.english: Give ear to my words, O Lord, consider my meditation.

verses.hebrew: הַקְשִׁיבָה לְקוֹל שַׁוְעִי מַלְכִּי וֵאלֹהָי כִּי־אֵלֶיךָ אֶתְפַּלָּל׃
verses.english: Hearken to the voice of my cry, my King, and my God: for to Thee I will pray.

verses.hebrew: יְהוָה בֹּקֶר תִּשְׁמַע קוֹלִי בֹּקֶר אֶעֱרָךְ־לְךָ וַאֲצַפֶּה׃
verses.english: My voice shalt Thou hear in the morning, O Lord; in the morning I will direct my prayer to Thee; and will wait expectantly.

verses.hebrew: כִּי לֹא אֵל־חָפֵץ רֶשַׁע אָתָּה לֹא יְגֻרְךָ רָע׃
verses.english: For Thou art not a God That hast pleasure in wickedness: nor shall evil dwell with Thee.

verses.hebrew: לֹא־יִתְיַצְּבוּ הוֹלְלִים לְנֶגֶד עֵינֶיךָ שָׂנֵאתָ כָּל־פֹּעֲלֵי אָוֶן׃
verses.english: The boastful shall not stand in Thy sight: Thou hatest all workers of iniquity.

verses.hebrew: תְּאַבֵּד דֹּבְרֵי כָזָב אִישׁ־דָּמִים וּמִרְמָה יְתָעֵב יְהוָה׃
verses.english: Thou dost destroy them that speak falsehood: the Lord abhors the bloody and deceitful man.

verses.hebrew: וַאֲנִי בְּרֹב חַסְדְּךָ אָבוֹא בֵיתֶךָ אֶשְׁתַּחֲוֶה אֶל־הֵיכַל־קָדְשְׁךָ בְּיִרְאָתֶךָ׃
verses.english: But as for me, I will come into Thy house in the multitude of Thy love: and in the fear of Thee I will worship towards Thy holy temple.

verses.hebrew: יְהוָה נְחֵנִי בְצִדְקָתֶךָ לְמַעַן שׁוֹרְרָי הושר [הַיְשַׁר] לְפָנַי דַּרְכֶּךָ׃
verses.english: Lead me, O Lord, in Thy righteousness because of my enemies; make Thy way straight before my face.

verses.hebrew: כִּי אֵין בְּפִיהוּ נְכוֹנָה קִרְבָּם הַוּוֹת קֶבֶר־פָּתוּחַ גְּרוֹנָם לְשׁוֹנָם יַחֲלִיקוּן׃
verses.english: For there is no sincerity in their mouth; in their heart is malice; their throat is an open sepulchre; they flatter with their tongue.

verses.hebrew: הַאֲשִׁימֵם אֱ‍לֹהִים יִפְּלוּ מִמֹּעֲצוֹתֵיהֶם בְּרֹב פִּשְׁעֵיהֶם הַדִּיחֵמוֹ כִּי־מָרוּ בָךְ׃
verses.english: Condemn them, O God; let them fall by their own counsels; cast them out for the multitude of their transgressions; for they have rebelled against Thee.

verses.hebrew: וְיִשְׂמְחוּ כָל־חוֹסֵי בָךְ לְעוֹלָם יְרַנֵּנוּ וְתָסֵךְ עָלֵימוֹ וְיַעְלְצוּ בְךָ אֹהֲבֵי שְׁמֶךָ׃
verses.english: But let all those that put their trust in Thee rejoice: let them ever shout for joy, because Thou dost defend them: and let those who love Thy name be joyful in Thee.

verses.hebrew: כִּי־אַתָּה תְּבָרֵךְ צַדִּיק יְהוָה כַּצִּנָּה רָצוֹן תַּעְטְרֶנּוּ׃
verses.english: For Thou, Lord, dost bless the righteous; Thou dost encircle him with favour as with a shield.

verses.hebrew: לַמְנַצֵּחַ בִּנְגִינוֹת עַל־הַשְּׁמִינִית מִזְמוֹר לְדָוִד׃
verses.english: To the chief Musician on strings upon the Sheminit, A Psalm of David.

verses.hebrew: יְהוָה אַל־בְּאַפְּךָ תוֹכִיחֵנִי וְאַל־בַּחֲמָתְךָ תְיַסְּרֵנִי׃
verses.english: O Lord, rebuke me not in Thy anger, nor chasten me in Thy hot displeasure.

verses.hebrew: חָנֵּנִי יְהוָה כִּי אֻמְלַל אָנִי רְפָאֵנִי יְהוָה כִּי נִבְהֲלוּ עֲצָמָי׃
verses.english: Have mercy upon me, O Lord; for I am weak: O Lord, heal me; for my bones shudder;

verses.hebrew: וְנַפְשִׁי נִבְהֲלָה מְאֹד ואת [וְאַתָּה] יְהוָה עַד־מָתָי׃
verses.english: and my soul is much affrighted. And Thou, O Lord, how long?

verses.hebrew: שׁוּבָה יְהוָה חַלְּצָה נַפְשִׁי הוֹשִׁיעֵנִי לְמַעַן חַסְדֶּךָ׃
verses.english: Return, O Lord, deliver my soul: oh save me on account of Thy steadfast love.

verses.hebrew: כִּי אֵין בַּמָּוֶת זִכְרֶךָ בִּשְׁאוֹל מִי יוֹדֶה־לָּךְ׃
verses.english: For in death there is no remembrance of Thee: in She᾽ol who shall give Thee thanks?

verses.hebrew: יָגַעְתִּי בְּאַנְחָתִי אַשְׂחֶה בְכָל־לַיְלָה מִטָּתִי בְּדִמְעָתִי עַרְשִׂי אַמְסֶה׃
verses.english: I am weary with my groaning: all the night I make my bed to swim; I water my couch with my tears.

verses.hebrew: עָשְׁשָׁה מִכַּעַס עֵינִי עָתְקָה בְּכָל־צוֹרְרָי׃
verses.english: My eye is wasted because of grief; it grows weak because of all my enemies.

verses.hebrew: סוּרוּ מִמֶּנִּי כָּל־פֹּעֲלֵי אָוֶן כִּי־שָׁמַע יְהוָה קוֹל בִּכְיִי׃
verses.english: Depart from me, all you workers of iniquity; for the Lord has heard the voice of my weeping.

verses.hebrew: שָׁמַע יְהוָה תְּחִנָּתִי יְהוָה תְּפִלָּתִי יִקָּח׃
verses.english: The Lord has heard my supplication; the Lord receives my prayer.

verses.hebrew: יֵבֹשׁוּ וְיִבָּהֲלוּ מְאֹד כָּל־אֹיְבָי יָשֻׁבוּ יֵבֹשׁוּ רָגַע׃
verses.english: All my enemies will be ashamed and much affrighted: they will turn back and be confounded in a moment.

verses.hebrew: שִׁגָּיוֹן לְדָוִד אֲשֶׁר־שָׁר לַיהוָה עַל־דִּבְרֵי־כוּשׁ בֶּן־יְמִינִי׃
verses.english: A Shiggayon of David, which he sang to the Lord, concerning the words of Kush the Benyeminite.

verses.hebrew: יְהוָה אֱלֹהַי בְּךָ חָסִיתִי הוֹשִׁיעֵנִי מִכָּל־רֹדְפַי וְהַצִּילֵנִי׃
verses.english: O Lord my God, in Thee do I put my trust: save me from all them that persecute me, and deliver me:

verses.hebrew: פֶּן־יִטְרֹף כְּאַרְיֵה נַפְשִׁי פֹּרֵק וְאֵין מַצִּיל׃
verses.english: lest he tear my soul like a lion, rending it in pieces, while there is none to deliver.

verses.hebrew: יְהוָה אֱלֹהַי אִם־עָשִׂיתִי זֹאת אִם־יֶשׁ־עָוֶל בְּכַפָּי׃
verses.english: O Lord my God, if I have done this; if there be iniquity in my hands;

verses.hebrew: אִם־גָּמַלְתִּי שׁוֹלְמִי רָע וָאֲחַלְּצָה צוֹרְרִי רֵיקָם׃
verses.english: if I have rewarded evil to him that was at peace with me; (indeed, I have rescued him that without cause is my enemy:)

verses.hebrew: יִרַדֹּף אוֹיֵב נַפְשִׁי וְיַשֵּׂג וְיִרְמֹס לָאָרֶץ חַיָּי וּכְבוֹדִי לֶעָפָר יַשְׁכֵּן סֶלָה׃
verses.english: let the enemy persecute my soul, and take it; and let him tread down my life to the earth, and lay my honour in the dust. (Sela.)

verses.hebrew: קוּמָה יְהוָה בְּאַפֶּךָ הִנָּשֵׂא בְּעַבְרוֹת צוֹרְרָי וְעוּרָה אֵלַי מִשְׁפָּט צִוִּיתָ׃
verses.english: Arise, O Lord, in Thy anger, lift up Thyself against the fury of my enemies: and awake for me: Thou hast commanded judgment.

verses.hebrew: וַעֲדַת לְאֻמִּים תְּסוֹבְבֶךָּ וְעָלֶיהָ לַמָּרוֹם שׁוּבָה׃
verses.english: Let the congregation of the peoples compass Thee about: and for their sakes return Thou on high.

verses.hebrew: יְהוָה יָדִין עַמִּים שָׁפְטֵנִי יְהוָה כְּצִדְקִי וּכְתֻמִּי עָלָי׃
verses.english: The Lord shall judge the peoples. Judge me, O Lord, according to my righteousness, and according to my integrity that is in me.

verses.hebrew: יִגְמָר־נָא רַע רְשָׁעִים וּתְכוֹנֵן צַדִּיק וּבֹחֵן לִבּוֹת וּכְלָיוֹת אֱלֹהִים צַדִּיק׃
verses.english: O let the wickedness of the wicked come to an end; but establish the just: for the righteous God tries the hearts and reins.

verses.hebrew: מָגִנִּי עַל־אֱלֹהִים מוֹשִׁיעַ יִשְׁרֵי־לֵב׃
verses.english: My defence is of God, who saves the upright in heart.

verses.hebrew: אֱלֹהִים שׁוֹפֵט צַדִּיק וְאֵל זֹעֵם בְּכָל־יוֹם׃
verses.english: God is a righteous judge; and a God who has indignation every day.

verses.hebrew: אִם־לֹא יָשׁוּב חַרְבּוֹ יִלְטוֹשׁ קַשְׁתּוֹ דָרַךְ וַיְכוֹנְנֶהָ׃
verses.english: If a man does not turn, then he will whet his sword; he has bent his bow, and made it ready.

verses.hebrew: וְלוֹ הֵכִין כְּלֵי־מָוֶת חִצָּיו לְדֹלְקִים יִפְעָל׃
verses.english: He has also prepared for him the instruments of death; he makes arrows for the pursuers.

verses.hebrew: הִנֵּה יְחַבֶּל־אָוֶן וְהָרָה עָמָל וְיָלַד שָׁקֶר׃
verses.english: Behold, he travails with iniquity, and has conceived mischief, and brings forth falsehood.

verses.hebrew: בּוֹר כָּרָה וַיַּחְפְּרֵהוּ וַיִּפֹּל בְּשַׁחַת יִפְעָל׃
verses.english: He has made a pit, and has dug it out, and has fallen into the ditch which he made.

verses.hebrew: יָשׁוּב עֲמָלוֹ בְרֹאשׁוֹ וְעַל קָדְקֳדוֹ חֲמָסוֹ יֵרֵד׃
verses.english: His mischief shall return upon his own head, and his violent dealing shall come down upon his own pate.

verses.hebrew: אוֹדֶה יְהוָה כְּצִדְקוֹ וַאֲזַמְּרָה שֵׁם־יְהוָה עֶלְיוֹן׃
verses.english: I will praise the Lord according to his righteousness: and will sing praise to the name of the Lord most high.

verses.hebrew: לַמְנַצֵּחַ עַל־הַגִּתִּית מִזְמוֹר לְדָוִד׃
verses.english: To the chief Musician upon the Gittit, A Psalm of David.

verses.hebrew: יְהוָה אֲדֹנֵינוּ מָה־אַדִּיר שִׁמְךָ בְּכָל־הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר תְּנָה הוֹדְךָ עַל־הַשָּׁמָיִם׃
verses.english: O Lord our Lord, how majestic is Thy name in all the earth; who hast set Thy glory above the heavens.

verses.hebrew: מִפִּי עוֹלְלִים וְיֹנְקִים יִסַּדְתָּ עֹז לְמַעַן צוֹרְרֶיךָ לְהַשְׁבִּית אוֹיֵב וּמִתְנַקֵּם׃
verses.english: Out of the mouth of babes and sucklings hast Thou founded strength because of Thy enemies, that Thou mightest still the enemy and the avenger.

verses.hebrew: כִּי־אֶרְאֶה שָׁמֶיךָ מַעֲשֵׂי אֶצְבְּעֹתֶיךָ יָרֵחַ וְכוֹכָבִים אֲשֶׁר כּוֹנָנְתָּה׃
verses.english: When I behold Thy heavens, the work of Thy fingers, the moon and the stars, which Thou hast ordained;

verses.hebrew: מָה־אֱנוֹשׁ כִּי־תִזְכְּרֶנּוּ וּבֶן־אָדָם כִּי תִפְקְדֶנּוּ׃
verses.english: what is man, that Thou art mindful of him? and the son of man, that Thou visitest him?

verses.hebrew: וַתְּחַסְּרֵהוּ מְּעַט מֵאֱלֹהִים וְכָבוֹד וְהָדָר תְּעַטְּרֵהוּ׃
verses.english: Yet Thou hast made him a little lower than the angels, and Thou dost crown him with glory and honour.

verses.hebrew: תַּמְשִׁילֵהוּ בְּמַעֲשֵׂי יָדֶיךָ כֹּל שַׁתָּה תַחַת־רַגְלָיו׃
verses.english: Thou makest him to have dominion over the works of Thy hands; Thou hast put all things under his feet:

verses.hebrew: צֹנֶה וַאֲלָפִים כֻּלָּם וְגַם בַּהֲמוֹת שָׂדָי׃
verses.english: all sheep, and oxen, and also the beasts of the field;

verses.hebrew: צִפּוֹר שָׁמַיִם וּדְגֵי הַיָּם עֹבֵר אָרְחוֹת יַמִּים׃
verses.english: the birds of the sky, and the fish of the sea; whatever passes through the paths of the seas.

verses.hebrew: יְהוָה אֲדֹנֵינוּ מָה־אַדִּיר שִׁמְךָ בְּכָל־הָאָרֶץ׃
verses.english: O Lord our Lord, how majestic is Thy name in all the earth!

verses.hebrew: לַמְנַצֵּחַ עַלְמוּת לַבֵּן מִזְמוֹר לְדָוִד׃
verses.english: To the chief Musician on the death of Labben, A Psalm of David.

verses.hebrew: אוֹדֶה יְהוָה בְּכָל־לִבִּי אֲסַפְּרָה כָּל־נִפְלְאוֹתֶיךָ׃
verses.english: I will praise Thee, O Lord, with my whole heart; I will relate all Thy marvellous works.

verses.hebrew: אֶשְׂמְחָה וְאֶעֶלְצָה בָךְ אֲזַמְּרָה שִׁמְךָ עֶלְיוֹן׃
verses.english: I will be glad and rejoice in Thee: I will sing praise to Thy name, O Thou most High:

verses.hebrew: בְּשׁוּב־אוֹיְבַי אָחוֹר יִכָּשְׁלוּ וְיֹאבְדוּ מִפָּנֶיךָ׃
verses.english: when my enemies are turned back, when they stumble and perish at Thy presence.

verses.hebrew: כִּי־עָשִׂיתָ מִשְׁפָּטִי וְדִינִי יָשַׁבְתָּ לְכִסֵּא שׁוֹפֵט צֶדֶק׃
verses.english: For Thou hast maintained my right and my cause; Thou didst sit on the throne giving righteous judgment.

verses.hebrew: גָּעַרְתָּ גוֹיִם אִבַּדְתָּ רָשָׁע שְׁמָם מָחִיתָ לְעוֹלָם וָעֶד׃
verses.english: Thou hast rebuked the nations, Thou hast destroyed the wicked, Thou hast blotted out their name for ever and ever.

verses.hebrew: הָאוֹיֵב תַּמּוּ חֳרָבוֹת לָנֶצַח וְעָרִים נָתַשְׁתָּ אָבַד זִכְרָם הֵמָּה׃
verses.english: The enemies are come to an end, in perpetual ruins: for Thou hast destroyed the cities; their memorial is perished.

verses.hebrew: וַיהוָה לְעוֹלָם יֵשֵׁב כּוֹנֵן לַמִּשְׁפָּט כִּסְאוֹ׃
verses.english: But the Lord shall endure forever: he has prepared his throne for judgment.

verses.hebrew: וְהוּא יִשְׁפֹּט־תֵּבֵל בְּצֶדֶק יָדִין לְאֻמִּים בְּמֵישָׁרִים׃
verses.english: And he will judge the world in righteousness, he will minister judgment to the people in uprightness.

verses.hebrew: וִיהִי יְהוָה מִשְׂגָּב לַדָּךְ מִשְׂגָּב לְעִתּוֹת בַּצָּרָה׃
verses.english: The Lord also will be a stronghold for the oppressed, a refuge in times of trouble.

verses.hebrew: וְיִבְטְחוּ בְךָ יוֹדְעֵי שְׁמֶךָ כִּי לֹא־עָזַבְתָּ דֹרְשֶׁיךָ יְהוָה׃
verses.english: And they that know Thy name will put their trust in Thee: for Thou, Lord, hast not forsaken those who seek Thee.

verses.hebrew: זַמְּרוּ לַיהוָה יֹשֵׁב צִיּוֹן הַגִּידוּ בָעַמִּים עֲלִילוֹתָיו׃
verses.english: Sing praises to the Lord, who dwells in Żiyyon: declare among the peoples his doings.

verses.hebrew: כִּי־דֹרֵשׁ דָּמִים אוֹתָם זָכָר לֹא־שָׁכַח צַעֲקַת עניים [עֲנָוִים׃]
verses.english: For he avenges blood, he remembers it: he does not forget the cry of the humble.

verses.hebrew: חָנְנֵנִי יְהוָה רְאֵה עָנְיִי מִשֹּׂנְאָי מְרוֹמְמִי מִשַּׁעֲרֵי מָוֶת׃
verses.english: Be gracious to me, O Lord; consider my trouble which I suffer from those who hate me, Thou that liftest me up from the gates of death:

verses.hebrew: לְמַעַן אֲסַפְּרָה כָּל־תְּהִלָּתֶיךָ בְּשַׁעֲרֵי בַת־צִיּוֹן אָגִילָה בִּישׁוּעָתֶךָ׃
verses.english: that I may relate all Thy praise in the gates of the daughter of Żiyyon. I will rejoice in Thy salvation.

verses.hebrew: טָבְעוּ גוֹיִם בְּשַׁחַת עָשׂוּ בְּרֶשֶׁת־זוּ טָמָנוּ נִלְכְּדָה רַגְלָם׃
verses.english: The nations are sunk down in the pit that they have made: in the net which they hid is their own foot taken.

verses.hebrew: נוֹדַע יְהוָה מִשְׁפָּט עָשָׂה בְּפֹעַל כַּפָּיו נוֹקֵשׁ רָשָׁע הִגָּיוֹן סֶלָה׃
verses.english: The Lord is known by the judgment which he executes: the wicked is snared in the work of his own hands. (A Higgayon. Sela.)

verses.hebrew: יָשׁוּבוּ רְשָׁעִים לִשְׁאוֹלָה כָּל־גּוֹיִם שְׁכֵחֵי אֱלֹהִים׃
verses.english: The wicked shall be turned back to She᾽ol, all the nations that forget God.

verses.hebrew: כִּי לֹא לָנֶצַח יִשָּׁכַח אֶבְיוֹן תִּקְוַת ענוים [עֲנִיִּים] תֹּאבַד לָעַד׃
verses.english: For the needy shall not always be forgotten: the expectation of the poor shall not perish forever.

verses.hebrew: קוּמָה יְהוָה אַל־יָעֹז אֱנוֹשׁ יִשָּׁפְטוּ גוֹיִם עַל־פָּנֶיךָ׃
verses.english: Arise, O Lord; let man not prevail: let the nations be judged in Thy sight.

verses.hebrew: שִׁיתָה יְהוָה מוֹרָה לָהֶם יֵדְעוּ גוֹיִם אֱנוֹשׁ הֵמָּה סֶּלָה׃
verses.english: Put them in fear, O Lord: the nations will then know themselves to be but men. (Sela.)

verses.hebrew: לָמָה יְהוָה תַּעֲמֹד בְּרָחוֹק תַּעְלִים לְעִתּוֹת בַּצָּרָה׃
verses.english: Why standest Thou afar off, O Lord? why hidest Thou Thyself in times of trouble?

verses.hebrew: בְּגַאֲוַת רָשָׁע יִדְלַק עָנִי יִתָּפְשׂוּ בִּמְזִמּוֹת זוּ חָשָׁבוּ׃
verses.english: The wicked in his pride hotly pursues the poor: let them be taken in the devices that they have imagined.

verses.hebrew: כִּי־הִלֵּל רָשָׁע עַל־תַּאֲוַת נַפְשׁוֹ וּבֹצֵעַ בֵּרֵךְ נִאֵץ יְהוָה׃
verses.english: For the wicked boasts of his heart’s desire, and the greedy wretch curses and renounces the Lord.

verses.hebrew: רָשָׁע כְּגֹבַהּ אַפּוֹ בַּל־יִדְרֹשׁ אֵין אֱלֹהִים כָּל־מְזִמּוֹתָיו׃
verses.english: The wicked, through the pride of his countenance thinks, He will not seek out: all his thoughts are, God is not.

verses.hebrew: יָחִילוּ דרכו [דְרָכָיו ] בְּכָל־עֵת מָרוֹם מִשְׁפָּטֶיךָ מִנֶּגְדּוֹ כָּל־צוֹרְרָיו יָפִיחַ בָּהֶם׃
verses.english: His ways are always strong; thy judgments are far above out of his sight: as for all his enemies, he hisses at them.

verses.hebrew: אָמַר בְּלִבּוֹ בַּל־אֶמּוֹט לְדֹר וָדֹר אֲשֶׁר לֹא־בְרָע׃
verses.english: He says in his heart, I shall not be moved: for I shall never be in adversity.

verses.hebrew: אָלָה פִּיהוּ מָלֵא וּמִרְמוֹת וָתֹךְ תַּחַת לְשׁוֹנוֹ עָמָל וָאָוֶן׃
verses.english: His mouth is full of cursing and deceit and fraud: under his tongue is mischief and iniquity.

verses.hebrew: יֵשֵׁב בְּמַאְרַב חֲצֵרִים בַּמִּסְתָּרִים יַהֲרֹג נָקִי עֵינָיו לְחֵלְכָה יִצְפֹּנוּ׃
verses.english: He sits in the lurking places of the villages: in the secret places he murders the innocent: his eyes stealthily watch for the helpless.

verses.hebrew: יֶאֱרֹב בַּמִּסְתָּר כְּאַרְיֵה בְסֻכֹּה יֶאֱרֹב לַחֲטוֹף עָנִי יַחְטֹף עָנִי בְּמָשְׁכוֹ בְרִשְׁתּוֹ׃
verses.english: He lies in wait secretly like a lion in his den: he lies in wait to catch the poor: he catches the poor, when he draws him into his net.

verses.hebrew: ודכה [יִדְכֶּה] יָשֹׁחַ וְנָפַל בַּעֲצוּמָיו חלכאים [חֵיל] [כָּאִים׃]
verses.english: The helpless collapse: they bow down, and fall into his power.

verses.hebrew: אָמַר בְּלִבּוֹ שָׁכַח אֵל הִסְתִּיר פָּנָיו בַּל־רָאָה לָנֶצַח׃
verses.english: He says in his heart, God has forgotten: he hides his face; he will never see it.

verses.hebrew: קוּמָה יְהוָה אֵל נְשָׂא יָדֶךָ אַל־תִּשְׁכַּח עניים [עֲנָוִים׃]
verses.english: Arise, O Lord; O God, lift up Thy hand: forget not the humble.

verses.hebrew: עַל־מֶה נִאֵץ רָשָׁע אֱלֹהִים אָמַר בְּלִבּוֹ לֹא תִּדְרֹשׁ׃
verses.english: Why does the wicked man renounce God? he says in his heart, Thou wilt not avenge.

verses.hebrew: רָאִתָה כִּי־אַתָּה עָמָל וָכַעַס תַּבִּיט לָתֵת בְּיָדֶךָ עָלֶיךָ יַעֲזֹב חֵלֶכָה יָתוֹם אַתָּה הָיִיתָ עוֹזֵר׃
verses.english: Thou hast seen it; for Thou beholdest mischief and spite, to requite it with Thy hand: the helpless man commits himself to Thee; Thou art the helper of the fatherless.

verses.hebrew: שְׁבֹר זְרוֹעַ רָשָׁע וָרָע תִּדְרוֹשׁ־רִשְׁעוֹ בַל־תִּמְצָא׃
verses.english: Break Thou the arm of the wicked and the evil man: seek out his wickedness till Thou find none left.

verses.hebrew: יְהוָה מֶלֶךְ עוֹלָם וָעֶד אָבְדוּ גוֹיִם מֵאַרְצוֹ׃
verses.english: The Lord is King for ever and ever: the nations are perished out of his land.

verses.hebrew: תַּאֲוַת עֲנָוִים שָׁמַעְתָּ יְהוָה תָּכִין לִבָּם תַּקְשִׁיב אָזְנֶךָ׃
verses.english: Lord, Thou hast heard the desire of the humble: Thou wilt strengthen their heart, Thou wilt cause Thy ear to hear:

verses.hebrew: לִשְׁפֹּט יָתוֹם וָדָךְ בַּל־יוֹסִיף עוֹד לַעֲרֹץ אֱנוֹשׁ מִן־הָאָרֶץ׃
verses.english: to judge the fatherless and the oppressed, so that none shall any longer terrify innocent men from the earth.

verses.hebrew: לַמְנַצֵּחַ לְדָוִד בַּיהוָה חָסִיתִי אֵיךְ תֹּאמְרוּ לְנַפְשִׁי נודו [נוּדִי] הַרְכֶם צִפּוֹר׃
verses.english: To the chief Musician, of David. In the Lord I put my trust: how can you say to my soul, Flee like a bird to your mountain?

verses.hebrew: כִּי הִנֵּה הָרְשָׁעִים יִדְרְכוּן קֶשֶׁת כּוֹנְנוּ חִצָּם עַל־יֶתֶר לִירוֹת בְּמוֹ־אֹפֶל לְיִשְׁרֵי־לֵב׃
verses.english: For, lo, the wicked bend the bow, they make ready their arrow upon the string, that they may shoot in darkness at the upright in heart.

verses.hebrew: כִּי הַשָּׁתוֹת יֵהָרֵסוּן צַדִּיק מַה־פָּעָל׃
verses.english: For when the foundations are destroyed, what can the righteous do?

verses.hebrew: יְהוָה בְּהֵיכַל קָדְשׁוֹ יְהוָה בַּשָּׁמַיִם כִּסְאוֹ עֵינָיו יֶחֱזוּ עַפְעַפָּיו יִבְחֲנוּ בְּנֵי אָדָם׃
verses.english: The Lord in his holy temple, the Lord whose throne is in heaven, whose eyes behold, whose eyelids try, the children of men:

verses.hebrew: יְהוָה צַדִּיק יִבְחָן וְרָשָׁע וְאֹהֵב חָמָס שָׂנְאָה נַפְשׁוֹ׃
verses.english: the Lord tries the righteous: but the wicked and him who loves violence his soul hates.

verses.hebrew: יַמְטֵר עַל־רְשָׁעִים פַּחִים אֵשׁ וְגָפְרִית וְרוּחַ זִלְעָפוֹת מְנָת כּוֹסָם׃
verses.english: Upon the wicked he shall rain coals, fire and brimstone, and a scorching wind shall be the portion of their cup.

verses.hebrew: כִּי־צַדִּיק יְהוָה צְדָקוֹת אָהֵב יָשָׁר יֶחֱזוּ פָנֵימוֹ׃
verses.english: For the Lord is righteous, he loves righteousness; the upright shall behold his face.

verses.hebrew: לַמְנַצֵּחַ עַל־הַשְּׁמִינִית מִזְמוֹר לְדָוִד׃
verses.english: To the chief Musician upon the Sheminit, A Psalm of David.

verses.hebrew: הוֹשִׁיעָה יְהוָה כִּי־גָמַר חָסִיד כִּי־פַסּוּ אֱמוּנִים מִבְּנֵי אָדָם׃
verses.english: Help, Lord; for the godly man ceases; for the faithful fail from among the children of men.

verses.hebrew: שָׁוְא יְדַבְּרוּ אִישׁ אֶת־רֵעֵהוּ שְׂפַת חֲלָקוֹת בְּלֵב וָלֵב יְדַבֵּרוּ׃
verses.english: They speak vanity every one with his fellow: with flattering lips and with a double heart they speak.

verses.hebrew: יַכְרֵת יְהוָה כָּל־שִׂפְתֵי חֲלָקוֹת לָשׁוֹן מְדַבֶּרֶת גְּדֹלוֹת׃
verses.english: May the Lord cut off all flattering lips, the tongue that speaks proud things:

verses.hebrew: אֲשֶׁר אָמְרוּ לִלְשֹׁנֵנוּ נַגְבִּיר שְׂפָתֵינוּ אִתָּנוּ מִי אָדוֹן לָנוּ׃
verses.english: who have said, With our tongue we will prevail; our lips are our own: who is lord over us?

verses.hebrew: מִשֹּׁד עֲנִיִּים מֵאַנְקַת אֶבְיוֹנִים עַתָּה אָקוּם יֹאמַר יְהוָה אָשִׁית בְּיֵשַׁע יָפִיחַ לוֹ׃
verses.english: For the violence done to the poor, for the sighing of the needy, now will I arise, says the Lord; I will set him in safety at whom they hiss.

verses.hebrew: אִמֲרוֹת יְהוָה אֲמָרוֹת טְהֹרוֹת כֶּסֶף צָרוּף בַּעֲלִיל לָאָרֶץ מְזֻקָּק שִׁבְעָתָיִם׃
verses.english: The words of the Lord are pure words: silver refined in a furnace upon the ground, purified seven times.

verses.hebrew: אַתָּה־יְהוָה תִּשְׁמְרֵם תִּצְּרֶנּוּ מִן־הַדּוֹר זוּ לְעוֹלָם׃
verses.english: Thou shalt keep them, O Lord, Thou shalt preserve them from this generation forever.

verses.hebrew: סָבִיב רְשָׁעִים יִתְהַלָּכוּן כְּרֻם זֻלּוּת לִבְנֵי אָדָם׃
verses.english: The wicked walk on every side, when vileness is exalted among the children of men.

verses.hebrew: לַמְנַצֵּחַ מִזְמוֹר לְדָוִד׃
verses.english: To the chief Musician, A Psalm of David.

verses.hebrew: עַד־אָנָה יְהוָה תִּשְׁכָּחֵנִי נֶצַח עַד־אָנָה תַּסְתִּיר אֶת־פָּנֶיךָ מִמֶּנִּי׃
verses.english: How long wilt Thou forget me O Lord? forever? how long wilt Thou hide Thy face from me?

verses.hebrew: עַד־אָנָה אָשִׁית עֵצוֹת בְּנַפְשִׁי יָגוֹן בִּלְבָבִי יוֹמָם עַד־אָנָה יָרוּם אֹיְבִי עָלָי׃
verses.english: How long shall I take counsel in my soul, having sorrow in my heart daily? how long shall my enemy be exalted over me?

verses.hebrew: הַבִּיטָה עֲנֵנִי יְהוָה אֱלֹהָי הָאִירָה עֵינַי פֶּן־אִישַׁן הַמָּוֶת׃
verses.english: Look, and hear me, O Lord my God: lighten my eyes, lest I sleep the sleep of death;

verses.hebrew: פֶּן־יֹאמַר אֹיְבִי יְכָלְתִּיו צָרַי יָגִילוּ כִּי אֶמּוֹט׃
verses.english: lest my enemy say, I have prevailed against him; and those who trouble me rejoice when I am moved.

verses.hebrew: וַאֲנִי בְּחַסְדְּךָ בָטַחְתִּי יָגֵל לִבִּי בִּישׁוּעָתֶךָ אָשִׁירָה לַיהוָה כִּי גָמַל עָלָי׃
verses.english: But I have trusted in Thy mercy; my heart shall rejoice in Thy salvation. I will sing to the Lord, because he has dealt bountifully with me.

verses.hebrew: לַמְנַצֵּחַ לְדָוִד אָמַר נָבָל בְּלִבּוֹ אֵין אֱלֹהִים הִשְׁחִיתוּ הִתְעִיבוּ עֲלִילָה אֵין עֹשֵׂה־טוֹב׃
verses.english: To the chief Musician, of David. The fool has said in his heart, There is no God. They are corrupt, they have done abominable works, there is none that does good.

verses.hebrew: יְהוָה מִשָּׁמַיִם הִשְׁקִיף עַל־בְּנֵי־אָדָם לִרְאוֹת הֲיֵשׁ מַשְׂכִּיל דֹּרֵשׁ אֶת־אֱלֹהִים׃
verses.english: The Lord looked down from heaven upon the children of men, to see if there were any that understood, and sought God.

verses.hebrew: הַכֹּל סָר יַחְדָּו נֶאֱלָחוּ אֵין עֹשֵׂה־טוֹב אֵין גַּם־אֶחָד׃
verses.english: They are all gone aside, they are all together become filthy: there is none that does good, no, not one.

verses.hebrew: הֲלֹא יָדְעוּ כָּל־פֹּעֲלֵי אָוֶן אֹכְלֵי עַמִּי אָכְלוּ לֶחֶם יְהוָה לֹא קָרָאוּ׃
verses.english: Have all the workers of iniquity no knowledge? who eat up my people as they eat bread, and call not upon the Lord.

verses.hebrew: שָׁם פָּחֲדוּ פָחַד כִּי־אֱלֹהִים בְּדוֹר צַדִּיק׃
verses.english: There were they in great fear: for God is in the generation of the righteous.

verses.hebrew: עֲצַת־עָנִי תָבִישׁוּ כִּי יְהוָה מַחְסֵהוּ׃
verses.english: You shame the counsel of the poor, because the Lord is his refuge.

verses.hebrew: מִי יִתֵּן מִצִּיּוֹן יְשׁוּעַת יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּשׁוּב יְהוָה שְׁבוּת עַמּוֹ יָגֵל יַעֲקֹב יִשְׂמַח יִשְׂרָאֵל׃
verses.english: Oh that the salvation of Yisra᾽el were come out of Żiyyon! when the Lord brings back the captivity of his people, Ya῾aqov shall rejoice, and Yisra᾽el shall be glad.

verses.hebrew: מִזְמוֹר לְדָוִד יְהֹוָה מִי־יָגוּר בְּאָהֳלֶךָ מִי־יִשְׁכֹּן בְּהַר קָדְשֶׁךָ׃
verses.english: A Psalm of David. Lord, who shall abide in Thy tent? who shall dwell in Thy holy hill?

verses.hebrew: הוֹלֵךְ תָּמִים וּפֹעֵל צֶדֶק וְדֹבֵר אֱמֶת בִּלְבָבוֹ׃
verses.english: He that walks uprightly, and acts justly, and speaks the truth in his heart.

verses.hebrew: לֹא־רָגַל עַל־לְשֹׁנוֹ לֹא־עָשָׂה לְרֵעֵהוּ רָעָה וְחֶרְפָּה לֹא־נָשָׂא עַל־קְרֹבוֹ׃
verses.english: He that does not slander with his tongue, nor does evil to his fellow, nor takes up a reproach against his neighbour.

verses.hebrew: נִבְזֶה בְּעֵינָיו נִמְאָס וְאֶת־יִרְאֵי יְהוָה יְכַבֵּד נִשְׁבַּע לְהָרַע וְלֹא יָמִר׃
verses.english: In whose eyes a vile person is despised; but he honours them that fear the Lord. He that swears to his own hurt, and changes not.

verses.hebrew: כַּסְפּוֹ לֹא־נָתַן בְּנֶשֶׁךְ וְשֹׁחַד עַל־נָקִי לֹא לָקָח עֹשֵׂה־אֵלֶּה לֹא יִמּוֹט לְעוֹלָם׃
verses.english: He that does not put out his money on interest, nor takes a bribe against the innocent. He that does these things shall never be moved.

verses.hebrew: מִכְתָּם לְדָוִד שָׁמְרֵנִי אֵל כִּי־חָסִיתִי בָךְ׃
verses.english: A Mikhtam of David. Preserve me, O God: for in Thee do I put my trust.

verses.hebrew: אָמַרְתְּ לַיהוָה אֲדֹנָי אָתָּה טוֹבָתִי בַּל־עָלֶיךָ׃
verses.english: I have said to the Lord, Thou art my Lord: I have no good apart from Thee;

verses.hebrew: לִקְדוֹשִׁים אֲשֶׁר־בָּאָרֶץ הֵמָּה וְאַדִּירֵי כָּל־חֶפְצִי־בָם׃
verses.english: and to the saints that are on the earth, They are the excellent, in whom is all my delight.

verses.hebrew: יִרְבּוּ עַצְּבוֹתָם אַחֵר מָהָרוּ בַּל־אַסִּיךְ נִסְכֵּיהֶם מִדָּם וּבַל־אֶשָּׂא אֶת־שְׁמוֹתָם עַל־שְׂפָתָי׃
verses.english: Their sorrows shall be multiplied that hasten after another god: their drink offerings of blood will I not offer, nor take up their names upon my lips.

verses.hebrew: יְהוָה מְנָת־חֶלְקִי וְכוֹסִי אַתָּה תּוֹמִיךְ גּוֹרָלִי׃
verses.english: The Lord is the portion of my inheritance and of my cup: Thou maintainest my lot.

verses.hebrew: חֲבָלִים נָפְלוּ־לִי בַּנְּעִמִים אַף־נַחֲלָת שָׁפְרָה עָלָי׃
verses.english: The lines are fallen to me in pleasant places; yea, I have a goodly heritage.

verses.hebrew: אֲבָרֵךְ אֶת־יְהוָה אֲשֶׁר יְעָצָנִי אַף־לֵילוֹת יִסְּרוּנִי כִלְיוֹתָי׃
verses.english: I bless the Lord, who gives me counsel: my reins also admonish me in the night seasons.

verses.hebrew: שִׁוִּיתִי יְהוָה לְנֶגְדִּי תָמִיד כִּי מִימִינִי בַּל־אֶמּוֹט׃
verses.english: I have set the Lord always before me: surely he is at my right hand, I shall not be moved.

verses.hebrew: לָכֵן שָׂמַח לִבִּי וַיָּגֶל כְּבוֹדִי אַף־בְּשָׂרִי יִשְׁכֹּן לָבֶטַח׃
verses.english: Therefore my heart is glad, and my glory rejoices: my flesh also dwells secure.

verses.hebrew: כִּי לֹא־תַעֲזֹב נַפְשִׁי לִשְׁאוֹל לֹא־תִתֵּן חֲסִידְךָ לִרְאוֹת שָׁחַת׃
verses.english: For Thou wilt not abandon my soul to She᾽ol; nor wilt Thou suffer thy holy one to see the pit.

verses.hebrew: תּוֹדִיעֵנִי אֹרַח חַיִּים שֹׂבַע שְׂמָחוֹת אֶת־פָּנֶיךָ נְעִמוֹת בִּימִינְךָ נֶצַח׃
verses.english: Thou wilt make known to me the path of life: in Thy presence is fulness of joy; at Thy right hand are pleasures for evermore.

verses.hebrew: תְּפִלָּה לְדָוִד שִׁמְעָה יְהוָה צֶדֶק הַקְשִׁיבָה רִנָּתִי הַאֲזִינָה תְפִלָּתִי בְּלֹא שִׂפְתֵי מִרְמָה׃
verses.english: A Prayer of David. Hear the right, O Lord, attend to my cry, give ear to my prayer, from lips without deceit.

verses.hebrew: מִלְּפָנֶיךָ מִשְׁפָּטִי יֵצֵא עֵינֶיךָ תֶּחֱזֶינָה מֵישָׁרִים׃
verses.english: Let my sentence come forth from Thy presence; let Thy eyes behold the right.

verses.hebrew: בָּחַנְתָּ לִבִּי פָּקַדְתָּ לַּיְלָה צְרַפְתַּנִי בַל־תִּמְצָא זַמֹּתִי בַּל־יַעֲבָר־פִּי׃
verses.english: Thou hast proved my heart; Thou hast visited it in the night: Thou hast tried me, but Thou findest nothing; let no presumptuous thought pass my lips.

verses.hebrew: לִפְעֻלּוֹת אָדָם בִּדְבַר שְׂפָתֶיךָ אֲנִי שָׁמַרְתִּי אָרְחוֹת פָּרִיץ׃
verses.english: Concerning the works of men, by the word of Thy lips I have kept me from the paths of the violent.

verses.hebrew: תָּמֹךְ אֲשֻׁרַי בְּמַעְגְּלוֹתֶיךָ בַּל־נָמוֹטּוּ פְעָמָי׃
verses.english: My steps have held fast to Thy paths; my feet have not slipped.

verses.hebrew: אֲנִי־קְרָאתִיךָ כִי־תַעֲנֵנִי אֵל הַט־אָזְנְךָ לִי שְׁמַע אִמְרָתִי׃
verses.english: I have called upon Thee, for Thou wilt hear me, O God: incline Thy ear to me, and hear my speech.

verses.hebrew: הַפְלֵה חֲסָדֶיךָ מוֹשִׁיעַ חוֹסִים מִמִּתְקוֹמְמִים בִּימִינֶךָ׃
verses.english: Show marvellously Thy steadfast love, saving with Thy right hand from their enemies those who seek refuge.

verses.hebrew: שָׁמְרֵנִי כְּאִישׁוֹן בַּת־עָיִן בְּצֵל כְּנָפֶיךָ תַּסְתִּירֵנִי׃
verses.english: Keep me as the apple of the eye, hide me under the shadow of Thy wings,

verses.hebrew: מִפְּנֵי רְשָׁעִים זוּ שַׁדּוּנִי אֹיְבַי בְּנֶפֶשׁ יַקִּיפוּ עָלָי׃
verses.english: from the wicked that oppress me, from my deadly enemies, who compass me about.

verses.hebrew: חֶלְבָּמוֹ סָּגְרוּ פִּימוֹ דִּבְּרוּ בְגֵאוּת׃
verses.english: They are inclosed in their own fat: with their mouth they speak proudly.

verses.hebrew: אַשֻּׁרֵינוּ עַתָּה סבבוני [סְבָבוּנוּ] עֵינֵיהֶם יָשִׁיתוּ לִנְטוֹת בָּאָרֶץ׃
verses.english: They dog our footsteps; they surround us: they set their eyes to tread us down to the earth;

verses.hebrew: דִּמְיֹנוֹ כְּאַרְיֵה יִכְסוֹף לִטְרוֹף וְכִכְפִיר יֹשֵׁב בְּמִסְתָּרִים׃
verses.english: he is like a lion greedy for its prey, and as it were a young lion lurking in secret places.

verses.hebrew: קוּמָה יְהוָה קַדְּמָה פָנָיו הַכְרִיעֵהוּ פַּלְּטָה נַפְשִׁי מֵרָשָׁע חַרְבֶּךָ׃
verses.english: Arise, O Lord, confront him, cast him down: deliver my soul from the wicked, by Thy sword:

verses.hebrew: מִמְתִים יָדְךָ יְהוָה מִמְתִים מֵחֶלֶד חֶלְקָם בַּחַיִּים וצפינך [וּצְפוּנְךָ] תְּמַלֵּא בִטְנָם יִשְׂבְּעוּ בָנִים וְהִנִּיחוּ יִתְרָם לְעוֹלְלֵיהֶם׃
verses.english: from men, by Thy hand, O Lord, from men whose portion in life is of the world, and whose belly Thou fillest with Thy treasure: who have children in plenty, and who leave their abundance to their babes.

verses.hebrew: אֲנִי בְּצֶדֶק אֶחֱזֶה פָנֶיךָ אֶשְׂבְּעָה בְהָקִיץ תְּמוּנָתֶךָ׃
verses.english: As for me, I will behold Thy face in righteousness: I shall be satisfied, when I awake, with beholding Thy likeness.

verses.hebrew: לַמְנַצֵּחַ לְעֶבֶד יְהוָה לְדָוִד אֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר לַיהוָה אֶת־דִּבְרֵי הַשִּׁירָה הַזֹּאת בְּיוֹם הִצִּיל־יְהוָה אוֹתוֹ מִכַּף כָּל־אֹיְבָיו וּמִיַּד שָׁאוּל׃
verses.english: To the chief Musician, of David, the servant of the Lord, who spoke to the Lord the words of this song in the day that the Lord delivered him from the hand of all his enemies, and from the hand of Sha᾽ul:

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמַר אֶרְחָמְךָ יְהוָה חִזְקִי׃
verses.english: and he said, I will love Thee, O Lord, my strength.

verses.hebrew: יְהוָה סַלְעִי וּמְצוּדָתִי וּמְפַלְטִי אֵלִי צוּרִי אֶחֱסֶה־בּוֹ מָגִנִּי וְקֶרֶן־יִשְׁעִי מִשְׂגַּבִּי׃
verses.english: The Lord is my rock, and my fortress, and my deliverer; my God, my rock, in whom I will trust; my shield, and the horn of my salvation, and my high tower.

verses.hebrew: מְהֻלָּל אֶקְרָא יְהוָה וּמִן־אֹיְבַי אִוָּשֵׁעַ׃
verses.english: He is worthy to be praised: I will call upon the Lord: so shall I be saved from my enemies.

verses.hebrew: אֲפָפוּנִי חֶבְלֵי־מָוֶת וְנַחֲלֵי בְלִיַּעַל יְבַעֲתוּנִי׃
verses.english: The bonds of death encircled me, and the floods of ungodly men made me afraid.

verses.hebrew: חֶבְלֵי שְׁאוֹל סְבָבוּנִי קִדְּמוּנִי מוֹקְשֵׁי מָוֶת׃
verses.english: The cords of She᾽ol compassed me about: the snares of death took me by surprise.

verses.hebrew: בַּצַּר־לִי אֶקְרָא יְהוָה וְאֶל־אֱלֹהַי אֲשַׁוֵּעַ יִשְׁמַע מֵהֵיכָלוֹ קוֹלִי וְשַׁוְעָתִי לְפָנָיו תָּבוֹא בְאָזְנָיו׃
verses.english: In my distress I called upon the Lord, and cried to my God: he heard my voice out of his temple, and my cry came before him, into his ears.

verses.hebrew: וַתִּגְעַשׁ וַתִּרְעַשׁ הָאָרֶץ וּמוֹסְדֵי הָרִים יִרְגָּזוּ וַיִּתְגָּעֲשׁוּ כִּי־חָרָה לוֹ׃
verses.english: Then the earth shook and trembled; and the foundations of the hills moved and were shaken, because of his anger.

verses.hebrew: עָלָה עָשָׁן בְּאַפּוֹ וְאֵשׁ־מִפִּיו תֹּאכֵל גֶּחָלִים בָּעֲרוּ מִמֶּנּוּ׃
verses.english: There went up a smoke out of his nostrils, and fire out of his mouth devoured: coals were kindled by it.

verses.hebrew: וַיֵּט שָׁמַיִם וַיֵּרַד וַעֲרָפֶל תַּחַת רַגְלָיו׃
verses.english: He bowed the heavens also, and came down: and darkness was under his feet.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּרְכַּב עַל־כְּרוּב וַיָּעֹף וַיֵּדֶא עַל־כַּנְפֵי־רוּחַ׃
verses.english: And he rode upon a keruv, and did fly: he soared on the wings of the wind.

verses.hebrew: יָשֶׁת חֹשֶׁךְ סִתְרוֹ סְבִיבוֹתָיו סֻכָּתוֹ חֶשְׁכַת־מַיִם עָבֵי שְׁחָקִים׃
verses.english: He made darkness his secret place; his pavilion round about him was dark water and thick clouds of the skies.

verses.hebrew: מִנֹּגַהּ נֶגְדּוֹ עָבָיו עָבְרוּ בָּרָד וְגַחֲלֵי־אֵשׁ׃
verses.english: At the brightness that was before him his thick clouds passed, hail and coals of fire.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּרְעֵם בַּשָּׁמַיִם יְהוָה וְעֶלְיוֹן יִתֵּן קֹלוֹ בָּרָד וְגַחֲלֵי־אֵשׁ׃
verses.english: The Lord also thundered in the heavens, and the Highest gave his voice; hail and coals of fire.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁלַח חִצָּיו וַיְפִיצֵם וּבְרָקִים רָב וַיְהֻמֵּם׃
verses.english: And he sent out his arrows, and scattered them; and he shot out lightnings, and confounded them.

verses.hebrew: וַיֵּרָאוּ אֲפִיקֵי מַיִם וַיִּגָּלוּ מוֹסְדוֹת תֵּבֵל מִגַּעֲרָתְךָ יְהוָה מִנִּשְׁמַת רוּחַ אַפֶּךָ׃
verses.english: Then the channels of waters were seen, and the foundations of the world were laid bare, at Thy rebuke, O Lord, at the blast of the breath of Thy nostrils.

verses.hebrew: יִשְׁלַח מִמָּרוֹם יִקָּחֵנִי יַמְשֵׁנִי מִמַּיִם רַבִּים׃
verses.english: He sent from above, he took me, he drew me out of many waters.

verses.hebrew: יַצִּילֵנִי מֵאֹיְבִי עָז וּמִשֹּׂנְאַי כִּי־אָמְצוּ מִמֶּנִּי׃
verses.english: He delivered me from my strong enemy, and from those who hated me: for they were too strong for me.

verses.hebrew: יְקַדְּמוּנִי בְיוֹם־אֵידִי וַיְהִי־יְהוָה לְמִשְׁעָן לִי׃
verses.english: They surprised me in the day of my calamity: but the Lord was my stay.

verses.hebrew: וַיּוֹצִיאֵנִי לַמֶּרְחָב יְחַלְּצֵנִי כִּי חָפֵץ בִּי׃
verses.english: He brought me forth also into a large place; he delivered me, because he delighted in me.

verses.hebrew: יִגְמְלֵנִי יְהוָה כְּצִדְקִי כְּבֹר יָדַי יָשִׁיב לִי׃
verses.english: The Lord rewards me according to my righteousness; according to the cleanness of my hands he recompenses me.

verses.hebrew: כִּי־שָׁמַרְתִּי דַּרְכֵי יְהוָה וְלֹא־רָשַׁעְתִּי מֵאֱלֹהָי׃
verses.english: For I have kept the ways of the Lord, and have not wickedly departed from my God.

verses.hebrew: כִּי כָל־מִשְׁפָּטָיו לְנֶגְדִּי וְחֻקֹּתָיו לֹא־אָסִיר מֶנִּי׃
verses.english: For all his judgments were before me, and I did not put away his statutes from me.

verses.hebrew: וָאֱהִי תָמִים עִמּוֹ וָאֶשְׁתַּמֵּר מֵעֲוֺנִי׃
verses.english: I was also upright before him, and I kept myself from my iniquity.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּשֶׁב־יְהוָה לִי כְצִדְקִי כְּבֹר יָדַי לְנֶגֶד עֵינָיו׃
verses.english: Therefore the Lord recompenses me according to my righteousness, according to the cleanness of my hands in his eyesight.

verses.hebrew: עִם־חָסִיד תִּתְחַסָּד עִם־גְּבַר תָּמִים תִּתַּמָּם׃
verses.english: With the merciful Thou wilt show Thyself merciful; with an upright man Thou wilt show Thyself upright;

verses.hebrew: עִם־נָבָר תִּתְבָּרָר וְעִם־עִקֵּשׁ תִּתְפַּתָּל׃
verses.english: with the pure Thou wilt show Thyself pure; and with the perverse Thou wilt show Thyself subtle.

verses.hebrew: כִּי־אַתָּה עַם־עָנִי תוֹשִׁיעַ וְעֵינַיִם רָמוֹת תַּשְׁפִּיל׃
verses.english: For Thou wilt save the afflicted people; but wilt bring down high looks.

verses.hebrew: כִּי־אַתָּה תָּאִיר נֵרִי יְהוָה אֱלֹהַי יַגִּיהַּ חָשְׁכִּי׃
verses.english: For Thou wilt light my candle: the Lord my God will enlighten my darkness.

verses.hebrew: כִּי־בְךָ אָרֻץ גְּדוּד וּבֵאלֹהַי אֲדַלֶּג־שׁוּר׃
verses.english: For by Thee I run through a troop; and by my God I leap over a wall.

verses.hebrew: הָאֵל תָּמִים דַּרְכּוֹ אִמְרַת־יְהוָה צְרוּפָה מָגֵן הוּא לְכֹל הַחֹסִים בּוֹ׃
verses.english: As for God, his way is perfect: the word of the Lord is tried: he is a shield to all those who trust in him.

verses.hebrew: כִּי מִי אֱלוֹהַּ מִבַּלְעֲדֵי יְהוָה וּמִי צוּר זוּלָתִי אֱלֹהֵינוּ׃
verses.english: For who is God save the Lord? or who is a rock save our God?

verses.hebrew: הָאֵל הַמְאַזְּרֵנִי חָיִל וַיִּתֵּן תָּמִים דַּרְכִּי׃
verses.english: It is God that girds me with strength, and makes my way perfect.

verses.hebrew: מְשַׁוֶּה רַגְלַי כָּאַיָּלוֹת וְעַל בָּמֹתַי יַעֲמִידֵנִי׃
verses.english: He makes my feet like hinds’ feet, and sets me upon my heights.

verses.hebrew: מְלַמֵּד יָדַי לַמִּלְחָמָה וְנִחֲתָה קֶשֶׁת־נְחוּשָׁה זְרוֹעֹתָי׃
verses.english: He teaches my hands to war, so that a bow of brass is bent in my arms.

verses.hebrew: וַתִּתֶּן־לִי מָגֵן יִשְׁעֶךָ וִימִינְךָ תִסְעָדֵנִי וְעַנְוַתְךָ תַרְבֵּנִי׃
verses.english: Thou hast also given me the shield of Thy salvation: and Thy right hand has supported me and Thy condescension has made me great.

verses.hebrew: תַּרְחִיב צַעֲדִי תַחְתָּי וְלֹא מָעֲדוּ קַרְסֻלָּי׃
verses.english: Thou hast enlarged my steps under me, that my feet did not slip.

verses.hebrew: אֶרְדּוֹף אוֹיְבַי וְאַשִּׂיגֵם וְלֹא־אָשׁוּב עַד־כַּלּוֹתָם׃
verses.english: I have pursued my enemies, and overtaken them: neither did I turn back till they were consumed.

verses.hebrew: אֶמְחָצֵם וְלֹא־יֻכְלוּ קוּם יִפְּלוּ תַּחַת רַגְלָי׃
verses.english: I have crushed them so that they were not able to rise: they are fallen under my feet.

verses.hebrew: וַתְּאַזְּרֵנִי חַיִל לַמִּלְחָמָה תַּכְרִיעַ קָמַי תַּחְתָּי׃
verses.english: For Thou hast girded me with strength to the battle: Thou hast subdued under me those who rose up against me.

verses.hebrew: וְאֹיְבַי נָתַתָּה לִּי עֹרֶף וּמְשַׂנְאַי אַצְמִיתֵם׃
verses.english: Thou hast also made my enemies turn their backs on me; that I might destroy those who hate me.

verses.hebrew: יְשַׁוְּעוּ וְאֵין־מוֹשִׁיעַ עַל־יְהוָה וְלֹא עָנָם׃
verses.english: They cried, but there was none to save them: to the Lord, but he answered them not.

verses.hebrew: וְאֶשְׁחָקֵם כְּעָפָר עַל־פְּנֵי־רוּחַ כְּטִיט חוּצוֹת אֲרִיקֵם׃
verses.english: Then did I beat them small like the dust before the wind: I did cast them out like the dirt in the streets.

verses.hebrew: תְּפַלְּטֵנִי מֵרִיבֵי עָם תְּשִׂימֵנִי לְרֹאשׁ גּוֹיִם עַם לֹא־יָדַעְתִּי יַעַבְדוּנִי׃
verses.english: Thou deliverest me from the strivings of the people; Thou makest me the head of nations: a people whom I have not known shall serve me.

verses.hebrew: לְשֵׁמַע אֹזֶן יִשָּׁמְעוּ לִי בְּנֵי־נֵכָר יְכַחֲשׁוּ־לִי׃
verses.english: As soon as they hear of me, they shall obey me: the strangers shall submit themselves to me.

verses.hebrew: בְּנֵי־נֵכָר יִבֹּלוּ וְיַחְרְגוּ מִמִּסְגְּרוֹתֵיהֶם׃
verses.english: The strangers shall fade away, and come trembling out of their close places.

verses.hebrew: חַי־יְהוָה וּבָרוּךְ צוּרִי וְיָרוּם אֱלוֹהֵי יִשְׁעִי׃
verses.english: The Lord lives; and blessed is my rock; and let the God of my salvation be exalted.

verses.hebrew: הָאֵל הַנּוֹתֵן נְקָמוֹת לִי וַיַּדְבֵּר עַמִּים תַּחְתָּי׃
verses.english: It is God who avenges me, and has subdued peoples under me.

verses.hebrew: מְפַלְּטִי מֵאֹיְבָי אַף מִן־קָמַי תְּרוֹמְמֵנִי מֵאִישׁ חָמָס תַּצִּילֵנִי׃
verses.english: He delivers me from my enemies: indeed, thou liftest me up above those who rise up against me: Thou deliverest me from the violent man.

verses.hebrew: עַל־כֵּן אוֹדְךָ בַגּוֹיִם יְהוָה וּלְשִׁמְךָ אֲזַמֵּרָה׃
verses.english: Therefore will I give thanks to Thee, O Lord, among the nations, and sing praises to Thy name.

verses.hebrew: מגדל [מַגְדִּיל] יְשׁוּעוֹת מַלְכּוֹ וְעֹשֶׂה חֶסֶד לִמְשִׁיחוֹ לְדָוִד וּלְזַרְעוֹ עַד־עוֹלָם׃
verses.english: Great deliverance he gives to his king; and shows steadfast love to his anointed, to David, and to his seed for evermore.

verses.hebrew: לַמְנַצֵּחַ מִזְמוֹר לְדָוִד׃
verses.english: To the chief Musician, A Psalm of David.

verses.hebrew: הַשָּׁמַיִם מְסַפְּרִים כְּבוֹד־אֵל וּמַעֲשֵׂה יָדָיו מַגִּיד הָרָקִיעַ׃
verses.english: The heavens declare the glory of God; and the firmament proclaims his handiwork.

verses.hebrew: יוֹם לְיוֹם יַבִּיעַ אֹמֶר וְלַיְלָה לְּלַיְלָה יְחַוֶּה־דָּעַת׃
verses.english: Day to day utters speech, and night to night expresses knowledge.

verses.hebrew: אֵין־אֹמֶר וְאֵין דְּבָרִים בְּלִי נִשְׁמָע קוֹלָם׃
verses.english: There is no speech nor are there words; their voice is not heard.

verses.hebrew: בְּכָל־הָאָרֶץ יָצָא קַוָּם וּבִקְצֵה תֵבֵל מִלֵּיהֶם לַשֶּׁמֶשׁ שָׂם־אֹהֶל בָּהֶם׃
verses.english: Their line is gone out through all the earth, and their words to the end of the world. In them he has set a tent for the sun,

verses.hebrew: וְהוּא כְּחָתָן יֹצֵא מֵחֻפָּתוֹ יָשִׂישׂ כְּגִבּוֹר לָרוּץ אֹרַח׃
verses.english: which is like a bridegroom coming out of his chamber, and rejoices like a strong man to run a race.

verses.hebrew: מִקְצֵה הַשָּׁמַיִם מוֹצָאוֹ וּתְקוּפָתוֹ עַל־קְצוֹתָם וְאֵין נִסְתָּר מֵחַמָּתוֹ׃
verses.english: His going forth is from the end of the heaven, and his circuit to the ends of it: and there is nothing hid from his heat.

verses.hebrew: תּוֹרַת יְהוָה תְּמִימָה מְשִׁיבַת נָפֶשׁ עֵדוּת יְהוָה נֶאֱמָנָה מַחְכִּימַת פֶּתִי׃
verses.english: The Tora of the Lord is perfect, restoring the soul: the testimony of the Lord is sure, making wise the simple.

verses.hebrew: פִּקּוּדֵי יְהוָה יְשָׁרִים מְשַׂמְּחֵי־לֵב מִצְוַת יְהוָה בָּרָה מְאִירַת עֵינָיִם׃
verses.english: The statutes of the Lord are right, rejoicing the heart: the commandment of the Lord is pure, enlightening the eyes.

verses.hebrew: יִרְאַת יְהוָה טְהוֹרָה עוֹמֶדֶת לָעַד מִשְׁפְּטֵי־יְהוָה אֱמֶת צָדְקוּ יַחְדָּו׃
verses.english: The fear of the Lord is clean, enduring forever: the judgments of the Lord are true and are righteous altogether.

verses.hebrew: הַנֶּחֱמָדִים מִזָּהָב וּמִפַּז רָב וּמְתוּקִים מִדְּבַשׁ וְנֹפֶת צוּפִים׃
verses.english: More to be desired are they than gold, even much fine gold: sweeter also than honey and the honeycomb.

verses.hebrew: גַּם־עַבְדְּךָ נִזְהָר בָּהֶם בְּשָׁמְרָם עֵקֶב רָב׃
verses.english: Moreover by them is Thy servant enlightened: and in keeping of them there is great reward.

verses.hebrew: שְׁגִיאוֹת מִי־יָבִין מִנִּסְתָּרוֹת נַקֵּנִי׃
verses.english: Who can discern errors? cleanse Thou me from secret faults.

verses.hebrew: גַּם מִזֵּדִים חֲשֹׂךְ עַבְדֶּךָ אַל־יִמְשְׁלוּ־בִי אָז אֵיתָם וְנִקֵּיתִי מִפֶּשַׁע רָב׃
verses.english: Keep back Thy servant also from presumptuous sins; let them not have dominion over me: then shall I be upright, and I shall be clear of much transgression.

verses.hebrew: יִהְיוּ לְרָצוֹן אִמְרֵי־פִי וְהֶגְיוֹן לִבִּי לְפָנֶיךָ יְהוָה צוּרִי וְגֹאֲלִי׃
verses.english: Let the words of my mouth, and the meditation of my heart, be acceptable in Thy sight, O Lord, my rock, and my redeemer.

verses.hebrew: לַמְנַצֵּחַ מִזְמוֹר לְדָוִד׃
verses.english: To the chief Musician, A Psalm for David.

verses.hebrew: יַעַנְךָ יְהוָה בְּיוֹם צָרָה יְשַׂגֶּבְךָ שֵׁם אֱלֹהֵי יַעֲקֹב׃
verses.english: May the Lord hear thee in the day of trouble; may the name of the God of Ya῾aqov defend thee!

verses.hebrew: יִשְׁלַח־עֶזְרְךָ מִקֹּדֶשׁ וּמִצִּיּוֹן יִסְעָדֶךָּ׃
verses.english: May he send thee help from the sanctuary, and strengthen thee out of Żiyyon!

verses.hebrew: יִזְכֹּר כָּל־מִנְחֹתֶךָ וְעוֹלָתְךָ יְדַשְּׁנֶה סֶלָה׃
verses.english: May he remember all thy offerings, and accept with favour thy burnt offering! (Sela.)

verses.hebrew: יִתֶּן־לְךָ כִלְבָבֶךָ וְכָל־עֲצָתְךָ יְמַלֵּא׃
verses.english: May he grant thee thy heart’s desire, and fulfil all thy counsel!

verses.hebrew: נְרַנְּנָה בִּישׁוּעָתֶךָ וּבְשֵׁם־אֱלֹהֵינוּ נִדְגֹּל יְמַלֵּא יְהוָה כָּל־מִשְׁאֲלוֹתֶיךָ׃
verses.english: May we rejoice in Thy salvation, and in the name of our God set up our banner! Let the Lord fulfil all thy petitions!

verses.hebrew: עַתָּה יָדַעְתִּי כִּי הוֹשִׁיעַ יְהוָה מְשִׁיחוֹ יַעֲנֵהוּ מִשְּׁמֵי קָדְשׁוֹ בִּגְבֻרוֹת יֵשַׁע יְמִינוֹ׃
verses.english: Now I know that the Lord saves his anointed; that he answers him from his holy heaven with the saving strength of his right hand.

verses.hebrew: אֵלֶּה בָרֶכֶב וְאֵלֶּה בַסּוּסִים וַאֲנַחְנוּ בְּשֵׁם־יְהוָה אֱלֹהֵינוּ נַזְכִּיר׃
verses.english: Some trust in chariots, and some in horses: but we will make mention of the name of the Lord our God.

verses.hebrew: הֵמָּה כָּרְעוּ וְנָפָלוּ וַאֲנַחְנוּ קַּמְנוּ וַנִּתְעוֹדָד׃
verses.english: They are bowed down and fallen: but we are risen, and stand upright.

verses.hebrew: יְהוָה הוֹשִׁיעָה הַמֶּלֶךְ יַעֲנֵנוּ בְיוֹם־קָרְאֵנוּ׃
verses.english: Save, Lord; O King, who hears us on the day when we call.

verses.hebrew: לַמְנַצֵּחַ מִזְמוֹר לְדָוִד׃
verses.english: To the chief Musicians, A Psalm of David.

verses.hebrew: יְהוָה בְּעָזְּךָ יִשְׂמַח־מֶלֶךְ וּבִישׁוּעָתְךָ מַה־יגיל [יָּגֶל] מְאֹד׃
verses.english: The king joys in Thy strength, O Lord; and in Thy salvation how greatly he rejoices!

verses.hebrew: תַּאֲוַת לִבּוֹ נָתַתָּה לּוֹ וַאֲרֶשֶׁת שְׂפָתָיו בַּל־מָנַעְתָּ סֶּלָה׃
verses.english: Thou hast given him his heart’s desire, and hast not withheld the request of his lips. (Sela.)

verses.hebrew: כִּי־תְקַדְּמֶנּוּ בִּרְכוֹת טוֹב תָּשִׁית לְרֹאשׁוֹ עֲטֶרֶת פָּז׃
verses.english: For Thou dost meet him with the blessings of goodness: Thou settest a crown of pure gold on his head.

verses.hebrew: חַיִּים שָׁאַל מִמְּךָ נָתַתָּה לּוֹ אֹרֶךְ יָמִים עוֹלָם וָעֶד׃
verses.english: He asked life of Thee, and Thou didst give it him; length of days for ever and ever.

verses.hebrew: גָּדוֹל כְּבוֹדוֹ בִּישׁוּעָתֶךָ הוֹד וְהָדָר תְּשַׁוֶּה עָלָיו׃
verses.english: His glory is great in Thy salvation: honour and majesty Thou dost lay upon him.

verses.hebrew: כִּי־תְשִׁיתֵהוּ בְרָכוֹת לָעַד תְּחַדֵּהוּ בְשִׂמְחָה אֶת־פָּנֶיךָ׃
verses.english: For Thou dost make him most blessed forever: Thou makest him exceeding glad with Thy countenance.

verses.hebrew: כִּי־הַמֶּלֶךְ בֹּטֵחַ בַּיהוָה וּבְחֶסֶד עֶלְיוֹן בַּל־יִמּוֹט׃
verses.english: For the king trusts in the Lord, and through the steadfast love of the most High he shall not be moved.

verses.hebrew: תִּמְצָא יָדְךָ לְכָל־אֹיְבֶיךָ יְמִינְךָ תִּמְצָא שֹׂנְאֶיךָ׃
verses.english: Thy hand shall find out all Thy enemies: Thy right hand shall seize those that hate Thee.

verses.hebrew: תְּשִׁיתֵמוֹ כְּתַנּוּר אֵשׁ לְעֵת פָּנֶיךָ יְהוָה בְּאַפּוֹ יְבַלְּעֵם וְתֹאכְלֵם אֵשׁ׃
verses.english: Thou shalt make them like a fiery oven in the time of Thy anger: the Lord shall swallow them up in his wrath, and the fire shall devour them.

verses.hebrew: פִּרְיָמוֹ מֵאֶרֶץ תְּאַבֵּד וְזַרְעָם מִבְּנֵי אָדָם׃
verses.english: Their fruit shalt Thou destroy from the earth, and their seed from among the children of men.

verses.hebrew: כִּי־נָטוּ עָלֶיךָ רָעָה חָשְׁבוּ מְזִמָּה בַּל־יוּכָלוּ׃
verses.english: For they intended evil against Thee: they imagined a mischievous device, but they will not succeed.

verses.hebrew: כִּי תְּשִׁיתֵמוֹ שֶׁכֶם בְּמֵיתָרֶיךָ תְּכוֹנֵן עַל־פְּנֵיהֶם׃
verses.english: For Thou shalt make them turn their back; Thou shalt aim Thy bowstrings against the face of them.

verses.hebrew: רוּמָה יְהוָה בְּעֻזֶּךָ נָשִׁירָה וּנְזַמְּרָה גְּבוּרָתֶךָ׃
verses.english: Be Thou exalted, Lord, in Thy own strength: we will sing and praise Thy power.

verses.hebrew: לַמְנַצֵּחַ עַל־אַיֶּלֶת הַשַּׁחַר מִזְמוֹר לְדָוִד׃
verses.english: To the chief Musician upon Ayyelet-hashshaĥar, A Psalm of David.

verses.hebrew: אֵלִי אֵלִי לָמָה עֲזַבְתָּנִי רָחוֹק מִישׁוּעָתִי דִּבְרֵי שַׁאֲגָתִי׃
verses.english: My God, my God, why hast Thou forsaken me? why art Thou so far from helping me, from the words of my loud complaint?

verses.hebrew: אֱ‍לֹהַי אֶקְרָא יוֹמָם וְלֹא תַעֲנֶה וְלַיְלָה וְלֹא־דוּמִיָּה לִי׃
verses.english: O my God, I cry in the daytime, but Thou hearest not; and in the night season, and I have no rest.

verses.hebrew: וְאַתָּה קָדוֹשׁ יוֹשֵׁב תְּהִלּוֹת יִשְׂרָאֵל׃
verses.english: But Thou art holy, O Thou That art enthroned upon the praises of Yisra᾽el.

verses.hebrew: בְּךָ בָּטְחוּ אֲבֹתֵינוּ בָּטְחוּ וַתְּפַלְּטֵמוֹ׃
verses.english: Our fathers trusted in Thee: they trusted, and Thou didst deliver them.

verses.hebrew: אֵלֶיךָ זָעֲקוּ וְנִמְלָטוּ בְּךָ בָטְחוּ וְלֹא־בוֹשׁוּ׃
verses.english: They cried to Thee, and were delivered: they trusted in Thee, and were not confounded.

verses.hebrew: וְאָנֹכִי תוֹלַעַת וְלֹא־אִישׁ חֶרְפַּת אָדָם וּבְזוּי עָם׃
verses.english: But I am a worm, and no man; a reproach of men, and despised of the people.

verses.hebrew: כָּל־רֹאַי יַלְעִגוּ לִי יַפְטִירוּ בְשָׂפָה יָנִיעוּ רֹאשׁ׃
verses.english: All that see me laugh me to scorn: they shoot out the lip, they shake the head,

verses.hebrew: גֹּל אֶל־יְהוָה יְפַלְּטֵהוּ יַצִּילֵהוּ כִּי חָפֵץ בּוֹ׃
verses.english: saying, He trusts in the Lord that he will deliver him! Let him deliver him, seeing he delights in him.

verses.hebrew: כִּי־אַתָּה גֹחִי מִבָּטֶן מַבְטִיחִי עַל־שְׁדֵי אִמִּי׃
verses.english: But Thou art he that took me out of the womb: Thou didst make me hope when I was upon my mother’s breasts.

verses.hebrew: עָלֶיךָ הָשְׁלַכְתִּי מֵרָחֶם מִבֶּטֶן אִמִּי אֵלִי אָתָּה׃
verses.english: I was cast upon Thee from the womb: Thou art my God from my mother’s belly.

verses.hebrew: אַל־תִּרְחַק מִמֶּנִּי כִּי־צָרָה קְרוֹבָה כִּי־אֵין עוֹזֵר׃
verses.english: Be not far from me; for trouble is near; for there is none to help.

verses.hebrew: סְבָבוּנִי פָּרִים רַבִּים אַבִּירֵי בָשָׁן כִּתְּרוּנִי׃
verses.english: Many bulls have compassed me: strong bulls of Bashan have beset me round.

verses.hebrew: פָּצוּ עָלַי פִּיהֶם אַרְיֵה טֹרֵף וְשֹׁאֵג׃
verses.english: They gape upon me with their mouths, like a ravening and a roaring lion.

verses.hebrew: כַּמַּיִם נִשְׁפַּכְתִּי וְהִתְפָּרְדוּ כָּל־עַצְמוֹתָי הָיָה לִבִּי כַּדּוֹנָג נָמֵס בְּתוֹךְ מֵעָי׃
verses.english: I am poured out like water, and all my bones are out of joint: my heart is become like wax; it is melted in the midst of my bowels.

verses.hebrew: יָבֵשׁ כַּחֶרֶשׂ כֹּחִי וּלְשׁוֹנִי מֻדְבָּק מַלְקוֹחָי וְלַעֲפַר־מָוֶת תִּשְׁפְּתֵנִי׃
verses.english: My strength is dried up like a potsherd; and my tongue cleaves to my jaws; and Thou layest me down in the dust of death.

verses.hebrew: כִּי סְבָבוּנִי כְּלָבִים עֲדַת מְרֵעִים הִקִּיפוּנִי כָּאֲרִי יָדַי וְרַגְלָי׃
verses.english: For dogs have compassed me: the assembly of the wicked have inclosed me: they seize my hands and my feet like a lion.

verses.hebrew: אֲסַפֵּר כָּל־עַצְמוֹתָי הֵמָּה יַבִּיטוּ יִרְאוּ־בִי׃
verses.english: I can count all my bones: they look and stare upon me.

verses.hebrew: יְחַלְּקוּ בְגָדַי לָהֶם וְעַל־לְבוּשִׁי יַפִּילוּ גוֹרָל׃
verses.english: They part my garments among them, and cast lots upon my vesture.

verses.hebrew: וְאַתָּה יְהוָה אַל־תִּרְחָק אֱיָלוּתִי לְעֶזְרָתִי חוּשָׁה׃
verses.english: But be not Thou far from me, O Lord: O my strength, haste Thee to help me.

verses.hebrew: הַצִּילָה מֵחֶרֶב נַפְשִׁי מִיַּד־כֶּלֶב יְחִידָתִי׃
verses.english: Deliver my life from the sword; my only one from the power of the dog.

verses.hebrew: הוֹשִׁיעֵנִי מִפִּי אַרְיֵה וּמִקַּרְנֵי רֵמִים עֲנִיתָנִי׃
verses.english: Save me from the lion’s mouth: for Thou hast answered me from the horns of the wild oxen.

verses.hebrew: אֲסַפְּרָה שִׁמְךָ לְאֶחָי בְּתוֹךְ קָהָל אֲהַלְלֶךָּ׃
verses.english: I will declare Thy name to my brethren: in the midst of the congregation I will praise Thee.

verses.hebrew: יִרְאֵי יְהוָה הַלְלוּהוּ כָּל־זֶרַע יַעֲקֹב כַּבְּדוּהוּ וְגוּרוּ מִמֶּנּוּ כָּל־זֶרַע יִשְׂרָאֵל׃
verses.english: You who fear the Lord, praise him; all you the seed of Ya῾aqov, glorify him; and fear him, all the seed of Yisra᾽el.

verses.hebrew: כִּי לֹא־בָזָה וְלֹא שִׁקַּץ עֱנוּת עָנִי וְלֹא־הִסְתִּיר פָּנָיו מִמֶּנּוּ וּבְשַׁוְּעוֹ אֵלָיו שָׁמֵעַ׃
verses.english: For he has not despised nor abhorred the affliction of the afflicted; nor has he hid his face from him; but when he cried to him, he heard.

verses.hebrew: מֵאִתְּךָ תְהִלָּתִי בְּקָהָל רָב נְדָרַי אֲשַׁלֵּם נֶגֶד יְרֵאָיו׃
verses.english: My praise shall be of Thee in the great congregation: I will pay my vows before those who fear him.

verses.hebrew: יֹאכְלוּ עֲנָוִים וְיִשְׂבָּעוּ יְהַלְלוּ יְהוָה דֹּרְשָׁיו יְחִי לְבַבְכֶם לָעַד׃
verses.english: The meek shall eat and be satisfied: those who seek him shall praise the Lord: may your heart forever revive!

verses.hebrew: יִזְכְּרוּ וְיָשֻׁבוּ אֶל־יְהוָה כָּל־אַפְסֵי־אָרֶץ וְיִשְׁתַּחֲווּ לְפָנֶיךָ כָּל־מִשְׁפְּחוֹת גּוֹיִם׃
verses.english: All the ends of the world shall remember and turn to the Lord: and all the families of the nations shall worship before Thee.

verses.hebrew: כִּי לַיהוָה הַמְּלוּכָה וּמֹשֵׁל בַּגּוֹיִם׃
verses.english: For the kingdom is the Lord’s: and he is ruler over the nations.

verses.hebrew: אָכְלוּ וַיִּשְׁתַּחֲוּוּ כָּל־דִּשְׁנֵי־אֶרֶץ לְפָנָיו יִכְרְעוּ כָּל־יוֹרְדֵי עָפָר וְנַפְשׁוֹ לֹא חִיָּה׃
verses.english: All the fat ones of the earth shall eat and worship: all they that go down to the dust, and he that cannot keep alive his own soul, shall bow before him.

verses.hebrew: זֶרַע יַעַבְדֶנּוּ יְסֻפַּר לַאדֹנָי לַדּוֹר׃
verses.english: Their seed shall serve him; it shall be told of the Lord to the coming generation.

verses.hebrew: יָבֹאוּ וְיַגִּידוּ צִדְקָתוֹ לְעַם נוֹלָד כִּי עָשָׂה׃
verses.english: They shall come, and shall declare his righteousness to a people that shall be born, that he has done this.

verses.hebrew: מִזְמוֹר לְדָוִד יְהוָה רֹעִי לֹא אֶחְסָר׃
verses.english: A Psalm of David. The Lord is my shepherd; I shall not want.

verses.hebrew: בִּנְאוֹת דֶּשֶׁא יַרְבִּיצֵנִי עַל־מֵי מְנֻחוֹת יְנַהֲלֵנִי׃
verses.english: He makes me to lie down in green pastures: he leads me beside the still waters.

verses.hebrew: נַפְשִׁי יְשׁוֹבֵב יַנְחֵנִי בְמַעְגְּלֵי־צֶדֶק לְמַעַן שְׁמוֹ׃
verses.english: He restores my soul: he leads me in the paths of righteousness for his name’s sake.

verses.hebrew: גַּם כִּי־אֵלֵךְ בְּגֵיא צַלְמָוֶת לֹא־אִירָא רָע כִּי־אַתָּה עִמָּדִי שִׁבְטְךָ וּמִשְׁעַנְתֶּךָ הֵמָּה יְנַחֲמֻנִי׃
verses.english: Even though I walk through the valley of the shadow of death, I will fear no evil: for Thou art with me; Thy rod and Thy staff they comfort me.

verses.hebrew: תַּעֲרֹךְ לְפָנַי שֻׁלְחָן נֶגֶד צֹרְרָי דִּשַּׁנְתָּ בַשֶּׁמֶן רֹאשִׁי כּוֹסִי רְוָיָה׃
verses.english: Thou preparest a table before me in the presence of my enemies: Thou anointest my head with oil; my cup runs over.

verses.hebrew: אַךְ טוֹב וָחֶסֶד יִרְדְּפוּנִי כָּל־יְמֵי חַיָּי וְשַׁבְתִּי בְּבֵית־יְהוָה לְאֹרֶךְ יָמִים׃
verses.english: Surely goodness and mercy shall follow me all the days of my life: and I will dwell in the house of the Lord forever.

verses.hebrew: לְדָוִד מִזְמוֹר לַיהוָה הָאָרֶץ וּמְלוֹאָהּ תֵּבֵל וְיֹשְׁבֵי בָהּ׃
verses.english: A Psalm of David. The earth is the Lord’s, and the fulness thereof; the world, and they that dwell in it.

verses.hebrew: כִּי־הוּא עַל־יַמִּים יְסָדָהּ וְעַל־נְהָרוֹת יְכוֹנְנֶהָ׃
verses.english: For he has founded it upon the seas, and established it upon the floods.

verses.hebrew: מִי־יַעֲלֶה בְהַר־יְהוָה וּמִי־יָקוּם בִּמְקוֹם קָדְשׁוֹ׃
verses.english: Who shall ascend into the mountain of the Lord? or who shall stand in his holy place?

verses.hebrew: נְקִי כַפַּיִם וּבַר־לֵבָב אֲשֶׁר לֹא־נָשָׂא לַשָּׁוְא נַפְשִׁי וְלֹא נִשְׁבַּע לְמִרְמָה׃
verses.english: He that has clean hands, and a pure heart; who has not taken my name in vain, nor sworn deceitfully.

verses.hebrew: יִשָּׂא בְרָכָה מֵאֵת יְהוָה וּצְדָקָה מֵאֱלֹהֵי יִשְׁעוֹ׃
verses.english: He shall receive a blessing from the Lord, and righteousness from the God of his salvation.

verses.hebrew: זֶה דּוֹר דרשו [דֹּרְשָׁיו] מְבַקְשֵׁי פָנֶיךָ יַעֲקֹב סֶלָה׃
verses.english: This is Ya῾aqov, the generation of those who seek him, that seek Thy face. (Sela.)

verses.hebrew: שְׂאוּ שְׁעָרִים רָאשֵׁיכֶם וְהִנָּשְׂאוּ פִּתְחֵי עוֹלָם וְיָבוֹא מֶלֶךְ הַכָּבוֹד׃
verses.english: Lift up your heads, O you gates; and be lifted up, you everlasting doors; and the King of glory shall come in.

verses.hebrew: מִי זֶה מֶלֶךְ הַכָּבוֹד יְהוָה עִזּוּז וְגִבּוֹר יְהוָה גִּבּוֹר מִלְחָמָה׃
verses.english: Who is this King of glory? The Lord strong and mighty, the Lord mighty in battle.

verses.hebrew: שְׂאוּ שְׁעָרִים רָאשֵׁיכֶם וּשְׂאוּ פִּתְחֵי עוֹלָם וְיָבֹא מֶלֶךְ הַכָּבוֹד׃
verses.english: Lift up your heads, O you gates; and lift them up, you everlasting doors; that the King of glory may come in.

verses.hebrew: מִי הוּא זֶה מֶלֶךְ הַכָּבוֹד יְהוָה צְבָאוֹת הוּא מֶלֶךְ הַכָּבוֹד סֶלָה׃
verses.english: Who is this King of glory? The Lord of hosts, he is the King of glory. (Sela.)

verses.hebrew: לְדָוִד אֵלֶיךָ יְהוָה נַפְשִׁי אֶשָּׂא׃
verses.english: Of David. To Thee, O Lord, do I lift up my soul.

verses.hebrew: אֱ‍לֹהַי בְּךָ בָטַחְתִּי אַל־אֵבוֹשָׁה אַל־יַעַלְצוּ אֹיְבַי לִי׃
verses.english: O my God, I trust in Thee: let me not be ashamed, let not my enemies triumph over me.

verses.hebrew: גַּם כָּל־קֹוֶיךָ לֹא יֵבֹשׁוּ יֵבֹשׁוּ הַבּוֹגְדִים רֵיקָם׃
verses.english: Moreover let none that wait on Thee be ashamed: let them be ashamed who betray without cause.

verses.hebrew: דְּרָכֶיךָ יְהוָה הוֹדִיעֵנִי אֹרְחוֹתֶיךָ לַמְּדֵנִי׃
verses.english: Make me know Thy ways, O Lord; teach me Thy paths.

verses.hebrew: הַדְרִיכֵנִי בַאֲמִתֶּךָ וְלַמְּדֵנִי כִּי־אַתָּה אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׁעִי אוֹתְךָ קִוִּיתִי כָּל־הַיּוֹם׃
verses.english: Lead me in Thy truth, and teach me: for Thou art the God of my salvation; for Thee do I wait all the day.

verses.hebrew: זְכֹר־רַחֲמֶיךָ יְהוָה וַחֲסָדֶיךָ כִּי מֵעוֹלָם הֵמָּה׃
verses.english: Remember, O Lord, Thy tender mercies and Thy truth; for they have been from of old.

verses.hebrew: חַטֹּאות נְעוּרַי וּפְשָׁעַי אַל־תִּזְכֹּר כְּחַסְדְּךָ זְכָר־לִי־אַתָּה לְמַעַן טוּבְךָ יְהוָה׃
verses.english: Remember not the sins of my youth, nor my transgressions: according to Thy loyal love remember Thou me for Thy goodness’ sake, O Lord.

verses.hebrew: טוֹב־וְיָשָׁר יְהוָה עַל־כֵּן יוֹרֶה חַטָּאִים בַּדָּרֶךְ׃
verses.english: Good and upright is the Lord: therefore does he instruct sinners in the way.

verses.hebrew: יַדְרֵךְ עֲנָוִים בַּמִּשְׁפָּט וִילַמֵּד עֲנָוִים דַּרְכּוֹ׃
verses.english: He directs the humble in justice: and he teaches the meek his way.

verses.hebrew: כָּל־אָרְחוֹת יְהוָה חֶסֶד וֶאֱמֶת לְנֹצְרֵי בְרִיתוֹ וְעֵדֹתָיו׃
verses.english: All the paths of the Lord are mercy and truth to such as keep his covenant and his testimonies.

verses.hebrew: לְמַעַן־שִׁמְךָ יְהוָה וְסָלַחְתָּ לַעֲוֺנִי כִּי רַב־הוּא׃
verses.english: For Thy name’s sake, O Lord, pardon my iniquity; for it is great.

verses.hebrew: מִי־זֶה הָאִישׁ יְרֵא יְהוָה יוֹרֶנּוּ בְּדֶרֶךְ יִבְחָר׃
verses.english: What man is he that fears the Lord? him shall he teach in the way that he should choose.

verses.hebrew: נַפְשׁוֹ בְּטוֹב תָּלִין וְזַרְעוֹ יִירַשׁ אָרֶץ׃
verses.english: His soul shall abide in prosperity; and his seed shall inherit the earth.

verses.hebrew: סוֹד יְהוָה לִירֵאָיו וּבְרִיתוֹ לְהוֹדִיעָם׃
verses.english: The counsel of the Lord is with them that fear him; and he will reveal to them his covenant.

verses.hebrew: עֵינַי תָּמִיד אֶל־יְהוָה כִּי הוּא־יוֹצִיא מֵרֶשֶׁת רַגְלָי׃
verses.english: My eyes are ever towards the Lord; for he shall pluck my feet out of the net.

verses.hebrew: פְּנֵה־אֵלַי וְחָנֵּנִי כִּי־יָחִיד וְעָנִי אָנִי׃
verses.english: Turn Thee to me, and be gracious to me; for I am desolate and afflicted.

verses.hebrew: צָרוֹת לְבָבִי הִרְחִיבוּ מִמְּצוּקוֹתַי הוֹצִיאֵנִי׃
verses.english: The troubles of my heart are enlarged: O bring me out of my distresses.

verses.hebrew: רְאֵה עָנְיִי וַעֲמָלִי וְשָׂא לְכָל־חַטֹּאותָי׃
verses.english: Look upon my affliction and my pain; and forgive all my sins.

verses.hebrew: רְאֵה־אוֹיְבַי כִּי־רָבּוּ וְשִׂנְאַת חָמָס שְׂנֵאוּנִי׃
verses.english: Consider my enemies; for they are many; and they hate me with a cruel hatred.

verses.hebrew: שָׁמְרָה נַפְשִׁי וְהַצִּילֵנִי אַל־אֵבוֹשׁ כִּי־חָסִיתִי בָךְ׃
verses.english: O keep my soul, and deliver me: let me not be ashamed; for I put my trust in Thee.

verses.hebrew: תֹּם־וָיֹשֶׁר יִצְּרוּנִי כִּי קִוִּיתִיךָ׃
verses.english: Let integrity and uprightness preserve me; because I wait for Thee.

verses.hebrew: פְּדֵה אֱלֹהִים אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל מִכֹּל צָרוֹתָיו׃
verses.english: Redeem Yisra᾽el, O God, out of all his troubles.

verses.hebrew: לְדָוִד שָׁפְטֵנִי יְהוָה כִּי־אֲנִי בְּתֻמִּי הָלַכְתִּי וּבַיהוָה בָּטַחְתִּי לֹא אֶמְעָד׃
verses.english: Of David. Judge me, O Lord; for I have walked in my integrity: and I have trusted in the Lord; I shall not slip.

verses.hebrew: בְּחָנֵנִי יְהוָה וְנַסֵּנִי צרופה [צָרְפָה] כִלְיוֹתַי וְלִבִּי׃
verses.english: Examine me, O Lord, and prove me; try my reins and my heart.

verses.hebrew: כִּי־חַסְדְּךָ לְנֶגֶד עֵינָי וְהִתְהַלַּכְתִּי בַּאֲמִתֶּךָ׃
verses.english: For Thy loyal love is before my eyes: and I have walked in Thy truth.

verses.hebrew: לֹא־יָשַׁבְתִּי עִם־מְתֵי־שָׁוְא וְעִם נַעֲלָמִים לֹא אָבוֹא׃
verses.english: I have not sat with vain persons, neither do I enter the company of dissemblers.

verses.hebrew: שָׂנֵאתִי קְהַל מְרֵעִים וְעִם־רְשָׁעִים לֹא אֵשֵׁב׃
verses.english: I have hated the congregation of evil doers; and I do not sit with the wicked.

verses.hebrew: אֶרְחַץ בְּנִקָּיוֹן כַּפָּי וַאֲסֹבְבָה אֶת־מִזְבַּחֲךָ יְהוָה׃
verses.english: I wash my hands in innocency: so I compass Thy altar, O Lord:

verses.hebrew: לַשְׁמִעַ בְּקוֹל תּוֹדָה וּלְסַפֵּר כָּל־נִפְלְאוֹתֶיךָ׃
verses.english: that I may sound the voice of thanksgiving, and tell of all Thy wondrous works.

verses.hebrew: יְהוָה אָהַבְתִּי מְעוֹן בֵּיתֶךָ וּמְקוֹם מִשְׁכַּן כְּבוֹדֶךָ׃
verses.english: Lord, I love the habitation of Thy house, and the place where Thy glory dwells.

verses.hebrew: אַל־תֶּאֱסֹף עִם־חַטָּאִים נַפְשִׁי וְעִם־אַנְשֵׁי דָמִים חַיָּי׃
verses.english: Gather not my soul with sinners, nor my life with bloody men:

verses.hebrew: אֲשֶׁר־בִּידֵיהֶם זִמָּה וִימִינָם מָלְאָה שֹּׁחַד׃
verses.english: in whose hands is mischief, and their right hand is full of bribes.

verses.hebrew: וַאֲנִי בְּתֻמִּי אֵלֵךְ פְּדֵנִי וְחָנֵּנִי׃
verses.english: But as for me, I will walk in my integrity: redeem me, and be gracious unto me.

verses.hebrew: רַגְלִי עָמְדָה בְמִישׁוֹר בְּמַקְהֵלִים אֲבָרֵךְ יְהוָה׃
verses.english: My foot stands in an even place: in the congregations I will bless the Lord.

verses.hebrew: לְדָוִד יְהוָה אוֹרִי וְיִשְׁעִי מִמִּי אִירָא יְהוָה מָעוֹז־חַיַּי מִמִּי אֶפְחָד׃
verses.english: Of David. The Lord is my light and my salvation; whom shall I fear? the Lord is the stronghold of my life; of whom shall I be afraid?

verses.hebrew: בִּקְרֹב עָלַי מְרֵעִים לֶאֱכֹל אֶת־בְּשָׂרִי צָרַי וְאֹיְבַי לִי הֵמָּה כָשְׁלוּ וְנָפָלוּ׃
verses.english: When the wicked, my enemies and my foes, came upon me to eat up my flesh, they stumbled and fell.

verses.hebrew: אִם־תַּחֲנֶה עָלַי מַחֲנֶה לֹא־יִירָא לִבִּי אִם־תָּקוּם עָלַי מִלְחָמָה בְּזֹאת אֲנִי בוֹטֵחַ׃
verses.english: Though a host should camp against me, my heart shall not fear: though war should rise against me, even then I will be confident.

verses.hebrew: אַחַת שָׁאַלְתִּי מֵאֵת־יְהוָה אוֹתָהּ אֲבַקֵּשׁ שִׁבְתִּי בְּבֵית־יְהוָה כָּל־יְמֵי חַיַּי לַחֲזוֹת בְּנֹעַם־יְהוָה וּלְבַקֵּר בְּהֵיכָלוֹ׃
verses.english: One thing have I desired of the Lord, that will I seek after; that I may dwell in the house of the Lord all the days of my life, to behold the beauty of the Lord, and to inquire in his temple.

verses.hebrew: כִּי יִצְפְּנֵנִי בְּסֻכֹּה בְּיוֹם רָעָה יַסְתִּרֵנִי בְּסֵתֶר אָהֳלוֹ בְּצוּר יְרוֹמְמֵנִי׃
verses.english: For in the day of evil he shall hide me in his pavilion: in the covert of his tent he shall hide me; he shall set me up upon a rock.

verses.hebrew: וְעַתָּה יָרוּם רֹאשִׁי עַל אֹיְבַי סְבִיבוֹתַי וְאֶזְבְּחָה בְאָהֳלוֹ זִבְחֵי תְרוּעָה אָשִׁירָה וַאֲזַמְּרָה לַיהוָה׃
verses.english: And now shall my head be lifted up above my enemies round about me: therefore I will offer in his tabernacle sacrifices of joy; I will sing, and I will make melody to the Lord.

verses.hebrew: שְׁמַע־יְהוָה קוֹלִי אֶקְרָא וְחָנֵּנִי וַעֲנֵנִי׃
verses.english: Hear, O Lord, when I cry with my voice: be gracious to me, and answer me.

verses.hebrew: לְךָ אָמַר לִבִּי בַּקְּשׁוּ פָנָי אֶת־פָּנֶיךָ יְהוָה אֲבַקֵּשׁ׃
verses.english: Of Thee my heart has said, Seek my face. Thy face, O Lord, I seek.

verses.hebrew: אַל־תַּסְתֵּר פָּנֶיךָ מִמֶּנִּי אַל־תַּט־בְּאַף עַבְדֶּךָ עֶזְרָתִי הָיִיתָ אַל־תִּטְּשֵׁנִי וְאַל־תַּעַזְבֵנִי אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׁעִי׃
verses.english: Hide not Thy face from me; put not Thy servant away in anger: Thou hast been my help; abandon me not, nor forsake me, O God of my salvation.

verses.hebrew: כִּי־אָבִי וְאִמִּי עֲזָבוּנִי וַיהוָה יַאַסְפֵנִי׃
verses.english: For my father and my mother have forsaken me, but the Lord will take me up.

verses.hebrew: הוֹרֵנִי יְהוָה דַּרְכֶּךָ וּנְחֵנִי בְּאֹרַח מִישׁוֹר לְמַעַן שׁוֹרְרָי׃
verses.english: Teach me Thy way, O Lord, and lead me in an even path, because of my enemies.

verses.hebrew: אַל־תִּתְּנֵנִי בְּנֶפֶשׁ צָרָי כִּי קָמוּ־בִי עֵדֵי־שֶׁקֶר וִיפֵחַ חָמָס׃
verses.english: Deliver me not over to the will of my enemies: for false witnesses are risen up against me, and such as breathe out violence.

verses.hebrew: לוּלֵא הֶאֱמַנְתִּי לִרְאוֹת בְּטוּב־יְהוָה בְּאֶרֶץ חַיִּים׃
verses.english: Were it not that I believed I should see the goodness of the Lord in the land of the living.

verses.hebrew: קַוֵּה אֶל־יְהוָה חֲזַק וְיַאֲמֵץ לִבֶּךָ וְקַוֵּה אֶל־יְהוָה׃
verses.english: Wait on the Lord: be of good courage, and he shall strengthen thy heart: and wait on the Lord.

verses.hebrew: לְדָוִד אֵלֶיךָ יְהוָה אֶקְרָא צוּרִי אַל־תֶּחֱרַשׁ מִמֶּנִּי פֶּן־תֶּחֱשֶׁה מִמֶּנִּי וְנִמְשַׁלְתִּי עִם־יוֹרְדֵי בוֹר׃
verses.english: Of David. To Thee I will cry, O Lord; my rock; be not silent to me: lest, if Thou be silent to me, I become like those who go down into the pit.

verses.hebrew: שְׁמַע קוֹל תַּחֲנוּנַי בְּשַׁוְּעִי אֵלֶיךָ בְּנָשְׂאִי יָדַי אֶל־דְּבִיר קָדְשֶׁךָ׃
verses.english: Hear the voice of my supplications, when I cry to Thee, when I lift up my hands towards Thy holy sanctuary.

verses.hebrew: אַל־תִּמְשְׁכֵנִי עִם־רְשָׁעִים וְעִם־פֹּעֲלֵי אָוֶן דֹּבְרֵי שָׁלוֹם עִם־רֵעֵיהֶם וְרָעָה בִּלְבָבָם׃
verses.english: Drag me not away with the wicked, and with the workers of iniquity, who speak peace to their neighbours, but there is evil in their hearts.

verses.hebrew: תֶּן־לָהֶם כְּפָעֳלָם וּכְרֹעַ מַעַלְלֵיהֶם כְּמַעֲשֵׂה יְדֵיהֶם תֵּן לָהֶם הָשֵׁב גְּמוּלָם לָהֶם׃
verses.english: Give them according to their deeds, and according to the wickedness of their endeavours: give them after the work of their hands; render to them their desert.

verses.hebrew: כִּי לֹא יָבִינוּ אֶל־פְּעֻלֹּת יְהוָה וְאֶל־מַעֲשֵׂה יָדָיו יֶהֶרְסֵם וְלֹא יִבְנֵם׃
verses.english: Because they give no heed to the works of the Lord, nor to the operation of his hands, he will destroy them, and not build them up.

verses.hebrew: בָּרוּךְ יְהוָה כִּי־שָׁמַע קוֹל תַּחֲנוּנָי׃
verses.english: Blessed be the Lord, because he has heard the voice of my supplications.

verses.hebrew: יְהוָה עֻזִּי וּמָגִנִּי בּוֹ בָטַח לִבִּי וְנֶעֱזָרְתִּי וַיַּעֲלֹז לִבִּי וּמִשִּׁירִי אֲהוֹדֶנּוּ׃
verses.english: The Lord is my strength and my shield; my heart trusted in him, and I am helped: therefore my heart greatly rejoices; and with my song I will praise him.

verses.hebrew: יְהוָה עֹז־לָמוֹ וּמָעוֹז יְשׁוּעוֹת מְשִׁיחוֹ הוּא׃
verses.english: The Lord is a strength to them, and he is the saving strength of his anointed.

verses.hebrew: הוֹשִׁיעָה אֶת־עַמֶּךָ וּבָרֵךְ אֶת־נַחֲלָתֶךָ וּרְעֵם וְנַשְּׂאֵם עַד־הָעוֹלָם׃
verses.english: Save Thy people, and bless Thy inheritance: and shepherd them, and carry them forever.

verses.hebrew: מִזְמוֹר לְדָוִד הָבוּ לַיהוָה בְּנֵי אֵלִים הָבוּ לַיהוָה כָּבוֹד וָעֹז׃
verses.english: A Psalm of David. Ascribe to the Lord, O you mighty, ascribe to the Lord glory and strength.

verses.hebrew: הָבוּ לַיהוָה כְּבוֹד שְׁמוֹ הִשְׁתַּחֲווּ לַיהוָה בְּהַדְרַת־קֹדֶשׁ׃
verses.english: Give to the Lord the glory due to his name; worship the Lord in the beauty of holiness.

verses.hebrew: קוֹל יְהוָה עַל־הַמָּיִם אֵל־הַכָּבוֹד הִרְעִים יְהוָה עַל־מַיִם רַבִּים׃
verses.english: The voice of the Lord is upon the waters: the God of glory thunders: the Lord is upon many waters.

verses.hebrew: קוֹל־יְהוָה בַּכֹּחַ קוֹל יְהוָה בֶּהָדָר׃
verses.english: The voice of the Lord is powerful; the voice of the Lord is full of majesty.

verses.hebrew: קוֹל יְהוָה שֹׁבֵר אֲרָזִים וַיְשַׁבֵּר יְהוָה אֶת־אַרְזֵי הַלְּבָנוֹן׃
verses.english: The voice of the Lord breaks the cedars; yea, the Lord breaks the cedars of the Levanon.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּרְקִידֵם כְּמוֹ־עֵגֶל לְבָנוֹן וְשִׂרְיֹן כְּמוֹ בֶן־רְאֵמִים׃
verses.english: He makes them also skip like a calf; Levanon and Shiryon like a young wild ox.

verses.hebrew: קוֹל־יְהוָה חֹצֵב לַהֲבוֹת אֵשׁ׃
verses.english: The voice of the Lord divides the flames of fire.

verses.hebrew: קוֹל יְהוָה יָחִיל מִדְבָּר יָחִיל יְהוָה מִדְבַּר קָדֵשׁ׃
verses.english: The voice of the Lord shakes the wilderness; the Lord shakes the wilderness of Qadesh.

verses.hebrew: קוֹל יְהוָה יְחוֹלֵל אַיָּלוֹת וַיֶּחֱשֹׂף יְעָרוֹת וּבְהֵיכָלוֹ כֻּלּוֹ אֹמֵר כָּבוֹד׃
verses.english: The voice of the Lord makes the hinds to calve, and strips the forests bare, and in his temple everyone speaks of his glory.

verses.hebrew: יְהוָה לַמַּבּוּל יָשָׁב וַיֵּשֶׁב יְהוָה מֶלֶךְ לְעוֹלָם׃
verses.english: The Lord sat enthroned at the flood; and he sits enthroned as King forever.

verses.hebrew: יְהוָה עֹז לְעַמּוֹ יִתֵּן יְהוָה יְבָרֵךְ אֶת־עַמּוֹ בַשָּׁלוֹם׃
verses.english: The Lord gives strength to his people; the Lord blesses his people with peace.

verses.hebrew: מִזְמוֹר שִׁיר־חֲנֻכַּת הַבַּיִת לְדָוִד׃
verses.english: A Psalm and Song at the dedication of the house; of David.

verses.hebrew: אֲרוֹמִמְךָ יְהוָה כִּי דִלִּיתָנִי וְלֹא־שִׂמַּחְתָּ אֹיְבַי לִי׃
verses.english: I will extol Thee, O Lord; for Thou hast lifted me up, and hast not made my foes to rejoice over me.

verses.hebrew: יְהוָה אֱלֹהָי שִׁוַּעְתִּי אֵלֶיךָ וַתִּרְפָּאֵנִי׃
verses.english: O Lord my God, I cried to Thee and Thou hast healed me.

verses.hebrew: יְהוָה הֶעֱלִיתָ מִן־שְׁאוֹל נַפְשִׁי חִיִּיתַנִי מיורדי־[מִיָּרְדִי־] בוֹר׃
verses.english: O Lord, Thou hast brought up my soul from She᾽ol: Thou hast kept me alive, that I should not go down to the pit.

verses.hebrew: זַמְּרוּ לַיהוָה חֲסִידָיו וְהוֹדוּ לְזֵכֶר קָדְשׁוֹ׃
verses.english: Sing to the Lord, O his pious ones, and give thanks to his holy name.

verses.hebrew: כִּי רֶגַע בְּאַפּוֹ חַיִּים בִּרְצוֹנוֹ בָּעֶרֶב יָלִין בֶּכִי וְלַבֹּקֶר רִנָּה׃
verses.english: For his anger endures but a moment; in his favour is life: weeping may endure for a night, but joy comes in the morning.

verses.hebrew: וַאֲנִי אָמַרְתִּי בְשַׁלְוִי בַּל־אֶמּוֹט לְעוֹלָם׃
verses.english: And in my prosperity I said, I shall never be moved.

verses.hebrew: יְהוָה בִּרְצוֹנְךָ הֶעֱמַדְתָּה לְהַרְרִי עֹז הִסְתַּרְתָּ פָנֶיךָ הָיִיתִי נִבְהָל׃
verses.english: Lord, by Thy favour Thou hast made my mountain to stand strong: Thou didst hide Thy face, and I was affrighted.

verses.hebrew: אֵלֶיךָ יְהוָה אֶקְרָא וְאֶל־אֲדֹנָי אֶתְחַנָּן׃
verses.english: I cried to Thee, O Lord; and to the Lord I made supplication.

verses.hebrew: מַה־בֶּצַע בְּדָמִי בְּרִדְתִּי אֶל־שָׁחַת הֲיוֹדְךָ עָפָר הֲיַגִּיד אֲמִתֶּךָ׃
verses.english: What profit is there in my blood, when I go down to the pit? Shall dust praise Thee? shall it declare Thy truth?

verses.hebrew: שְׁמַע־יְהוָה וְחָנֵּנִי יְהוָה הֱ‍יֵה־עֹזֵר לִי׃
verses.english: Hear, O Lord, and be gracious to me: Lord, be Thou my helper.

verses.hebrew: הָפַכְתָּ מִסְפְּדִי לְמָחוֹל לִי פִּתַּחְתָּ שַׂקִּי וַתְּאַזְּרֵנִי שִׂמְחָה׃
verses.english: Thou hast turned for me my mourning into dancing: Thou hast loosed my sackcloth, and girded me with gladness;

verses.hebrew: לְמַעַן יְזַמֶּרְךָ כָבוֹד וְלֹא יִדֹּם יְהוָה אֱלֹהַי לְעוֹלָם אוֹדֶךָּ׃
verses.english: to the end that my glory may sing praise to Thee, and not be silent. O Lord my God, I will give thanks to Thee forever.

verses.hebrew: לַמְנַצֵּחַ מִזְמוֹר לְדָוִד׃
verses.english: To the chief Musician, A Psalm of David.

verses.hebrew: בְּךָ יְהוָה חָסִיתִי אַל־אֵבוֹשָׁה לְעוֹלָם בְּצִדְקָתְךָ פַלְּטֵנִי׃
