verses.english: In Thee, O Lord, do I take refuge; let me never be ashamed: deliver me in Thy righteousness.

verses.hebrew: הַטֵּה אֵלַי אָזְנְךָ מְהֵרָה הַצִּילֵנִי הֱיֵה לִי לְצוּר־מָעוֹז לְבֵית מְצוּדוֹת לְהוֹשִׁיעֵנִי׃
verses.english: Incline Thy ear to me; deliver me speedily: be Thou my strong rock, a fortress of defence to save me.

verses.hebrew: כִּי־סַלְעִי וּמְצוּדָתִי אָתָּה וּלְמַעַן שִׁמְךָ תַּנְחֵנִי וּתְנַהֲלֵנִי׃
verses.english: For Thou art my rock and my fortress; therefore for Thy name’s sake lead me, and guide me.

verses.hebrew: תּוֹצִיאֵנִי מֵרֶשֶׁת זוּ טָמְנוּ לִי כִּי־אַתָּה מָעוּזִּי׃
verses.english: Pull me out of the net that they have hidden for me: for Thou art my stronghold.

verses.hebrew: בְּיָדְךָ אַפְקִיד רוּחִי פָּדִיתָה אוֹתִי יְהוָה אֵל אֱמֶת׃
verses.english: Into Thy hand I commit my spirit: Thou hast redeemed me, O Lord God of truth.

verses.hebrew: שָׂנֵאתִי הַשֹּׁמְרִים הַבְלֵי־שָׁוְא וַאֲנִי אֶל־יְהוָה בָּטָחְתִּי׃
verses.english: I hate them that regard vain idols: but I trust in the Lord.

verses.hebrew: אָגִילָה וְאֶשְׂמְחָה בְּחַסְדֶּךָ אֲשֶׁר רָאִיתָ אֶת־עָנְיִי יָדַעְתָּ בְּצָרוֹת נַפְשִׁי׃
verses.english: I will be glad and rejoice in Thy loyal love: for Thou hast considered my affliction: Thou hast known the troubles of my soul;

verses.hebrew: וְלֹא הִסְגַּרְתַּנִי בְּיַד־אוֹיֵב הֶעֱמַדְתָּ בַמֶּרְחָב רַגְלָי׃
verses.english: and Thou hast not delivered me up into the hand of the enemy: Thou hast set my feet in a broad place.

verses.hebrew: חָנֵּנִי יְהוָה כִּי צַר־לִי עָשְׁשָׁה בְכַעַס עֵינִי נַפְשִׁי וּבִטְנִי׃
verses.english: Be gracious to me, O Lord, for I am in trouble: my eye is consumed with grief, my soul and my body.

verses.hebrew: כִּי כָלוּ בְיָגוֹן חַיַּי וּשְׁנוֹתַי בַּאֲנָחָה כָּשַׁל בַּעֲוֺנִי כֹחִי וַעֲצָמַי עָשֵׁשׁוּ׃
verses.english: For my life is spent with grief, and my years with sighing: my strength fails because of my iniquity, and my bones are wasted away.

verses.hebrew: מִכָּל־צֹרְרַי הָיִיתִי חֶרְפָּה וְלִשֲׁכֵנַי מְאֹד וּפַחַד לִמְיֻדָּעָי רֹאַי בַּחוּץ נָדְדוּ מִמֶּנִּי׃
verses.english: I am the scorn of all my adversaries, and very much of my neighbours, and a dread to my acquaintances: those who see me in the street flee from me.

verses.hebrew: נִשְׁכַּחְתִּי כְּמֵת מִלֵּב הָיִיתִי כִּכְלִי אֹבֵד׃
verses.english: I am forgotten as a dead man out of mind: I am like a broken vessel.

verses.hebrew: כִּי שָׁמַעְתִּי דִּבַּת רַבִּים מָגוֹר מִסָּבִיב בְּהִוָּסְדָם יַחַד עָלַי לָקַחַת נַפְשִׁי זָמָמוּ׃
verses.english: For I have heard the slander of many: fear on every side: while they took counsel together against me, they devised to take away my life.

verses.hebrew: וַאֲנִי עָלֶיךָ בָטַחְתִּי יְהוָה אָמַרְתִּי אֱלֹהַי אָתָּה׃
verses.english: But I trusted in Thee, O Lord: I said, Thou art my God.

verses.hebrew: בְּיָדְךָ עִתֹּתָי הַצִּילֵנִי מִיַּד־אוֹיְבַי וּמֵרֹדְפָי׃
verses.english: My times are in Thy hand: deliver me from the hand of my enemies, and from those who persecute me.

verses.hebrew: הָאִירָה פָנֶיךָ עַל־עַבְדֶּךָ הוֹשִׁיעֵנִי בְחַסְדֶּךָ׃
verses.english: Make Thy face to shine upon Thy servant: save me by Thy loyal love.

verses.hebrew: יְהוָה אַל־אֵבוֹשָׁה כִּי קְרָאתִיךָ יֵבֹשׁוּ רְשָׁעִים יִדְּמוּ לִשְׁאוֹל׃
verses.english: Let me not be ashamed, O Lord; for I have called upon Thee: let the wicked be ashamed, and let them be silent in She᾽ol.

verses.hebrew: תֵּאָלַמְנָה שִׂפְתֵי שָׁקֶר הַדֹּבְרוֹת עַל־צַדִּיק עָתָק בְּגַאֲוָה וָבוּז׃
verses.english: Let the lying lips be put to silence; which speak arrogant words, proudly and contemptuously, against the righteous.

verses.hebrew: מָה רַב־טוּבְךָ אֲשֶׁר־צָפַנְתָּ לִּירֵאֶיךָ פָּעַלְתָּ לַחֹסִים בָּךְ נֶגֶד בְּנֵי אָדָם׃
verses.english: Oh how great is Thy goodness, which Thou has laid up for those who fear Thee; which Thou hast performed for those who trust in Thee in the sight of the sons of men!

verses.hebrew: תַּסְתִּירֵם בְּסֵתֶר פָּנֶיךָ מֵרֻכְסֵי אִישׁ תִּצְפְּנֵם בְּסֻכָּה מֵרִיב לְשֹׁנוֹת׃
verses.english: Thou hidest them in the covert of Thy presence from the plots of men: Thou shalt keep them secretly in a pavilion from the strife of tongues.

verses.hebrew: בָּרוּךְ יְהוָה כִּי הִפְלִיא חַסְדּוֹ לִי בְּעִיר מָצוֹר׃
verses.english: Blessed be the Lord: for he has shown me his marvellous love in a strong city.

verses.hebrew: וַאֲנִי אָמַרְתִּי בְחָפְזִי נִגְרַזְתִּי מִנֶּגֶד עֵינֶיךָ אָכֵן שָׁמַעְתָּ קוֹל תַּחֲנוּנַי בְּשַׁוְּעִי אֵלֶיךָ׃
verses.english: For I said in my haste, I am cut off from before Thy eyes: nevertheless Thou didst hear the voice of my supplications when I cried to Thee.

verses.hebrew: אֶהֱבוּ אֶת־יְהוָה כָּל־חֲסִידָיו אֱמוּנִים נֹצֵר יְהוָה וּמְשַׁלֵּם עַל־יֶתֶר עֹשֵׂה גַאֲוָה׃
verses.english: O love the Lord, all his pious ones: for the Lord preserves the faithful, and plentifully repays him who acts haughtily.

verses.hebrew: חִזְקוּ וְיַאֲמֵץ לְבַבְכֶם כָּל־הַמְיַחֲלִים לַיהוָה׃
verses.english: Be of good courage, and let your heart be strong, all you who hope in the Lord.

verses.hebrew: לְדָוִד מַשְׂכִּיל אַשְׁרֵי נְשׂוּי־פֶּשַׁע כְּסוּי חֲטָאָה׃
verses.english: Of David. A maskil. Blessed is he whose transgression is forgiven, whose sin is covered.

verses.hebrew: אַשְׁרֵי אָדָם לֹא יַחְשֹׁב יְהוָה לוֹ עָוֺן וְאֵין בְּרוּחוֹ רְמִיָּה׃
verses.english: Blessed is the man to whom the Lord imputes no iniquity, and in whose spirit there is no guile.

verses.hebrew: כִּי־הֶחֱרַשְׁתִּי בָּלוּ עֲצָמָי בְּשַׁאֲגָתִי כָּל־הַיּוֹם׃
verses.english: When I kept silence, my bones wasted away through my groaning all the day long.

verses.hebrew: כִּי יוֹמָם וָלַיְלָה תִּכְבַּד עָלַי יָדֶךָ נֶהְפַּךְ לְשַׁדִּי בְּחַרְבֹנֵי קַיִץ סֶלָה׃
verses.english: For day and night Thy hand was heavy upon me: my moisture is turned into the drought of summer. (Sela.)

verses.hebrew: חַטָּאתִי אוֹדִיעֲךָ וַעֲוֺנִי לֹא־כִסִּיתִי אָמַרְתִּי אוֹדֶה עֲלֵי פְשָׁעַי לַיהוָה וְאַתָּה נָשָׂאתָ עֲוֺן חַטָּאתִי סֶלָה׃
verses.english: I acknowledged my sin to Thee, and my iniquity I have not hid. I said, I will confess my transgressions to the Lord; and Thou didst forgive the iniquity of my sin. (Sela.)

verses.hebrew: עַל־זֹאת יִתְפַּלֵּל כָּל־חָסִיד אֵלֶיךָ לְעֵת מְצֹא רַק לְשֵׁטֶף מַיִם רַבִּים אֵלָיו לֹא יַגִּיעוּ׃
verses.english: For this shall everyone that is godly pray to Thee in a time when Thou mayst be found: then surely the floods of great waters shall not come near him.

verses.hebrew: אַתָּה סֵתֶר לִי מִצַּר תִּצְּרֵנִי רָנֵּי פַלֵּט תְּסוֹבְבֵנִי סֶלָה׃
verses.english: Thou art my hiding place; Thou shalt preserve me from trouble; Thou dost compass me about with songs of deliverance. (Sela.)

verses.hebrew: אַשְׂכִּילְךָ וְאוֹרְךָ בְּדֶרֶךְ־זוּ תֵלֵךְ אִיעֲצָה עָלֶיךָ עֵינִי׃
verses.english: I will instruct thee and teach thee in the way which thou shalt go: I will counsel thee, with my eye upon thee.

verses.hebrew: אַל־תִּהְיוּ כְּסוּס כְּפֶרֶד אֵין הָבִין בְּמֶתֶג־וָרֶסֶן עֶדְיוֹ לִבְלוֹם בַּל קְרֹב אֵלֶיךָ׃
verses.english: Be not like the horse, or the mule, which have no understanding: whose mouth must be held in with bit and bridle, that they come not near to thee.

verses.hebrew: רַבִּים מַכְאוֹבִים לָרָשָׁע וְהַבּוֹטֵחַ בַּיהוָה חֶסֶד יְסוֹבְבֶנּוּ׃
verses.english: Many are the sorrows of the wicked: but he that trusts in the Lord, shall be surrounded by love.

verses.hebrew: שִׂמְחוּ בַיהוָה וְגִילוּ צַדִּיקִים וְהַרְנִינוּ כָּל־יִשְׁרֵי־לֵב׃
verses.english: Be glad in the Lord, and rejoice, O you righteous: and shout for joy, all you who are upright in heart.

verses.hebrew: רַנְּנוּ צַדִּיקִים בַּיהוָה לַיְשָׁרִים נָאוָה תְהִלָּה׃
verses.english: Rejoice in the Lord, O you righteous: praise is comely for the upright.

verses.hebrew: הוֹדוּ לַיהוָה בְּכִנּוֹר בְּנֵבֶל עָשׂוֹר זַמְּרוּ־לוֹ׃
verses.english: Praise the Lord with a lyre: make melody to him with the harp of ten strings.

verses.hebrew: שִׁירוּ־לוֹ שִׁיר חָדָשׁ הֵיטִיבוּ נַגֵּן בִּתְרוּעָה׃
verses.english: Sing to him a new song; play skillfully with loud jubilations.

verses.hebrew: כִּי־יָשָׁר דְּבַר־יְהוָה וְכָל־מַעֲשֵׂהוּ בֶּאֱמוּנָה׃
verses.english: For the word of the Lord is right; and all his work is done in faithfulness.

verses.hebrew: אֹהֵב צְדָקָה וּמִשְׁפָּט חֶסֶד יְהוָה מָלְאָה הָאָרֶץ׃
verses.english: He loves righteousness and judgment: the earth is full of the goodness of the Lord.

verses.hebrew: בִּדְבַר יְהוָה שָׁמַיִם נַעֲשׂוּ וּבְרוּחַ פִּיו כָּל־צְבָאָם׃
verses.english: By the word of the Lord were the heavens made; and all the host of them by the breath of his mouth.

verses.hebrew: כֹּנֵס כַּנֵּד מֵי הַיָּם נֹתֵן בְּאֹצָרוֹת תְּהוֹמוֹת׃
verses.english: He gathers the waters of the sea together like a rampart: he lays up the depths in storehouses.

verses.hebrew: יִירְאוּ מֵיְהוָה כָּל־הָאָרֶץ מִמֶּנּוּ יָגוּרוּ כָּל־יֹשְׁבֵי תֵבֵל׃
verses.english: Let all the earth fear the Lord: let all the inhabitants of the world stand in awe of him.

verses.hebrew: כִּי הוּא אָמַר וַיֶּהִי הוּא־צִוָּה וַיַּעֲמֹד׃
verses.english: For he spoke, and it was; he commanded, and it stood fast.

verses.hebrew: יְהוָה הֵפִיר עֲצַת־גּוֹיִם הֵנִיא מַחְשְׁבוֹת עַמִּים׃
verses.english: The Lord brings the counsel of the nations to nought: he makes the devices of the peoples to be of no effect.

verses.hebrew: עֲצַת יְהוָה לְעוֹלָם תַּעֲמֹד מַחְשְׁבוֹת לִבּוֹ לְדֹר וָדֹר׃
verses.english: The counsel of the Lord stands forever, the thoughts of his heart to all generations.

verses.hebrew: אַשְׁרֵי הַגּוֹי אֲשֶׁר־יְהוָה אֱלֹהָיו הָעָם בָּחַר לְנַחֲלָה לוֹ׃
verses.english: Happy is the nation whose God is the Lord; and the people whom he has chosen for his own inheritance.

verses.hebrew: מִשָּׁמַיִם הִבִּיט יְהוָה רָאָה אֶת־כָּל־בְּנֵי הָאָדָם׃
verses.english: The Lord looks down from heaven; he beholds all the sons of men.

verses.hebrew: מִמְּכוֹן־שִׁבְתּוֹ הִשְׁגִּיחַ אֶל כָּל־יֹשְׁבֵי הָאָרֶץ׃
verses.english: From the place of his habitation he looks upon all the inhabitants of the earth;

verses.hebrew: הַיֹּצֵר יַחַד לִבָּם הַמֵּבִין אֶל־כָּל־מַעֲשֵׂיהֶם׃
verses.english: he who fashions their hearts alike; who considers all their deeds.

verses.hebrew: אֵין־הַמֶּלֶךְ נוֹשָׁע בְּרָב־חָיִל גִּבּוֹר לֹא־יִנָּצֵל בְּרָב־כֹּחַ׃
verses.english: There is no king saved by the multitude of a host: a mighty man is not delivered by great strength.

verses.hebrew: שֶׁקֶר הַסּוּס לִתְשׁוּעָה וּבְרֹב חֵילוֹ לֹא יְמַלֵּט׃
verses.english: A horse is a vain thing for safety: nor shall he save by his great strength.

verses.hebrew: הִנֵּה עֵין יְהוָה אֶל־יְרֵאָיו לַמְיַחֲלִים לְחַסְדּוֹ׃
verses.english: Behold, the eye of the Lord is upon those who fear him, upon those who hope in his steadfast love:

verses.hebrew: לְהַצִּיל מִמָּוֶת נַפְשָׁם וּלְחַיּוֹתָם בָּרָעָב׃
verses.english: to deliver their soul from death, and to keep them alive in famine.

verses.hebrew: נַפְשֵׁנוּ חִכְּתָה לַיהוָה עֶזְרֵנוּ וּמָגִנֵּנוּ הוּא׃
verses.english: Our soul waited for the Lord: he is our help and our shield.

verses.hebrew: כִּי־בוֹ יִשְׂמַח לִבֵּנוּ כִּי בְשֵׁם קָדְשׁוֹ בָטָחְנוּ׃
verses.english: For our heart shall rejoice in him, because we have trusted in his holy name.

verses.hebrew: יְהִי־חַסְדְּךָ יְהוָה עָלֵינוּ כַּאֲשֶׁר יִחַלְנוּ לָךְ׃
verses.english: Let Thy steadfast love, O Lord be upon us, even as we hope in Thee.

verses.hebrew: לְדָוִד בְּשַׁנּוֹתוֹ אֶת־טַעְמוֹ לִפְנֵי אֲבִימֶלֶךְ וַיְגָרֲשֵׁהוּ וַיֵּלַךְ׃
verses.english: Of David, when he changed his demeanour before Avimelekh; who drove him away, and he departed.

verses.hebrew: אֲבָרֲכָה אֶת־יְהוָה בְּכָל־עֵת תָּמִיד תְּהִלָּתוֹ בְּפִי׃
verses.english: I will bless the Lord at all time: his praise shall continually be in my mouth.

verses.hebrew: בַּיהוָה תִּתְהַלֵּל נַפְשִׁי יִשְׁמְעוּ עֲנָוִים וְיִשְׂמָחוּ׃
verses.english: My soul shall glory in the Lord: the humble shall hear of it, and be glad.

verses.hebrew: גַּדְּלוּ לַיהוָה אִתִּי וּנְרוֹמְמָה שְׁמוֹ יַחְדָּו׃
verses.english: O magnify the Lord with me, and let us exalt his name together.

verses.hebrew: דָּרַשְׁתִּי אֶת־יְהוָה וְעָנָנִי וּמִכָּל־מְגוּרוֹתַי הִצִּילָנִי׃
verses.english: I sought the Lord, and he answered me, and delivered me from all my fears.

verses.hebrew: הִבִּיטוּ אֵלָיו וְנָהָרוּ וּפְנֵיהֶם אַל־יֶחְפָּרוּ׃
verses.english: They looked to him, and are radiant: and their faces shall not be ashamed.

verses.hebrew: זֶה עָנִי קָרָא וַיהוָה שָׁמֵעַ וּמִכָּל־צָרוֹתָיו הוֹשִׁיעוֹ׃
verses.english: This poor man cries, and the Lord hears, and saves him out of all his troubles.

verses.hebrew: חֹנֶה מַלְאַךְ־יְהוָה סָבִיב לִירֵאָיו וַיְחַלְּצֵם׃
verses.english: The angel of the Lord encamps round about those who fear him, and he delivers them.

verses.hebrew: טַעֲמוּ וּרְאוּ כִּי־טוֹב יְהוָה אַשְׁרֵי הַגֶּבֶר יֶחֱסֶה־בּוֹ׃
verses.english: O taste and see that the Lord is good: blessed is the man who trusts in him.

verses.hebrew: יְראוּ אֶת־יְהוָה קְדֹשָׁיו כִּי־אֵין מַחְסוֹר לִירֵאָיו׃
verses.english: O fear the Lord, you saints of his: for those who fear him have no lack.

verses.hebrew: כְּפִירִים רָשׁוּ וְרָעֵבוּ וְדֹרְשֵׁי יְהוָה לֹא־יַחְסְרוּ כָל־טוֹב׃
verses.english: The young lions lack, and suffer hunger: but they who seek the Lord shall not want any good thing.

verses.hebrew: לְכוּ־בָנִים שִׁמְעוּ־לִי יִרְאַת יְהוָה אֲלַמֶּדְכֶם׃
verses.english: Come, children, hearken to me: I will teach you the fear of the Lord.

verses.hebrew: מִי־הָאִישׁ הֶחָפֵץ חַיִּים אֹהֵב יָמִים לִרְאוֹת טוֹב׃
verses.english: Who is the man that desires life, and loves many days, that he may see good?

verses.hebrew: נְצֹר לְשׁוֹנְךָ מֵרָע וּשְׂפָתֶיךָ מִדַּבֵּר מִרְמָה׃
verses.english: Keep thy tongue from evil, and thy lips from speaking guile.

verses.hebrew: סוּר מֵרָע וַעֲשֵׂה־טוֹב בַּקֵּשׁ שָׁלוֹם וְרָדְפֵהוּ׃
verses.english: Depart from evil, and do good; seek peace, and pursue it.

verses.hebrew: עֵינֵי יְהוָה אֶל־צַדִּיקִים וְאָזְנָיו אֶל־שַׁוְעָתָם׃
verses.english: The eyes of the Lord are towards the righteous, and his ears are open to their cry.

verses.hebrew: פְּנֵי יְהוָה בְּעֹשֵׂי רָע לְהַכְרִית מֵאֶרֶץ זִכְרָם׃
verses.english: The face of the Lord is against those who do evil, to cut off the remembrance of them from the earth.

verses.hebrew: צָעֲקוּ וַיהוָה שָׁמֵעַ וּמִכָּל־צָרוֹתָם הִצִּילָם׃
verses.english: The righteous cry, and the Lord hears, and delivers them out of all their troubles.

verses.hebrew: קָרוֹב יְהוָה לְנִשְׁבְּרֵי־לֵב וְאֶת־דַּכְּאֵי־רוּחַ יוֹשִׁיעַ׃
verses.english: The Lord is near to them who are of a broken heart; and he saves such as are of a contrite spirit.

verses.hebrew: רַבּוֹת רָעוֹת צַדִּיק וּמִכֻּלָּם יַצִּילֶנּוּ יְהוָה׃
verses.english: Many are the afflictions of the righteous: but the Lord delivers him out of them all.

verses.hebrew: שֹׁמֵר כָּל־עַצְמוֹתָיו אַחַת מֵהֵנָּה לֹא נִשְׁבָּרָה׃
verses.english: He keeps all his bones: not one of them is broken.

verses.hebrew: תְּמוֹתֵת רָשָׁע רָעָה וְשֹׂנְאֵי צַדִּיק יֶאְשָׁמוּ׃
verses.english: Evil shall slay the wicked: and they that hate the righteous shall be condemned.

verses.hebrew: פּוֹדֶה יְהוָה נֶפֶשׁ עֲבָדָיו וְלֹא יֶאְשְׁמוּ כָּל־הַחֹסִים בּוֹ׃
verses.english: The Lord redeems the soul of his servants: and none of them that trust in him shall be condemned.

verses.hebrew: לְדָוִד רִיבָה יְהוָה אֶת־יְרִיבַי לְחַם אֶת־לֹחֲמָי׃
verses.english: Of David. Strive, O Lord, with those who contend against me: fight with those who oppose me.

verses.hebrew: הַחֲזֵק מָגֵן וְצִנָּה וְקוּמָה בְּעֶזְרָתִי׃
verses.english: Take hold of shield and buckler, and rise up for my help.

verses.hebrew: וְהָרֵק חֲנִית וּסְגֹר לִקְרַאת רֹדְפָי אֱמֹר לְנַפְשִׁי יְשֻׁעָתֵךְ אָנִי׃
verses.english: Draw out also the spear, and battle axe against those who persecute me: say to my soul, I am thy salvation.

verses.hebrew: יֵבֹשׁוּ וְיִכָּלְמוּ מְבַקְשֵׁי נַפְשִׁי יִסֹּגוּ אָחוֹר וְיַחְפְּרוּ חֹשְׁבֵי רָעָתִי׃
verses.english: Let them be confounded and put to shame who seek after my soul: let them be turned back and brought to confusion who devise my hurt.

verses.hebrew: יִהְיוּ כְּמֹץ לִפְנֵי־רוּחַ וּמַלְאַךְ יְהוָה דּוֹחֶה׃
verses.english: Let them be as chaff before the wind: the angel of the Lord thrusting them.

verses.hebrew: יְהִי־דַרְכָּם חֹשֶׁךְ וַחֲלַקְלַקּוֹת וּמַלְאַךְ יְהוָה רֹדְפָם׃
verses.english: Let their way be dark and slippery: the angel of the Lord pursuing them.

verses.hebrew: כִּי־חִנָּם טָמְנוּ־לִי שַׁחַת רִשְׁתָּם חִנָּם חָפְרוּ לְנַפְשִׁי׃
verses.english: For without cause have they hid for me their net; a pit without cause have they dug for my soul.

verses.hebrew: תְּבוֹאֵהוּ שׁוֹאָה לֹא־יֵדָע וְרִשְׁתּוֹ אֲשֶׁר־טָמַן תִּלְכְּדוֹ בְּשׁוֹאָה יִפָּל־בָּהּ׃
verses.english: Let destruction come upon him unawares; and let his net that he has hid catch himself: let him fall to ruin.

verses.hebrew: וְנַפְשִׁי תָּגִיל בַּיהוָה תָּשִׂישׂ בִּישׁוּעָתוֹ׃
verses.english: And my soul shall be joyful in the Lord: it shall rejoice in his salvation.

verses.hebrew: כָּל עַצְמוֹתַי תֹּאמַרְנָה יְהוָה מִי כָמוֹךָ מַצִּיל עָנִי מֵחָזָק מִמֶּנּוּ וְעָנִי וְאֶבְיוֹן מִגֹּזְלוֹ׃
verses.english: All my bones shall say, Lord, who is like Thee, who delivers the poor from him that is too strong for him, and the poor and the needy from him that robs him?

verses.hebrew: יְקוּמוּן עֵדֵי חָמָס אֲשֶׁר לֹא־יָדַעְתִּי יִשְׁאָלוּנִי׃
verses.english: False witnesses rise up; they ask me things that I know not.

verses.hebrew: יְשַׁלְּמוּנִי רָעָה תַּחַת טוֹבָה שְׁכוֹל לְנַפְשִׁי׃
verses.english: They repay me evil for good; a bereavement to my soul!

verses.hebrew: וַאֲנִי בַּחֲלוֹתָם לְבוּשִׁי שָׂק עִנֵּיתִי בַצּוֹם נַפְשִׁי וּתְפִלָּתִי עַל־חֵיקִי תָשׁוּב׃
verses.english: But as for me, when they were sick, my clothing was sackcloth: I afflicted my soul with fasting; and as for my prayer may it return to my own bosom.

verses.hebrew: כְּרֵעַ־כְּאָח לִי הִתְהַלָּכְתִּי כַּאֲבֶל־אֵם קֹדֵר שַׁחוֹתִי׃
verses.english: I went about as for my friend or brother: I bowed down heavily, as one who mourns for his mother.

verses.hebrew: וּבְצַלְעִי שָׂמְחוּ וְנֶאֱסָפוּ נֶאֶסְפוּ עָלַי נֵכִים וְלֹא יָדַעְתִּי קָרְעוּ וְלֹא־דָמּוּ׃
verses.english: But when I stumble they rejoice, and gather themselves together. Wretches whom I have not known tear me in pieces without ceasing.

verses.hebrew: בְּחַנְפֵי לַעֲגֵי מָעוֹג חָרֹק עָלַי שִׁנֵּימוֹ׃
verses.english: Like profane men, scornful mockers, they grind their teeth against me.

verses.hebrew: אֲדֹנָי כַּמָּה תִּרְאֶה הָשִׁיבָה נַפְשִׁי מִשֹּׁאֵיהֶם מִכְּפִירִים יְחִידָתִי׃
verses.english: Lord, how long wilt Thou look on? rescue my soul from their destructions, my only one from the lions.

verses.hebrew: אוֹדְךָ בְּקָהָל רָב בְּעַם עָצוּם אֲהַלְלֶךָּ׃
verses.english: I will give Thee thanks in the great congregation: I will praise Thee among a numerous people.

verses.hebrew: אַל־יִשְׂמְחוּ־לִי אֹיְבַי שֶׁקֶר שֹׂנְאַי חִנָּם יִקְרְצוּ־עָיִן׃
verses.english: Let not those who are wrongfully my enemies rejoice over me; or those who hate me without cause wink their eye.

verses.hebrew: כִּי לֹא שָׁלוֹם יְדַבֵּרוּ וְעַל רִגְעֵי־אֶרֶץ דִּבְרֵי מִרְמוֹת יַחֲשֹׁבוּן׃
verses.english: For they seek not peace: but they devise deceitful matters against those who are quiet in the land.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּרְחִיבוּ עָלַי פִּיהֶם אָמְרוּ הֶאָח הֶאָח רָאֲתָה עֵינֵינוּ׃
verses.english: For they open their mouths wide against me, and say, Aha, aha, our eye has seen it.

verses.hebrew: רָאִיתָה יְהוָה אַל־תֶּחֱרַשׁ אֲדֹנָי אֲל־תִּרְחַק מִמֶּנִּי׃
verses.english: Thou hast seen, O Lord: keep no silence: O Lord, be not far from me.

verses.hebrew: הָעִירָה וְהָקִיצָה לְמִשְׁפָּטִי אֱלֹהַי וַאדֹנָי לְרִיבִי׃
verses.english: Rouse Thyself, and awake to my judgment; to my cause, my God and my Lord.

verses.hebrew: שָׁפְטֵנִי כְצִדְקְךָ יְהוָה אֱלֹהָי וְאַל־יִשְׂמְחוּ־לִי׃
verses.english: Judge me, O Lord my God, according to Thy righteousness; and let them not rejoice over me.

verses.hebrew: אַל־יֹאמְרוּ בְלִבָּם הֶאָח נַפְשֵׁנוּ אַל־יֹאמְרוּ בִּלַּעֲנוּהוּ׃
verses.english: Let them not say in their hearts, Ah, so we have our desire: let them not say, We have swallowed him up.

verses.hebrew: יֵבֹשׁוּ וְיַחְפְּרוּ יַחְדָּו שְׂמֵחֵי רָעָתִי יִלְבְּשׁוּ־בֹשֶׁת וּכְלִמָּה הַמַּגְדִּילִים עָלָי׃
verses.english: Let them be ashamed and brought to confusion together, those who rejoice at my hurt: let them be clothed with shame and dishonour, those who magnify themselves against me.

verses.hebrew: יָרֹנּוּ וְיִשְׂמְחוּ חֲפֵצֵי צִדְקִי וְיֹאמְרוּ תָמִיד יִגְדַּל יְהוָה הֶחָפֵץ שְׁלוֹם עַבְדּוֹ׃
verses.english: Let them shout for joy, and be glad, those who favour my righteous cause: and let them say continually, Let the Lord be magnified, who has pleasure in the welfare of his servant.

verses.hebrew: וּלְשׁוֹנִי תֶּהְגֶּה צִדְקֶךָ כָּל־הַיּוֹם תְּהִלָּתֶךָ׃
verses.english: And my tongue shall speak of Thy righteousness; of Thy praise all the day long.

verses.hebrew: לַמְנַצֵּחַ לְעֶבֶד־יְהוָה לְדָוִד׃
verses.english: To the chief Musician, of David the servant of the Lord.

verses.hebrew: נְאֻם־פֶּשַׁע לָרָשָׁע בְּקֶרֶב לִבִּי אֵין־פַּחַד אֱלֹהִים לְנֶגֶד עֵינָיו׃
verses.english: Transgression speaks to the wicked within his heart; there is no fear of God before his eyes.

verses.hebrew: כִּי־הֶחֱלִיק אֵלָיו בְּעֵינָיו לִמְצֹא עֲוֺנוֹ לִשְׂנֹא׃
verses.english: For he flatters himself in his own eyes, that his iniquity cannot be found out and hated.

verses.hebrew: דִּבְרֵי־פִיו אָוֶן וּמִרְמָה חָדַל לְהַשְׂכִּיל לְהֵיטִיב׃
verses.english: The words of his mouth are iniquity and deceit: he has left off being wise, and doing good.

verses.hebrew: אָוֶן יַחְשֹׁב עַל־מִשְׁכָּבוֹ יִתְיַצֵּב עַל־דֶּרֶךְ לֹא־טוֹב רָע לֹא יִמְאָס׃
verses.english: He devises mischief upon his bed; he sets himself in a way that is not good; he does not abhor evil.

verses.hebrew: יְהוָה בְּהַשָּׁמַיִם חַסְדֶּךָ אֱמוּנָתְךָ עַד־שְׁחָקִים׃
verses.english: Thy steadfast love, O Lord, is in the heavens; and Thy faithfulness reaches the clouds.

verses.hebrew: צִדְקָתְךָ כְּהַרְרֵי־אֵל מִשְׁפָּטֶךָ תְּהוֹם רַבָּה אָדָם־וּבְהֵמָה תוֹשִׁיעַ יְהוָה׃
verses.english: Thy righteousness is like the great mountains; Thy judgments are a great deep: O Lord, Thou preservest man and beast.

verses.hebrew: מַה־יָּקָר חַסְדְּךָ אֱלֹהִים וּבְנֵי אָדָם בְּצֵל כְּנָפֶיךָ יֶחֱסָיוּן׃
verses.english: How excellent is Thy love, O God! therefore the children of men shelter under the shadow of Thy wings.

verses.hebrew: יִרְוְיֻן מִדֶּשֶׁן בֵּיתֶךָ וְנַחַל עֲדָנֶיךָ תַשְׁקֵם׃
verses.english: They are abundantly satisfied with the fatness of Thy house; and Thou makest them to drink of the river of Thy pleasures.

verses.hebrew: כִּי־עִמְּךָ מְקוֹר חַיִּים בְּאוֹרְךָ נִרְאֶה־אוֹר׃
verses.english: For with Thee is the fountain of life: in Thy light we see light.

verses.hebrew: מְשֹׁךְ חַסְדְּךָ לְיֹדְעֶיךָ וְצִדְקָתְךָ לְיִשְׁרֵי־לֵב׃
verses.english: O continue Thy steadfast love to those who know Thee; and Thy righteousness to the upright in heart.

verses.hebrew: אַל־תְּבוֹאֵנִי רֶגֶל גַּאֲוָה וְיַד־רְשָׁעִים אַל־תְּנִדֵנִי׃
verses.english: Let not the foot of pride come against me, and let not the hand of the wicked drive me away.

verses.hebrew: שָׁם נָפְלוּ פֹּעֲלֵי אָוֶן דֹּחוּ וְלֹא־יָכְלוּ קוּם׃
verses.english: There are the workers of iniquity fallen: they are cast down, and are not able to rise.

verses.hebrew: לְדָוִד אַל־תִּתְחַר בַּמְּרֵעִים אַל־תְּקַנֵּא בְּעֹשֵׂי עַוְלָה׃
verses.english: Of David. Fret not thyself because of evil doers, nor be envious against the workers of iniquity.

verses.hebrew: כִּי כֶחָצִיר מְהֵרָה יִמָּלוּ וּכְיֶרֶק דֶּשֶׁא יִבּוֹלוּן׃
verses.english: For they shall soon be cut down like the grass, and wither like the green herb.

verses.hebrew: בְּטַח בַּיהוָה וַעֲשֵׂה־טוֹב שְׁכָן־אֶרֶץ וּרְעֵה אֱמוּנָה׃
verses.english: Trust in the Lord, and do good; dwell in the land, and enjoy security.

verses.hebrew: וְהִתְעַנַּג עַל־יְהוָה וְיִתֶּן־לְךָ מִשְׁאֲלֹת לִבֶּךָ׃
verses.english: Delight thyself also in the Lord; and he shall give thee the desires of thy heart.

verses.hebrew: גּוֹל עַל־יְהוָה דַּרְכֶּךָ וּבְטַח עָלָיו וְהוּא יַעֲשֶׂה׃
verses.english: Commit thy way to the Lord; trust also in him; and he will bring it to pass.

verses.hebrew: וְהוֹצִיא כָאוֹר צִדְקֶךָ וּמִשְׁפָּטֶךָ כַּצָּהֳרָיִם׃
verses.english: And he will bring forth thy righteousness as the light, and thy judgment like the noonday.

verses.hebrew: דּוֹם לַיהוָה וְהִתְחוֹלֵל לוֹ אַל־תִּתְחַר בְּמַצְלִיחַ דַּרְכּוֹ בְּאִישׁ עֹשֶׂה מְזִמּוֹת׃
verses.english: Rest in the Lord, and wait patiently for him: fret not thyself because of him who prospers in his way, because of the man who accomplishes wicked devices.

verses.hebrew: הֶרֶף מֵאַף וַעֲזֹב חֵמָה אַל־תִּתְחַר אַךְ־לְהָרֵעַ׃
verses.english: Cease from anger, and forsake wrath: fret not thyself: it comes to no good.

verses.hebrew: כִּי־מְרֵעִים יִכָּרֵתוּן וְקֹוֵי יְהוָה הֵמָּה יִירְשׁוּ־אָרֶץ׃
verses.english: For evildoers shall be cut off: but those who wait upon the Lord, they shall inherit the earth.

verses.hebrew: וְעוֹד מְעַט וְאֵין רָשָׁע וְהִתְבּוֹנַנְתָּ עַל־מְקוֹמוֹ וְאֵינֶנּוּ׃
verses.english: For yet a little while, and the wicked shall not be: and thou shalt look well at his place, but he will not be there.

verses.hebrew: וַעֲנָוִים יִירְשׁוּ־אָרֶץ וְהִתְעַנְּגוּ עַל־רֹב שָׁלוֹם׃
verses.english: But the meek shall inherit the earth; and shall delight themselves in the abundance of peace.

verses.hebrew: זֹמֵם רָשָׁע לַצַּדִּיק וְחֹרֵק עָלָיו שִׁנָּיו׃
verses.english: The wicked man plots against the just, and grinds his teeth against him.

verses.hebrew: אֲדֹנָי יִשְׂחַק־לוֹ כִּי־רָאָה כִּי־יָבֹא יוֹמוֹ׃
verses.english: The Lord shall laugh at him: for he sees that his day is coming.

verses.hebrew: חֶרֶב פָּתְחוּ רְשָׁעִים וְדָרְכוּ קַשְׁתָּם לְהַפִּיל עָנִי וְאֶבְיוֹן לִטְבוֹחַ יִשְׁרֵי־דָרֶךְ׃
verses.english: The wicked have drawn out the sword, and have bent their bow, to cast down the poor and needy, and to slay such as are of upright ways.

verses.hebrew: חַרְבָּם תָּבוֹא בְלִבָּם וְקַשְּׁתוֹתָם תִּשָּׁבַרְנָה׃
verses.english: Their sword shall enter into their own heart, and their bows shall be broken.

verses.hebrew: טוֹב־מְעַט לַצַּדִּיק מֵהֲמוֹן רְשָׁעִים רַבִּים׃
verses.english: A little that a righteous man has is better than the riches of many wicked men.

verses.hebrew: כִּי זְרוֹעוֹת רְשָׁעִים תִּשָּׁבַרְנָה וְסוֹמֵךְ צַדִּיקִים יְהוָה׃
verses.english: For the arms of the wicked shall be broken: but the Lord upholds the just.

verses.hebrew: יוֹדֵעַ יְהוָה יְמֵי תְמִימִם וְנַחֲלָתָם לְעוֹלָם תִּהְיֶה׃
verses.english: The Lord knows the days of the innocent: and their inheritance shall be for ever.

verses.hebrew: לֹא־יֵבֹשׁוּ בְּעֵת רָעָה וּבִימֵי רְעָבוֹן יִשְׂבָּעוּ׃
verses.english: They shall not be ashamed in the evil time: and in the days of famine they shall be satisfied.

verses.hebrew: כִּי רְשָׁעִים יֹאבֵדוּ וְאֹיְבֵי יְהוָה כִּיקַר כָּרִים כָּלוּ בֶעָשָׁן כָּלוּ׃
verses.english: But the wicked and the enemies of the Lord shall perish like the glory of the meadows; they shall consume; they shall pass away in smoke.

verses.hebrew: לֹוֶה רָשָׁע וְלֹא יְשַׁלֵּם וְצַדִּיק חוֹנֵן וְנוֹתֵן׃
verses.english: The wicked borrows, but does not pay back: but the righteous man gives with a good grace.

verses.hebrew: כִּי מְבֹרָכָיו יִירְשׁוּ אָרֶץ וּמְקֻלָּלָיו יִכָּרֵתוּ׃
verses.english: For such as are blessed of him shall inherit the earth; and they that are cursed of him shall be cut off.

verses.hebrew: מֵיְהוָה מִצְעֲדֵי־גֶבֶר כּוֹנָנוּ וְדַרְכּוֹ יֶחְפָּץ׃
verses.english: The steps of a man are ordered by the Lord: and he delights in his way.

verses.hebrew: כִּי־יִפֹּל לֹא־יוּטָל כִּי־יְהוָה סוֹמֵךְ יָדוֹ׃
verses.english: Though he fall, he shall not be utterly cast down: for the Lord upholds him with his hand.

verses.hebrew: נַעַר הָיִיתִי גַּם־זָקַנְתִּי וְלֹא־רָאִיתִי צַדִּיק נֶעֱזָב וְזַרְעוֹ מְבַקֶּשׁ־לָחֶם׃
verses.english: I have been young, and now am old; yet I have not seen a just man forsaken, and his seed begging bread.

verses.hebrew: כָּל־הַיּוֹם חוֹנֵן וּמַלְוֶה וְזַרְעוֹ לִבְרָכָה׃
verses.english: He lends generously at all times; and his seed is blessed.

verses.hebrew: סוּר מֵרָע וַעֲשֵׂה־טוֹב וּשְׁכֹן לְעוֹלָם׃
verses.english: Depart from evil, and do good; and dwell for evermore.

verses.hebrew: כִּי יְהוָה אֹהֵב מִשְׁפָּט וְלֹא־יַעֲזֹב אֶת־חֲסִידָיו לְעוֹלָם נִשְׁמָרוּ וְזֶרַע רְשָׁעִים נִכְרָת׃
verses.english: For the Lord loves justice, and forsakes not his pious ones; they are preserved for ever: but the seed of the wicked shall be cut off.

verses.hebrew: צַדִּיקִים יִירְשׁוּ־אָרֶץ וְיִשְׁכְּנוּ לָעַד עָלֶיהָ׃
verses.english: The righteous shall inherit the land, and dwell in it for ever.

verses.hebrew: פִּי־צַדִּיק יֶהְגֶּה חָכְמָה וּלְשׁוֹנוֹ תְּדַבֵּר מִשְׁפָּט׃
verses.english: The mouth of the righteous speaks wisdom, and his tongue discourses justice.

verses.hebrew: תּוֹרַת אֱלֹהָיו בְּלִבּוֹ לֹא תִמְעַד אֲשֻׁרָיו׃
verses.english: The Tora of his God is in his heart; none of his steps shall falter.

verses.hebrew: צוֹפֶה רָשָׁע לַצַּדִּיק וּמְבַקֵּשׁ לַהֲמִיתוֹ׃
verses.english: The wicked man watches the righteous, and seeks to slay him.

verses.hebrew: יְהוָה לֹא־יַעַזְבֶנּוּ בְיָדוֹ וְלֹא יַרְשִׁיעֶנּוּ בְּהִשָּׁפְטוֹ׃
verses.english: The Lord will not leave him in his hand, nor allow him to be condemned when he is judged.

verses.hebrew: קַוֵּה אֶל־יְהוָה וּשְׁמֹר דַּרְכּוֹ וִירוֹמִמְךָ לָרֶשֶׁת אָרֶץ בְּהִכָּרֵת רְשָׁעִים תִּרְאֶה׃
verses.english: Wait on the Lord, and keep his way, and he shall exalt thee to inherit the land: when the wicked are cut off, thou shalt see it.

verses.hebrew: רָאִיתִי רָשָׁע עָרִיץ וּמִתְעָרֶה כְּאֶזְרָח רַעֲנָן׃
verses.english: I have seen the wicked in great power, and spreading himself like a green tree in its native soil.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעֲבֹר וְהִנֵּה אֵינֶנּוּ וָאֲבַקְשֵׁהוּ וְלֹא נִמְצָא׃
verses.english: Yet he passed away, and, lo, he was not: I sought him, but he could not be found.

verses.hebrew: שְׁמָר־תָּם וּרְאֵה יָשָׁר כִּי־אַחֲרִית לְאִישׁ שָׁלוֹם׃
verses.english: Mark the perfect man, and behold the upright: for the end of that man is peace.

verses.hebrew: וּפֹשְׁעִים נִשְׁמְדוּ יַחְדָּו אַחֲרִית רְשָׁעִים נִכְרָתָה׃
verses.english: But the transgressors are destroyed together: the end of the wicked is cut off.

verses.hebrew: וּתְשׁוּעַת צַדִּיקִים מֵיְהוָה מָעוּזָּם בְּעֵת צָרָה׃
verses.english: And the salvation of the righteous is of the Lord: he is their strength in the time of trouble.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעְזְרֵם יְהוָה וַיְפַלְּטֵם יְפַלְּטֵם מֵרְשָׁעִים וְיוֹשִׁיעֵם כִּי־חָסוּ בוֹ׃
verses.english: And the Lord will help them, and deliver them: he shall deliver them from the wicked, and save them, because they take refuge in him.

verses.hebrew: מִזְמוֹר לְדָוִד לְהַזְכִּיר׃
verses.english: A Psalm of David, for invocation.

verses.hebrew: יְהוָה אַל־בְּקֶצְפְּךָ תוֹכִיחֵנִי וּבַחֲמָתְךָ תְיַסְּרֵנִי׃
verses.english: O Lord, rebuke me not in Thy wrath: nor chasten me in Thy hot displeasure.

verses.hebrew: כִּי־חִצֶּיךָ נִחֲתוּ בִי וַתִּנְחַת עָלַי יָדֶךָ׃
verses.english: For Thy arrows stick fast in me, and Thy hand presses me sore.

verses.hebrew: אֵין־מְתֹם בִּבְשָׂרִי מִפְּנֵי זַעְמֶךָ אֵין־שָׁלוֹם בַּעֲצָמַי מִפְּנֵי חַטָּאתִי׃
verses.english: There is no soundness in my flesh because of Thy anger; nor is there any health in my bones because of my sin.

verses.hebrew: כִּי עֲוֺנֹתַי עָבְרוּ רֹאשִׁי כְּמַשָּׂא כָבֵד יִכְבְּדוּ מִמֶּנִּי׃
verses.english: For my iniquities are gone over my head: like a heavy burden they are too heavy for me.

verses.hebrew: הִבְאִישׁוּ נָמַקּוּ חַבּוּרֹתָי מִפְּנֵי אִוַּלְתִּי׃
verses.english: My wounds stink; they fester because of my foolishness.

verses.hebrew: נַעֲוֵיתִי שַׁחֹתִי עַד־מְאֹד כָּל־הַיּוֹם קֹדֵר הִלָּכְתִּי׃
verses.english: I am troubled; I am bowed down greatly; I go mourning all the day long.

verses.hebrew: כִּי־כְסָלַי מָלְאוּ נִקְלֶה וְאֵין מְתֹם בִּבְשָׂרִי׃
verses.english: For my loins are filled with burning: and there is no soundness in my flesh.

verses.hebrew: נְפוּגוֹתִי וְנִדְכֵּיתִי עַד־מְאֹד שָׁאַגְתִּי מִנַּהֲמַת לִבִּי׃
verses.english: I am feeble and sore broken: I groan by reason of the disquietness of my heart.

verses.hebrew: אֲ‍דֹנָי נֶגְדְּךָ כָל־תַּאֲוָתִי וְאַנְחָתִי מִמְּךָ לֹא־נִסְתָּרָה׃
verses.english: Lord, all my desire is before Thee; and my sighing is not hid from Thee.

verses.hebrew: לִבִּי סְחַרְחַר עֲזָבַנִי כֹחִי וְאוֹר־עֵינַי גַּם־הֵם אֵין אִתִּי׃
verses.english: My heart palpitates, my strength fails me: as for the light of my eyes, it also is gone from me.

verses.hebrew: אֹהֲבַי וְרֵעַי מִנֶּגֶד נִגְעִי יַעֲמֹדוּ וּקְרוֹבַי מֵרָחֹק עָמָדוּ׃
verses.english: My lovers and my friends stand aloof from my plague; and my kinsmen stand afar off.

verses.hebrew: וַיְנַקְשׁוּ מְבַקְשֵׁי נַפְשִׁי וְדֹרְשֵׁי רָעָתִי דִּבְּרוּ הַוּוֹת וּמִרְמוֹת כָּל־הַיּוֹם יֶהְגּוּ׃
verses.english: And they who seek after my life lay snares for me: and they who seek my hurt speak mischievous things, and meditate deceits all the day long.

verses.hebrew: וַאֲנִי כְחֵרֵשׁ לֹא אֶשְׁמָע וּכְאִלֵּם לֹא יִפְתַּח־פִּיו׃
verses.english: But I, like a deaf man, hear not; and like a dumb man that opens not his mouth.

verses.hebrew: וָאֱהִי כְּאִישׁ אֲשֶׁר לֹא־שֹׁמֵעַ וְאֵין בְּפִיו תּוֹכָחוֹת׃
verses.english: Thus I was like a man that hears not, and in whose mouth are no rebukes.

verses.hebrew: כִּי־לְךָ יְהוָה הוֹחָלְתִּי אַתָּה תַעֲנֶה אֲדֹנָי אֱלֹהָי׃
verses.english: For in Thee, O Lord, I hope: Thou wilt hear, O Lord my God.

verses.hebrew: כִּי־אָמַרְתִּי פֶּן־יִשְׂמְחוּ־לִי בְּמוֹט רַגְלִי עָלַי הִגְדִּילוּ׃
verses.english: For I said, Lest they should rejoice over me: when my foot slips, they magnify themselves against me.

verses.hebrew: כִּי־אֲנִי לְצֶלַע נָכוֹן וּמַכְאוֹבִי נֶגְדִּי תָמִיד׃
verses.english: For I am ready to stumble, and my pain is continually before me.

verses.hebrew: כִּי־עֲוֺנִי אַגִּיד אֶדְאַג מֵחַטָּאתִי׃
verses.english: For I will declare my iniquity; I will be sorry for my sin.

verses.hebrew: וְאֹיְבַי חַיִּים עָצֵמוּ וְרַבּוּ שֹׂנְאַי שָׁקֶר׃
verses.english: But my enemies are in vigorous life; and they who hate me wrongfully are many.

verses.hebrew: וּמְשַׁלְּמֵי רָעָה תַּחַת טוֹבָה יִשְׂטְנוּנִי תַּחַת רדופי־[רָדְפִי־] טוֹב׃
verses.english: They also who render evil for good are my adversaries; because I follow what is good.

verses.hebrew: אַל־תַּעַזְבֵנִי יְהוָה אֱלֹהַי אַל־תִּרְחַק מִמֶּנִּי׃
verses.english: Forsake me not, O Lord: O my God, be not far from me.

verses.hebrew: חוּשָׁה לְעֶזְרָתִי אֲדֹנָי תְּשׁוּעָתִי׃
verses.english: Make haste to help me, O Lord my salvation.

verses.hebrew: לַמְנַצֵּחַ לידיתון [לִידוּתוּן] מִזְמוֹר לְדָוִד׃
verses.english: To the chief Musician, for Yedutun, A Psalm of David.

verses.hebrew: אָמַרְתִּי אֶשְׁמְרָה דְרָכַי מֵחֲטוֹא בִלְשׁוֹנִי אֶשְׁמְרָה לְפִי מַחְסוֹם בְּעֹד רָשָׁע לְנֶגְדִּי׃
verses.english: I said, I will take heed to my ways, that I sin not with my tongue: I will keep a curb on my mouth, while the wicked man is before me.

verses.hebrew: נֶאֱלַמְתִּי דוּמִיָּה הֶחֱשֵׁיתִי מִטּוֹב וּכְאֵבִי נֶעְכָּר׃
verses.english: I was dumb with silence, I held my peace, had no comfort, and my pain was stirred up.

verses.hebrew: חַם־לִבִּי בְּקִרְבִּי בַּהֲגִיגִי תִבְעַר־אֵשׁ דִּבַּרְתִּי בִּלְשׁוֹנִי׃
verses.english: My heart was hot within me; while I was musing, the fire burned: then I spoke with my tongue,

verses.hebrew: הוֹדִיעֵנִי יְהוָה קִצִּי וּמִדַּת יָמַי מַה־הִיא אֵדְעָה מֶה־חָדֵל אָנִי׃
verses.english: Lord, make me to know my end, and the measure of my days, what it is; I will know how frail I am.

verses.hebrew: הִנֵּה טְפָחוֹת נָתַתָּה יָמַי וְחֶלְדִּי כְאַיִן נֶגְדֶּךָ אַךְ כָּל־הֶבֶל כָּל־אָדָם נִצָּב סֶלָה׃
verses.english: Behold, Thou hast made my days like handbreadths; and my age is as nothing before Thee: truly every man at his best state is altogether vanity. (Sela.)

verses.hebrew: אַךְ־בְּצֶלֶם יִתְהַלֶּךְ־אִישׁ אַךְ־הֶבֶל יֶהֱמָיוּן יִצְבֹּר וְלֹא־יֵדַע מִי־אֹסְפָם׃
verses.english: Surely every man walks in a vain show: surely they are disquieted in vain: he heaps up riches, and knows not who shall gather them.

verses.hebrew: וְעַתָּה מַה־קִּוִּיתִי אֲדֹנָי תּוֹחַלְתִּי לְךָ הִיא׃
verses.english: And now, Lord, what do I wait for? my hope is in Thee.

verses.hebrew: מִכָּל־פְּשָׁעַי הַצִּילֵנִי חֶרְפַּת נָבָל אַל־תְּשִׂימֵנִי׃
verses.english: Deliver me from all my transgressions: make me not the reproach of the base man.

verses.hebrew: נֶאֱלַמְתִּי לֹא אֶפְתַּח־פִּי כִּי אַתָּה עָשִׂיתָ׃
verses.english: I am dumb, I open not my mouth; because Thou didst it.

verses.hebrew: הָסֵר מֵעָלַי נִגְעֶךָ מִתִּגְרַת יָדְךָ אֲנִי כָלִיתִי׃
verses.english: Remove Thy stroke away from me: I am consumed by the blow of Thy hand.

verses.hebrew: בְּתוֹכָחוֹת עַל־עָוֺן יִסַּרְתָּ אִישׁ וַתֶּמֶס כָּעָשׁ חֲמוּדוֹ אַךְ הֶבֶל כָּל־אָדָם סֶלָה׃
verses.english: When Thou with rebukes dost correct a man for iniquity, Thou makest his beauty to consume away like a moth: surely every man is vanity. (Sela.)

verses.hebrew: שִׁמְעָה־תְפִלָּתִי יְהוָה וְשַׁוְעָתִי הַאֲזִינָה אֶל־דִּמְעָתִי אַל־תֶּחֱרַשׁ כִּי גֵר אָנֹכִי עִמָּךְ תּוֹשָׁב כְּכָל־אֲבוֹתָי׃
verses.english: Hear my prayer, O Lord, and give ear to my cry; keep not silence at my tears: for I am a stranger with Thee, and a sojourner, as all my fathers were.

verses.hebrew: הָשַׁע מִמֶּנִּי וְאַבְלִיגָה בְּטֶרֶם אֵלֵךְ וְאֵינֶנִּי׃
verses.english: Look away from me, that I may recover brightness, before I go hence, and am no more.

verses.hebrew: לַמְנַצֵּחַ לְדָוִד מִזְמוֹר׃
verses.english: To the chief Musician, A Psalm of David.

verses.hebrew: קַוֺּה קִוִּיתִי יְהוָה וַיֵּט אֵלַי וַיִּשְׁמַע שַׁוְעָתִי׃
verses.english: I waited patiently for the Lord; and he inclined to me, and heard my cry.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעֲלֵנִי מִבּוֹר שָׁאוֹן מִטִּיט הַיָּוֵן וַיָּקֶם עַל־סֶלַע רַגְלַי כּוֹנֵן אֲשֻׁרָי׃
verses.english: He brought me up also out of the gruesome pit, out of the miry clay, and set my feet upon a rock, and established my footsteps.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּתֵּן בְּפִי שִׁיר חָדָשׁ תְּהִלָּה לֵאלֹהֵינוּ יִרְאוּ רַבִּים וְיִירָאוּ וְיִבְטְחוּ בַּיהוָה׃
verses.english: And he has put a new song in my mouth, a praise to our God. Many shall see, and fear, and shall trust in the Lord.

verses.hebrew: אַשְׁרֵי הַגֶּבֶר אֲשֶׁר־שָׂם יְהֹוָה מִבְטַחוֹ וְלֹא־פָנָה אֶל־רְהָבִים וְשָׂטֵי כָזָב׃
verses.english: Blessed is that man that makes the Lord his trust, and looks not to the proud, nor to such as turn aside to lies.

verses.hebrew: רַבּוֹת עָשִׂיתָ אַתָּה יְהוָה אֱלֹהַי נִפְלְאֹתֶיךָ וּמַחְשְׁבֹתֶיךָ אֵלֵינוּ אֵין עֲרֹךְ אֵלֶיךָ אַגִּידָה וַאֲדַבֵּרָה עָצְמוּ מִסַּפֵּר׃
verses.english: Many, O Lord my God, are Thy wonderful works which Thou hast done, and Thy thoughts which are towards us: none can compare with Thee: if I would declare and speak of them, they are more than can be numbered.

verses.hebrew: זֶבַח וּמִנְחָה לֹא־חָפַצְתָּ אָזְנַיִם כָּרִיתָ לִּי עוֹלָה וַחֲטָאָה לֹא שָׁאָלְתָּ׃
verses.english: Thou dost not desire sacrifice or meal offering; Thou hast dug open my ears; burnt offering and sin offering hast Thou not required.

verses.hebrew: אָז אָמַרְתִּי הִנֵּה־בָאתִי בִּמְגִלַּת־סֵפֶר כָּתוּב עָלָי׃
verses.english: Then said I, Lo, I come with the scroll of the book which is written for me;

verses.hebrew: לַעֲשׂוֹת־רְצוֹנְךָ אֱלֹהַי חָפָצְתִּי וְתוֹרָתְךָ בְּתוֹךְ מֵעָי׃
verses.english: I delight to do Thy will, O my God: and Thy Tora is within my heart.

verses.hebrew: בִּשַּׂרְתִּי צֶדֶק בְּקָהָל רָב הִנֵּה שְׂפָתַי לֹא אֶכְלָא יְהוָה אַתָּה יָדָעְתָּ׃
verses.english: I have preached righteousness in the great congregation: lo, I did not refrain my lips, O Lord, Thou knowst.

verses.hebrew: צִדְקָתְךָ לֹא־כִסִּיתִי בְּתוֹךְ לִבִּי אֱמוּנָתְךָ וּתְשׁוּעָתְךָ אָמָרְתִּי לֹא־כִחַדְתִּי חַסְדְּךָ וַאֲמִתְּךָ לְקָהָל רָב׃
verses.english: I have not hid Thy righteousness within my heart; I have declared Thy faithfulness and Thy salvation: I have not concealed Thy love and Thy truth from the great congregation.

verses.hebrew: אַתָּה יְהוָה לֹא־תִכְלָא רַחֲמֶיךָ מִמֶּנִּי חַסְדְּךָ וַאֲמִתְּךָ תָּמִיד יִצְּרוּנִי׃
verses.english: Withhold not Thou Thy tender mercies from me, O Lord: let Thy steadfast love and Thy truth continually preserve me.

verses.hebrew: כִּי אָפְפוּ־עָלַי רָעוֹת עַד־אֵין מִסְפָּר הִשִּׂיגוּנִי עֲוֺנֹתַי וְלֹא־יָכֹלְתִּי לִרְאוֹת עָצְמוּ מִשַּׂעֲרוֹת רֹאשִׁי וְלִבִּי עֲזָבָנִי׃
verses.english: For innumerable evils have compassed me about: my iniquities have taken hold upon me, so that I am not able to look up; they are more than the hairs of my head: therefore my heart fails me.

verses.hebrew: רְצֵה יְהוָה לְהַצִּילֵנִי יְהוָה לְעֶזְרָתִי חוּשָׁה׃
verses.english: Be pleased, O Lord, to deliver me: O Lord, make haste to help me.

verses.hebrew: יֵבֹשׁוּ וְיַחְפְּרוּ יַחַד מְבַקְשֵׁי נַפְשִׁי לִסְפּוֹתָהּ יִסֹּגוּ אָחוֹר וְיִכָּלְמוּ חֲפֵצֵי רָעָתִי׃
verses.english: Let them be ashamed and confounded together who seek after my soul to destroy it; let them be turned backward and put to shame who wish me evil.

verses.hebrew: יָשֹׁמּוּ עַל־עֵקֶב בָּשְׁתָּם הָאֹמְרִים לִי הֶאָח הֶאָח׃
verses.english: Let them be appalled because of their shame who say concerning me, Aha, aha.

verses.hebrew: יָשִׂישׂוּ וְיִשְׂמְחוּ בְּךָ כָּל־מְבַקְשֶׁיךָ יֹאמְרוּ תָמִיד יִגְדַּל יְהוָה אֹהֲבֵי תְּשׁוּעָתֶךָ׃
verses.english: Let all those who seek Thee rejoice and be glad in Thee: let such as love Thy salvation say continually, The Lord be magnified.

verses.hebrew: וַאֲנִי עָנִי וְאֶבְיוֹן אֲדֹנָי יַחֲשָׁב לִי עֶזְרָתִי וּמְפַלְטִי אַתָּה אֱלֹהַי אַל־תְּאַחַר׃
verses.english: But I am poor and needy; yet the Lord takes thought for me: Thou art my help and my deliverer; delay not, O my God!

verses.hebrew: לַמְנַצֵּחַ מִזְמוֹר לְדָוִד׃
verses.english: To the chief Musician, A Psalm of David.

verses.hebrew: אַשְׁרֵי מַשְׂכִּיל אֶל־דָּל בְּיוֹם רָעָה יְמַלְּטֵהוּ יְהוָה׃
verses.english: Blessed is he who considers the poor: the Lord will deliver him in the day of evil.

verses.hebrew: יְהוָה יִשְׁמְרֵהוּ וִיחַיֵּהוּ יאשר [וְאֻשַּׁר] בָּאָרֶץ וְאַל־תִּתְּנֵהוּ בְּנֶפֶשׁ אֹיְבָיו׃
verses.english: The Lord preserves him, and keeps him alive; he is called happy upon the earth: and Thou wilt not deliver him to the will of his enemies.

verses.hebrew: יְהוָה יִסְעָדֶנּוּ עַל־עֶרֶשׂ דְּוָי כָּל־מִשְׁכָּבוֹ הָפַכְתָּ בְחָלְיוֹ׃
verses.english: The Lord strengthens him upon the bed of sickness: whenever he is prostrate Thou recoverest him in his illness.

verses.hebrew: אֲ‍נִי־אָמַרְתִּי יְהוָה חָנֵּנִי רְפָאָה נַפְשִׁי כִּי־חָטָאתִי לָךְ׃
verses.english: I said, Lord, be gracious to me: heal my soul; for I have sinned against Thee.

verses.hebrew: אוֹיְבַי יֹאמְרוּ רַע לִי מָתַי יָמוּת וְאָבַד שְׁמוֹ׃
verses.english: My enemies speak evil of me, When shall he die, and his name perish?

verses.hebrew: וְאִם־בָּא לִרְאוֹת שָׁוְא יְדַבֵּר לִבּוֹ יִקְבָּץ־אָוֶן לוֹ יֵצֵא לַחוּץ יְדַבֵּר׃
verses.english: And if one comes to see me, he speaks vanity: his heart gathers iniquity to itself; when he goes abroad, he tells it.

verses.hebrew: יַחַד עָלַי יִתְלַחֲשׁוּ כָּל־שֹׂנְאָי עָלַי יַחְשְׁבוּ רָעָה לִי׃
verses.english: All that hate me whisper together against me: against me they devise my hurt.

verses.hebrew: דְּבַר־בְּלִיַּעַל יָצוּק בּוֹ וַאֲשֶׁר שָׁכַב לֹא־יוֹסִיף לָקוּם׃
verses.english: An evil disease, say they, cleaves fast to him: and from where he lies he shall rise up no more.

verses.hebrew: גַּם־אִישׁ שְׁלוֹמִי אֲשֶׁר־בָּטַחְתִּי בוֹ אוֹכֵל לַחְמִי הִגְדִּיל עָלַי עָקֵב׃
verses.english: Even my own familiar friend, in whom I trusted, who did eat of my bread, has lifted up his heel against me.

verses.hebrew: וְאַתָּה יְהוָה חָנֵּנִי וַהֲקִימֵנִי וַאֲשַׁלְּמָה לָהֶם׃
verses.english: But Thou, O Lord, be gracious to me, and raise me up, that I may pay them back.

verses.hebrew: בְּזֹאת יָדַעְתִּי כִּי־חָפַצְתָּ בִּי כִּי לֹא־יָרִיעַ אֹיְבִי עָלָי׃
verses.english: By this I know that Thou favourest me, because my enemy does not triumph over me.

verses.hebrew: וַאֲנִי בְּתֻמִּי תָּמַכְתָּ בִּי וַתַּצִּיבֵנִי לְפָנֶיךָ לְעוֹלָם׃
verses.english: And as for me, Thou upholdest me in my integrity, and settest me before Thy face for ever.

verses.hebrew: בָּרוּךְ יְהוָה אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל מֵהָעוֹלָם וְעַד הָעוֹלָם אָמֵן וְאָמֵן׃
verses.english: Blessed be the Lord, the God of Yisra᾽el from everlasting, and to everlasting. Amen, and Amen.

verses.hebrew: לַמְנַצֵּחַ מַשְׂכִּיל לִבְנֵי־קֹרַח׃
verses.english: To the chief Musician, A Maskil, for the sons of Qoraĥ.

verses.hebrew: כְּאַיָּל תַּעֲרֹג עַל־אֲפִיקֵי־מָיִם כֵּן נַפְשִׁי תַעֲרֹג אֵלֶיךָ אֱלֹהִים׃
verses.english: As the hart pants after the water brooks, so my soul pants after Thee, O God.

verses.hebrew: צָמְאָה נַפְשִׁי לֵאלֹהִים לְאֵל חָי מָתַי אָבוֹא וְאֵרָאֶה פְּנֵי אֱלֹהִים׃
verses.english: My soul thirsts for God, for the living God: when shall I come and appear before God?

verses.hebrew: הָיְתָה־לִּי דִמְעָתִי לֶחֶם יוֹמָם וָלָיְלָה בֶּאֱמֹר אֵלַי כָּל־הַיּוֹם אַיֵּה אֱלֹהֶיךָ׃
verses.english: My tears have been my bread day and night, while they say to me all the day, Where is thy God?

verses.hebrew: אֵלֶּה אֶזְכְּרָה וְאֶשְׁפְּכָה עָלַי נַפְשִׁי כִּי אֶעֱבֹר בַּסָּךְ אֶדַּדֵּם עַד־בֵּית אֱלֹהִים בְּקוֹל־רִנָּה וְתוֹדָה הָמוֹן חוֹגֵג׃
verses.english: When I remember these things, I pour out my soul in me: how I was wont to pass on with the throng, leading them in procession to the house of God, with the voice of joy and praise, a crowd keeping holiday.

verses.hebrew: מַה־תִּשְׁתּוֹחֲחִי נַפְשִׁי וַתֶּהֱמִי עָלָי הוֹחִילִי לֵאלֹהִים כִּי־עוֹד אוֹדֶנּוּ יְשׁוּעוֹת פָּנָיו׃
verses.english: Why art thou cast down, O my soul? and why dost thou moan within me? hope thou in God: for I shall yet praise him for the help of his countenance.

verses.hebrew: אֱ‍לֹהַי עָלַי נַפְשִׁי תִשְׁתּוֹחָח עַל־כֵּן אֶזְכָּרְךָ מֵאֶרֶץ יַרְדֵּן וְחֶרְמוֹנִים מֵהַר מִצְעָר׃
verses.english: O my God, my soul is cast down within me: because I remember Thee from the land of Yarden and the hills of Ḥermon, from the mount Miż῾ar.

verses.hebrew: תְּהוֹם־אֶל־תְּהוֹם קוֹרֵא לְקוֹל צִנּוֹרֶיךָ כָּל־מִשְׁבָּרֶיךָ וְגַלֶּיךָ עָלַי עָבָרוּ׃
verses.english: Deep calls to deep at the noise of Thy cataracts: all Thy waves and Thy billows are gone over me.

verses.hebrew: יוֹמָם יְצַוֶּה יְהוָה חַסְדּוֹ וּבַלַּיְלָה שירה [שִׁירוֹ] עִמִּי תְּפִלָּה לְאֵל חַיָּי׃
verses.english: Yet the Lord will command his steadfast love in the daytime, and in the night his song shall be with me, a prayer to the God of my life.

verses.hebrew: אוֹמְרָה לְאֵל סַלְעִי לָמָה שְׁכַחְתָּנִי לָמָּה־קֹדֵר אֵלֵךְ בְּלַחַץ אוֹיֵב׃
verses.english: I will say to God my rock, Why hast Thou forgotten me? why go I mourning under the oppression of the enemy?

verses.hebrew: בְּרֶצַח בְּעַצְמוֹתַי חֵרְפוּנִי צוֹרְרָי בְּאָמְרָם אֵלַי כָּל־הַיּוֹם אַיֵּה אֱלֹהֶיךָ׃
verses.english: Like a deadly wound in my bones, my enemies taunt me; while they say daily to me, Where is thy God?

verses.hebrew: מַה־תִּשְׁתּוֹחֲחִי נַפְשִׁי וּמַה־תֶּהֱמִי עָלָי הוֹחִילִי לֵאלֹהִים כִּי־עוֹד אוֹדֶנּוּ יְשׁוּעֹת פָּנַי וֵאלֹהָי׃
verses.english: Why art thou cast down, O my soul? and why moanest thou within me? hope thou in God: for I shall yet praise him, who is the health of my countenance, and my God.

verses.hebrew: שָׁפְטֵנִי אֱלֹהִים וְרִיבָה רִיבִי מִגּוֹי לֹא־חָסִיד מֵאִישׁ־מִרְמָה וְעַוְלָה תְפַלְּטֵנִי׃
verses.english: Judge me, O God, and plead my cause against an ungodly nation: O deliver me from the deceitful and unjust man.

verses.hebrew: כִּי־אַתָּה אֱלֹהֵי מָעוּזִּי לָמָה זְנַחְתָּנִי לָמָּה־קֹדֵר אֶתְהַלֵּךְ בְּלַחַץ אוֹיֵב׃
verses.english: For Thou art the God of my strength: why dost Thou cast me off? why go I mourning under the oppression of the enemy?

verses.hebrew: שְׁלַח־אוֹרְךָ וַאֲמִתְּךָ הֵמָּה יַנְחוּנִי יְבִיאוּנִי אֶל־הַר־קָדְשְׁךָ וְאֶל־מִשְׁכְּנוֹתֶיךָ׃
verses.english: O send out Thy light and Thy truth: let them lead me; let them bring me to Thy holy hill, and to Thy dwelling places.

verses.hebrew: וְאָבוֹאָה אֶל־מִזְבַּח אֱלֹהִים אֶל־אֵל שִׂמְחַת גִּילִי וְאוֹדְךָ בְכִנּוֹר אֱלֹהִים אֱלֹהָי׃
verses.english: Then will I go to the altar of God, to God my exceeding joy: and I will praise thee with the lyre, O God my God.

verses.hebrew: מַה־תִּשְׁתּוֹחֲחִי נַפְשִׁי וּמַה־תֶּהֱמִי עָלָי הוֹחִילִי לֵאלֹהִים כִּי־עוֹד אוֹדֶנּוּ יְשׁוּעֹת פָּנַי וֵאלֹהָי׃
verses.english: Why art thou cast down, O my soul? and why dost thou moan within me? hope in God: for I shall yet praise him, who is the health of my countenance, and my God.

verses.hebrew: לַמְנַצֵּחַ לִבְנֵי־קֹרַח מַשְׂכִּיל׃
verses.english: To the chief Musician for the sons of Qoraĥ, A Maskil.

verses.hebrew: אֱלֹהִים בְּאָזְנֵינוּ שָׁמַעְנוּ אֲבוֹתֵינוּ סִפְּרוּ־לָנוּ פֹּעַל פָּעַלְתָּ בִימֵיהֶם בִּימֵי קֶדֶם׃
verses.english: We have heard with our ears, O God; our fathers have told us, what work Thou didst in their days, in the times of old:

verses.hebrew: אַתָּה יָדְךָ גּוֹיִם הוֹרַשְׁתָּ וַתִּטָּעֵם תָּרַע לְאֻמִּים וַתְּשַׁלְּחֵם׃
verses.english: how Thou didst drive out nations with Thy hand, and didst plant them; how Thou didst batter the peoples, and cast them out.

verses.hebrew: כִּי לֹא בְחַרְבָּם יָרְשׁוּ אָרֶץ וּזְרוֹעָם לֹא־הוֹשִׁיעָה לָּמוֹ כִּי־יְמִינְךָ וּזְרוֹעֲךָ וְאוֹר פָּנֶיךָ כִּי רְצִיתָם׃
verses.english: For they did not get the land in possession by their own sword, nor did their own arm save them: but Thy right hand, and Thy arm, and the light of Thy countenance, because Thou didst favourably accept them.

verses.hebrew: אַתָּה־הוּא מַלְכִּי אֱלֹהִים צַוֵּה יְשׁוּעוֹת יַעֲקֹב׃
verses.english: Thou art my King, O God: command deliverances for Ya῾aqov.

verses.hebrew: בְּךָ צָרֵינוּ נְנַגֵּחַ בְּשִׁמְךָ נָבוּס קָמֵינוּ׃
verses.english: Through Thee will we push down our enemies: through Thy name will we tread those under who rise up against us.

verses.hebrew: כִּי לֹא בְקַשְׁתִּי אֶבְטָח וְחַרְבִּי לֹא תוֹשִׁיעֵנִי׃
verses.english: For I trust not in my bow, nor shall my sword save me.

verses.hebrew: כִּי הוֹשַׁעְתָּנוּ מִצָּרֵינוּ וּמְשַׂנְאֵינוּ הֱבִישׁוֹתָ׃
verses.english: But Thou hast saved us from our enemies, and hast put to shame those who hated us.

verses.hebrew: בֵּאלֹהִים הִלַּלְנוּ כָל־הַיּוֹם וְשִׁמְךָ לְעוֹלָם נוֹדֶה סֶלָה׃
verses.english: In God we have gloried all the day long, and we praise Thy name for ever. (Sela.)

verses.hebrew: אַף־זָנַחְתָּ וַתַּכְלִימֵנוּ וְלֹא־תֵצֵא בְּצִבְאוֹתֵינוּ׃
verses.english: Yet, Thou hast cast off, and put us to shame; and Thou goest not forth with our armies.

verses.hebrew: תְּשִׁיבֵנוּ אָחוֹר מִנִּי־צָר וּמְשַׂנְאֵינוּ שָׁסוּ לָמוֹ׃
verses.english: Thou makest us to turn back from the enemy: and they who hate us take plunder for themselves.

verses.hebrew: תִּתְּנֵנוּ כְּצֹאן מַאֲכָל וּבַגּוֹיִם זֵרִיתָנוּ׃
verses.english: Thou hast given us like sheep to be eaten: and hast scattered us among the nations.

verses.hebrew: תִּמְכֹּר־עַמְּךָ בְלֹא־הוֹן וְלֹא־רִבִּיתָ בִּמְחִירֵיהֶם׃
verses.english: Thou sellest Thy people for no great gain, and hast not put high their prices.

verses.hebrew: תְּשִׂימֵנוּ חֶרְפָּה לִשְׁכֵנֵינוּ לַעַג וָקֶלֶס לִסְבִיבוֹתֵינוּ׃
verses.english: Thou dost make us a taunt to our neighbours, a scorn and a derision to those round about us.

verses.hebrew: תְּשִׂימֵנוּ מָשָׁל בַּגּוֹיִם מְנוֹד־רֹאשׁ בַּל־אֻמִּים׃
verses.english: Thou makest us a byword among the nations, a shaking of the head among the peoples.

verses.hebrew: כָּל־הַיּוֹם כְּלִמָּתִי נֶגְדִּי וּבֹשֶׁת פָּנַי כִּסָּתְנִי׃
verses.english: My confusion is before me all the day, and the shame of my face has covered me,

verses.hebrew: מִקּוֹל מְחָרֵף וּמְגַדֵּף מִפְּנֵי אוֹיֵב וּמִתְנַקֵּם׃
verses.english: For the voice of him that taunts and blasphemes; by reason of the enemy and avenger.

verses.hebrew: כָּל־זֹאת בָּאַתְנוּ וְלֹא שְׁכַחֲנוּךָ וְלֹא־שִׁקַּרְנוּ בִּבְרִיתֶךָ׃
verses.english: All this is come upon us; yet we have not forgotten Thee, nor have we been false to Thy covenant.

verses.hebrew: לֹא־נָסוֹג אָחוֹר לִבֵּנוּ וַתֵּט אֲשֻׁרֵינוּ מִנִּי אָרְחֶךָ׃
verses.english: Our heart is not turned back, nor have our steps declined from Thy way;

verses.hebrew: כִּי דִכִּיתָנוּ בִּמְקוֹם תַּנִּים וַתְּכַס עָלֵינוּ בְצַלְמָוֶת׃
verses.english: though Thou hast sore broken us in the place of jackals, and covered us with the shadow of death.

verses.hebrew: אִם־שָׁכַחְנוּ שֵׁם אֱלֹהֵינוּ וַנִּפְרֹשׂ כַּפֵּינוּ לְאֵל זָר׃
verses.english: If we had forgotten the name of our God, or stretched out our hands to a strange god;

verses.hebrew: הֲלֹא אֱלֹהִים יַחֲקָר־זֹאת כִּי־הוּא יֹדֵעַ תַּעֲלֻמוֹת לֵב׃
verses.english: would not God search this out? for he knows the secrets of the heart.

verses.hebrew: כִּי־עָלֶיךָ הֹרַגְנוּ כָל־הַיּוֹם נֶחְשַׁבְנוּ כְּצֹאן טִבְחָה׃
verses.english: But for Thy sake are we killed all the day long; we are reckoned as sheep for the slaughter.

verses.hebrew: עוּרָה לָמָּה תִישַׁן אֲדֹנָי הָקִיצָה אַל־תִּזְנַח לָנֶצַח׃
verses.english: Awake, why sleepest Thou, O Lord? arise, cast us not off for ever.

verses.hebrew: לָמָּה־פָנֶיךָ תַסְתִּיר תִּשְׁכַּח עָנְיֵנוּ וְלַחֲצֵנוּ׃
verses.english: Why dost Thou hide Thy face, and forget our affliction and our oppression?

verses.hebrew: כִּי שָׁחָה לֶעָפָר נַפְשֵׁנוּ דָּבְקָה לָאָרֶץ בִּטְנֵנוּ׃
verses.english: For our soul is bowed down to the dust: our belly cleaves to the earth.

verses.hebrew: קוּמָה עֶזְרָתָה לָּנוּ וּפְדֵנוּ לְמַעַן חַסְדֶּךָ׃
verses.english: Arise for our help, and redeem us for the sake of Thy steadfast love.

verses.hebrew: לַמְנַצֵּחַ עַל־שֹׁשַׁנִּים לִבְנֵי־קֹרַח מַשְׂכִּיל שִׁיר יְדִידֹת׃
verses.english: To the chief Musician, to Shoshannim, A Maskil for the sons of Qoraĥ. A Song of loves.

verses.hebrew: רָחַשׁ לִבִּי דָּבָר טוֹב אֹמֵר אָנִי מַעֲשַׂי לְמֶלֶךְ לְשׁוֹנִי עֵט סוֹפֵר מָהִיר׃
verses.english: My heart overflows with a goodly matter: I relate my verses for the king: my tongue is the pen of a ready writer.

verses.hebrew: יָפְיָפִיתָ מִבְּנֵי אָדָם הוּצַק חֵן בְּשְׂפְתוֹתֶיךָ עַל־כֵּן בֵּרַכְךָ אֱלֹהִים לְעוֹלָם׃
verses.english: Thou art fairer than the children of men: grace is poured into thy lips: therefore God has blessed thee for ever.

verses.hebrew: חֲגוֹר־חַרְבְּךָ עַל־יָרֵךְ גִּבּוֹר הוֹדְךָ וַהֲדָרֶךָ׃
verses.english: Gird thy sword upon thy thigh, O mighty warrior: thy glory and thy majesty.

verses.hebrew: וַהֲדָרְךָ צְלַח רְכַב עַל־דְּבַר־אֱמֶת וְעַנְוָה־צֶדֶק וְתוֹרְךָ נוֹרָאוֹת יְמִינֶךָ׃
verses.english: And in thy majesty ride prosperously on in the cause of truth and for the sake of righteousness; and let thy right hand teach thee terrible things.

verses.hebrew: חִצֶּיךָ שְׁנוּנִים עַמִּים תַּחְתֶּיךָ יִפְּלוּ בְּלֵב אוֹיְבֵי הַמֶּלֶךְ׃
verses.english: Thy arrows are sharp: the people fall under thee: they sink into the heart of the king’s enemies.

verses.hebrew: כִּסְאֲךָ אֱלֹהִים עוֹלָם וָעֶד שֵׁבֶט מִישֹׁר שֵׁבֶט מַלְכוּתֶךָ׃
verses.english: Thy throne, of God, is for ever and ever: the sceptre of thy kingdom is a sceptre of equity.

verses.hebrew: אָהַבְתָּ צֶּדֶק וַתִּשְׂנָא רֶשַׁע עַל־כֵּן מְשָׁחֲךָ אֱלֹהִים אֱלֹהֶיךָ שֶׁמֶן שָׂשׂוֹן מֵחֲבֵרֶיךָ׃
verses.english: Thou lovest righteousness, and hatest wickedness: therefore God, thy God, has anointed thee with the oil of gladness above thy fellows.

verses.hebrew: מֹר־וַאֲהָלוֹת קְצִיעוֹת כָּל־בִּגְדֹתֶיךָ מִן־הֵיכְלֵי שֵׁן מִנִּי שִׂמְּחוּךָ׃
verses.english: All thy garments are fragrant with myrrh, and aloes, and cassia: out of the ivory palaces stringed instruments have made thee glad.

verses.hebrew: בְּנוֹת מְלָכִים בְּיִקְּרוֹתֶיךָ נִצְּבָה שֵׁגַל לִימִינְךָ בְּכֶתֶם אוֹפִיר׃
verses.english: Kings’ daughters are among thy favourites: upon thy right hand stands the queen in gold of Ofir.

verses.hebrew: שִׁמְעִי־בַת וּרְאִי וְהַטִּי אָזְנֵךְ וְשִׁכְחִי עַמֵּךְ וּבֵית אָבִיךְ׃
verses.english: Hearken, O daughter, and consider, and incline thy ear; forget also thy own people, and thy father’s house;

verses.hebrew: וְיִתְאָו הַמֶּלֶךְ יָפְיֵךְ כִּי־הוּא אֲדֹנַיִךְ וְהִשְׁתַּחֲוִי־לוֹ׃
verses.english: so shall the king desire thy beauty: for he is thy lord; and do homage to him.

verses.hebrew: וּבַת־צֹר בְּמִנְחָה פָּנַיִךְ יְחַלּוּ עֲשִׁירֵי עָם׃
verses.english: And O daughter of Żor, the rich among the people, shall entreat thy favour with a gift.

verses.hebrew: כָּל־כְּבוּדָּה בַת־מֶלֶךְ פְּנִימָה מִמִּשְׁבְּצוֹת זָהָב לְבוּשָׁהּ׃
verses.english: The king’s daughter is all glorious within: her clothing is inwrought with gold.

verses.hebrew: לִרְקָמוֹת תּוּבַל לַמֶּלֶךְ בְּתוּלוֹת אַחֲרֶיהָ רֵעוֹתֶיהָ מוּבָאוֹת לָךְ׃
verses.english: She shall be brought to the king in embroidered garments: the virgins, her companions that follow her, shall be brought to thee.

verses.hebrew: תּוּבַלְנָה בִּשְׂמָחֹת וָגִיל תְּבֹאֶינָה בְּהֵיכַל מֶלֶךְ׃
verses.english: With gladness and rejoicing shall they be led: they shall enter the king’s palace.

verses.hebrew: תַּחַת אֲבֹתֶיךָ יִהְיוּ בָנֶיךָ תְּשִׁיתֵמוֹ לְשָׂרִים בְּכָל־הָאָרֶץ׃
verses.english: Instead of thy fathers shall be thy children, whom thou shalt make princes in all the earth.

verses.hebrew: אַזְכִּירָה שִׁמְךָ בְּכָל־דֹּר וָדֹר עַל־כֵּן עַמִּים יְהוֹדֻךָ לְעֹלָם וָעֶד׃
verses.english: I will make thy name to be remembered in all generations: therefore shall the people praise Thee for ever and ever.

verses.hebrew: לַמְנַצֵּחַ לִבְנֵי־קֹרַח עַל־עֲלָמוֹת שִׁיר׃
verses.english: To the chief Musician for the sons of Qoraĥ, A Song to ῾Alamot.

verses.hebrew: אֱלֹהִים לָנוּ מַחֲסֶה וָעֹז עֶזְרָה בְצָרוֹת נִמְצָא מְאֹד׃
verses.english: God is our refuge and strength, a very present help in trouble.

verses.hebrew: עַל־כֵּן לֹא־נִירָא בְּהָמִיר אָרֶץ וּבְמוֹט הָרִים בְּלֵב יַמִּים׃
verses.english: Therefore we will not fear, though the earth change, and though the mountains are moved in the midst of the sea;

verses.hebrew: יֶהֱמוּ יֶחְמְרוּ מֵימָיו יִרְעֲשׁוּ־הָרִים בְּגַאֲוָתוֹ סֶלָה׃
verses.english: though its waters roar and are troubled, though the mountains shake with the swelling thereof. (Sela.)

verses.hebrew: נָהָר פְּלָגָיו יְשַׂמְּחוּ עִיר־אֱלֹהִים קְדֹשׁ מִשְׁכְּנֵי עֶלְיוֹן׃
verses.english: There is a river, whose streams make glad the city of God, the holiest dwelling place of the most High.

verses.hebrew: אֱלֹהִים בְּקִרְבָּהּ בַּל־תִּמּוֹט יַעְזְרֶהָ אֱלֹהִים לִפְנוֹת בֹּקֶר׃
verses.english: God is in the midst of her; she shall not be moved: God shall help her at the dawn of day.

verses.hebrew: הָמוּ גוֹיִם מָטוּ מַמְלָכוֹת נָתַן בְּקוֹלוֹ תָּמוּג אָרֶץ׃
verses.english: Nations raged, kingdoms were moved: he uttered his voice, the earth melted.

verses.hebrew: יְהוָה צְבָאוֹת עִמָּנוּ מִשְׂגָּב־לָנוּ אֱלֹהֵי יַעֲקֹב סֶלָה׃
verses.english: The Lord of hosts is with us; the God of Ya῾aqov is our fortress. (Sela.)

verses.hebrew: לְכוּ־חֲזוּ מִפְעֲלוֹת יְהוָה אֲשֶׁר־שָׂם שַׁמּוֹת בָּאָרֶץ׃
verses.english: Come, behold the works of the Lord, who has made desolations in the earth.

verses.hebrew: מַשְׁבִּית מִלְחָמוֹת עַד־קְצֵה הָאָרֶץ קֶשֶׁת יְשַׁבֵּר וְקִצֵּץ חֲנִית עֲגָלוֹת יִשְׂרֹף בָּאֵשׁ׃
verses.english: He makes wars to cease to the end of the earth; he breaks the bow, and cuts the spear in sunder; he burns the chariots in the fire.

verses.hebrew: הַרְפּוּ וּדְעוּ כִּי־אָנֹכִי אֱלֹהִים אָרוּם בַּגּוֹיִם אָרוּם בָּאָרֶץ׃
verses.english: Be still, and know that I am God: I will be exalted among the nations, I will be exalted in the earth.

verses.hebrew: יְהוָה צְבָאוֹת עִמָּנוּ מִשְׂגָּב־לָנוּ אֱלֹהֵי יַעֲקֹב סֶלָה׃
verses.english: The Lord of hosts is with us; the God of Ya῾aqov is our fortress. (Sela.)

verses.hebrew: לַמְנַצֵּחַ לִבְנֵי־קֹרַח מִזְמוֹר׃
verses.english: To the chief Musician, A Psalm for the sons of Qoraĥ.

verses.hebrew: כָּל־הָעַמִּים תִּקְעוּ־כָף הָרִיעוּ לֵאלֹהִים בְּקוֹל רִנָּה׃
verses.english: O clap your hands, all you peoples; shout to God with the voice of triumph.

verses.hebrew: כִּי־יְהוָה עֶלְיוֹן נוֹרָא מֶלֶךְ גָּדוֹל עַל־כָּל־הָאָרֶץ׃
verses.english: For the Lord most high is terrible; he is a great King over all the earth.

verses.hebrew: יַדְבֵּר עַמִּים תַּחְתֵּינוּ וּלְאֻמִּים תַּחַת רַגְלֵינוּ׃
verses.english: He subdues peoples under us, and nations under our feet.

verses.hebrew: יִבְחַר־לָנוּ אֶת־נַחֲלָתֵנוּ אֶת גְּאוֹן יַעֲקֹב אֲשֶׁר־אָהֵב סֶלָה׃
verses.english: He chooses our inheritance for us, the pride of Ya῾aqov whom he loves. (Sela.)

verses.hebrew: עָלָה אֱלֹהִים בִּתְרוּעָה יְהֹוָה בְּקוֹל שׁוֹפָר׃
verses.english: God is gone up with a shout, the Lord with the sound of a shofar.

verses.hebrew: זַמְּרוּ אֱלֹהִים זַמֵּרוּ זַמְּרוּ לְמַלְכֵּנוּ זַמֵּרוּ׃
verses.english: Sing praises to God, sing praises: sing praises to our King, sing praises.

verses.hebrew: כִּי מֶלֶךְ כָּל־הָאָרֶץ אֱלֹהִים זַמְּרוּ מַשְׂכִּיל׃
verses.english: For God is the King of all the earth: sing a Maskil psalm.

verses.hebrew: מָלַךְ אֱלֹהִים עַל־גּוֹיִם אֱלֹהִים יָשַׁב עַל־כִּסֵּא קָדְשׁוֹ׃
verses.english: God reigns over the nations: God sits upon the throne of his holiness.

verses.hebrew: נְדִיבֵי עַמִּים נֶאֱסָפוּ עַם אֱלֹהֵי אַבְרָהָם כִּי לֵאלֹהִים מָגִנֵּי־אֶרֶץ מְאֹד נַעֲלָה׃
verses.english: The nobles of the peoples are gathered together, the people of the God of Avraham: for the shields of the earth belong to God: he is greatly exalted.

verses.hebrew: שִׁיר מִזְמוֹר לִבְנֵי־קֹרַח׃
verses.english: A Song, A Psalm for the sons of Qoraĥ.

verses.hebrew: גָּדוֹל יְהוָה וּמְהֻלָּל מְאֹד בְּעִיר אֱלֹהֵינוּ הַר־קָדְשׁוֹ׃
verses.english: Great is the Lord, and highly to be praised in the city of our God, in the mountain of his holiness.

verses.hebrew: יְפֵה נוֹף מְשׂוֹשׂ כָּל־הָאָרֶץ הַר־צִיּוֹן יַרְכְּתֵי צָפוֹן קִרְיַת מֶלֶךְ רָב׃
verses.english: Beautiful for situation, the joy of the whole earth: mount Żiyyon, the sides of the north, the city of the great King.

verses.hebrew: אֱלֹהִים בְּאַרְמְנוֹתֶיהָ נוֹדַע לְמִשְׂגָּב׃
verses.english: God is known in her palaces for a fortress.

verses.hebrew: כִּי־הִנֵּה הַמְּלָכִים נוֹעֲדוּ עָבְרוּ יַחְדָּו׃
verses.english: For, lo, the kings were assembled, they came on together.

verses.hebrew: הֵמָּה רָאוּ כֵּן תָּמָהוּ נִבְהֲלוּ נֶחְפָּזוּ׃
verses.english: As soon as they saw, they were astounded; they were affrighted; they rushed away.

verses.hebrew: רְעָדָה אֲחָזָתַם שָׁם חִיל כַּיּוֹלֵדָה׃
verses.english: Fear took hold of them there, and pain, like a woman in travail.

verses.hebrew: בְּרוּחַ קָדִים תְּשַׁבֵּר אֳנִיּוֹת תַּרְשִׁישׁ׃
verses.english: Thou breakest the ships of Tarshish with an east wind.

verses.hebrew: כַּאֲשֶׁר שָׁמַעְנוּ כֵּן רָאִינוּ בְּעִיר־יְהוָה צְבָאוֹת בְּעִיר אֱלֹהֵינוּ אֱלֹהִים יְכוֹנְנֶהָ עַד־עוֹלָם סֶלָה׃
verses.english: As we have heard, so have we seen in the city of the Lord of hosts, in the city of our God: may God establish it for ever. (Sela.)

verses.hebrew: דִּמִּינוּ אֱלֹהִים חַסְדֶּךָ בְּקֶרֶב הֵיכָלֶךָ׃
verses.english: We have thought of Thy steadfast love, O God, in the midst of Thy temple.

verses.hebrew: כְּשִׁמְךָ אֱלֹהִים כֵּן תְּהִלָּתְךָ עַל־קַצְוֵי־אֶרֶץ צֶדֶק מָלְאָה יְמִינֶךָ׃
verses.english: According to Thy name, O God, so is Thy praise to the ends of the earth: Thy right hand is full of righteousness.

verses.hebrew: יִשְׂמַח הַר־צִיּוֹן תָּגֵלְנָה בְּנוֹת יְהוּדָה לְמַעַן מִשְׁפָּטֶיךָ׃
verses.english: Let mount Żiyyon rejoice, let the daughters of Yehuda be glad, because of Thy judgments.

verses.hebrew: סֹבּוּ צִיּוֹן וְהַקִּיפוּהָ סִפְרוּ מִגְדָּלֶיהָ׃
verses.english: Walk about Żiyyon, and go round about her: count her towers.

verses.hebrew: שִׁיתוּ לִבְּכֶם לְחֵילָה פַּסְּגוּ אַרְמְנוֹתֶיהָ לְמַעַן תְּסַפְּרוּ לְדוֹר אַחֲרוֹן׃
verses.english: Mark well her bulwarks, consider her palaces; that you may tell it to the generation following.

verses.hebrew: כִּי זֶה אֱלֹהִים אֱלֹהֵינוּ עוֹלָם וָעֶד הוּא יְנַהֲגֵנוּ עַל־מוּת׃
verses.english: For such is God, our God, for ever and ever: he will be our guide to the death.

verses.hebrew: לַמְנַצֵּחַ לִבְנֵי־קֹרַח מִזְמוֹר׃
verses.english: To the chief Musician, A Psalm for the sons of Qoraĥ.

verses.hebrew: שִׁמְעוּ־זֹאת כָּל־הָעַמִּים הַאֲזִינוּ כָּל־יֹשְׁבֵי חָלֶד׃
verses.english: Hear this, all the peoples; give ear, all the inhabitants of the world:

verses.hebrew: גַּם־בְּנֵי אָדָם גַּם־בְּנֵי־אִישׁ יַחַד עָשִׁיר וְאֶבְיוֹן׃
verses.english: both low and high, rich and poor, together.

verses.hebrew: פִּי יְדַבֵּר חָכְמוֹת וְהָגוּת לִבִּי תְבוּנוֹת׃
verses.english: My mouth shall speak wisdom; and the meditation of my heart shall be understanding.

verses.hebrew: אַטֶּה לְמָשָׁל אָזְנִי אֶפְתַּח בְּכִנּוֹר חִידָתִי׃
verses.english: I will incline my ear to a parable: I will open my riddle to the lyre.

verses.hebrew: לָמָּה אִירָא בִּימֵי רָע עֲוֺן עֲקֵבַי יְסוּבֵּנִי׃
verses.english: Why should I fear in the days of evil, when the iniquity of my persecutors compasses me about?

verses.hebrew: הַבֹּטְחִים עַל־חֵילָם וּבְרֹב עָשְׁרָם יִתְהַלָּלוּ׃
verses.english: They that trust in their wealth, and boast themselves in the multitude of their riches;

verses.hebrew: אָח לֹא־פָדֹה יִפְדֶּה אִישׁ לֹא־יִתֵּן לֵאלֹהִים כָּפְרוֹ׃
verses.english: none of them can by any means redeem his brother, nor give to God a ransom for him:

verses.hebrew: וְיֵקַר פִּדְיוֹן נַפְשָׁם וְחָדַל לְעוֹלָם׃
verses.english: for the redemption of their soul is too dear, and he leaves it for ever:

verses.hebrew: וִיחִי־עוֹד לָנֶצַח לֹא יִרְאֶה הַשָּׁחַת׃
verses.english: that he might still live for ever, and not see the pit.

verses.hebrew: כִּי יִרְאֶה חֲכָמִים יָמוּתוּ יַחַד כְּסִיל וָבַעַר יֹאבֵדוּ וְעָזְבוּ לַאֲחֵרִים חֵילָם׃
verses.english: When he sees that wise men die, that the fool and the brutish person perish together, and leave their wealth to others:

verses.hebrew: קִרְבָּם בָּתֵּימוֹ לְעוֹלָם מִשְׁכְּנֹתָם לְדֹר וָדֹר קָרְאוּ בִשְׁמוֹתָם עֲלֵי אֲדָמוֹת׃
verses.english: their inward thought is, that their houses shall continue for ever, and their dwelling places to all generations; they call their lands after their own names.

verses.hebrew: וְאָדָם בִּיקָר בַּל־יָלִין נִמְשַׁל כַּבְּהֵמוֹת נִדְמוּ׃
verses.english: Nevertheless man abides not in honour: he is like the beasts that perish.

verses.hebrew: זֶה דַרְכָּם כֵּסֶל לָמוֹ וְאַחֲרֵיהֶם בְּפִיהֶם יִרְצוּ סֶלָה׃
verses.english: This is their way in their folly: and their posterity who approve their sayings. (Sela.)

verses.hebrew: כַּצֹּאן לִשְׁאוֹל שַׁתּוּ מָוֶת יִרְעֵם וַיִּרְדּוּ בָם יְשָׁרִים לַבֹּקֶר וצירם [וְצוּרָם] לְבַלּוֹת שְׁאוֹל מִזְּבֻל לוֹ׃
verses.english: Like sheep they are appointed to She᾽ol; death shall be their shepherd; and the upright shall have dominion over them in the morning; and their form shall waste away in She᾽ol, leaving behind their dwelling.

verses.hebrew: אַךְ־אֱלֹהִים יִפְדֶּה נַפְשִׁי מִיַּד־שְׁאוֹל כִּי יִקָּחֵנִי סֶלָה׃
verses.english: But God will redeem my soul from the power of She᾽ol: for he shall receive me. (Sela.)

verses.hebrew: אַל־תִּירָא כִּי־יַעֲשִׁר אִישׁ כִּי־יִרְבֶּה כְּבוֹד בֵּיתוֹ׃
verses.english: Be not thou afraid when one is made rich, when the glory of his house is increased;

verses.hebrew: כִּי לֹא בְמוֹתוֹ יִקַּח הַכֹּל לֹא־יֵרֵד אַחֲרָיו כְּבוֹדוֹ׃
verses.english: for when he dies he shall carry nothing away: his glory shall not descend after him.

verses.hebrew: כִּי־נַפְשׁוֹ בְּחַיָּיו יְבָרֵךְ וְיוֹדֻךָ כִּי־תֵיטִיב לָךְ׃
verses.english: Though while he lives he blesses his soul: and though men praise thee, when thou doest well to thyself:

verses.hebrew: תָּבוֹא עַד־דּוֹר אֲבוֹתָיו עַד־נֵצַח לֹא יִרְאוּ־אוֹר׃
verses.english: it shall go to the generation of his fathers; they shall never see light.

verses.hebrew: אָדָם בִּיקָר וְלֹא יָבִין נִמְשַׁל כַּבְּהֵמוֹת נִדְמוּ׃
verses.english: Man that is in honour, and understands not, is like the beasts that perish.

verses.hebrew: מִזְמוֹר לְאָסָף אֵל אֱ‍לֹהִים יְהוָה דִּבֶּר וַיִּקְרָא־אָרֶץ מִמִּזְרַח־שֶׁמֶשׁ עַד־מְבֹאוֹ׃
verses.english: A Psalm of Asaf. The mighty one, God, the Lord, has spoken, and called the earth from the rising of the sun to the going down thereof.

verses.hebrew: מִצִּיּוֹן מִכְלַל־יֹפִי אֱלֹהִים הוֹפִיעַ׃
verses.english: Out of Żiyyon, the perfection of beauty, God has shone forth.

verses.hebrew: יָבֹא אֱלֹהֵינוּ וְאַל־יֶחֱרַשׁ אֵשׁ־לְפָנָיו תֹּאכֵל וּסְבִיבָיו נִשְׂעֲרָה מְאֹד׃
verses.english: Our God comes, and does not keep silence: a fire devours before him, and it is very tempestuous round about him.

verses.hebrew: יִקְרָא אֶל־הַשָּׁמַיִם מֵעָל וְאֶל־הָאָרֶץ לָדִין עַמּוֹ׃
verses.english: He calls to the heavens above, and to the earth, that he may judge his people.

verses.hebrew: אִסְפוּ־לִי חֲסִידָי כֹּרְתֵי בְרִיתִי עֲלֵי־זָבַח׃
verses.english: Gather my pious ones together to me; those that have made a covenant with me by sacrifice.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּגִּידוּ שָׁמַיִם צִדְקוֹ כִּי־אֱלֹהִים שֹׁפֵט הוּא סֶלָה׃
verses.english: And the heavens declare his righteousness: for God is judge himself. (Sela.)

verses.hebrew: שִׁמְעָה עַמִּי וַאֲדַבֵּרָה יִשְׂרָאֵל וְאָעִידָה בָּךְ אֱלֹהִים אֱלֹהֶיךָ אָנֹכִי׃
verses.english: Hear, O my people, and I will speak; O Yisra᾽el, and I will testify against thee: I am God, thy God.

verses.hebrew: לֹא עַל־זְבָחֶיךָ אוֹכִיחֶךָ וְעוֹלֹתֶיךָ לְנֶגְדִּי תָמִיד׃
verses.english: I will not reprove thee for thy sacrifices; and thy burnt offerings are continually before me.

verses.hebrew: לֹא־אֶקַּח מִבֵּיתְךָ פָר מִמִּכְלְאֹתֶיךָ עַתּוּדִים׃
verses.english: I will take no bullock out of thy house, nor he goats out of thy folds.

verses.hebrew: כִּי־לִי כָל־חַיְתוֹ־יָעַר בְּהֵמוֹת בְּהַרְרֵי־אָלֶף׃
verses.english: For every beast of the forest is mine, and the cattle upon a thousand hills.

verses.hebrew: יָדַעְתִּי כָּל־עוֹף הָרִים וְזִיז שָׂדַי עִמָּדִי׃
verses.english: I know all the birds of the mountains: and the wild beasts of the field are mine.

verses.hebrew: אִם־אֶרְעַב לֹא־אֹמַר לָךְ כִּי־לִי תֵבֵל וּמְלֹאָהּ׃
verses.english: If I were hungry, I would not tell thee: for the world is mine, and the fulness thereof.

verses.hebrew: הַאוֹכַל בְּשַׂר אַבִּירִים וְדַם עַתּוּדִים אֶשְׁתֶּה׃
verses.english: Do I eat the flesh of bulls, or drink the blood of goats?

verses.hebrew: זְבַח לֵאלֹהִים תּוֹדָה וְשַׁלֵּם לְעֶלְיוֹן נְדָרֶיךָ׃
verses.english: Offer to God a thanksgiving; and pay thy vows to the most High:

verses.hebrew: וּקְרָאֵנִי בְּיוֹם צָרָה אֲחַלֶּצְךָ וּתְכַבְּדֵנִי׃
verses.english: and call upon me in the day of trouble: I will deliver thee, and thou shalt glorify me.

verses.hebrew: וְלָרָשָׁע אָמַר אֱלֹהִים מַה־לְּךָ לְסַפֵּר חֻקָּי וַתִּשָּׂא בְרִיתִי עֲלֵי־פִיךָ׃
verses.english: But to the wicked man God says, What hast thou to do to declare my statutes, or that thou shouldst take my covenant in thy mouth?

verses.hebrew: וְאַתָּה שָׂנֵאתָ מוּסָר וַתַּשְׁלֵךְ דְּבָרַי אַחֲרֶיךָ׃
verses.english: Seeing thou hatest instruction, and dost cast my words behind thee.

verses.hebrew: אִם־רָאִיתָ גַנָּב וַתִּרֶץ עִמּוֹ וְעִם מְנָאֲפִים חֶלְקֶךָ׃
verses.english: When thou didst see a thief, then thou didst consort with him, and hast been partaker with adulterers.

verses.hebrew: פִּיךָ שָׁלַחְתָּ בְרָעָה וּלְשׁוֹנְךָ תַּצְמִיד מִרְמָה׃
verses.english: Thou givest thy mouth free rein for evil, and thy tongue frames deceit.

verses.hebrew: תֵּשֵׁב בְּאָחִיךָ תְדַבֵּר בְּבֶן־אִמְּךָ תִּתֶּן־דֹּפִי׃
verses.english: Thou sittest and speakest against thy brother; thou dost slander thy own mother’s son.

verses.hebrew: אֵלֶּה עָשִׂיתָ וְהֶחֱרַשְׁתִּי דִּמִּיתָ הֱיוֹת־אֶהְיֶה כָמוֹךָ אוֹכִיחֲךָ וְאֶעֶרְכָה לְעֵינֶיךָ׃
verses.english: These things hast thou done, and if I kept silence, thou wouldst think that I was altogether such a one as thyself: but I will reprove thee, and set the matter before thy eyes.

verses.hebrew: בִּינוּ־נָא זֹאת שֹׁכְחֵי אֱלוֹהַּ פֶּן־אֶטְרֹף וְאֵין מַצִּיל׃
verses.english: Now consider this, you who forget God, lest I tear you in pieces, and there be none to deliver.

verses.hebrew: זֹבֵחַ תּוֹדָה יְכַבְּדָנְנִי וְשָׂם דֶּרֶךְ אַרְאֶנּוּ בְּיֵשַׁע אֱלֹהִים׃
verses.english: Whoever offers praise glorifies me: and to him that orders his way aright I will show the salvation of God.

verses.hebrew: לַמְנַצֵּחַ מִזְמוֹר לְדָוִד׃
verses.english: To the chief Musician, A Psalm of David,

verses.hebrew: בְּבוֹא־אֵלָיו נָתָן הַנָּבִיא כַּאֲשֶׁר־בָּא אֶל־בַּת־שָׁבַע׃
verses.english: when Natan the prophet came to him, after he had gone in to Bat-sheva.

verses.hebrew: חָנֵּנִי אֱלֹהִים כְּחַסְדֶּךָ כְּרֹב רַחֲמֶיךָ מְחֵה פְשָׁעָי׃
verses.english: Be gracious to me, O God, according to Thy steadfast love: according to the multitude of Thy tender mercies blot out my transgressions.

verses.hebrew: הרבה [הֶרֶב] כַּבְּסֵנִי מֵעֲוֺנִי וּמֵחַטָּאתִי טַהֲרֵנִי׃
verses.english: Wash me thoroughly from my iniquity, and cleanse me from my sin.

verses.hebrew: כִּי־פְשָׁעַי אֲנִי אֵדָע וְחַטָּאתִי נֶגְדִּי תָמִיד׃
verses.english: For I acknowledge my transgressions: and my sin is ever before me.

verses.hebrew: לְךָ לְבַדְּךָ חָטָאתִי וְהָרַע בְּעֵינֶיךָ עָשִׂיתִי לְמַעַן תִּצְדַּק בְּדָבְרֶךָ תִּזְכֶּה בְשָׁפְטֶךָ׃
verses.english: Against Thee, Thee alone, have I sinned, and done that which is evil in Thy sight: so that Thou art justified in Thy sentence, and clear in Thy judgment.

verses.hebrew: הֵן־בְּעָווֹן חוֹלָלְתִּי וּבְחֵטְא יֶחֱמַתְנִי אִמִּי׃
verses.english: Behold, I was shaped in iniquity; and in sin did my mother conceive me.

verses.hebrew: הֵן־אֱמֶת חָפַצְתָּ בַטֻּחוֹת וּבְסָתֻם חָכְמָה תוֹדִיעֵנִי׃
verses.english: Behold, Thou desirest truth in the inward parts: therefore teach me wisdom in the inmost heart.

verses.hebrew: תְּחַטְּאֵנִי בְאֵזוֹב וְאֶטְהָר תְּכַבְּסֵנִי וּמִשֶּׁלֶג אַלְבִּין׃
verses.english: Purge me with hyssop, and I shall be clean: wash me, and I shall be whiter than snow.

verses.hebrew: תַּשְׁמִיעֵנִי שָׂשׂוֹן וְשִׂמְחָה תָּגֵלְנָה עֲצָמוֹת דִּכִּיתָ׃
verses.english: Make me to hear joy and gladness: that the bones which Thou hast broken may rejoice.

verses.hebrew: הַסְתֵּר פָּנֶיךָ מֵחֲטָאָי וְכָל־עֲוֺנֹתַי מְחֵה׃
verses.english: Hide Thy face from my sins, and blot out all my iniquities.

verses.hebrew: לֵב טָהוֹר בְּרָא־לִי אֱלֹהִים וְרוּחַ נָכוֹן חַדֵּשׁ בְּקִרְבִּי׃
verses.english: Create in me a clean heart, O God and renew a steadfast spirit within me.

verses.hebrew: אַל־תַּשְׁלִיכֵנִי מִלְּפָנֶיךָ וְרוּחַ קָדְשְׁךָ אַל־תִּקַּח מִמֶּנִּי׃
verses.english: Cast me not away from Thy presence; and take not Thy holy spirit from me.

verses.hebrew: הָשִׁיבָה לִּי שְׂשׂוֹן יִשְׁעֶךָ וְרוּחַ נְדִיבָה תִסְמְכֵנִי׃
verses.english: Restore to me the joy of Thy salvation; and uphold me with a willing spirit.

verses.hebrew: אֲלַמְּדָה פֹשְׁעִים דְּרָכֶיךָ וְחַטָּאִים אֵלֶיךָ יָשׁוּבוּ׃
verses.english: Then I will teach transgressors Thy ways; and sinners shall return to Thee.

verses.hebrew: הַצִּילֵנִי מִדָּמִים אֱ‍לֹהִים אֱלֹהֵי תְּשׁוּעָתִי תְּרַנֵּן לְשׁוֹנִי צִדְקָתֶךָ׃
verses.english: Deliver me from bloodguiltiness, O God, Thou God of my salvation: and my tongue shall sing aloud of Thy righteousness.

verses.hebrew: אֲדֹנָי שְׂפָתַי תִּפְתָּח וּפִי יַגִּיד תְּהִלָּתֶךָ׃
verses.english: O Lord, open my lips; and my mouth shall rehearse Thy praise.

verses.hebrew: כִּי לֹא־תַחְפֹּץ זֶבַח וְאֶתֵּנָה עוֹלָה לֹא תִרְצֶה׃
verses.english: For Thou desirest not sacrifice; or else I would give it: Thou delightest not in burnt offering.

verses.hebrew: זִבְחֵי אֱלֹהִים רוּחַ נִשְׁבָּרָה לֵב־נִשְׁבָּר וְנִדְכֶּה אֱלֹהִים לֹא תִבְזֶה׃
verses.english: The sacrifices of God are a broken spirit: a broken and a contrite heart, O God, Thou wilt not despise.

verses.hebrew: הֵיטִיבָה בִרְצוֹנְךָ אֶת־צִיּוֹן תִּבְנֶה חוֹמוֹת יְרוּשָׁלִָם׃
verses.english: Do good in Thy favour to Żiyyon: build Thou the walls of Yerushalayim.

verses.hebrew: אָז תַּחְפֹּץ זִבְחֵי־צֶדֶק עוֹלָה וְכָלִיל אָז יַעֲלוּ עַל־מִזְבַּחֲךָ פָרִים׃
verses.english: Then shalt Thou be pleased with the sacrifices of righteousness, with burnt offering and whole burnt offering: then shall they offer bullocks upon Thy altar.

verses.hebrew: לַמְנַצֵּחַ מַשְׂכִּיל לְדָוִד׃
verses.english: To the chief Musician, A Maskil of David,

verses.hebrew: בְּבוֹא דּוֹאֵג הָאֲדֹמִי וַיַּגֵּד לְשָׁאוּל וַיֹּאמֶר לוֹ בָּא דָוִד אֶל־בֵּית אֲחִימֶלֶךְ׃
verses.english: when Do᾽eg the Edomite came and told Sha᾽ul, and said to him, David is come to the house of Aĥimelekh.

verses.hebrew: מַה־תִּתְהַלֵּל בְּרָעָה הַגִּבּוֹר חֶסֶד אֵל כָּל־הַיּוֹם׃
verses.english: Why boastest thou thyself of evil, O mighty man? the love of God endures for all time.

verses.hebrew: הַוּוֹת תַּחְשֹׁב לְשׁוֹנֶךָ כְּתַעַר מְלֻטָּשׁ עֹשֵׂה רְמִיָּה׃
verses.english: Thy tongue devises mischiefs; like a sharp razor, working deceitfully.

verses.hebrew: אָהַבְתָּ רָּע מִטּוֹב שֶׁקֶר מִדַּבֵּר צֶדֶק סֶלָה׃
verses.english: Thou lovest evil more than good; and lying rather than speaking righteousness. (Sela.)

verses.hebrew: אָהַבְתָּ כָל־דִּבְרֵי־בָלַע לְשׁוֹן מִרְמָה׃
verses.english: Thou lovest all devouring words, a deceitful tongue.

verses.hebrew: גַּם־אֵל יִתָּצְךָ לָנֶצַח יַחְתְּךָ וְיִסָּחֲךָ מֵאֹהֶל וְשֵׁרֶשְׁךָ מֵאֶרֶץ חַיִּים סֶלָה׃
verses.english: God shall likewise destroy thee for ever, he shall take thee away, and pluck thee out of thy tent, and root thee out of the land of the living. (Sela.)

verses.hebrew: וְיִרְאוּ צַדִּיקִים וְיִירָאוּ וְעָלָיו יִשְׂחָקוּ׃
verses.english: The righteous also shall see, and fear, and shall laugh at him:

verses.hebrew: הִנֵּה הַגֶּבֶר לֹא יָשִׂים אֱלֹהִים מָעוּזּוֹ וַיִּבְטַח בְּרֹב עָשְׁרוֹ יָעֹז בְּהַוָּתוֹ׃
verses.english: lo, this is the man who made not God his strength; but trusted in the abundance of his riches, and strengthened himself in his wickedness.

verses.hebrew: וַאֲנִי כְּזַיִת רַעֲנָן בְּבֵית אֱלֹהִים בָּטַחְתִּי בְחֶסֶד־אֱלֹהִים עוֹלָם וָעֶד׃
verses.english: But I am like a green olive tree in the house of God: I trust in the love of God for ever and ever.

verses.hebrew: אוֹדְךָ לְעוֹלָם כִּי עָשִׂיתָ וַאֲקַוֶּה שִׁמְךָ כִי־טוֹב נֶגֶד חֲסִידֶיךָ׃
verses.english: I will give Thee thanks for ever, because Thou hast done it: and I will wait on Thy name, for it is good, before Thy saints.

verses.hebrew: לַמְנַצֵּחַ עַל־מָחֲלַת מַשְׂכִּיל לְדָוִד׃
verses.english: To the chief Musician on Maĥalat, A Maskil of David.

verses.hebrew: אָמַר נָבָל בְּלִבּוֹ אֵין אֱלֹהִים הִשְׁחִיתוּ וְהִתְעִיבוּ עָוֶל אֵין עֹשֵׂה־טוֹב׃
verses.english: The fool has said in his heart, There is no God. They have acted corruptly, and they have done abominable iniquity: there is none that does good.

verses.hebrew: אֱ‍לֹהִים מִשָּׁמַיִם הִשְׁקִיף עַל־בְּנֵי אָדָם לִרְאוֹת הֲיֵשׁ מַשְׂכִּיל דֹּרֵשׁ אֶת־אֱלֹהִים׃
verses.english: God looked down from heaven upon the children of men, to see if there were any man of discernment, that did seek God.

verses.hebrew: כֻּלּוֹ סָג יַחְדָּו נֶאֱלָחוּ אֵין עֹשֵׂה־טוֹב אֵין גַּם־אֶחָד׃
verses.english: Is every one of them dross? are they altogether filthy? is there no one who does good? No, not even one.

verses.hebrew: הֲלֹא יָדְעוּ פֹּעֲלֵי אָוֶן אֹכְלֵי עַמִּי אָכְלוּ לֶחֶם אֱלֹהִים לֹא קָרָאוּ׃
verses.english: Have the workers of iniquity no knowledge, who eat up my people as they eat bread: and do not call upon God?

verses.hebrew: שָׁם פָּחֲדוּ־פַחַד לֹא־הָיָה פָחַד כִּי־אֱלֹהִים פִּזַּר עַצְמוֹת חֹנָךְ הֱבִשֹׁתָה כִּי־אֱלֹהִים מְאָסָם׃
verses.english: There were they in great fear, where no fear was: for God has scattered the bones of him that encamps against thee: thou hast put them to shame, because God has rejected them.

verses.hebrew: מִי יִתֵּן מִצִּיּוֹן יְשֻׁעוֹת יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּשׁוּב אֱלֹהִים שְׁבוּת עַמּוֹ יָגֵל יַעֲקֹב יִשְׂמַח יִשְׂרָאֵל׃
