verses.english: Oh that the salvation of Yisra᾽el were come out of Żiyyon! When God brings back the captivity of his people, Ya῾aqov shall rejoice, and Yisra᾽el shall be glad.

verses.hebrew: לַמְנַצֵּחַ בִּנְגִינֹת מַשְׂכִּיל לְדָוִד׃
verses.english: To the chief Musician for strings, A Maskil of David,

verses.hebrew: בְּבוֹא הַזִּיפִים וַיֹּאמְרוּ לְשָׁאוּל הֲלֹא דָוִד מִסְתַּתֵּר עִמָּנוּ׃
verses.english: when the Zifim came and said to Sha᾽ul, Does not David hide himself with us?

verses.hebrew: אֱלֹהִים בְּשִׁמְךָ הוֹשִׁיעֵנִי וּבִגְבוּרָתְךָ תְדִינֵנִי׃
verses.english: Save me, O God, by Thy name, and judge me by Thy strength.

verses.hebrew: אֱלֹהִים שְׁמַע תְּפִלָּתִי הַאֲזִינָה לְאִמְרֵי־פִי׃
verses.english: Hear my prayer, O God; give ear to the words of my mouth.

verses.hebrew: כִּי זָרִים קָמוּ עָלַי וְעָרִיצִים בִּקְשׁוּ נַפְשִׁי לֹא שָׂמוּ אֱלֹהִים לְנֶגְדָּם סֶלָה׃
verses.english: For strangers are risen up against me, and violent men seek after my soul: they have not set God before them. (Sela.)

verses.hebrew: הִנֵּה אֱלֹהִים עֹזֵר לִי אֲדֹנָי בְּסֹמְכֵי נַפְשִׁי׃
verses.english: Behold, God is my helper: the Lord is the sustainer of my soul.

verses.hebrew: ישוב [יָשִׁיב] הָרַע לְשֹׁרְרָי בַּאֲמִתְּךָ הַצְמִיתֵם׃
verses.english: He rewards evil to my enemies: O, cut them off in Thy truth.

verses.hebrew: בִּנְדָבָה אֶזְבְּחָה־לָּךְ אוֹדֶה שִּׁמְךָ יְהוָה כִּי־טוֹב׃
verses.english: I will sacrifice a free will offering to Thee: I will praise Thy name, O Lord; for it is good.

verses.hebrew: כִּי מִכָּל־צָרָה הִצִּילָנִי וּבְאֹיְבַי רָאֲתָה עֵינִי׃
verses.english: For he has delivered me out of all trouble: and my eye has gazed upon my enemies.

verses.hebrew: לַמְנַצֵּחַ בִּנְגִינֹת מַשְׂכִּיל לְדָוִד׃
verses.english: To the chief Musician for strings, A Maskil of David.

verses.hebrew: הַאֲזִינָה אֱלֹהִים תְּפִלָּתִי וְאַל־תִּתְעַלַּם מִתְּחִנָּתִי׃
verses.english: Give ear to my prayer, O God; and hide not Thyself from my supplication.

verses.hebrew: הַקְשִׁיבָה לִּי וַעֲנֵנִי אָרִיד בְּשִׂיחִי וְאָהִימָה׃
verses.english: Attend to me, and answer me: I sob in my complaint, and make moan;

verses.hebrew: מִקּוֹל אוֹיֵב מִפְּנֵי עָקַת רָשָׁע כִּי־יָמִיטוּ עָלַי אָוֶן וּבְאַף יִשְׂטְמוּנִי׃
verses.english: because of the voice of the enemy, because of the oppression of the wicked: for they cast iniquity upon me, and in wrath they persecute me.

verses.hebrew: לִבִּי יָחִיל בְּקִרְבִּי וְאֵימוֹת מָוֶת נָפְלוּ עָלָי׃
verses.english: My heart is sore pained within me: and the terrors of death are fallen upon me.

verses.hebrew: יִרְאָה וָרַעַד יָבֹא בִי וַתְּכַסֵּנִי פַּלָּצוּת׃
verses.english: Fearfulness and trembling are come upon me, and horror has overwhelmed me.

verses.hebrew: וָאֹמַר מִי־יִתֶּן־לִּי אֵבֶר כַּיּוֹנָה אָעוּפָה וְאֶשְׁכֹּנָה׃
verses.english: And I said, Oh that I had wings like a dove! for then I would fly away, and be at rest.

verses.hebrew: הִנֵּה אַרְחִיק נְדֹד אָלִין בַּמִּדְבָּר סֶלָה׃
verses.english: Lo, then I would wander far off, and remain in the wilderness. (Sela.)

verses.hebrew: אָחִישָׁה מִפְלָט לִי מֵרוּחַ סֹעָה מִסָּעַר׃
verses.english: I would hasten to find a refuge for myself from the windy storm and the tempest.

verses.hebrew: בַּלַּע אֲדֹנָי פַּלַּג לְשׁוֹנָם כִּי־רָאִיתִי חָמָס וְרִיב בָּעִיר׃
verses.english: Destroy, O Lord, and divide their tongues: for I have seen violence and strife in the city.

verses.hebrew: יוֹמָם וָלַיְלָה יְסוֹבְבֻהָ עַל־חוֹמֹתֶיהָ וְאָוֶן וְעָמָל בְּקִרְבָּהּ׃
verses.english: Day and night they go about it upon its walls: mischief also and trouble are in the midst of it.

verses.hebrew: הַוּוֹת בְּקִרְבָּהּ וְלֹא־יָמִישׁ מֵרְחֹבָהּ תֹּךְ וּמִרְמָה׃
verses.english: Wickedness is in the midst of it: oppression and fraud depart not from her streets.

verses.hebrew: כִּי לֹא־אוֹיֵב יְחָרְפֵנִי וְאֶשָּׂא לֹא־מְשַׂנְאִי עָלַי הִגְדִּיל וְאֶסָּתֵר מִמֶּנּוּ׃
verses.english: For it was not an enemy who taunted me; then I could have borne it: nor was it one who hated me who did magnify himself against me; then I would have hid myself from him:

verses.hebrew: וְאַתָּה אֱנוֹשׁ כְּעֶרְכִּי אַלּוּפִי וּמְיֻדָּעִי׃
verses.english: but it was Thou, a man my equal, my companion, and my familiar friend.

verses.hebrew: אֲשֶׁר יַחְדָּו נַמְתִּיק סוֹד בְּבֵית אֱלֹהִים נְהַלֵּךְ בְּרָגֶשׁ׃
verses.english: We took sweet counsel together, and walked to the house of God in company.

verses.hebrew: ישימות [יַשִּׁי] [מָוֶת ] עָלֵימוֹ יֵרְדוּ שְׁאוֹל חַיִּים כִּי־רָעוֹת בִּמְגוּרָם בְּקִרְבָּם׃
verses.english: Let death spread its oblivion upon them, and let them go down alive into She᾽ol: for wickedness is in their dwellings, and among them.

verses.hebrew: אֲנִי אֶל־אֱלֹהִים אֶקְרָא וַיהוָה יוֹשִׁיעֵנִי׃
verses.english: As for me, I will call upon God; and the Lord shall save me.

verses.hebrew: עֶרֶב וָבֹקֶר וְצָהֳרַיִם אָשִׂיחָה וְאֶהֱמֶה וַיִּשְׁמַע קוֹלִי׃
verses.english: Evening, and morning, and at noon, I pray, and cry aloud: and he hears my voice.

verses.hebrew: פָּדָה בְשָׁלוֹם נַפְשִׁי מִקֲּרָב־לִי כִּי־בְרַבִּים הָיוּ עִמָּדִי׃
verses.english: He has delivered my soul in peace from the battle that was against me: for there were many who strove with me.

verses.hebrew: יִשְׁמַע אֵל וְיַעֲנֵם וְיֹשֵׁב קֶדֶם סֶלָה אֲשֶׁר אֵין חֲלִיפוֹת לָמוֹ וְלֹא יָרְאוּ אֱלֹהִים׃
verses.english: God who is enthroned from olden time, shall hear and afflict them (Sela;) those who dread no changes, and do not fear God.

verses.hebrew: שָׁלַח יָדָיו בִּשְׁלֹמָיו חִלֵּל בְּרִיתוֹ׃
verses.english: He has put forth his hands against such as are at peace with him: he has broken his covenant.

verses.hebrew: חָלְקוּ מַחְמָאֹת פִּיו וּקֲרָב־לִבּוֹ רַכּוּ דְבָרָיו מִשֶּׁמֶן וְהֵמָּה פְתִחוֹת׃
verses.english: The words of his mouth were smoother than butter, but war was in his heart: his words were softer than oil, yet they were drawn swords.

verses.hebrew: הַשְׁלֵךְ עַל־יְהוָה יְהָבְךָ וְהוּא יְכַלְכְּלֶךָ לֹא־יִתֵּן לְעוֹלָם מוֹט לַצַּדִּיק׃
verses.english: Cast thy burden upon the Lord, and he shall sustain thee: he shall never suffer the righteous to be moved.

verses.hebrew: וְאַתָּה אֱלֹהִים תּוֹרִדֵם לִבְאֵר שַׁחַת אַנְשֵׁי דָמִים וּמִרְמָה לֹא־יֶחֱצוּ יְמֵיהֶם וַאֲנִי אֶבְטַח־בָּךְ׃
verses.english: But Thou, O God, shalt bring them down into the pit of destruction: bloody and deceitful men shall not live out half their days; but I will trust in Thee.

verses.hebrew: לַמְנַצֵּחַ עַל־יוֹנַת אֵלֶם רְחֹקִים לְדָוִד מִכְתָּם בֶּאֱחֹז אֹתוֹ פְלִשְׁתִּים בְּגַת׃
verses.english: To the chief Musician, upon Yonat-elem-reĥoqim, A Mikhtam of David, when the Pelishtim seized him in Gat.

verses.hebrew: חָנֵּנִי אֱלֹהִים כִּי־שְׁאָפַנִי אֱנוֹשׁ כָּל־הַיּוֹם לֹחֵם יִלְחָצֵנִי׃
verses.english: Be gracious to me, O God: for men long to swallow me up; all day long the foeman oppresses me.

verses.hebrew: שָׁאֲפוּ שׁוֹרְרַי כָּל־הַיּוֹם כִּי־רַבִּים לֹחֲמִים לִי מָרוֹם׃
verses.english: My enemies daily long to swallow me up, for they are many who fight against me, O Thou most High.

verses.hebrew: יוֹם אִירָא אֲנִי אֵלֶיךָ אֶבְטָח׃
verses.english: When I am afraid, I will trust in Thee.

verses.hebrew: בֵּאלֹהִים אֲהַלֵּל דְּבָרוֹ בֵּאלֹהִים בָּטַחְתִּי לֹא אִירָא מַה־יַּעֲשֶׂה בָשָׂר לִי׃
verses.english: In God, I will praise his word, in God I have put my trust; I will not fear; what can flesh do to me?

verses.hebrew: כָּל־הַיּוֹם דְּבָרַי יְעַצֵּבוּ עָלַי כָּל־מַחְשְׁבֹתָם לָרָע׃
verses.english: Every day they wrest my words: all their thoughts are against me for evil.

verses.hebrew: יָגוּרוּ יצפינו [יִצְפּוֹנוּ] הֵמָּה עֲקֵבַי יִשְׁמֹרוּ כַּאֲשֶׁר קִוּוּ נַפְשִׁי׃
verses.english: They gather themselves together, they hide themselves, they mark my steps, as they wait for my soul.

verses.hebrew: עַל־אָוֶן פַּלֶּט־לָמוֹ בְּאַף עַמִּים הוֹרֵד אֱלֹהִים׃
verses.english: Shall they escape by iniquity? in Thy anger cast down the peoples, O God.

verses.hebrew: נֹדִי סָפַרְתָּה אָתָּה שִׂימָה דִמְעָתִי בְנֹאדֶךָ הֲלֹא בְּסִפְרָתֶךָ׃
verses.english: Thou dost count my wanderings: put my tears into Thy bottle: are they not in Thy book?

verses.hebrew: אָז יָשׁוּבוּ אוֹיְבַי אָחוֹר בְּיוֹם אֶקְרָא זֶה־יָדַעְתִּי כִּי־אֱלֹהִים לִי׃
verses.english: When I cry to Thee, then shall my enemies turn back: this I know; for God is for me.

verses.hebrew: בֵּאלֹהִים אֲהַלֵּל דָּבָר בַּיהוָה אֲהַלֵּל דָּבָר׃
verses.english: In God, I will praise his word: in the Lord, I will praise his word.

verses.hebrew: בֵּאלֹהִים בָּטַחְתִּי לֹא אִירָא מַה־יַּעֲשֶׂה אָדָם לִי׃
verses.english: In God have I put my trust: I will not be afraid. What can man do to me?

verses.hebrew: עָלַי אֱלֹהִים נְדָרֶיךָ אֲשַׁלֵּם תּוֹדֹת לָךְ׃
verses.english: Thy vows are upon me, O God: I will pay Thee my offerings of thanksgiving.

verses.hebrew: כִּי הִצַּלְתָּ נַפְשִׁי מִמָּוֶת הֲלֹא רַגְלַי מִדֶּחִי לְהִתְהַלֵּךְ לִפְנֵי אֱלֹהִים בְּאוֹר הַחַיִּים׃
verses.english: For Thou hast delivered my soul from death, yea, my feet from falling, that I may walk before God in the light of the living!

verses.hebrew: לַמְנַצֵּחַ אַל־תַּשְׁחֵת לְדָוִד מִכְתָּם בְּבָרְחוֹ מִפְּנֵי־שָׁאוּל בַּמְּעָרָה׃
verses.english: To the chief Musician, Al-tashĥet, a Mikhtam of David, when he fled from Sha᾽ul in the cave.

verses.hebrew: חָנֵּנִי אֱלֹהִים חָנֵּנִי כִּי בְךָ חָסָיָה נַפְשִׁי וּבְצֵל־כְּנָפֶיךָ אֶחְסֶה עַד יַעֲבֹר הַוּוֹת׃
verses.english: Be gracious to me, O God, be gracious to me: for my soul trusts in Thee: and in the shadow of Thy wings will I take refuge, until calamities be overpast.

verses.hebrew: אֶקְרָא לֵאלֹהִים עֶלְיוֹן לָאֵל גֹּמֵר עָלָי׃
verses.english: I will cry to God most high; to God who performs all things for me.

verses.hebrew: יִשְׁלַח מִשָּׁמַיִם וְיוֹשִׁיעֵנִי חֵרֵף שֹׁאֲפִי סֶלָה יִשְׁלַח אֱלֹהִים חַסְדּוֹ וַאֲמִתּוֹ׃
verses.english: He will send from heaven, and save me; he scorns him who would swallow me up. (Sela.) God shall send forth his steadfast love and his truth.

verses.hebrew: נַפְשִׁי בְּתוֹךְ לְבָאִם אֶשְׁכְּבָה לֹהֲטִים בְּנֵי־אָדָם שִׁנֵּיהֶם חֲנִית וְחִצִּים וּלְשׁוֹנָם חֶרֶב חַדָּה׃
verses.english: My soul is among lions: and I lie down among those who are aflame, the sons of men, whose teeth are spears and arrows, and their tongue a sharp sword.

verses.hebrew: רוּמָה עַל־הַשָּׁמַיִם אֱלֹהִים עַל כָּל־הָאָרֶץ כְּבוֹדֶךָ׃
verses.english: Be Thou exalted, O God, above the heavens; let Thy glory be above all the earth.

verses.hebrew: רֶשֶׁת הֵכִינוּ לִפְעָמַי כָּפַף נַפְשִׁי כָּרוּ לְפָנַי שִׁיחָה נָפְלוּ בְתוֹכָהּ סֶלָה׃
verses.english: They have prepared a net for my steps; my soul is bowed down: they have dug a pit before me, into the midst of which they are fallen themselves. (Sela.)

verses.hebrew: נָכוֹן לִבִּי אֱלֹהִים נָכוֹן לִבִּי אָשִׁירָה וַאֲזַמֵּרָה׃
verses.english: My heart is steadfast, O God, my heart is steadfast: I will sing and give praise.

verses.hebrew: עוּרָה כְבוֹדִי עוּרָה הַנֵּבֶל וְכִנּוֹר אָעִירָה שָּׁחַר׃
verses.english: Wake up, my glory; awake, the harp and the lyre: I will awake the dawn.

verses.hebrew: אוֹדְךָ בָעַמִּים אֲדֹנָי אֲזַמֶּרְךָ בַּל־אֻמִּים׃
verses.english: I will praise Thee, O Lord, among the peoples: I will sing to Thee among the nations.

verses.hebrew: כִּי־גָדֹל עַד־שָׁמַיִם חַסְדֶּךָ וְעַד־שְׁחָקִים אֲמִתֶּךָ׃
verses.english: For Thy love is great unto the heavens, and Thy truth to the clouds.

verses.hebrew: רוּמָה עַל־שָׁמַיִם אֱלֹהִים עַל כָּל־הָאָרֶץ כְּבוֹדֶךָ׃
verses.english: Be Thou exalted, O God, above the heavens: let Thy glory be above all the earth.

verses.hebrew: לַמְנַצֵּחַ אַל־תַּשְׁחֵת לְדָוִד מִכְתָּם׃
verses.english: To the chief Musician, Al-tashĥet, A Mikhtam of David.

verses.hebrew: הַאֻמְנָם אֵלֶם צֶדֶק תְּדַבֵּרוּן מֵישָׁרִים תִּשְׁפְּטוּ בְּנֵי אָדָם׃
verses.english: Do you indeed speak righteousness in private? do you judge uprightly, O you sons of men?

verses.hebrew: אַף־בְּלֵב עוֹלֹת תִּפְעָלוּן בָּאָרֶץ חֲמַס יְדֵיכֶם תְּפַלֵּסוּן׃
verses.english: No, in your hearts you work wickedness; your hands deal out violence on the earth.

verses.hebrew: זֹרוּ רְשָׁעִים מֵרָחֶם תָּעוּ מִבֶּטֶן דֹּבְרֵי כָזָב׃
verses.english: The wicked are estranged from the womb: they err from birth, speaking lies.

verses.hebrew: חֲמַת־לָמוֹ כִּדְמוּת חֲמַת־נָחָשׁ כְּמוֹ־פֶתֶן חֵרֵשׁ יַאְטֵם אָזְנוֹ׃
verses.english: Their poison is like the poison of a snake: they are like the deaf adder that stops its ear;

verses.hebrew: אֲשֶׁר לֹא־יִשְׁמַע לְקוֹל מְלַחֲשִׁים חוֹבֵר חֲבָרִים מְחֻכָּם׃
verses.english: which will not hearken to the voice of charmers, charming never so wisely.

verses.hebrew: אֱ‍לֹהִים הֲרָס־שִׁנֵּימוֹ בְּפִימוֹ מַלְתְּעוֹת כְּפִירִים נְתֹץ יְהוָה׃
verses.english: Break their teeth, O God, in their mouth: break out the fangs of the young lions, O Lord.

verses.hebrew: יִמָּאֲסוּ כְמוֹ־מַיִם יִתְהַלְּכוּ־לָמוֹ יִדְרֹךְ חצו [חִצָּיו] כְּמוֹ יִתְמֹלָלוּ׃
verses.english: Let them melt away like waters which run continually: when he aims his arrows, let them be as if cut in pieces;

verses.hebrew: כְּמוֹ שַׁבְּלוּל תֶּמֶס יַהֲלֹךְ נֵפֶל אֵשֶׁת בַּל־חָזוּ שָׁמֶשׁ׃
verses.english: like the slimy track of a snail which disappears: like the untimely births of a woman, that have not seen the sun.

verses.hebrew: בְּטֶרֶם יָבִינוּ סִּירֹתֵיכֶם אָטָד כְּמוֹ־חַי כְּמוֹ־חָרוֹן יִשְׂעָרֶנּוּ׃
verses.english: Before your pots can feel the thorns, he shall sweep them away as with a whirlwind, both the green and the burning.

verses.hebrew: יִשְׂמַח צַדִּיק כִּי־חָזָה נָקָם פְּעָמָיו יִרְחַץ בְּדַם הָרָשָׁע׃
verses.english: The righteous shall rejoice when he sees the vengeance: he shall wash his feet in the blood of the wicked.

verses.hebrew: וְיֹאמַר אָדָם אַךְ־פְּרִי לַצַּדִּיק אַךְ יֵשׁ־אֱלֹהִים שֹׁפְטִים בָּאָרֶץ׃
verses.english: So that a man shall say, Verily there is a reward for the righteous: verily there is a God who judges in the earth.

verses.hebrew: לַמְנַצֵּחַ אַל־תַּשְׁחֵת לְדָוִד מִכְתָּם בִּשְׁלֹחַ שָׁאוּל וַיִּשְׁמְרוּ אֶת־הַבַּיִת לַהֲמִיתוֹ׃
verses.english: To the chief Musician, Al-tashĥet, A Mikhtam of David; when Sha᾽ul sent, and they watched the house to kill him.

verses.hebrew: הַצִּילֵנִי מֵאֹיְבַי אֱלֹהָי מִּמִתְקוֹמְמַי תְּשַׂגְּבֵנִי׃
verses.english: Deliver me from my enemies, O my God: defend me from those who rise up against me.

verses.hebrew: הַצִּילֵנִי מִפֹּעֲלֵי אָוֶן וּמֵאַנְשֵׁי דָמִים הוֹשִׁיעֵנִי׃
verses.english: Deliver me from the workers of iniquity, and save me from bloody men.

verses.hebrew: כִּי הִנֵּה אָרְבוּ לְנַפְשִׁי יָגוּרוּ עָלַי עַזִים לֹא־פִשְׁעִי וְלֹא־חַטָּאתִי יְהוָה׃
verses.english: For, lo, they lie in wait for my soul: fierce men are gathered against me; not for my transgression, nor for my sin, O Lord.

verses.hebrew: בְּלִי־עָוֺן יְרוּצוּן וְיִכּוֹנָנוּ עוּרָה לִקְרָאתִי וּרְאֵה׃
verses.english: They run and prepare themselves for no fault of mine: awake to help me, and behold.

verses.hebrew: וְאַתָּה יְהוָה־אֱלֹהִים צְבָאוֹת אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל הָקִיצָה לִפְקֹד כָּל־הַגּוֹיִם אַל־תָּחֹן כָּל־בֹּגְדֵי אָוֶן סֶלָה׃
verses.english: Thou therefore, O Lord God of hosts, the God of Yisra᾽el, awake to punish all the nations: be not gracious to any wicked traitors. (Sela.)

verses.hebrew: יָשׁוּבוּ לָעֶרֶב יֶהֱמוּ כַכָּלֶב וִיסוֹבְבוּ עִיר׃
verses.english: They return at evening: they howl like a dog, and go round about the city.

verses.hebrew: הִנֵּה יַבִּיעוּן בְּפִיהֶם חֲרָבוֹת בְּשִׂפְתוֹתֵיהֶם כִּי־מִי שֹׁמֵעַ׃
verses.english: Behold, they belch out with their mouth: swords are in their lips: for who hears?

verses.hebrew: וְאַתָּה יְהוָה תִּשְׂחַק־לָמוֹ תִּלְעַג לְכָל־גּוֹיִם׃
verses.english: But Thou, O Lord, shalt laugh at them; Thou shalt have all the nations in derision.

verses.hebrew: עֻזּוֹ אֵלֶיךָ אֶשְׁמֹרָה כִּי־אֱלֹהִים מִשְׂגַּבִּי׃
verses.english: Upon Thee, O my strength, will I wait: for God is my fortress.

verses.hebrew: אֱלֹהֵי חסדו [חַסְדִּי] יְקַדְּמֵנִי אֱלֹהִים יַרְאֵנִי בְשֹׁרְרָי׃
verses.english: God who loves me shall come to meet me: God shall let me gaze upon my enemies.

verses.hebrew: אַל־תַּהַרְגֵם פֶּן־יִשְׁכְּחוּ עַמִּי הֲנִיעֵמוֹ בְחֵילְךָ וְהוֹרִידֵמוֹ מָגִנֵּנוּ אֲדֹנָי׃
verses.english: Slay them not, lest my people forget: scatter them by Thy power; and bring them down, O Lord our shield.

verses.hebrew: חַטַּאת־פִּימוֹ דְּבַר־שְׂפָתֵימוֹ וְיִלָּכְדוּ בִגְאוֹנָם וּמֵאָלָה וּמִכַּחַשׁ יְסַפֵּרוּ׃
verses.english: For the sin of their mouth and the words of their lips let them even be taken in their pride: and for cursing and lying which they speak.

verses.hebrew: כַּלֵּה בְחֵמָה כַּלֵּה וְאֵינֵמוֹ וְיֵדְעוּ כִּי־אֱלֹהִים מֹשֵׁל בְּיַעֲקֹב לְאַפְסֵי הָאָרֶץ סֶלָה׃
verses.english: Consume them in wrath, consume them, that they may be no more: and let them know that God rules in Ya῾aqov to the ends of the earth. (Sela.)

verses.hebrew: וְיָשׁוּבוּ לָעֶרֶב יֶהֱמוּ כַכָּלֶב וִיסוֹבְבוּ עִיר׃
verses.english: And at evening let them return; and let them howl like a dog, and go round about the city.

verses.hebrew: הֵמָּה ינועון [יְנִיעוּן] לֶאֱכֹל אִם־לֹא יִשְׂבְּעוּ וַיָּלִינוּ׃
verses.english: Let them wander up and down for food, and murmur if they have not their fill.

verses.hebrew: וַאֲנִי אָשִׁיר עֻזֶּךָ וַאֲרַנֵּן לַבֹּקֶר חַסְדֶּךָ כִּי־הָיִיתָ מִשְׂגָּב לִי וּמָנוֹס בְּיוֹם צַר־לִי׃
verses.english: But I will sing of Thy power; yea, I will sing aloud of Thy steadfast love in the morning: for Thou hast been my defence and refuge in the day of my distress.

verses.hebrew: עֻזִּי אֵלֶיךָ אֲזַמֵּרָה כִּי־אֱלֹהִים מִשְׂגַּבִּי אֱלֹהֵי חַסְדִּי׃
verses.english: To Thee, O my strength, will I sing: for God is my fortress, and the God who loves me.

verses.hebrew: לַמְנַצֵּחַ עַל־שׁוּשַׁן עֵדוּת מִכְתָּם לְדָוִד לְלַמֵּד׃
verses.english: To the chief Musician upon Shushan-῾edut, A Mikhtam of David, to teach;

verses.hebrew: בְּהַצּוֹתוֹ אֶת אֲרַם נַהֲרַיִם וְאֶת־אֲרַם צוֹבָה וַיָּשָׁב יוֹאָב וַיַּךְ אֶת־אֱדוֹם בְּגֵיא־מֶלַח שְׁנֵים עָשָׂר אָלֶף׃
verses.english: when he strove with Aram-naharayim and with Aram-Żova, and Yo᾽av returned, and smote twelve thousand of Edom in the valley of salt.

verses.hebrew: אֱלֹהִים זְנַחְתָּנוּ פְרַצְתָּנוּ אָנַפְתָּ תְּשׁוֹבֵב לָנוּ׃
verses.english: O God, Thou hast cast us off, Thou hast shattered us, Thou hast been angry; O turn Thyself to us again.

verses.hebrew: הִרְעַשְׁתָּה אֶרֶץ פְּצַמְתָּהּ רְפָה שְׁבָרֶיהָ כִי־מָטָה׃
verses.english: Thou hast made the earth to tremble; Thou hast broken it: heal its breaches; for it totters.

verses.hebrew: הִרְאִיתָה עַמְּךָ קָשָׁה הִשְׁקִיתָנוּ יַיִן תַּרְעֵלָה׃
verses.english: Thou hast shown Thy people hard things: Thou hast made us drink the wine of staggering.

verses.hebrew: נָתַתָּה לִּירֵאֶיךָ נֵּס לְהִתְנוֹסֵס מִפְּנֵי קֹשֶׁט סֶלָה׃
verses.english: Thou hast given a banner to those who fear Thee, that it may be displayed because of the truth. (Sela.)

verses.hebrew: לְמַעַן יֵחָלְצוּן יְדִידֶיךָ הוֹשִׁיעָה יְמִינְךָ ועננו [וַעֲנֵנִי׃]
verses.english: That Thy beloved ones may be delivered; save with Thy right hand, and answer me.

verses.hebrew: אֱלֹהִים דִּבֶּר בְּקָדְשׁוֹ אֶעְלֹזָה אֲחַלְּקָה שְׁכֶם וְעֵמֶק סֻכּוֹת אֲמַדֵּד׃
verses.english: God has spoken in his holiness; I will rejoice, I will divide Shekhem, and measure out the valley of Sukkot.

verses.hebrew: לִי גִלְעָד וְלִי מְנַשֶּׁה וְאֶפְרַיִם מָעוֹז רֹאשִׁי יְהוּדָה מְחֹקְקִי׃
verses.english: Gil῾ad is mine, and Menashshe is mine; Efrayim also is the strength of my head; Yehuda is my sceptre;

verses.hebrew: מוֹאָב סִיר רַחְצִי עַל־אֱדוֹם אַשְׁלִיךְ נַעֲלִי עָלַי פְּלֶשֶׁת הִתְרֹעָעִי׃
verses.english: Mo᾽av is my washpot; over Edom will I cast my shoe: Peleshet, cry aloud because of me.

verses.hebrew: מִי יֹבִלֵנִי עִיר מָצוֹר מִי נָחַנִי עַד־אֱדוֹם׃
verses.english: Who will bring me into the strong city? who will lead me into Edom?

verses.hebrew: הֲלֹא־אַתָּה אֱלֹהִים זְנַחְתָּנוּ וְלֹא־תֵצֵא אֱלֹהִים בְּצִבְאוֹתֵינוּ׃
verses.english: Hast thou not rejected us, O God? so that Thou goest not forth, O God, with our hosts.

verses.hebrew: הָבָה־לָּנוּ עֶזְרָת מִצָּר וְשָׁוְא תְּשׁוּעַת אָדָם׃
verses.english: Give us help against the foe: for vain is the help of man.

verses.hebrew: בֵּאלֹהִים נַעֲשֶׂה־חָיִל וְהוּא יָבוּס צָרֵינוּ׃
verses.english: Through God we shall do valiantly: for he it is who will tread down our enemies.

verses.hebrew: לַמְנַצֵּחַ עַל־נְגִינַת לְדָוִד׃
verses.english: To the chief Musician, on strings, Of David.

verses.hebrew: שִׁמְעָה אֱלֹהִים רִנָּתִי הַקְשִׁיבָה תְּפִלָּתִי׃
verses.english: Hear my cry, O God; attend to my prayer.

verses.hebrew: מִקְצֵה הָאָרֶץ אֵלֶיךָ אֶקְרָא בַּעֲטֹף לִבִּי בְּצוּר־יָרוּם מִמֶּנִּי תַנְחֵנִי׃
verses.english: From the end of the earth I will cry to Thee, when my heart faints. lead me to the rock that is too high for me.

verses.hebrew: כִּי־הָיִיתָ מַחְסֶה לִי מִגְדַּל־עֹז מִפְּנֵי אוֹיֵב׃
verses.english: For Thou hast been a shelter for me, and a strong tower from the enemy.

verses.hebrew: אָגוּרָה בְאָהָלְךָ עוֹלָמִים אֶחֱסֶה בְסֵתֶר כְּנָפֶיךָ סֶּלָה׃
verses.english: I will abide in Thy tent for ever: I will trust in the covert of Thy wings. (Sela.)

verses.hebrew: כִּי־אַתָּה אֱלֹהִים שָׁמַעְתָּ לִנְדָרָי נָתַתָּ יְרֻשַּׁת יִרְאֵי שְׁמֶךָ׃
verses.english: For Thou, O God, hast heard my vows: Thou hast granted the heritage of those who fear Thy name.

verses.hebrew: יָמִים עַל־יְמֵי־מֶלֶךְ תּוֹסִיף שְׁנוֹתָיו כְּמוֹ־דֹר וָדֹר׃
verses.english: Prolong the king’s life: may his years be as many generations.

verses.hebrew: יֵשֵׁב עוֹלָם לִפְנֵי אֱלֹהִים חֶסֶד וֶאֱמֶת מַן יִנְצְרֻהוּ׃
verses.english: May he be enthroned before God for ever: O appoint love and truth, that they may preserve him.

verses.hebrew: כֵּן אֲזַמְּרָה שִׁמְךָ לָעַד לְשַׁלְּמִי נְדָרַי יוֹם יוֹם׃
verses.english: So will I sing praise to Thy name for ever, as I perform my vows day by day.

verses.hebrew: לַמְנַצֵּחַ עַל־יְדוּתוּן מִזְמוֹר לְדָוִד׃
verses.english: To the chief Musician, to Yedutun, A Psalm of David.

verses.hebrew: אַךְ אֶל־אֱלֹהִים דּוּמִיָּה נַפְשִׁי מִמֶּנּוּ יְשׁוּעָתִי׃
verses.english: My soul waits in silence only for God: from him comes my salvation.

verses.hebrew: אַךְ־הוּא צוּרִי וִישׁוּעָתִי מִשְׂגַּבִּי לֹא־אֶמּוֹט רַבָּה׃
verses.english: He alone is my rock and my salvation; he is my fortress: I shall not be greatly moved.

verses.hebrew: עַד־אָנָה תְּהוֹתְתוּ עַל אִישׁ תְּרָצְּחוּ כֻלְּכֶם כְּקִיר נָטוּי גָּדֵר הַדְּחוּיָה׃
verses.english: How long will you seek to overwhelm a man? You will be all of you demolished like a leaning wall, or a tottering fence.

verses.hebrew: אַךְ מִשְּׂאֵתוֹ יָעֲצוּ לְהַדִּיחַ יִרְצוּ כָזָב בְּפִיו יְבָרֵכוּ וּבְקִרְבָּם יְקַלְלוּ־סֶלָה׃
verses.english: They even devise to thrust him down from his majesty: they delight in lies: they bless with their mouth, but they curse inwardly. (Sela.)

verses.hebrew: אַךְ לֵאלֹהִים דּוֹמִּי נַפְשִׁי כִּי־מִמֶּנּוּ תִּקְוָתִי׃
verses.english: My soul waits in silence only for God; for my expectation is from him.

verses.hebrew: אַךְ־הוּא צוּרִי וִישׁוּעָתִי מִשְׂגַּבִּי לֹא אֶמּוֹט׃
verses.english: He alone is my rock and my salvation: he is my defence; I shall not be moved.

verses.hebrew: עַל־אֱלֹהִים יִשְׁעִי וּכְבוֹדִי צוּר־עֻזִּי מַחְסִי בֵּאלֹהִים׃
verses.english: In God is my salvation and my glory: the rock of my strength, and my refuge, is in God.

verses.hebrew: בִּטְחוּ בוֹ בְכָל־עֵת עָם שִׁפְכוּ־לְפָנָיו לְבַבְכֶם אֱלֹהִים מַחֲסֶה־לָּנוּ סֶלָה׃
verses.english: Trust in him at all times; you people, pour out your heart before him: God is a refuge for us. (Sela.)

verses.hebrew: אַךְ הֶבֶל בְּנֵי־אָדָם כָּזָב בְּנֵי אִישׁ בְּמֹאזְנַיִם לַעֲלוֹת הֵמָּה מֵהֶבֶל יָחַד׃
verses.english: Men of low degree are mere breath, and men of high degree are a lie: to be laid in the balance, they are altogether lighter than air.

verses.hebrew: אַל־תִּבְטְחוּ בְעֹשֶׁק וּבְגָזֵל אַל־תֶּהְבָּלוּ חַיִל כִּי־יָנוּב אַל־תָּשִׁיתוּ לֵב׃
verses.english: Trust not in oppression, and become not vain in robbery: if riches increase, set not your heart upon them.

verses.hebrew: אַחַת דִּבֶּר אֱלֹהִים שְׁתַּיִם־זוּ שָׁמָעְתִּי כִּי עֹז לֵאלֹהִים׃
verses.english: God has spoken once: twice have I heard this; that power belongs to God.

verses.hebrew: וּלְךָ־אֲדֹנָי חָסֶד כִּי־אַתָּה תְשַׁלֵּם לְאִישׁ כְּמַעֲשֵׂהוּ׃
verses.english: But love is also Thine, when Thou renderest to every man according to his work.

verses.hebrew: מִזְמוֹר לְדָוִד בִּהְיוֹתוֹ בְּמִדְבַּר יְהוּדָה׃
verses.english: A Psalm of David, when he was in the wilderness of Yehuda.

verses.hebrew: אֱלֹהִים אֵלִי אַתָּה אֲ‍שַׁחֲרֶךָּ צָמְאָה לְךָ נַפְשִׁי כָּמַהּ לְךָ בְשָׂרִי בְּאֶרֶץ־צִיָּה וְעָיֵף בְּלִי־מָיִם׃
verses.english: O God, Thou art my God; earnestly I seek Thee: my soul thirsts for Thee, my flesh longs for Thee in a dry and thirsty land, where no water is;

verses.hebrew: כֵּן בַּקֹּדֶשׁ חֲזִיתִיךָ לִרְאוֹת עֻזְּךָ וּכְבוֹדֶךָ׃
verses.english: to see Thy power and Thy glory, as I have seen Thee in the sanctuary.

verses.hebrew: כִּי־טוֹב חַסְדְּךָ מֵחַיִּים שְׂפָתַי יְשַׁבְּחוּנְךָ׃
verses.english: Because Thy steadfast love is better than life, my lips shall praise Thee.

verses.hebrew: כֵּן אֲבָרֶכְךָ בְחַיָּי בְּשִׁמְךָ אֶשָּׂא כַפָּי׃
verses.english: Thus will I bless Thee while I live: I will lift up my hands in Thy name.

verses.hebrew: כְּמוֹ חֵלֶב וָדֶשֶׁן תִּשְׂבַּע נַפְשִׁי וְשִׂפְתֵי רְנָנוֹת יְהַלֶּל־פִּי׃
verses.english: My soul is satisfied as with marrow and fatness; and my mouth praises Thee with joyful lips:

verses.hebrew: אִם־זְכַרְתִּיךָ עַל־יְצוּעָי בְּאַשְׁמֻרוֹת אֶהְגֶּה־בָּךְ׃
verses.english: when I remember Thee upon my bed, and meditate on Thee in the night watches.

verses.hebrew: כִּי־הָיִיתָ עֶזְרָתָה לִּי וּבְצֵל כְּנָפֶיךָ אֲרַנֵּן׃
verses.english: Because Thou hast been my help, therefore in the shadow of Thy wings I will rejoice.

verses.hebrew: דָּבְקָה נַפְשִׁי אַחֲרֶיךָ בִּי תָּמְכָה יְמִינֶךָ׃
verses.english: My soul clings to Thee: Thy right hand upholds me.

verses.hebrew: וְהֵמָּה לְשׁוֹאָה יְבַקְשׁוּ נַפְשִׁי יָבֹאוּ בְּתַחְתִּיּוֹת הָאָרֶץ׃
verses.english: But those who seek my soul, to destroy it, shall go into the lower parts of the earth.

verses.hebrew: יַגִּירֻהוּ עַל־יְדֵי־חָרֶב מְנָת שֻׁעָלִים יִהְיוּ׃
verses.english: They shall be given over to the sword: they shall be a portion for foxes.

verses.hebrew: וְהַמֶּלֶךְ יִשְׂמַח בֵּאלֹהִים יִתְהַלֵּל כָּל־הַנִּשְׁבָּע בּוֹ כִּי יִסָּכֵר פִּי דוֹבְרֵי־שָׁקֶר׃
verses.english: But the king shall rejoice in God; everyone who swears by him shall glory: for the mouth of those who speak lies shall be stopped.

verses.hebrew: לַמְנַצֵּחַ מִזְמוֹר לְדָוִד׃
verses.english: To the chief Musician, A Psalm of David.

verses.hebrew: שְׁמַע־אֱלֹהִים קוֹלִי בְשִׂיחִי מִפַּחַד אוֹיֵב תִּצֹּר חַיָּי׃
verses.english: Hear my voice, O God, in my prayer: preserve my life from fear of the enemy.

verses.hebrew: תַּסְתִּירֵנִי מִסּוֹד מְרֵעִים מֵרִגְשַׁת פֹּעֲלֵי אָוֶן׃
verses.english: Hide me from the secret council of the wicked; from the tumult of the workers of iniquity:

verses.hebrew: אֲשֶׁר שָׁנְנוּ כַחֶרֶב לְשׁוֹנָם דָּרְכוּ חִצָּם דָּבָר מָר׃
verses.english: who have whetted their tongue like a sword, aimed their arrows of bitter words:

verses.hebrew: לִירוֹת בַּמִּסְתָּרִים תָּם פִּתְאֹם יֹרֻהוּ וְלֹא יִירָאוּ׃
verses.english: to shoot the innocent man in secret; suddenly do they shoot at him, and fear not.

verses.hebrew: יְחַזְּקוּ־לָמוֹ דָּבָר רָע יְסַפְּרוּ לִטְמוֹן מוֹקְשִׁים אָמְרוּ מִי יִרְאֶה־לָּמוֹ׃
verses.english: They encourage one another in an evil matter: they speak of laying snares secretly; they say, Who shall see them?

verses.hebrew: יַחְפְּשׂוּ־עוֹלֹת תַּמְנוּ חֵפֶשׂ מְחֻפָּשׂ וְקֶרֶב אִישׁ וְלֵב עָמֹק׃
verses.english: They search out iniquities; they accomplish a diligent search: for the inward thought of man, and the heart, is deep.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּרֵם אֱלֹהִים חֵץ פִּתְאוֹם הָיוּ מַכּוֹתָם׃
verses.english: But God shoots his arrow at them: suddenly their wounds are on them.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּכְשִׁילוּהוּ עָלֵימוֹ לְשׁוֹנָם יִתְנֹדֲדוּ כָּל־רֹאֵה בָם׃
verses.english: So they make their own tongue a stumbling to themselves; all that see them shake the head.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּירְאוּ כָּל־אָדָם וַיַּגִּידוּ פֹּעַל אֱלֹהִים וּמַעֲשֵׂהוּ הִשְׂכִּילוּ׃
verses.english: And all men are afraid, and they declare the work of God; for they wisely consider of his doing.

verses.hebrew: יִשְׂמַח צַדִּיק בַּיהוָה וְחָסָה בוֹ וְיִתְהַלְלוּ כָּל־יִשְׁרֵי־לֵב׃
verses.english: The just man shall be glad in the Lord, and shall trust in him; and all the upright in heart shall glory.

verses.hebrew: לַמְנַצֵּחַ מִזְמוֹר לְדָוִד שִׁיר׃
verses.english: To the chief Musician, A Psalm of David, a Poem.

verses.hebrew: לְךָ דֻמִיָּה תְהִלָּה אֱלֹהִים בְּצִיּוֹן וּלְךָ יְשֻׁלַּם־נֶדֶר׃
verses.english: Praise awaits Thee, O God, in Żiyyon: and to Thee shall the vow be performed.

verses.hebrew: שֹׁמֵעַ תְּפִלָּה עָדֶיךָ כָּל־בָּשָׂר יָבֹאוּ׃
verses.english: O Thou that hearest prayer, to Thee shall all flesh come.

verses.hebrew: דִּבְרֵי עֲוֺנֹת גָּבְרוּ מֶנִּי פְּשָׁעֵינוּ אַתָּה תְכַפְּרֵם׃
verses.english: Iniquities prevail against me: as for our transgressions, Thou shalt purge them away.

verses.hebrew: אַשְׁרֵי תִּבְחַר וּתְקָרֵב יִשְׁכֹּן חֲצֵרֶיךָ נִשְׂבְּעָה בְּטוּב בֵּיתֶךָ קְדֹשׁ הֵיכָלֶךָ׃
verses.english: Happy is the man whom Thou choosest, and causest to approach to Thee, that he may dwell in Thy courts: we will be satisfied with the goodness of Thy house, Thy holy temple.

verses.hebrew: נוֹרָאוֹת בְּצֶדֶק תַּעֲנֵנוּ אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׁעֵנוּ מִבְטָח כָּל־קַצְוֵי־אֶרֶץ וְיָם רְחֹקִים׃
verses.english: By terrible things in righteousness wilt Thou answer us, O God of our salvation; who art the confidence of all the ends of the earth, and of the farthest sea.

verses.hebrew: מֵכִין הָרִים בְּכֹחוֹ נֶאְזָר בִּגְבוּרָה׃
verses.english: Who by his strength places the mountains in position; who is girded with power:

verses.hebrew: מַשְׁבִּיחַ שְׁאוֹן יַמִּים שְׁאוֹן גַּלֵּיהֶם וַהֲמוֹן לְאֻמִּים׃
verses.english: who stills the noise of the seas, the roaring of their waves, and the tumult of the peoples.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּירְאוּ יֹשְׁבֵי קְצָוֺת מֵאוֹתֹתֶיךָ מוֹצָאֵי־בֹקֶר וָעֶרֶב תַּרְנִין׃
verses.english: They also who dwell in the uttermost parts are afraid at Thy signs: Thou makest the outgoings of the morning and evening to rejoice.

verses.hebrew: פָּקַדְתָּ הָאָרֶץ וַתְּשֹׁקְקֶהָ רַבַּת תַּעְשְׁרֶנָּה פֶּלֶג אֱלֹהִים מָלֵא מָיִם תָּכִין דְּגָנָם כִּי־כֵן תְּכִינֶהָ׃
verses.english: Thou visitest the earth, and waterest it: Thou greatly enrichest it with the river of God, which is full of water: Thou providest corn for them, for so Thou hast prepared it.

verses.hebrew: תְּלָמֶיהָ רַוֵּה נַחֵת גְּדוּדֶיהָ בִּרְבִיבִים תְּמֹגְגֶנָּה צִמְחָהּ תְּבָרֵךְ׃
verses.english: Watering her furrows abundantly, settling her ridges: Thou makest it soft with showers: Thou blessest its growth.

verses.hebrew: עִטַּרְתָּ שְׁנַת טוֹבָתֶךָ וּמַעְגָּלֶיךָ יִרְעֲפוּן דָּשֶׁן׃
verses.english: Thou crownest the year with Thy goodness; and Thy paths drop fatness.

verses.hebrew: יִרְעֲפוּ נְאוֹת מִדְבָּר וְגִיל גְּבָעוֹת תַּחְגֹּרְנָה׃
verses.english: The pastures of the wilderness drop moisture: and the little hills rejoice on every side.

verses.hebrew: לָבְשׁוּ כָרִים הַצֹּאן וַעֲמָקִים יַעַטְפוּ־בָר יִתְרוֹעֲעוּ אַף־יָשִׁירוּ׃
verses.english: The meadows are clothed with flocks; the valleys also are covered over with corn; they shout for joy, they also sing.

verses.hebrew: לַמְנַצֵּחַ שִׁיר מִזְמוֹר הָרִיעוּ לֵאלֹהִים כָּל־הָאָרֶץ׃
verses.english: To the chief Musician, A Poem, a Psalm. Make a joyful noise to God, all the earth:

verses.hebrew: זַמְּרוּ כְבוֹד־שְׁמוֹ שִׂימוּ כָבוֹד תְּהִלָּתוֹ׃
verses.english: sing to the glory of his name: make his praise glorious.

verses.hebrew: אִמְרוּ לֵאלֹהִים מַה־נּוֹרָא מַעֲשֶׂיךָ בְּרֹב עֻזְּךָ יְכַחֲשׁוּ לְךָ אֹיְבֶיךָ׃
verses.english: Say to God, How terrible are Thy works! through the greatness of Thy power shall Thy enemies cringe before Thee.

verses.hebrew: כָּל־הָאָרֶץ יִשְׁתַּחֲווּ לְךָ וִיזַמְּרוּ־לָךְ יְזַמְּרוּ שִׁמְךָ סֶלָה׃
verses.english: All the earth shall worship Thee, and shall sing to Thee; they shall sing to Thy name. (Sela.)

verses.hebrew: לְכוּ וּרְאוּ מִפְעֲלוֹת אֱלֹהִים נוֹרָא עֲלִילָה עַל־בְּנֵי אָדָם׃
verses.english: Come and see the works of God: terrible is his doing towards the children of men.

verses.hebrew: הָפַךְ יָם לְיַבָּשָׁה בַּנָּהָר יַעַבְרוּ בְרָגֶל שָׁם נִשְׂמְחָה־בּוֹ׃
verses.english: He turned the sea into dry land: they went through the river on foot: there did we rejoice in him.

verses.hebrew: מֹשֵׁל בִּגְבוּרָתוֹ עוֹלָם עֵינָיו בַּגּוֹיִם תִּצְפֶּינָה הַסּוֹרְרִים אַל־ירימו [יָרוּמוּ] לָמוֹ סֶלָה׃
verses.english: He rules by his power forever; his eyes behold the nations: let not the rebellious exalt themselves. (Sela.)

verses.hebrew: בָּרְכוּ עַמִּים אֱלֹהֵינוּ וְהַשְׁמִיעוּ קוֹל תְּהִלָּתוֹ׃
verses.english: O bless our God, you peoples, and make the voice of his praise to be heard:

verses.hebrew: הַשָּׂם נַפְשֵׁנוּ בַּחַיִּים וְלֹא־נָתַן לַמּוֹט רַגְלֵנוּ׃
verses.english: who has kept our soul in life, and has not suffered our foot to be moved.

verses.hebrew: כִּי־בְחַנְתָּנוּ אֱלֹהִים צְרַפְתָּנוּ כִּצְרָף־כָּסֶף׃
verses.english: For Thou, O God, hast tested us: Thou hast tried us, as silver is refined.

verses.hebrew: הֲבֵאתָנוּ בַמְּצוּדָה שַׂמְתָּ מוּעָקָה בְמָתְנֵינוּ׃
verses.english: Thou hast brought us into the net; Thou hast laid affliction upon our loins.

verses.hebrew: הִרְכַּבְתָּ אֱנוֹשׁ לְרֹאשֵׁנוּ בָּאנוּ־בָאֵשׁ וּבַמַּיִם וַתּוֹצִיאֵנוּ לָרְוָיָה׃
verses.english: Thou hast caused men to ride over our heads; we went through fire and through water: but Thou didst bring us out into abundance.

verses.hebrew: אָבוֹא בֵיתְךָ בְעוֹלוֹת אֲשַׁלֵּם לְךָ נְדָרָי׃
verses.english: I will go into Thy house with burnt offerings: I will pay Thee my vows,

verses.hebrew: אֲשֶׁר־פָּצוּ שְׂפָתָי וְדִבֶּר־פִּי בַּצַּר־לִי׃
verses.english: which my lips have uttered, and my mouth has spoken, when I was in trouble.

verses.hebrew: עֹלוֹת מֵחִים אַעֲלֶה־לָּךְ עִם־קְטֹרֶת אֵילִים אֶעֱשֶׂה בָקָר עִם־עַתּוּדִים סֶלָה׃
verses.english: I will offer unto Thee burnt sacrifices of fatlings, with the sweet smoke of rams; I will offer bullocks with goats. (Sela.)

verses.hebrew: לְכוּ־שִׁמְעוּ וַאֲסַפְּרָה כָּל־יִרְאֵי אֱלֹהִים אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה לְנַפְשִׁי׃
verses.english: Come and hear, all you that fear God, and I will declare what he has done for my soul.

verses.hebrew: אֵלָיו פִּי־קָרָאתִי וְרוֹמַם תַּחַת לְשׁוֹנִי׃
verses.english: I cried to him with my mouth, and he was extolled with my tongue.

verses.hebrew: אָוֶן אִם־רָאִיתִי בְלִבִּי לֹא יִשְׁמַע אֲדֹנָי׃
verses.english: If I had looked on wickedness with my heart, the Lord would not have heard:

verses.hebrew: אָכֵן שָׁמַע אֱלֹהִים הִקְשִׁיב בְּקוֹל תְּפִלָּתִי׃
verses.english: but verily God has heard me; he has attended to the voice of my prayer.

verses.hebrew: בָּרוּךְ אֱלֹהִים אֲשֶׁר לֹא־הֵסִיר תְּפִלָּתִי וְחַסְדּוֹ מֵאִתִּי׃
verses.english: Blessed be God, who has not turned away my prayer, nor removed his steadfast love from me.

verses.hebrew: לַמְנַצֵּח בִּנְגִינֹת מִזְמוֹר שִׁיר׃
verses.english: To the chief Musician on strings, A Psalm, a Poem.

verses.hebrew: אֱלֹהִים יְחָנֵּנוּ וִיבָרְכֵנוּ יָאֵר פָּנָיו אִתָּנוּ סֶלָה׃
verses.english: God be gracious to us, and bless us; and cause his face to shine upon us; (Sela.)

verses.hebrew: לָדַעַת בָּאָרֶץ דַּרְכֶּךָ בְּכָל־גּוֹיִם יְשׁוּעָתֶךָ׃
verses.english: that Thy way may be known upon earth, Thy salvation among all nations.

verses.hebrew: יוֹדוּךָ עַמִּים אֱלֹהִים יוֹדוּךָ עַמִּים כֻּלָּם׃
verses.english: Let the peoples praise Thee, O God; let all the peoples give thanks to Thee.

verses.hebrew: יִשְׂמְחוּ וִירַנְּנוּ לְאֻמִּים כִּי־תִשְׁפֹּט עַמִּים מִישׁוֹר וּלְאֻמִּים בָּאָרֶץ תַּנְחֵם סֶלָה׃
verses.english: O let the nations be glad and sing for joy: for Thou shalt judge the peoples with equity, and govern the nations upon earth. (Sela.)

verses.hebrew: יוֹדוּךָ עַמִּים אֱלֹהִים יוֹדוּךָ עַמִּים כֻּלָּם׃
verses.english: Let the peoples praise Thee, O God; let all the peoples give Thee thanks.

verses.hebrew: אֶרֶץ נָתְנָה יְבוּלָהּ יְבָרְכֵנוּ אֱלֹהִים אֱלֹהֵינוּ׃
verses.english: The earth has yielded her increase; and God, our own God, shall bless us.

verses.hebrew: יְבָרְכֵנוּ אֱלֹהִים וְיִירְאוּ אֹתוֹ כָּל־אַפְסֵי־אָרֶץ׃
verses.english: God shall bless us; and let all the ends of the earth fear him.

verses.hebrew: לַמְנַצֵּחַ לְדָוִד מִזְמוֹר שִׁיר׃
verses.english: To the chief Musician, A Psalm, a Poem of David.

verses.hebrew: יָקוּם אֱלֹהִים יָפוּצוּ אוֹיְבָיו וְיָנוּסוּ מְשַׂנְאָיו מִפָּנָיו׃
verses.english: Let God arise, let his enemies be scattered: and let those who hate him flee before him.

verses.hebrew: כְּהִנְדֹּף עָשָׁן תִּנְדֹּף כְּהִמֵּס דּוֹנַג מִפְּנֵי־אֵשׁ יֹאבְדוּ רְשָׁעִים מִפְּנֵי אֱלֹהִים׃
verses.english: As smoke is driven away, so drive them away: as wax melts before the fire, so let the wicked perish at the presence of God.

verses.hebrew: וְצַדִּיקִים יִשְׂמְחוּ יַעַלְצוּ לִפְנֵי אֱלֹהִים וְיָשִׂישׂוּ בְשִׂמְחָה׃
verses.english: But let the righteous be glad; let them rejoice before God: and let them joyfully exult.

verses.hebrew: שִׁירוּ לֵאלֹהִים זַמְּרוּ שְׁמוֹ סֹלּוּ לָרֹכֵב בָּעֲרָבוֹת בְּיָהּ שְׁמוֹ וְעִלְזוּ לְפָנָיו׃
verses.english: Sing to God, sing praises to his name: extol him who rides upon the clouds; Ya is his name: and rejoice before him.

verses.hebrew: אֲבִי יְתוֹמִים וְדַיַּן אַלְמָנוֹת אֱלֹהִים בִּמְעוֹן קָדְשׁוֹ׃
verses.english: A father of the fatherless, and a judge of widows, is God in his holy habitation.

verses.hebrew: אֱלֹהִים מוֹשִׁיב יְחִידִים בַּיְתָה מוֹצִיא אֲסִירִים בַּכּוֹשָׁרוֹת אַךְ סוֹרֲרִים שָׁכְנוּ צְחִיחָה׃
verses.english: God makes the lonely ones dwell in a house: he brings out the prisoners into prosperity; but the rebellious dwell in a parched land.

verses.hebrew: אֱ‍לֹהִים בְּצֵאתְךָ לִפְנֵי עַמֶּךָ בְּצַעְדְּךָ בִישִׁימוֹן סֶלָה׃
verses.english: O God, when Thou didst go out before Thy people, when Thou didst march through the wilderness; (Sela;)

verses.hebrew: אֶרֶץ רָעָשָׁה אַף־שָׁמַיִם נָטְפוּ מִפְּנֵי אֱלֹהִים זֶה סִינַי מִפְּנֵי אֱלֹהִים אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃
verses.english: the earth shook, the heavens also dropped at the presence of God: even Sinay itself at the presence of God, the God of Yisra᾽el.

verses.hebrew: גֶּשֶׁם נְדָבוֹת תָּנִיף אֱלֹהִים נַחֲלָתְךָ וְנִלְאָה אַתָּה כוֹנַנְתָּהּ׃
verses.english: Thou, O God, didst send a plentiful rain, whereby Thou didst strengthen Thy inheritance, when it languished.

verses.hebrew: חַיָּתְךָ יָשְׁבוּ־בָהּ תָּכִין בְּטוֹבָתְךָ לֶעָנִי אֱלֹהִים׃
verses.english: Thy flock found a dwelling in it: Thou, O God, preparest of Thy goodness for the poor.

verses.hebrew: אֲדֹנָי יִתֶּן־אֹמֶר הַמְבַשְּׂרוֹת צָבָא רָב׃
verses.english: The Lord gives the word: great is the company of those who bear the tidings.

verses.hebrew: מַלְכֵי צְבָאוֹת יִדֹּדוּן יִדֹּדוּן וּנְוַת בַּיִת תְּחַלֵּק שָׁלָל׃
verses.english: Kings of armies flee, they flee: and she who dwells in the house divides the spoil.

verses.hebrew: אִם־תִּשְׁכְּבוּן בֵּין שְׁפַתָּיִם כַּנְפֵי יוֹנָה נֶחְפָּה בַכֶּסֶף וְאֶבְרוֹתֶיהָ בִּירַקְרַק חָרוּץ׃
verses.english: When you lie among the sheep folds you shall shine as the wings of a dove covered with silver, and her pinions with yellow gold.

verses.hebrew: בְּפָרֵשׂ שַׁדַּי מְלָכִים בָּהּ תַּשְׁלֵג בְּצַלְמוֹן׃
verses.english: When the Almighty scatters kings in it, snow falls in Żalmon.

verses.hebrew: הַר־אֱלֹהִים הַר־בָּשָׁן הַר גַּבְנֻנִּים הַר־בָּשָׁן׃
verses.english: O mighty hill, O hill of Bashan; O high peaked hill, hill of Bashan:

verses.hebrew: לָמָּה תְּרַצְּדוּן הָרִים גַּבְנֻנִּים הָהָר חָמַד אֱלֹהִים לְשִׁבְתּוֹ אַף־יְהוָה יִשְׁכֹּן לָנֶצַח׃
verses.english: why dost thou look askance, O high peaked hill, at the mountain which God has desired for his abode? truly the Lord will dwell there forever.

verses.hebrew: רֶכֶב אֱלֹהִים רִבֹּתַיִם אַלְפֵי שִׁנְאָן אֲדֹנָי בָם סִינַי בַּקֹּדֶשׁ׃
verses.english: The chariots of God are twice ten thousand, thousands upon thousands: the Lord is among them: Sinay in holiness!

verses.hebrew: עָלִיתָ לַמָּרוֹם שָׁבִיתָ שֶּׁבִי לָקַחְתָּ מַתָּנוֹת בָּאָדָם וְאַף סוֹרְרִים לִשְׁכֹּן יָהּ אֱלֹהִים׃
verses.english: Thou hast ascended on high, thou hast led captivity captive: thou hast received gifts from men; yea, from the rebellious also, that the Lord God might dwell there.

verses.hebrew: בָּרוּךְ אֲדֹנָי יוֹם יוֹם יַעֲמָס־לָנוּ הָאֵל יְשׁוּעָתֵנוּ סֶלָה׃
verses.english: Blessed be the Lord who day by day bears our burden. God is our salvation. (Sela.)

verses.hebrew: הָאֵל לָנוּ אֵל לְמוֹשָׁעוֹת וְלֵיהוִה אֲדֹנָי לַמָּוֶת תּוֹצָאוֹת׃
verses.english: He That is our God is the God of salvations; and to God the Lord belong the issues of death.

verses.hebrew: אַךְ־אֱלֹהִים יִמְחַץ רֹאשׁ אֹיְבָיו קָדְקֹד שֵׂעָר מִתְהַלֵּךְ בַּאֲשָׁמָיו׃
verses.english: But God will smite through the head of his enemies, the hairy scalp of such as goes on still in his trespasses.

verses.hebrew: אָמַר אֲדֹנָי מִבָּשָׁן אָשִׁיב אָשִׁיב מִמְּצֻלוֹת יָם׃
verses.english: The Lord said, I will bring back from Bashan, I will bring them back from the depths of the sea:

verses.hebrew: לְמַעַן תִּמְחַץ רַגְלְךָ בְּדָם לְשׁוֹן כְּלָבֶיךָ מֵאֹיְבִים מִנֵּהוּ׃
verses.english: that thy foot may wade in blood; and the tongue of thy dogs have its portion of thy enemies.

verses.hebrew: רָאוּ הֲלִיכוֹתֶיךָ אֱלֹהִים הֲלִיכוֹת אֵלִי מַלְכִּי בַקֹּדֶשׁ׃
verses.english: They see Thy processions, O God; the processions of my God, my King, in the sanctuary.

verses.hebrew: קִדְּמוּ שָׁרִים אַחַר נֹגְנִים בְּתוֹךְ עֲלָמוֹת תּוֹפֵפוֹת׃
verses.english: The singers go before, the players on instruments follow after; among them are maidens beating tambourines.

verses.hebrew: בְּמַקְהֵלוֹת בָּרְכוּ אֱלֹהִים יְהוָה מִמְּקוֹר יִשְׂרָאֵל׃
verses.english: Bless God in the congregations, the Lord, from the fountain of Yisra᾽el.

verses.hebrew: שָׁם בִּנְיָמִן צָעִיר רֹדֵם שָׂרֵי יְהוּדָה רִגְמָתָם שָׂרֵי זְבֻלוּן שָׂרֵי נַפְתָּלִי׃
verses.english: There is Binyamin, the youngest, ruling them, the princes of Yehuda, their council, the princes of Zevulun, and the princes of Naftali.

verses.hebrew: צִוָּה אֱלֹהֶיךָ עֻזֶּךָ עוּזָּה אֱלֹהִים זוּ פָּעַלְתָּ לָּנוּ׃
verses.english: Thy God has commanded thy strength: strengthen, O God, that which Thou hast wrought for us,

verses.hebrew: מֵהֵיכָלֶךָ עַל־יְרוּשָׁלִָם לְךָ יוֹבִילוּ מְלָכִים שָׁי׃
verses.english: out of Thy temple at Yerushalayim, whither kings shall bring Thee gifts.

verses.hebrew: גְּעַר חַיַּת קָנֶה עֲדַת אַבִּירִים בְּעֶגְלֵי עַמִּים מִתְרַפֵּס בְּרַצֵּי־כָסֶף בִּזַּר עַמִּים קְרָבוֹת יֶחְפָּצוּ׃
verses.english: Rebuke the wild beast of the reed grass, the company of bulls with the calves of the peoples, who seek to ingratiate themselves with pieces of silver; the prodigality of nations desiring to approach Thee.

verses.hebrew: יֶאֱתָיוּ חַשְׁמַנִּים מִנִּי מִצְרָיִם כּוּשׁ תָּרִיץ יָדָיו לֵאלֹהִים׃
verses.english: Nobles shall come out of Miżrayim; Kush shall soon stretch out her hands to God.

verses.hebrew: מַמְלְכוֹת הָאָרֶץ שִׁירוּ לֵאלֹהִים זַמְּרוּ אֲדֹנָי סֶלָה׃
verses.english: Sing to God, you kingdoms of the earth; O sing praise to the Lord; (Sela;)

verses.hebrew: לָרֹכֵב בִּשְׁמֵי שְׁמֵי־קֶדֶם הֵן יִתֵּן בְּקוֹלוֹ קוֹל עֹז׃
verses.english: to him that rides upon the heavens of heavens, which are of old; lo, he sends out his voice, a mighty voice.

verses.hebrew: תְּנוּ עֹז לֵאלֹהִים עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵל גַּאֲוָתוֹ וְעֻזּוֹ בַּשְּׁחָקִים׃
verses.english: Ascribe strength to God: his majesty is over Yisra᾽el, and his strength is in the clouds.

verses.hebrew: נוֹרָא אֱלֹהִים מִמִּקְדָּשֶׁיךָ אֵל יִשְׂרָאֵל הוּא נֹתֵן עֹז וְתַעֲצֻמוֹת לָעָם בָּרוּךְ אֱלֹהִים׃
verses.english: O God, Thou art terrible out of Thy holy places: the God of Yisra᾽el: he gives strength and power to his people. Blessed is God.

verses.hebrew: לַמְנַצֵּחַ עַל־שׁוֹשַׁנִּים לְדָוִד׃
verses.english: To the chief Musician upon Shoshannim, Of David.

verses.hebrew: הוֹשִׁיעֵנִי אֱלֹהִים כִּי בָאוּ מַיִם עַד־נָפֶשׁ׃
verses.english: Save me, O God; for the waters are come in to my soul.

verses.hebrew: טָבַעְתִּי בִּיוֵן מְצוּלָה וְאֵין מָעֳמָד בָּאתִי בְמַעֲמַקֵּי־מַיִם וְשִׁבֹּלֶת שְׁטָפָתְנִי׃
verses.english: I sink in deep mire, where there is no standing: I am come into deep waters, and the flood overwhelms me.

verses.hebrew: יָגַעְתִּי בְקָרְאִי נִחַר גְּרוֹנִי כָּלוּ עֵינַי מְיַחֵל לֵאלֹהָי׃
verses.english: I am weary with my crying: my throat is dried: my eyes fail while I wait for my God.

verses.hebrew: רַבּוּ מִשַּׂעֲרוֹת רֹאשִׁי שֹׂנְאַי חִנָּם עָצְמוּ מַצְמִיתַי אֹיְבַי שֶׁקֶר אֲשֶׁר לֹא־גָזַלְתִּי אָז אָשִׁיב׃
verses.english: They who hate me without cause are more than the hairs of my head: they who would destroy me are many, who hate me wrongfully.

verses.hebrew: אֱ‍לֹהִים אַתָּה יָדַעְתָּ לְאִוַּלְתִּי וְאַשְׁמוֹתַי מִמְּךָ לֹא־נִכְחָדוּ׃
verses.english: What I took not away, that must I restore. O God, Thou knowst my folly; and my sins are not hid from Thee.

verses.hebrew: אַל־יֵבֹשׁוּ בִי קֹוֶיךָ אֲדֹנָי יְהוִה צְבָאוֹת אַל־יִכָּלְמוּ בִי מְבַקְשֶׁיךָ אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃
verses.english: Let not those who wait on Thee, O Lord God of hosts, be ashamed for my sake: let not those who seek Thee be confounded for my sake, O God of Yisra᾽el.

verses.hebrew: כִּי־עָלֶיךָ נָשָׂאתִי חֶרְפָּה כִּסְּתָה כְלִמָּה פָנָי׃
verses.english: Because for Thy sake I have borne insult; confusion has covered my face.

verses.hebrew: מוּזָר הָיִיתִי לְאֶחָי וְנָכְרִי לִבְנֵי אִמִּי׃
verses.english: I am become a stranger to my brothers, and an alien to my mother’s children.

verses.hebrew: כִּי־קִנְאַת בֵּיתְךָ אֲכָלָתְנִי וְחֶרְפּוֹת חוֹרְפֶיךָ נָפְלוּ עָלָי׃
verses.english: For the zeal of Thy house has eaten me up; and the taunts of those who taunt Thee are fallen upon me.

verses.hebrew: וָאֶבְכֶּה בַצּוֹם נַפְשִׁי וַתְּהִי לַחֲרָפוֹת לִי׃
verses.english: When I wept, and chastened my soul with fasting, that became a reproach to me.

verses.hebrew: וָאֶתְּנָה לְבוּשִׁי שָׂק וָאֱהִי לָהֶם לְמָשָׁל׃
verses.english: I made sackcloth also my garment; and I became a proverb to them.

verses.hebrew: יָשִׂיחוּ בִי יֹשְׁבֵי שָׁעַר וּנְגִינוֹת שׁוֹתֵי שֵׁכָר׃
verses.english: They who sit in the gate talk of me; and I am the song of drunkards.

verses.hebrew: וַאֲנִי תְפִלָּתִי־לְךָ יְהוָה עֵת רָצוֹן אֱלֹהִים בְּרָב־חַסְדֶּךָ עֲנֵנִי בֶּאֱמֶת יִשְׁעֶךָ׃
verses.english: But as for me, let my prayer be to Thee, O Lord, in an acceptable time: O God, in the greatness of Thy steadfast love hear me, in the truth of Thy salvation.

verses.hebrew: הַצִּילֵנִי מִטִּיט וְאַל־אֶטְבָּעָה אִנָּצְלָה מִשֹּׂנְאַי וּמִמַּעֲמַקֵּי־מָיִם׃
verses.english: Deliver me out of the mire, and let me not sink: let me be delivered from those who hate me, and out of the deep waters.

verses.hebrew: אַל־תִּשְׁטְפֵנִי שִׁבֹּלֶת מַיִם וְאַל־תִּבְלָעֵנִי מְצוּלָה וְאַל־תֶּאְטַר־עָלַי בְּאֵר פִּיהָ׃
verses.english: Let not the waterflood overwhelm me, nor let the deep swallow me up, and let not the pit shut her mouth upon me.

verses.hebrew: עֲנֵנִי יְהוָה כִּי־טוֹב חַסְדֶּךָ כְּרֹב רַחֲמֶיךָ פְּנֵה אֵלָי׃
verses.english: Hear me, O Lord; for Thy love is good: turn towards me according to the multitude of Thy compassion.

verses.hebrew: וְאַל־תַּסְתֵּר פָּנֶיךָ מֵעַבְדֶּךָ כִּי־צַר־לִי מַהֵר עֲנֵנִי׃
verses.english: And hide not Thy face from Thy servant; for I am in trouble: answer me speedily.

verses.hebrew: קָרְבָה אֶל־נַפְשִׁי גְאָלָהּ לְמַעַן אֹיְבַי פְּדֵנִי׃
verses.english: Draw near to my soul, and redeem it: ransom me because of my enemies.

verses.hebrew: אַתָּה יָדַעְתָּ חֶרְפָּתִי וּבָשְׁתִּי וּכְלִמָּתִי נֶגְדְּךָ כָּל־צוֹרְרָי׃
verses.english: Thou knowst my reproach, and my shame, and my dishonour: my adversaries are all before Thee.

verses.hebrew: חֶרְפָּה שָׁבְרָה לִבִּי וָאָנוּשָׁה וָאֲקַוֶּה לָנוּד וָאַיִן וְלַמְנַחֲמִים וְלֹא מָצָאתִי׃
verses.english: Insult has broken my heart; and I am sick: and I looked for some to take pity, but there was none; and for comforters, but I found none.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּתְּנוּ בְּבָרוּתִי רֹאשׁ וְלִצְמָאִי יַשְׁקוּנִי חֹמֶץ׃
verses.english: And they gave me poison in my food; and for my thirst they gave me vinegar to drink.

verses.hebrew: יְהִי־שֻׁלְחָנָם לִפְנֵיהֶם לְפָח וְלִשְׁלוֹמִים לְמוֹקֵשׁ׃
verses.english: Let their table become a snare before them: and when they are at peace, let it be a trap.

verses.hebrew: תֶּחְשַׁכְנָה עֵינֵיהֶם מֵרְאוֹת וּמָתְנֵיהֶם תָּמִיד הַמְעַד׃
verses.english: Let their eyes be darkened, that they see not; and make their loins continually to shake.

verses.hebrew: שְׁפָךְ־עֲלֵיהֶם זַעְמֶךָ וַחֲרוֹן אַפְּךָ יַשִּׂיגֵם׃
verses.english: Pour out Thy indignation upon them, and let Thy fierce anger overtake them.

verses.hebrew: תְּהִי־טִירָתָם נְשַׁמָּה בְּאָהֳלֵיהֶם אַל־יְהִי יֹשֵׁב׃
verses.english: Let their habitation be desolate; let none dwell in their tents.

verses.hebrew: כִּי־אַתָּה אֲשֶׁר־הִכִּיתָ רָדָפוּ וְאֶל־מַכְאוֹב חֲלָלֶיךָ יְסַפֵּרוּ׃
verses.english: For they persecute him whom Thou hast smitten; and they tell of the pain of those whom Thou hast wounded.

verses.hebrew: תְּנָה־עָוֺן עַל־עֲוֺנָם וְאַל־יָבֹאוּ בְּצִדְקָתֶךָ׃
verses.english: Add iniquity to their iniquity: and let them not be admitted to Thy vindication.

verses.hebrew: יִמָּחוּ מִסֵּפֶר חַיִּים וְעִם צַדִּיקִים אַל־יִכָּתֵבוּ׃
verses.english: Let them be blotted out of the book of the living, and not be written with the righteous.

verses.hebrew: וַאֲנִי עָנִי וְכוֹאֵב יְשׁוּעָתְךָ אֱלֹהִים תְּשַׂגְּבֵנִי׃
verses.english: But I am afflicted and in pain: let thy salvation, O God, set me on high.

verses.hebrew: אֲהַלְלָה שֵׁם־אֱלֹהִים בְּשִׁיר וַאֲגַדְּלֶנּוּ בְתוֹדָה׃
verses.english: I will praise the name of God with a song, and will magnify him with thanksgiving.

verses.hebrew: וְתִיטַב לַיהוָה מִשּׁוֹר פָּר מַקְרִן מַפְרִיס׃
verses.english: And it shall please the Lord better than an ox or a bullock that has horns and hoofs.

verses.hebrew: רָאוּ עֲנָוִים יִשְׂמָחוּ דֹּרְשֵׁי אֱלֹהִים וִיחִי לְבַבְכֶם׃
verses.english: The humble shall see this, and be glad: and let your hearts revive, you who seek God.

verses.hebrew: כִּי־שֹׁמֵעַ אֶל־אֶבְיוֹנִים יְהוָה וְאֶת־אֲסִירָיו לֹא בָזָה׃
verses.english: For the Lord hears the poor, and despises not his prisoners.

verses.hebrew: יְהַלְלוּהוּ שָׁמַיִם וָאָרֶץ יַמִּים וְכָל־רֹמֵשׂ בָּם׃
verses.english: Let the heaven and earth praise him, the seas, and everything that moves therein.

verses.hebrew: כִּי אֱלֹהִים יוֹשִׁיעַ צִיּוֹן וְיִבְנֶה עָרֵי יְהוּדָה וְיָשְׁבוּ שָׁם וִירֵשׁוּהָ׃
verses.english: For God will save Żiyyon, and will build the cities of Yehuda: that they may dwell there, and have it in possession.

verses.hebrew: וְזֶרַע עֲבָדָיו יִנְחָלוּהָ וְאֹהֲבֵי שְׁמוֹ יִשְׁכְּנוּ־בָהּ׃
verses.english: The seed also of his servants shall inherit it: and they that love his name shall dwell there.

verses.hebrew: לַמְנַצֵּחַ לְדָוִד לְהַזְכִּיר׃
verses.english: To the chief Musician, of David, for invocation.

verses.hebrew: אֱלֹהִים לְהַצִּילֵנִי יְהוָה לְעֶזְרָתִי חוּשָׁה׃
verses.english: Make haste, O God, to deliver me; to help me, O Lord.

verses.hebrew: יֵבֹשׁוּ וְיַחְפְּרוּ מְבַקְשֵׁי נַפְשִׁי יִסֹּגוּ אָחוֹר וְיִכָּלְמוּ חֲפֵצֵי רָעָתִי׃
verses.english: Let them be ashamed and confounded who seek after my soul: let them be turned backward, and put to confusion, who desire my hurt.

verses.hebrew: יָשׁוּבוּ עַל־עֵקֶב בָּשְׁתָּם הָאֹמְרִים הֶאָח הֶאָח׃
verses.english: Let them be turned back because of their shame who say, Aha, aha.

verses.hebrew: יָשִׂישׂוּ וְיִשְׂמְחוּ בְּךָ כָּל־מְבַקְשֶׁיךָ וְיֹאמְרוּ תָמִיד יִגְדַּל אֱלֹהִים אֹהֲבֵי יְשׁוּעָתֶךָ׃
verses.english: Let all those who seek Thee rejoice and be glad in Thee: and let such as love Thy salvation say continually, Let God be magnified.

verses.hebrew: וַאֲנִי עָנִי וְאֶבְיוֹן אֱלֹהִים חוּשָׁה־לִּי עֶזְרִי וּמְפַלְטִי אַתָּה יְהוָה אַל־תְּאַחַר׃
verses.english: But I am poor and needy: make haste to me, O God: Thou art my help and my deliverer; delay not, O Lord.

verses.hebrew: בְּךָ־יְהוָה חָסִיתִי אַל־אֵבוֹשָׁה לְעוֹלָם׃
verses.english: In thee, O Lord, do I take refuge: let me never be put to confusion.

verses.hebrew: בְּצִדְקָתְךָ תַּצִּילֵנִי וּתְפַלְּטֵנִי הַטֵּה־אֵלַי אָזְנְךָ וְהוֹשִׁיעֵנִי׃
verses.english: Deliver me in Thy righteousness, and cause me to escape: incline Thy ear to me, and save me.

verses.hebrew: הֱיֵה לִי לְצוּר מָעוֹן לָבוֹא תָּמִיד צִוִּיתָ לְהוֹשִׁיעֵנִי כִּי־סַלְעִי וּמְצוּדָתִי אָתָּה׃
verses.english: Be Thou my strong habitation, to which I may continually resort; which Thou hast appointed to save me; for Thou art my rock and my fortress.

verses.hebrew: אֱ‍לֹהַי פַּלְּטֵנִי מִיַּד רָשָׁע מִכַּף מְעַוֵּל וְחוֹמֵץ׃
verses.english: Deliver me, O my God, out of the hand of the wicked man, out of the hand of the unrighteous and violent man.

verses.hebrew: כִּי־אַתָּה תִקְוָתִי אֲדֹנָי יְהוִה מִבְטַחִי מִנְּעוּרָי׃
verses.english: For Thou art my hope, O Lord God: Thou art my trust from my youth.

verses.hebrew: עָלֶיךָ נִסְמַכְתִּי מִבֶּטֶן מִמְּעֵי אִמִּי אַתָּה גוֹזִי בְּךָ תְהִלָּתִי תָמִיד׃
verses.english: By Thee have I been sustained from the womb: Thou art he who took me out of my mother’s bowels: my praise is continually of Thee.

verses.hebrew: כְּמוֹפֵת הָיִיתִי לְרַבִּים וְאַתָּה מַחֲסִי־עֹז׃
verses.english: I am as a marvel to many; but Thou art my strong refuge.

verses.hebrew: יִמָּלֵא פִי תְּהִלָּתֶךָ כָּל־הַיּוֹם תִּפְאַרְתֶּךָ׃
verses.english: Let my mouth be filled with Thy praise and with Thy glory all the day.

verses.hebrew: אַל־תַּשְׁלִיכֵנִי לְעֵת זִקְנָה כִּכְלוֹת כֹּחִי אַל־תַּעַזְבֵנִי׃
verses.english: Cast me not off in the time of old age; forsake me not when my strength fails me.

verses.hebrew: כִּי־אָמְרוּ אוֹיְבַי לִי וְשֹׁמְרֵי נַפְשִׁי נוֹעֲצוּ יַחְדָּו׃
verses.english: For my enemies speak against me; and they who watch for my soul take counsel together,

verses.hebrew: לֵאמֹר אֱלֹהִים עֲזָבוֹ רִדְפוּ וְתִפְשׂוּהוּ כִּי־אֵין מַצִּיל׃
verses.english: saying, God has forsaken him: pursue and catch him; for there is none to deliver him.

verses.hebrew: אֱלֹהִים אַל־תִּרְחַק מִמֶּנִּי אֱלֹהַי לְעֶזְרָתִי חישה [חוּשָׁה׃]
verses.english: O God, be not far from me: O my God, make haste to help me.

verses.hebrew: יֵבֹשׁוּ יִכְלוּ שֹׂטְנֵי נַפְשִׁי יַעֲטוּ חֶרְפָּה וּכְלִמָּה מְבַקְשֵׁי רָעָתִי׃
verses.english: Let them be confounded and consumed who are adversaries to my soul; let them be covered with reproach and dishonour who seek my hurt.

verses.hebrew: וַאֲנִי תָּמִיד אֲיַחֵל וְהוֹסַפְתִּי עַל־כָּל־תְּהִלָּתֶךָ׃
verses.english: But as for me, I will hope continually, and will praise Thee yet more and more.

verses.hebrew: פִּי יְסַפֵּר צִדְקָתֶךָ כָּל־הַיּוֹם תְּשׁוּעָתֶךָ כִּי לֹא יָדַעְתִּי סְפֹרוֹת׃
verses.english: My mouth shall rehearse Thy righteousness and Thy salvation all the day; for I cannot count them.

verses.hebrew: אָבוֹא בִּגְבֻרוֹת אֲדֹנָי יְהוִה אַזְכִּיר צִדְקָתְךָ לְבַדֶּךָ׃
verses.english: I will come to celebrate the mighty acts of the Lord God: I will make mention of Thy righteousness, Thine alone.

verses.hebrew: אֱ‍לֹהִים לִמַּדְתַּנִי מִנְּעוּרָי וְעַד־הֵנָּה אַגִּיד נִפְלְאוֹתֶיךָ׃
verses.english: O God, Thou hast taught me from my youth: and I still declare Thy wondrous deeds.

verses.hebrew: וְגַם עַד־זִקְנָה וְשֵׂיבָה אֱלֹהִים אַל־תַּעַזְבֵנִי עַד־אַגִּיד זְרוֹעֲךָ לְדוֹר לְכָל־יָבוֹא גְּבוּרָתֶךָ׃
verses.english: Now also when I am old and greyheaded, O God, forsake me not; until I have related Thy strength to this generation, and Thy power to everyone that is to come.

verses.hebrew: וְצִדְקָתְךָ אֱלֹהִים עַד־מָרוֹם אֲשֶׁר־עָשִׂיתָ גְדֹלוֹת אֱלֹהִים מִי כָמוֹךָ׃
verses.english: Thy righteousness also, O God, reaches the high heavens, who hast done great things.

verses.hebrew: אֲשֶׁר הראיתנו [הִרְאִיתַנִי ] צָרוֹת רַבּוֹת וְרָעוֹת תָּשׁוּב תחיינו [תְּחַיֵּינִי] וּמִתְּהֹמוֹת הָאָרֶץ תָּשׁוּב תַּעֲלֵנִי׃
verses.english: O God, who is like Thee! Thou who hast shown me many and grievous troubles, restore me to life again, and bring me up again from the depths of the earth.

verses.hebrew: תֶּרֶב גְּדֻלָּתִי וְתִסֹּב תְּנַחֲמֵנִי׃
verses.english: Increase my greatness, and turn to comfort me.

verses.hebrew: גַּם־אֲנִי אוֹדְךָ בִכְלִי־נֶבֶל אֲמִתְּךָ אֱלֹהָי אֲזַמְּרָה לְךָ בְכִנּוֹר קְדוֹשׁ יִשְׂרָאֵל׃
verses.english: I too will praise Thee with the harp, speaking of Thy truth, O my God: to Thee will I sing with the lyre, O Thou Holy One of Yisra᾽el.

verses.hebrew: תְּרַנֵּנָּה שְׂפָתַי כִּי אֲזַמְּרָה־לָּךְ וְנַפְשִׁי אֲשֶׁר פָּדִיתָ׃
verses.english: My lips shall greatly rejoice when I sing to Thee; and my soul, which Thou hast redeemed.

verses.hebrew: גַּם־לְשׁוֹנִי כָּל־הַיּוֹם תֶּהְגֶּה צִדְקָתֶךָ כִּי־בֹשׁוּ כִי־חָפְרוּ מְבַקְשֵׁי רָעָתִי׃
verses.english: My tongue also shall tell of Thy righteousness all the day long: for they are confounded, for they are brought to shame, who seek my hurt.

verses.hebrew: לִשְׁלֹמֹה אֱ‍לֹהִים מִשְׁפָּטֶיךָ לְמֶלֶךְ תֵּן וְצִדְקָתְךָ לְבֶן־מֶלֶךְ׃
verses.english: For Shelomo. Give the king Thy judgments, O God, and Thy righteousness to the king’s son.

verses.hebrew: יָדִין עַמְּךָ בְצֶדֶק וַעֲנִיֶּיךָ בְמִשְׁפָּט׃
verses.english: That he may judge Thy people with righteousness, and Thy poor with justice.

verses.hebrew: יִשְׂאוּ הָרִים שָׁלוֹם לָעָם וּגְבָעוֹת בִּצְדָקָה׃
verses.english: Let the mountains bring peace to the people, and the hills, by righteousness.

verses.hebrew: יִשְׁפֹּט עֲ‍נִיֵּי־עָם יוֹשִׁיעַ לִבְנֵי אֶבְיוֹן וִידַכֵּא עוֹשֵׁק׃
verses.english: May he judge the cause of the poor of the people, may he save the children of the needy, and break the oppressor in pieces.

verses.hebrew: יִירָאוּךָ עִם־שָׁמֶשׁ וְלִפְנֵי יָרֵחַ דּוֹר דּוֹרִים׃
verses.english: May they fear Thee as long as the sun and moon endure, throughout all generations.

verses.hebrew: יֵרֵד כְּמָטָר עַל־גֵּז כִּרְבִיבִים זַרְזִיף אָרֶץ׃
verses.english: May he come down like rain upon the mown grass: like showers that water the earth.

verses.hebrew: יִפְרַח־בְּיָמָיו צַדִּיק וְרֹב שָׁלוֹם עַד־בְּלִי יָרֵחַ׃
verses.english: In his days let the righteous flourish; and let there be abundance of peace till the moon is no more.

verses.hebrew: וְיֵרְדְּ מִיָּם עַד־יָם וּמִנָּהָר עַד־אַפְסֵי־אָרֶץ׃
verses.english: May he have dominion also from sea to sea, and from the river to the ends of the earth.

verses.hebrew: לְפָנָיו יִכְרְעוּ צִיִּים וְאֹיְבָיו עָפָר יְלַחֵכוּ׃
verses.english: Let them who dwell in the wilderness bow down before him, and his enemies lick the dust.

verses.hebrew: מַלְכֵי תַרְשִׁישׁ וְאִיִּים מִנְחָה יָשִׁיבוּ מַלְכֵי שְׁבָא וּסְבָא אֶשְׁכָּר יַקְרִיבוּ׃
verses.english: May the kings of Tarshish and of the isles bring presents: let the kings of Sheva and Seva offer gifts.

verses.hebrew: וְיִשְׁתַּחֲווּ־לוֹ כָל־מְלָכִים כָּל־גּוֹיִם יַעַבְדוּהוּ׃
verses.english: And may all kings fall down before him; all nations serve him.

verses.hebrew: כִּי־יַצִּיל אֶבְיוֹן מְשַׁוֵּעַ וְעָנִי וְאֵין־עֹזֵר לוֹ׃
verses.english: For he shall deliver the needy when he cries; the poor also, and him who has no helper.

verses.hebrew: יָחֹס עַל־דַּל וְאֶבְיוֹן וְנַפְשׁוֹת אֶבְיוֹנִים יוֹשִׁיעַ׃
verses.english: He will spare the poor and needy, and shall save the souls of the needy.

verses.hebrew: מִתּוֹךְ וּמֵחָמָס יִגְאַל נַפְשָׁם וְיֵיקַר דָּמָם בְּעֵינָיו׃
verses.english: He will redeem their soul from deceit and violence: and precious shall their blood be in his sight.

verses.hebrew: וִיחִי וְיִתֶּן־לוֹ מִזְּהַב שְׁבָא וְיִתְפַּלֵּל בַּעֲדוֹ תָמִיד כָּל־הַיּוֹם יְבָרֲכֶנְהוּ׃
verses.english: Long may he live, and may the gold of Sheva be given to him: and let prayer be continually offered for him: let them bless him all the day.

verses.hebrew: יְהִי פִסַּת־בַּר בָּאָרֶץ בְּרֹאשׁ הָרִים יִרְעַשׁ כַּלְּבָנוֹן פִּרְיוֹ וְיָצִיצוּ מֵעִיר כְּעֵשֶׂב הָאָרֶץ׃
verses.english: May there be abundance of corn in the land: may it rustle on the tops of the mountains: may its fruit be like the Levanon: and may they flourish in the city like the grass of the earth.

verses.hebrew: יְהִי שְׁמוֹ לְעוֹלָם לִפְנֵי־שֶׁמֶשׁ ינין [יִנּוֹן] שְׁמוֹ וְיִתְבָּרְכוּ בוֹ כָּל־גּוֹיִם יְאַשְּׁרוּהוּ׃
verses.english: May his name endure forever: may his name continue as long as the sun: and may men bless themselves by him: let all nations call him happy!

verses.hebrew: בָּרוּךְ יְהוָה אֱלֹהִים אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל עֹשֵׂה נִפְלָאוֹת לְבַדּוֹ׃
verses.english: Blessed be the Lord God, the God of Yisra᾽el, who does wondrous things alone.

verses.hebrew: וּבָרוּךְ שֵׁם כְּבוֹדוֹ לְעוֹלָם וְיִמָּלֵא כְבוֹדוֹ אֶת־כֹּל הָאָרֶץ אָמֵן וְאָמֵן׃
verses.english: And blessed be his glorious name for ever: and let the whole earth be filled with his glory; Amen, and Amen.

verses.hebrew: כָּלּוּ תְפִלּוֹת דָּוִד בֶּן־יִשָׁי׃
verses.english: The prayers of David the son of Yishay are ended.

verses.hebrew: מִזְמוֹר לְאָסָף אַךְ טוֹב לְיִשְׂרָאֵל אֱלֹהִים לְבָרֵי לֵבָב׃
verses.english: A Psalm of Asaf. Truly God is good to Yisra᾽el, to such as are of a clean heart.

verses.hebrew: וַאֲנִי כִּמְעַט נטוי [נָטָיוּ] רַגְלָי כְּאַיִן שפכה [שֻׁפְּכוּ] אֲשֻׁרָי׃
verses.english: But as for me, my feet were almost gone; my steps had well nigh slipped.

verses.hebrew: כִּי־קִנֵּאתִי בַּהוֹלְלִים שְׁלוֹם רְשָׁעִים אֶרְאֶה׃
verses.english: For I was envious of the arrogant, when I saw the prosperity of the wicked.

verses.hebrew: כִּי אֵין חַרְצֻבּוֹת לְמוֹתָם וּבָרִיא אוּלָם׃
verses.english: For there are no pangs at their death; their body is firm.

verses.hebrew: בַּעֲמַל אֱנוֹשׁ אֵינֵמוֹ וְעִם־אָדָם לֹא יְנֻגָּעוּ׃
verses.english: They are not in trouble as other men; nor are they plagued like other men.

verses.hebrew: לָכֵן עֲנָקַתְמוֹ גַאֲוָה יַעֲטָף־שִׁית חָמָס לָמוֹ׃
verses.english: Therefore pride is their necklace; violence covers them like a garment.

verses.hebrew: יָצָא מֵחֵלֶב עֵינֵמוֹ עָבְרוּ מַשְׂכִּיּוֹת לֵבָב׃
verses.english: Their eyes stand out with fatness: they have more than heart could wish.

verses.hebrew: יָמִיקוּ וִידַבְּרוּ בְרָע עֹשֶׁק מִמָּרוֹם יְדַבֵּרוּ׃
verses.english: They deride, and wickedly speak oppression: they speak loftily.

verses.hebrew: שַׁתּוּ בַשָּׁמַיִם פִּיהֶם וּלְשׁוֹנָם תִּהֲלַךְ בָּאָרֶץ׃
verses.english: They set their mouth against the heavens, and their tongue struts through the earth.

verses.hebrew: לָכֵן ישיב [יָשׁוּב] עַמּוֹ הֲלֹם וּמֵי מָלֵא יִמָּצוּ לָמוֹ׃
verses.english: Therefore his people return here: and abundant waters are drained out by them.

verses.hebrew: וְאָמְרוּ אֵיכָה יָדַע־אֵל וְיֵשׁ דֵּעָה בְעֶלְיוֹן׃
verses.english: And they say, How does God know? and is there knowledge in the most High?

verses.hebrew: הִנֵּה־אֵלֶּה רְשָׁעִים וְשַׁלְוֵי עוֹלָם הִשְׂגּוּ־חָיִל׃
verses.english: Behold, these are the wicked, always at ease; they increase in riches.

verses.hebrew: אַךְ־רִיק זִכִּיתִי לְבָבִי וָאֶרְחַץ בְּנִקָּיוֹן כַּפָּי׃
verses.english: Surely I have cleansed my heart in vain, and washed my hands in innocency;

verses.hebrew: וָאֱהִי נָגוּעַ כָּל־הַיּוֹם וְתוֹכַחְתִּי לַבְּקָרִים׃
verses.english: for all the day I have been stricken, and chastised every morning.

verses.hebrew: אִם־אָמַרְתִּי אֲסַפְּרָה כְמוֹ הִנֵּה דוֹר בָּנֶיךָ בָגָדְתִּי׃
verses.english: If I had said, I will speak thus; behold, I should have offended against the generation of Thy children.

verses.hebrew: וָאֲחַשְּׁבָה לָדַעַת זֹאת עָמָל היא [הוּא] בְעֵינָי׃
verses.english: So I pondered how I might understand this, but it was too wearisome for me.

verses.hebrew: עַד־אָבוֹא אֶל־מִקְדְּשֵׁי־אֵל אָבִינָה לְאַחֲרִיתָם׃
verses.english: Until I entered the sanctuary of God; then I understood their end.

verses.hebrew: אַךְ בַּחֲלָקוֹת תָּשִׁית לָמוֹ הִפַּלְתָּם לְמַשּׁוּאוֹת׃
verses.english: Surely Thou dost set them in slippery places: Thou dost cast them down into destruction.

verses.hebrew: אֵיךְ הָיוּ לְשַׁמָּה כְרָגַע סָפוּ תַמּוּ מִן־בַּלָּהוֹת׃
verses.english: How are they brought into desolation in a moment! they are utterly consumed with terrors.

verses.hebrew: כַּחֲלוֹם מֵהָקִיץ אֲדֹנָי בָּעִיר צַלְמָם תִּבְזֶה׃
verses.english: As a dream when one awakes; so, O Lord, on awaking, Thou shalt despise their image.

verses.hebrew: כִּי יִתְחַמֵּץ לְבָבִי וְכִלְיוֹתַי אֶשְׁתּוֹנָן׃
verses.english: When my heart was embittered, and I was pricked in my reins;

verses.hebrew: וַאֲנִי־בַעַר וְלֹא אֵדָע בְּהֵמוֹת הָיִיתִי עִמָּךְ׃
verses.english: then I was foolish and ignorant: I was like a beast before Thee.

verses.hebrew: וַאֲנִי תָמִיד עִמָּךְ אָחַזְתָּ בְּיַד־יְמִינִי׃
verses.english: But I am continually with Thee: Thou holdest my right hand.

verses.hebrew: בַּעֲצָתְךָ תַנְחֵנִי וְאַחַר כָּבוֹד תִּקָּחֵנִי׃
verses.english: Thou shalt guide me with Thy counsel, and afterwards receive me to honourable state.

verses.hebrew: מִי־לִי בַשָּׁמָיִם וְעִמְּךָ לֹא־חָפַצְתִּי בָאָרֶץ׃
verses.english: Whom have I in heaven but Thee? and there is none upon earth that I desire beside Thee.

verses.hebrew: כָּלָה שְׁאֵרִי וּלְבָבִי צוּר־לְבָבִי וְחֶלְקִי אֱלֹהִים לְעוֹלָם׃
verses.english: My flesh and my heart fail: but God is the strength of my heart, and my portion for ever.

verses.hebrew: כִּי־הִנֵּה רְחֵקֶיךָ יֹאבֵדוּ הִצְמַתָּה כָּל־זוֹנֶה מִמֶּךָּ׃
verses.english: For, lo, they that are far from Thee shall perish: Thou hast destroyed all those who go astray from Thee.

verses.hebrew: וַאֲנִי קִרֲבַת אֱלֹהִים לִי־טוֹב שַׁתִּי בַּאדֹנָי יְהֹוִה מַחְסִי לְסַפֵּר כָּל־מַלְאֲכוֹתֶיךָ׃
verses.english: But as for me, the nearness of God is my good: I have made the Lord God my refuge, that I may relate all Thy works.

verses.hebrew: מַשְׂכִּיל לְאָסָף לָמָה אֱלֹהִים זָנַחְתָּ לָנֶצַח יֶעְשַׁן אַפְּךָ בְּצֹאן מַרְעִיתֶךָ׃
verses.english: A Maskil of Asaf. O God, why hast Thou cast us off for ever? why does Thy anger smoke against the sheep of Thy pasture?

verses.hebrew: זְכֹר עֲדָתְךָ קָנִיתָ קֶּדֶם גָּאַלְתָּ שֵׁבֶט נַחֲלָתֶךָ הַר־צִיּוֹן זֶה שָׁכַנְתָּ בּוֹ׃
verses.english: Remember Thy congregation, which Thou hast purchased of old; the tribe of Thy inheritance, which Thou hast redeemed; this mount Żiyyon, wherein Thou hast dwelt.

verses.hebrew: הָרִימָה פְעָמֶיךָ לְמַשֻּׁאוֹת נֶצַח כָּל־הֵרַע אוֹיֵב בַּקֹּדֶשׁ׃
verses.english: Lift up Thy feet to the perpetual desolations; the enemy has destroyed everything in the sanctuary.

verses.hebrew: שָׁאֲגוּ צֹרְרֶיךָ בְּקֶרֶב מוֹעֲדֶךָ שָׂמוּ אוֹתֹתָם אֹתוֹת׃
verses.english: Thy enemies roar in the midst of thy meeting place; they set up their signs for signs:

verses.hebrew: יִוָּדַע כְּמֵבִיא לְמָעְלָה בִּסֲבָךְ־עֵץ קַרְדֻּמּוֹת׃
verses.english: they are known as swingers of axes upwards in the thick forest:

verses.hebrew: ועת [וְעַתָּה] פִּתּוּחֶיהָ יָּחַד בְּכַשִּׁיל וְכֵילַפֹּת יַהֲלֹמוּן׃
verses.english: and now they break down its carved work altogether with hatchet and with hammers.

verses.hebrew: שִׁלְחוּ בָאֵשׁ מִקְדָּשֶׁךָ לָאָרֶץ חִלְּלוּ מִשְׁכַּן־שְׁמֶךָ׃
verses.english: They have burned Thy sanctuary with fire, to the ground: they have defiled the dwelling place of Thy name.

verses.hebrew: אָמְרוּ בְלִבָּם נִינָם יָחַד שָׂרְפוּ כָל־מוֹעֲדֵי־אֵל בָּאָרֶץ׃
verses.english: They have said in their hearts, Let us destroy them together: they have burned up all the meeting places of God in the land.

verses.hebrew: אוֹתֹתֵינוּ לֹא רָאִינוּ אֵין־עוֹד נָבִיא וְלֹא־אִתָּנוּ יֹדֵעַ עַד־מָה׃
verses.english: We see not our signs: there is no longer a prophet: nor is there among us any that knows how long.

verses.hebrew: עַד־מָתַי אֱלֹהִים יְחָרֶף צָר יְנָאֵץ אוֹיֵב שִׁמְךָ לָנֶצַח׃
verses.english: O God, how long shall the adversary insult? shall the enemy blaspheme Thy name for ever?

verses.hebrew: לָמָּה תָשִׁיב יָדְךָ וִימִינֶךָ מִקֶּרֶב חוקך [חֵיקְךָ] כַלֵּה׃
verses.english: Why dost Thou withdraw Thy hand, even Thy right hand? out of Thy bosom with it! destroy!

verses.hebrew: וֵאלֹהִים מַלְכִּי מִקֶּדֶם פֹּעֵל יְשׁוּעוֹת בְּקֶרֶב הָאָרֶץ׃
verses.english: for God is my King of old, working salvation in the midst of the earth.

verses.hebrew: אַתָּה פוֹרַרְתָּ בְעָזְּךָ יָם שִׁבַּרְתָּ רָאשֵׁי תַנִּינִים עַל־הַמָּיִם׃
verses.english: Thou didst divide the sea by Thy strength: Thou didst break the heads of the sea monsters in the waters.

verses.hebrew: אַתָּה רִצַּצְתָּ רָאשֵׁי לִוְיָתָן תִּתְּנֶנּוּ מַאֲכָל לְעָם לְצִיִּים׃
verses.english: Thou didst crush the heads of livyatan: thou didst give him for food to the desert people.

verses.hebrew: אַתָּה בָקַעְתָּ מַעְיָן וָנָחַל אַתָּה הוֹבַשְׁתָּ נַהֲרוֹת אֵיתָן׃
verses.english: Thou didst split open springs and wadis: Thou didst dry up the ever flowing streams.

verses.hebrew: לְךָ יוֹם אַף־לְךָ לָיְלָה אַתָּה הֲכִינוֹתָ מָאוֹר וָשָׁמֶשׁ׃
verses.english: The day is Thine, the night also is Thine: Thou hast prepared the light and the sun.

verses.hebrew: אַתָּה הִצַּבְתָּ כָּל־גְּבוּלוֹת אָרֶץ קַיִץ וָחֹרֶף אַתָּה יְצַרְתָּם׃
verses.english: Thou hast set all the borders of the earth: Thou hast made summer and winter.

verses.hebrew: זְכָר־זֹאת אוֹיֵב חֵרֵף יְהוָה וְעַם נָבָל נִאֲצוּ שְׁמֶךָ׃
verses.english: Remember this, how the enemy has insulted the Lord, and how a base people have blasphemed Thy name.

verses.hebrew: אַל־תִּתֵּן לְחַיַּת נֶפֶשׁ תּוֹרֶךָ חַיַּת עֲנִיֶּיךָ אַל־תִּשְׁכַּח לָנֶצַח׃
verses.english: O deliver not the soul of Thy turtledove to the wild beast: forget not the congregation of Thy poor for ever.

verses.hebrew: הַבֵּט לַבְּרִית כִּי מָלְאוּ מַחֲשַׁכֵּי־אֶרֶץ נְאוֹת חָמָס׃
verses.english: Look upon the covenant: for the dark places of the earth are full, the habitations of cruelty.

verses.hebrew: אַל־יָשֹׁב דַּךְ נִכְלָם עָנִי וְאֶבְיוֹן יְהַלְלוּ שְׁמֶךָ׃
verses.english: O let not the oppressed return ashamed: let the poor and needy praise Thy name.

verses.hebrew: קוּמָה אֱלֹהִים רִיבָה רִיבֶךָ זְכֹר חֶרְפָּתְךָ מִנִּי־נָבָל כָּל־הַיּוֹם׃
verses.english: Arise, O God, plead Thy own cause: remember how the foolish man insults Thee daily.

verses.hebrew: אַל־תִּשְׁכַּח קוֹל צֹרְרֶיךָ שְׁאוֹן קָמֶיךָ עֹלֶה תָמִיד׃
verses.english: Forget not the voice of Thy enemies: the tumult of those who rise up against Thee increases continually.

verses.hebrew: לַמְנַצֵּחַ אַל־תַּשְׁחֵת מִזְמוֹר לְאָסָף שִׁיר׃
verses.english: To the chief Musician, Al-tashĥet, A Psalm of Asaf, A Poem.

verses.hebrew: הוֹדִינוּ לְּךָ אֱ‍לֹהִים הוֹדִינוּ וְקָרוֹב שְׁמֶךָ סִפְּרוּ נִפְלְאוֹתֶיךָ׃
verses.english: To Thee, O God, we give thanks; we give thanks; for Thy name is near; men declare Thy wondrous works.

verses.hebrew: כִּי אֶקַּח מוֹעֵד אֲנִי מֵישָׁרִים אֶשְׁפֹּט׃
verses.english: Surely I shall take the appointed time; I will judge with equity.

verses.hebrew: נְמֹגִים אֶרֶץ וְכָל־יֹשְׁבֶיהָ אָנֹכִי תִכַּנְתִּי עַמּוּדֶיהָ סֶּלָה׃
verses.english: When the earth and all its inhabitants are dissolved, I bear up the pillars of it. (Sela.)

verses.hebrew: אָמַרְתִּי לַהוֹלְלִים אַל־תָּהֹלּוּ וְלָרְשָׁעִים אַל־תָּרִימוּ קָרֶן׃
verses.english: I said to the arrogant, Deal not arrogantly! and to the wicked, Lift not the horn.

verses.hebrew: אַל־תָּרִימוּ לַמָּרוֹם קַרְנְכֶם תְּדַבְּרוּ בְצַוָּאר עָתָק׃
verses.english: Lift not your horn on high: speak not with an insolent neck.

verses.hebrew: כִּי לֹא מִמּוֹצָא וּמִמַּעֲרָב וְלֹא מִמִּדְבַּר הָרִים׃
verses.english: For judgment comes neither from the east, nor from the west, nor from the desert peaks:

verses.hebrew: כִּי־אֱלֹהִים שֹׁפֵט זֶה יַשְׁפִּיל וְזֶה יָרִים׃
verses.english: but God is the judge: he puts one down, and sets up another.

verses.hebrew: כִּי כוֹס בְּיַד־יְהוָה וְיַיִן חָמַר מָלֵא מֶסֶךְ וַיַּגֵּר מִזֶּה אַךְ־שְׁמָרֶיהָ יִמְצוּ יִשְׁתּוּ כֹּל רִשְׁעֵי־אָרֶץ׃
verses.english: For in the hand of the Lord there is a cup, with foaming wine; it is full of mixture; and he pours out of the same: but its dregs, shall all the wicked of the earth drain and drink.

verses.hebrew: וַאֲנִי אַגִּיד לְעֹלָם אֲזַמְּרָה לֵאלֹהֵי יַעֲקֹב׃
verses.english: But I will declare for ever; I will sing praises to the God of Ya῾aqov.

verses.hebrew: וְכָל־קַרְנֵי רְשָׁעִים אֲגַדֵּעַ תְּרוֹמַמְנָה קַרְנוֹת צַדִּיק׃
verses.english: All the horns of the wicked also will I cut off; but the horns of the righteous shall be exalted.

verses.hebrew: לַמְנַצֵּחַ בִּנְגִינֹת מִזְמוֹר לְאָסָף שִׁיר׃
verses.english: To the chief Musician on strings, A Psalm of Asaf, A Poem.

verses.hebrew: נוֹדָע בִּיהוּדָה אֱלֹהִים בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל גָּדוֹל שְׁמוֹ׃
verses.english: In Yehuda is God known: his name is great in Yisra᾽el.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי בְשָׁלֵם סֻכּוֹ וּמְעוֹנָתוֹ בְצִיּוֹן׃
verses.english: In Shalem also is his tabernacle, and his dwelling place is in Żiyyon.

verses.hebrew: שָׁמָּה שִׁבַּר רִשְׁפֵי־קָשֶׁת מָגֵן וְחֶרֶב וּמִלְחָמָה סֶלָה׃
verses.english: There he broke the flashing arrows, the shield, and the sword, and the battle. (Sela.)

verses.hebrew: נָאוֹר אַתָּה אַדִּיר מֵהַרְרֵי־טָרֶף׃
verses.english: Thou art glorious and excellent, coming down from the mountains of prey.

verses.hebrew: אֶשְׁתּוֹלְלוּ אַבִּירֵי לֵב נָמוּ שְׁנָתָם וְלֹא־מָצְאוּ כָל־אַנְשֵׁי־חַיִל יְדֵיהֶם׃
verses.english: The stouthearted are bereft of reason, they have slept their sleep: and none of the men of might have found their hands.

verses.hebrew: מִגַּעֲרָתְךָ אֱלֹהֵי יַעֲקֹב נִרְדָּם וְרֶכֶב וָסוּס׃
verses.english: At Thy rebuke, O God of Ya῾aqov, he is put to sleep, together with chariot and horse.

verses.hebrew: אַתָּה נוֹרָא אַתָּה וּמִי־יַעֲמֹד לְפָנֶיךָ מֵאָז אַפֶּךָ׃
verses.english: Thou, even Thou, art to be feared: and who may stand in Thy sight when once Thou art angry?

verses.hebrew: מִשָּׁמַיִם הִשְׁמַעְתָּ דִּין אֶרֶץ יָרְאָה וְשָׁקָטָה׃
verses.english: Thou didst cause judgment to be heard from heaven; the earth feared, and was still,

verses.hebrew: בְּקוּם־לַמִּשְׁפָּט אֱלֹהִים לְהוֹשִׁיעַ כָּל־עַנְוֵי־אֶרֶץ סֶלָה׃
verses.english: When God arose to judgment, to save all the humble of the earth. (Sela.)

verses.hebrew: כִּי־חֲמַת אָדָם תּוֹדֶךָּ שְׁאֵרִית חֵמֹת תַּחְגֹּר׃
verses.english: Surely the wrath of man shall praise Thee: Thou wilt gird Thyself with the remainder of wrath.

verses.hebrew: נִדֲרוּ וְשַׁלְּמוּ לַיהוָה אֱ‍לֹהֵיכֶם כָּל־סְבִיבָיו יוֹבִילוּ שַׁי לַמּוֹרָא׃
verses.english: Vow, and pay to the Lord your God: let all that be round about him bring presents to him that is to be feared.

verses.hebrew: יִבְצֹר רוּחַ נְגִידִים נוֹרָא לְמַלְכֵי־אָרֶץ׃
verses.english: He shall cut off the spirit of princes: he is terrible to the kings of the earth.

verses.hebrew: לַמְנַצֵּחַ עַל־ידיתון [יְדוּתוּן] לְאָסָף מִזְמוֹר׃
verses.english: To the chief Musician, to Yedutun, A Psalm of Asaf.

verses.hebrew: קוֹלִי אֶל־אֱלֹהִים וְאֶצְעָקָה קוֹלִי אֶל־אֱלֹהִים וְהַאֲזִין אֵלָי׃
verses.english: To God I will cry aloud: aloud to God. O, hear me!

verses.hebrew: בְּיוֹם צָרָתִי אֲדֹנָי דָּרָשְׁתִּי יָדִי לַיְלָה נִגְּרָה וְלֹא תָפוּג מֵאֲנָה הִנָּחֵם נַפְשִׁי׃
verses.english: In the day of my trouble I sought the Lord: my hand is stretched out in the night, and rests not: my soul refuses to be comforted.

verses.hebrew: אֶזְכְּרָה אֱלֹהִים וְאֶהֱמָיָה אָשִׂיחָה וְתִתְעַטֵּף רוּחִי סֶלָה׃
verses.english: I remember God, and moan: I meditate, and my spirit faints. (Sela.)

verses.hebrew: אָחַזְתָּ שְׁמֻרוֹת עֵינָי נִפְעַמְתִּי וְלֹא אֲדַבֵּר׃
verses.english: Thou holdest fast my eyelids: I am so troubled that I cannot speak.

verses.hebrew: חִשַּׁבְתִּי יָמִים מִקֶּדֶם שְׁנוֹת עוֹלָמִים׃
verses.english: I have considered the days of old, the years of ancient times.

verses.hebrew: אֶזְכְּרָה נְגִינָתִי בַּלָּיְלָה עִם־לְבָבִי אָשִׂיחָה וַיְחַפֵּשׂ רוּחִי׃
verses.english: I call to remembrance my song in the night: I meditate with my heart: and my spirit makes diligent search.

verses.hebrew: הַלְעוֹלָמִים יִזְנַח אֲדֹנָי וְלֹא־יֹסִיף לִרְצוֹת עוֹד׃
verses.english: Will the Lord cast off for ever? and will he be favourable no more?

verses.hebrew: הֶאָפֵס לָנֶצַח חַסְדּוֹ גָּמַר אֹמֶר לְדֹר וָדֹר׃
verses.english: Is his steadfast love clean gone forever? does his promise fail for evermore?

verses.hebrew: הֲשָׁכַח חַנּוֹת אֵל אִם־קָפַץ בְּאַף רַחֲמָיו סֶלָה׃
verses.english: Has God forgotten to be gracious? has he in anger shut up his tender mercies? (Sela.)

verses.hebrew: וָאֹמַר חַלּוֹתִי הִיא שְׁנוֹת יְמִין עֶלְיוֹן׃
verses.english: And I said, I am sick at heart, for the right hand of the most High has changed.

verses.hebrew: אזכיר [אֶזְכּוֹר] מַעַלְלֵי־יָהּ כִּי־אֶזְכְּרָה מִקֶּדֶם פִּלְאֶךָ׃
verses.english: I will remember the works of the Lord: surely I will remember Thy wonders of old.

verses.hebrew: וְהָגִיתִי בְכָל־פָּעֳלֶךָ וּבַעֲלִילוֹתֶיךָ אָשִׂיחָה׃
verses.english: I will meditate also on all Thy work, and muse on Thy doings.

verses.hebrew: אֱלֹהִים בַּקֹּדֶשׁ דַּרְכֶּךָ מִי־אֵל גָּדוֹל כֵּאלֹהִים׃
verses.english: Thy way, O God, is in holiness: who is so great a God as our God?

verses.hebrew: אַתָּה הָאֵל עֹשֵׂה פֶלֶא הוֹדַעְתָּ בָעַמִּים עֻזֶּךָ׃
verses.english: Thou art the God That doest wonders: Thou hast declared Thy strength among the people.

verses.hebrew: גָּאַלְתָּ בִּזְרוֹעַ עַמֶּךָ בְּנֵי־יַעֲקֹב וְיוֹסֵף סֶלָה׃
verses.english: Thou hast with Thy arm redeemed Thy people, the sons of Ya῾aqov and Yosef. (Sela.)

verses.hebrew: רָאוּךָ מַּיִם אֱ‍לֹהִים רָאוּךָ מַּיִם יָחִילוּ אַף יִרְגְּזוּ תְהֹמוֹת׃
verses.english: The waters saw Thee, O God, the waters saw Thee: they were afraid: the depths also trembled.

verses.hebrew: זֹרְמוּ מַיִם עָבוֹת קוֹל נָתְנוּ שְׁחָקִים אַף־חֲצָצֶיךָ יִתְהַלָּכוּ׃
verses.english: The clouds poured out water: the skies sent out a sound: Thy arrows also went abroad.

verses.hebrew: קוֹל רַעַמְךָ בַּגַּלְגַּל הֵאִירוּ בְרָקִים תֵּבֵל רָגְזָה וַתִּרְעַשׁ הָאָרֶץ׃
verses.english: The voice of Thy thunder was in the whirlwind: the lightnings lightened the world: the earth trembled and shook.

verses.hebrew: בַּיָּם דַּרְכֶּךָ ושביליך [וּשְׁבִילְךָ] בְּמַיִם רַבִּים וְעִקְּבוֹתֶיךָ לֹא נֹדָעוּ׃
verses.english: Thy way was in the sea, and Thy path in the great waters, and Thy footsteps were not known.

verses.hebrew: נָחִיתָ כַצֹּאן עַמֶּךָ בְּיַד־מֹשֶׁה וְאַהֲרֹן׃
verses.english: Thou didst lead Thy people like a flock by the hand of Moshe and Aharon.

verses.hebrew: מַשְׂכִּיל לְאָסָף הַאֲזִינָה עַמִּי תּוֹרָתִי הַטּוּ אָזְנְכֶם לְאִמְרֵי־פִי׃
verses.english: A Maskil of Asaf. Give ear, O my people, to my Tora: incline your ears to the words of my mouth.

verses.hebrew: אֶפְתְּחָה בְמָשָׁל פִּי אַבִּיעָה חִידוֹת מִנִּי־קֶדֶם׃
verses.english: I will open my mouth with a parable: I will utter riddles concerning ancient times:

verses.hebrew: אֲשֶׁר שָׁמַעְנוּ וַנֵּדָעֵם וַאֲבוֹתֵינוּ סִפְּרוּ־לָנוּ׃
verses.english: of that which we have heard and known, and our fathers have told us.

verses.hebrew: לֹא נְכַחֵד מִבְּנֵיהֶם לְדוֹר אַחֲרוֹן מְסַפְּרִים תְּהִלּוֹת יְהוָה וֶעֱזוּזוֹ וְנִפְלְאוֹתָיו אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה׃
verses.english: We will not hide them from their children, relating to the latter generation the praises of the Lord, and his strength, and his wonderful works that he has done.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּקֶם עֵדוּת בְּיַעֲקֹב וְתוֹרָה שָׂם בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל אֲשֶׁר צִוָּה אֶת־אֲבוֹתֵינוּ לְהוֹדִיעָם לִבְנֵיהֶם׃
verses.english: For he established a Testimony in Ya῾aqov, and appointed a Tora in Yisra᾽el, which he commanded our fathers, that they should make them known to their children:

verses.hebrew: לְמַעַן יֵדְעוּ דּוֹר אַחֲרוֹן בָּנִים יִוָּלֵדוּ יָקֻמוּ וִיסַפְּרוּ לִבְנֵיהֶם׃
verses.english: that the generation to come might know them, the children which should be born; who should arise and declare them to their children:
