verses.hebrew: וְיָשִׂימוּ בֵאלֹהִים כִּסְלָם וְלֹא יִשְׁכְּחוּ מַעַלְלֵי־אֵל וּמִצְוֺתָיו יִנְצֹרוּ׃
verses.english: that they might set their hope in God, and not forget the works of God, but keep his commandments:

verses.hebrew: וְלֹא יִהְיוּ כַּאֲבוֹתָם דּוֹר סוֹרֵר וּמֹרֶה דּוֹר לֹא־הֵכִין לִבּוֹ וְלֹא־נֶאֶמְנָה אֶת־אֵל רוּחוֹ׃
verses.english: and that they might not be as their fathers, a stubborn and rebellious generation; a generation that set not their heart aright, and whose spirit was not steadfast with God.

verses.hebrew: בְּנֵי־אֶפְרַיִם נוֹשְׁקֵי רוֹמֵי־קָשֶׁת הָפְכוּ בְּיוֹם קְרָב׃
verses.english: The children of Efrayim were as archers, carrying bows, who turned back in the day of battle.

verses.hebrew: לֹא שָׁמְרוּ בְּרִית אֱלֹהִים וּבְתוֹרָתוֹ מֵאֲנוּ לָלֶכֶת׃
verses.english: They kept not the covenant of God, and refused to follow his Tora;

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁכְּחוּ עֲלִילוֹתָיו וְנִפְלְאוֹתָיו אֲשֶׁר הֶרְאָם׃
verses.english: and forgot his works, and his wonders that he had shown them.

verses.hebrew: נֶגֶד אֲבוֹתָם עָשָׂה פֶלֶא בְּאֶרֶץ מִצְרַיִם שְׂדֵה־צֹעַן׃
verses.english: Marvellous things he did in the sight of their fathers, in the land of Miżrayim, in the field of Żo῾an.

verses.hebrew: בָּקַע יָם וַיַּעֲבִירֵם וַיַּצֶּב־מַיִם כְּמוֹ־נֵד׃
verses.english: He divided the sea, and caused them to pass through; and he made the waters to stand like a heap.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּנְחֵם בֶּעָנָן יוֹמָם וְכָל־הַלַּיְלָה בְּאוֹר אֵשׁ׃
verses.english: In the daytime also he led them with a cloud, and all the night with a light of fire.

verses.hebrew: יְבַקַּע צֻרִים בַּמִּדְבָּר וַיַּשְׁקְ כִּתְהֹמוֹת רַבָּה׃
verses.english: He split rocks in the wilderness, and gave them drink as out of the great depths.

verses.hebrew: וַיּוֹצִא נוֹזְלִים מִסָּלַע וַיּוֹרֶד כַּנְּהָרוֹת מָיִם׃
verses.english: He brought streams also out of the rock, and caused waters to run down like rivers.

verses.hebrew: וַיּוֹסִיפוּ עוֹד לַחֲטֹא־לוֹ לַמְרוֹת עֶלְיוֹן בַּצִּיָּה׃
verses.english: And they sinned yet more against him, rebelling against the most High in the wilderness.

verses.hebrew: וַיְנַסּוּ־אֵל בִּלְבָבָם לִשְׁאָל־אֹכֶל לְנַפְשָׁם׃
verses.english: And they tempted God in their heart by asking food for their craving.

verses.hebrew: וַיְדַבְּרוּ בֵּאלֹהִים אָמְרוּ הֲיוּכַל אֵל לַעֲרֹךְ שֻׁלְחָן בַּמִּדְבָּר׃
verses.english: And they spoke against God; they said, Can God furnish a table in the wilderness?

verses.hebrew: הֵן הִכָּה־צוּר וַיָּזוּבוּ מַיִם וּנְחָלִים יִשְׁטֹפוּ הֲגַם־לֶחֶם יוּכַל תֵּת אִם־יָכִין שְׁאֵר לְעַמּוֹ׃
verses.english: Behold, he smote the rock, that the waters gushed out, and the streams overflowed; can he give bread also? can he provide meat for his people?

verses.hebrew: לָכֵן שָׁמַע יְהוָה וַיִּתְעַבָּר וְאֵשׁ נִשְּׂקָה בְיַעֲקֹב וְגַם־אַף עָלָה בְיִשְׂרָאֵל׃
verses.english: Therefore the Lord heard this, and was angry: so a fire was kindled against Ya῾aqov, and anger also came up against Yisra᾽el;

verses.hebrew: כִּי לֹא הֶאֱמִינוּ בֵּאלֹהִים וְלֹא בָטְחוּ בִּישׁוּעָתוֹ׃
verses.english: because they believed not in God, and trusted not in his salvation:

verses.hebrew: וַיְצַו שְׁחָקִים מִמָּעַל וְדַלְתֵי שָׁמַיִם פָּתָח׃
verses.english: though he commanded the clouds from above, and opened the doors of heaven,

verses.hebrew: וַיַּמְטֵר עֲלֵיהֶם מָן לֶאֱכֹל וּדְגַן־שָׁמַיִם נָתַן לָמוֹ׃
verses.english: and rained down manna upon them to eat, and gave them of the corn of heaven.

verses.hebrew: לֶחֶם אַבִּירִים אָכַל אִישׁ צֵידָה שָׁלַח לָהֶם לָשֹׂבַע׃
verses.english: Man ate the bread of angels: he sent them provision to the full.

verses.hebrew: יַסַּע קָדִים בַּשָּׁמָיִם וַיְנַהֵג בְּעֻזּוֹ תֵימָן׃
verses.english: He caused an east wind to blow in the sky: and by his power he brought on the south wind.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּמְטֵר עֲלֵיהֶם כֶּעָפָר שְׁאֵר וּכְחוֹל יַמִּים עוֹף כָּנָף׃
verses.english: And he rained meat upon them like dust, and feathered birds like the sand of the sea:

verses.hebrew: וַיַּפֵּל בְּקֶרֶב מַחֲנֵהוּ סָבִיב לְמִשְׁכְּנֹתָיו׃
verses.english: and he let it fall in the midst of their camp, round about their habitations.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאכְלוּ וַיִּשְׂבְּעוּ מְאֹד וְתַאֲוָתָם יָבִא לָהֶם׃
verses.english: So they did eat, and were well filled: for he gave them their own desire;

verses.hebrew: לֹא־זָרוּ מִתַּאֲוָתָם עוֹד אָכְלָם בְּפִיהֶם׃
verses.english: they were not yet sated with their lust: whilst their meat was still in their mouths,

verses.hebrew: וְאַף אֱלֹהִים עָלָה בָהֶם וַיַּהֲרֹג בְּמִשְׁמַנֵּיהֶם וּבַחוּרֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל הִכְרִיעַ׃
verses.english: the wrath of God came upon them, and slew the fattest of them, and smote down the young men of Yisra᾽el.

verses.hebrew: בְּכָל־זֹאת חָטְאוּ־עוֹד וְלֹא־הֶאֱמִינוּ בְּנִפְלְאוֹתָיו׃
verses.english: For all this they sinned still, and did not believe in his wondrous works.

verses.hebrew: וַיְכַל־בַּהֶבֶל יְמֵיהֶם וּשְׁנוֹתָם בַּבֶּהָלָה׃
verses.english: Therefore he ended their days with emptiness, and their years with trouble.

verses.hebrew: אִם־הֲרָגָם וּדְרָשׁוּהוּ וְשָׁבוּ וְשִׁחֲרוּ־אֵל׃
verses.english: When he slew them, then they sought him: and they returned and earnestly inquired after God.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּזְכְּרוּ כִּי־אֱלֹהִים צוּרָם וְאֵל עֶלְיוֹן גֹּאֲלָם׃
verses.english: And they remembered that God was their rock, and the high God their redeemer.

verses.hebrew: וַיְפַתּוּהוּ בְּפִיהֶם וּבִלְשׁוֹנָם יְכַזְּבוּ־לוֹ׃
verses.english: Nevertheless they did flatter him with their mouths, and they lied to him with their tongues.

verses.hebrew: וְלִבָּם לֹא־נָכוֹן עִמּוֹ וְלֹא נֶאֶמְנוּ בִּבְרִיתוֹ׃
verses.english: For their heart was not steadfast with him, neither were they faithful in his covenant.

verses.hebrew: וְהוּא רַחוּם יְכַפֵּר עָוֺן וְלֹא־יַשְׁחִית וְהִרְבָּה לְהָשִׁיב אַפּוֹ וְלֹא־יָעִיר כָּל־חֲמָתוֹ׃
verses.english: But he was full of compassion, forgiving iniquity, and he did not destroy them: often he turned away his anger, not stirring up all his wrath.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּזְכֹּר כִּי־בָשָׂר הֵמָּה רוּחַ הוֹלֵךְ וְלֹא יָשׁוּב׃
verses.english: For he remembered that they were but flesh; a wind that passes away, and comes not again.

verses.hebrew: כַּמָּה יַמְרוּהוּ בַמִּדְבָּר יַעֲצִיבוּהוּ בִּישִׁימוֹן׃
verses.english: How often did they rebel against him in the wilderness, and grieve him in the desert!

verses.hebrew: וַיָּשׁוּבוּ וַיְנַסּוּ אֵל וּקְדוֹשׁ יִשְׂרָאֵל הִתְווּ׃
verses.english: They turned back also and tempted God, and pained the Holy One of Yisra᾽el.

verses.hebrew: לֹא־זָכְרוּ אֶת־יָדוֹ יוֹם אֲ‍שֶׁר־פָּדָם מִנִּי־צָר׃
verses.english: They remembered not his hand, nor the day when he delivered them from the enemy.

verses.hebrew: אֲשֶׁר־שָׂם בְּמִצְרַיִם אֹתוֹתָיו וּמוֹפְתָיו בִּשְׂדֵה־צֹעַן׃
verses.english: How he had wrought his signs in Miżrayim, and his wonders in the field of Żo῾an:

verses.hebrew: וַיַּהֲפֹךְ לְדָם יְאֹרֵיהֶם וְנֹזְלֵיהֶם בַּל־יִשְׁתָּיוּן׃
verses.english: and had turned their canals into blood; and their floods, so that they could not drink.

verses.hebrew: יְשַׁלַּח בָּהֶם עָרֹב וַיֹּאכְלֵם וּצְפַרְדֵּעַ וַתַּשְׁחִיתֵם׃
verses.english: He sent swarms of gnats among them, which devoured them; and frogs, which destroyed them.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּתֵּן לֶחָסִיל יְבוּלָם וִיגִיעָם לָאַרְבֶּה׃
verses.english: He gave also their increase to the destroying locust, and their labour to the swarming locust.

verses.hebrew: יַהֲרֹג בַּבָּרָד גַּפְנָם וְשִׁקְמוֹתָם בַּחֲנָמַל׃
verses.english: He destroyed their vines with hail, and their sycamore trees with frost.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּסְגֵּר לַבָּרָד בְּעִירָם וּמִקְנֵיהֶם לָרְשָׁפִים׃
verses.english: He gave over their cattle also to the hail, and their flocks to hot thunderbolts.

verses.hebrew: יְשַׁלַּח־בָּם חֲרוֹן אַפּוֹ עֶבְרָה וָזַעַם וְצָרָה מִשְׁלַחַת מַלְאֲכֵי רָעִים׃
verses.english: He cast upon them the fierceness of his anger, wrath, and indignation, and trouble, an embassy of evil messengers.

verses.hebrew: יְפַלֵּס נָתִיב לְאַפּוֹ לֹא־חָשַׂךְ מִמָּוֶת נַפְשָׁם וְחַיָּתָם לַדֶּבֶר הִסְגִּיר׃
verses.english: He levelled a path for his anger; he spared not their soul from death, but gave their life over to the pestilence;

verses.hebrew: וַיַּךְ כָּל־בְּכוֹר בְּמִצְרָיִם רֵאשִׁית אוֹנִים בְּאָהֳלֵי־חָם׃
verses.english: and smote all the firstborn in Miżrayim; the first of their strength in the tents of Ḥam:

verses.hebrew: וַיַּסַּע כַּצֹּאן עַמּוֹ וַיְנַהֲגֵם כַּעֵדֶר בַּמִּדְבָּר׃
verses.english: but made his own people to go out like sheep, and guided them in the wilderness like a flock.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּנְחֵם לָבֶטַח וְלֹא פָחָדוּ וְאֶת־אוֹיְבֵיהֶם כִּסָּה הַיָּם׃
verses.english: And he led them on safely, so that they feared not: but the sea overwhelmed their enemies.

verses.hebrew: וַיְבִיאֵם אֶל־גְּבוּל קָדְשׁוֹ הַר־זֶה קָנְתָה יְמִינוֹ׃
verses.english: And he brought them to his holy border, to the mountain, which his right hand had purchased.

verses.hebrew: וַיְגָרֶשׁ מִפְּנֵיהֶם גּוֹיִם וַיַּפִּילֵם בְּחֶבֶל נַחֲלָה וַיַּשְׁכֵּן בְּאָהֳלֵיהֶם שִׁבְטֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃
verses.english: He cast out nations before them, and apportioned to them an inheritance by line, and made the tribes of Yisra᾽el to dwell in their tents.

verses.hebrew: וַיְנַסּוּ וַיַּמְרוּ אֶת־אֱלֹהִים עֶלְיוֹן וְעֵדוֹתָיו לֹא שָׁמָרוּ׃
verses.english: Yet they tempted and rebelled against the most high God, and kept not his testimonies:

verses.hebrew: וַיִּסֹּגוּ וַיִּבְגְּדוּ כַּאֲבוֹתָם נֶהְפְּכוּ כְּקֶשֶׁת רְמִיָּה׃
verses.english: but turned back, and dealt unfaithfully like their fathers: they were turned aside like a deceitful bow.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּכְעִיסוּהוּ בְּבָמוֹתָם וּבִפְסִילֵיהֶם יַקְנִיאוּהוּ׃
verses.english: For they provoked him to anger with their high places, and moved him to jealousy with their carved idols.

verses.hebrew: שָׁמַע אֱלֹהִים וַיִּתְעַבָּר וַיִּמְאַס מְאֹד בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל׃
verses.english: When God heard this, he was wroth, and greatly abhorred Yisra᾽el:

verses.hebrew: וַיִּטֹּשׁ מִשְׁכַּן שִׁלוֹ אֹהֶל שִׁכֵּן בָּאָדָם׃
verses.english: so that he forsook the tabernacle of Shilo, the tent where he made his dwelling among men;

verses.hebrew: וַיִּתֵּן לַשְּׁבִי עֻזּוֹ וְתִפְאַרְתּוֹ בְיַד־צָר׃
verses.english: and delivered his strength into captivity, and his glory into the enemy’s hand.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּסְגֵּר לַחֶרֶב עַמּוֹ וּבְנַחֲלָתוֹ הִתְעַבָּר׃
verses.english: He gave his people over also to the sword; and was wroth with his inheritance.

verses.hebrew: בַּחוּרָיו אָכְלָה־אֵשׁ וּבְתוּלֹתָיו לֹא הוּלָּלוּ׃
verses.english: The fire consumed their young men; and their virgins had no marriage song.

verses.hebrew: כֹּהֲנָיו בַּחֶרֶב נָפָלוּ וְאַלְמְנֹתָיו לֹא תִבְכֶּינָה׃
verses.english: Their priests fell by the sword; and their widows made no lamentation.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּקַץ כְּיָשֵׁן אֲדֹנָי כְּגִבּוֹר מִתְרוֹנֵן מִיָּיִן׃
verses.english: Then the Lord awoke as one out of sleep, and like a mighty man that shouts by reason of wine.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּךְ־צָרָיו אָחוֹר חֶרְפַּת עוֹלָם נָתַן לָמוֹ׃
verses.english: And he smote his enemies backward: he put upon them a perpetual reproach.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּמְאַס בְּאֹהֶל יוֹסֵף וּבְשֵׁבֶט אֶפְרַיִם לֹא בָחָר׃
verses.english: And he rejected the tabernacle of Yosef, and chose not the tribe of Efrayim:

verses.hebrew: וַיִּבְחַר אֶת־שֵׁבֶט יְהוּדָה אֶת־הַר צִיּוֹן אֲשֶׁר אָהֵב׃
verses.english: but chose the tribe of Yehuda, the mount Żiyyon which he loved.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּבֶן כְּמוֹ־רָמִים מִקְדָּשׁוֹ כְּאֶרֶץ יְסָדָהּ לְעוֹלָם׃
verses.english: And he built his sanctuary like the high heavens, like the earth which he has established for ever.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּבְחַר בְּדָוִד עַבְדּוֹ וַיִּקָּחֵהוּ מִמִּכְלְאֹת צֹאן׃
verses.english: And chose David his servant, and took him from the sheepfolds:

verses.hebrew: מֵאַחַר עָלוֹת הֱבִיאוֹ לִרְעוֹת בְּיַעֲקֹב עַמּוֹ וּבְיִשְׂרָאֵל נַחֲלָתוֹ׃
verses.english: from following the ewes that gave suck, he brought him to be shepherd of Ya῾aqov his people, and Yisra᾽el his inheritance.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּרְעֵם כְּתֹם לְבָבוֹ וּבִתְבוּנוֹת כַּפָּיו יַנְחֵם׃
verses.english: So he tended them according to the integrity of his heart; and guided them by the skilfulness of his hands.

verses.hebrew: מִזְמוֹר לְאָסָף אֱ‍לֹהִים בָּאוּ גוֹיִם בְּנַחֲלָתֶךָ טִמְּאוּ אֶת־הֵיכַל קָדְשֶׁךָ שָׂמוּ אֶת־יְרוּשָׁלִַם לְעִיִּים׃
verses.english: A Psalm of Asaf. O God, heathen nations are come into Thy inheritance; Thy holy temple they have defiled; they have laid Yerushalayim in heaps.

verses.hebrew: נָתְנוּ אֶת־נִבְלַת עֲבָדֶיךָ מַאֲכָל לְעוֹף הַשָּׁמָיִם בְּשַׂר חֲסִידֶיךָ לְחַיְתוֹ־אָרֶץ׃
verses.english: The dead bodies of Thy servants they have given to be food to the birds of the sky, the flesh of Thy pious ones to the beasts of the earth.

verses.hebrew: שָׁפְכוּ דָמָם כַּמַּיִם סְבִיבוֹת יְרוּשָׁלִָם וְאֵין קוֹבֵר׃
verses.english: Their blood have they shed like water round about Yerushalayim; and there was none to bury them.

verses.hebrew: הָיִינוּ חֶרְפָּה לִשְׁכֵנֵינוּ לַעַג וָקֶלֶס לִסְבִיבוֹתֵינוּ׃
verses.english: We are become a taunt to our neighbours, a scorn and derision to those round about us.

verses.hebrew: עַד־מָה יְהוָה תֶּאֱנַף לָנֶצַח תִּבְעַר כְּמוֹ־אֵשׁ קִנְאָתֶךָ׃
verses.english: How long, Lord? wilt Thou be angry for ever? will Thy jealousy burn like fire?

verses.hebrew: שְׁפֹךְ חֲמָתְךָ אֶל־הַגּוֹיִם אֲשֶׁר לֹא־יְדָעוּךָ וְעַל מַמְלָכוֹת אֲשֶׁר בְּשִׁמְךָ לֹא קָרָאוּ׃
verses.english: Pour out Thy wrath upon the nations that do not know Thee, and upon the kingdoms that do not call upon Thy name.

verses.hebrew: כִּי אָכַל אֶת־יַעֲקֹב וְאֶת־נָוֵהוּ הֵשַׁמּוּ׃
verses.english: For they have devoured Ya῾aqov, and laid waste his dwelling place.

verses.hebrew: אַל־תִּזְכָּר־לָנוּ עֲוֺנֹת רִאשֹׁנִים מַהֵר יְקַדְּמוּנוּ רַחֲמֶיךָ כִּי דַלּוֹנוּ מְאֹד׃
verses.english: O remember not against us former iniquities: let Thy tender mercies speedily come to meet us: for we are brought very low.

verses.hebrew: עָזְרֵנוּ אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׁעֵנוּ עַל־דְּבַר כְּבוֹד־שְׁמֶךָ וְהַצִּילֵנוּ וְכַפֵּר עַל־חַטֹּאתֵינוּ לְמַעַן שְׁמֶךָ׃
verses.english: Help us, O God of our salvation, for the glory of Thy name: and deliver us, and forgive our sins, for Thy name’s sake.

verses.hebrew: לָמָּה יֹאמְרוּ הַגּוֹיִם אַיֵּה אֱ‍לֹהֵיהֶם יִוָּדַע בגיים [בַּגּוֹיִם] לְעֵינֵינוּ נִקְמַת דַּם־עֲבָדֶיךָ הַשָּׁפוּךְ׃
verses.english: Why should the nations say, Where is their God? let the revenging of the blood of Thy servants which is shed be made manifest among the nations, and before our eyes.

verses.hebrew: תָּבוֹא לְפָנֶיךָ אֶנְקַת אָסִיר כְּגֹדֶל זְרוֹעֲךָ הוֹתֵר בְּנֵי תְמוּתָה׃
verses.english: Let the groaning of the prisoners come before thee; according to the greatness of Thy power preserve a remnant of those who are appointed to die;

verses.hebrew: וְהָשֵׁב לִשְׁכֵנֵינוּ שִׁבְעָתַיִם אֶל־חֵיקָם חֶרְפָּתָם אֲשֶׁר חֵרְפוּךָ אֲדֹנָי׃
verses.english: and render to our neighbours sevenfold into their bosom their insult, wherewith they have insulted Thee, O Lord.

verses.hebrew: וַאֲנַחְנוּ עַמְּךָ וְצֹאן מַרְעִיתֶךָ נוֹדֶה לְּךָ לְעוֹלָם לְדֹר וָדֹר נְסַפֵּר תְּהִלָּתֶךָ׃
verses.english: So we Thy people and the sheep of Thy pasture will give Thee thanks for ever: we will relate Thy praise to all generations.

verses.hebrew: לַמְנַצֵּחַ אֶל־שֹׁשַׁנִּים עֵדוּת לְאָסָף מִזְמוֹר׃
verses.english: To the chief Musician upon Shoshannim, A Testimony, A Psalm of Asaf.

verses.hebrew: רֹעֵה יִשְׂרָאֵל הַאֲזִינָה נֹהֵג כַּצֹּאן יוֹסֵף יֹשֵׁב הַכְּרוּבִים הוֹפִיעָה׃
verses.english: Give ear, O shepherd of Yisra᾽el, that leadest Yosef like flock, Thou who art enthroned upon the keruvim, shine forth.

verses.hebrew: לִפְנֵי אֶפְרַיִם וּבִנְיָמִן וּמְנַשֶּׁה עוֹרְרָה אֶת־גְּבוּרָתֶךָ וּלְכָה לִישֻׁעָתָה לָּנוּ׃
verses.english: Before Efrayim, and Binyamin, and Menashshe, stir up Thy might, and come to save us.

verses.hebrew: אֱלֹהִים הֲשִׁיבֵנוּ וְהָאֵר פָּנֶיךָ וְנִוָּשֵׁעָה׃
verses.english: Restore us, O God, and cause Thy face to shine; and we shall be saved.

verses.hebrew: יְהוָה אֱלֹהִים צְבָאוֹת עַד־מָתַי עָשַׁנְתָּ בִּתְפִלַּת עַמֶּךָ׃
verses.english: O Lord God of hosts, how long wilt Thou be angry against the prayer of Thy people?

verses.hebrew: הֶאֱכַלְתָּם לֶחֶם דִּמְעָה וַתַּשְׁקֵמוֹ בִּדְמָעוֹת שָׁלִישׁ׃
verses.english: Thou hast fed them with the bread of tears; and hast given them tears to drink in great measure.

verses.hebrew: תְּשִׂימֵנוּ מָדוֹן לִשְׁכֵנֵינוּ וְאֹיְבֵינוּ יִלְעֲגוּ־לָמוֹ׃
verses.english: Thou makest us a strife to our neighbours: and our enemies mock as they please.

verses.hebrew: אֱלֹהִים צְבָאוֹת הֲשִׁיבֵנוּ וְהָאֵר פָּנֶיךָ וְנִוָּשֵׁעָה׃
verses.english: Restore us, O God of hosts, and cause Thy face to shine; and we shall be saved.

verses.hebrew: גֶּפֶן מִמִּצְרַיִם תַּסִּיעַ תְּגָרֵשׁ גּוֹיִם וַתִּטָּעֶהָ׃
verses.english: Thou hast brought a vine out of Miżrayim, Thou hast cast out nations, and planted it.

verses.hebrew: פִּנִּיתָ לְפָנֶיהָ וַתַּשְׁרֵשׁ שָׁרָשֶׁיהָ וַתְּמַלֵּא־אָרֶץ׃
verses.english: Thou didst clear a space for it, and didst cause it to take deep root, and it filled the land.

verses.hebrew: כָּסּוּ הָרִים צִלָּהּ וַעֲנָפֶיהָ אַרְזֵי־אֵל׃
verses.english: The hills were covered with the shadow of it, and the mighty cedars with its boughs.

verses.hebrew: תְּשַׁלַּח קְצִירֶהָ עַד־יָם וְאֶל־נָהָר יוֹנְקוֹתֶיהָ׃
verses.english: She sent out her boughs to the sea, and her branches to the river.

verses.hebrew: לָמָּה פָּרַצְתָּ גְדֵרֶיהָ וְאָרוּהָ כָּל־עֹבְרֵי דָרֶךְ׃
verses.english: Why hast Thou then broken down her fences, so that all they who pass by the way do pluck her fruit?

verses.hebrew: יְכַרְסְמֶנָּה חֲזִיר מִיָּעַר וְזִיז שָׂדַי יִרְעֶנָּה׃
verses.english: The boar out of the wood ravages it, and the wild beast of the field devours it.

verses.hebrew: אֱלֹהִים צְבָאוֹת שׁוּב־נָא הַבֵּט מִשָּׁמַיִם וּרְאֵה וּפְקֹד גֶּפֶן זֹאת׃
verses.english: Return, we beseech Thee, O God of hosts: look down from heaven, and behold, and be mindful of this vine;

verses.hebrew: וְכַנָּה אֲשֶׁר־נָטְעָה יְמִינֶךָ וְעַל־בֵּן אִמַּצְתָּה לָּךְ׃
verses.english: and of the stock which Thy right hand has planted, and the branch that Thou madest strong for Thyself.

verses.hebrew: שְׂרֻפָה בָאֵשׁ כְּסוּחָה מִגַּעֲרַת פָּנֶיךָ יֹאבֵדוּ׃
verses.english: It is burned with fire, it is cut down: they perish at the rebuke of Thy countenance.

verses.hebrew: תְּהִי־יָדְךָ עַל־אִישׁ יְמִינֶךָ עַל־בֶּן־אָדָם אִמַּצְתָּ לָּךְ׃
verses.english: Let Thy hand be upon the man of Thy right hand, upon the son of a man whom Thou madest strong for Thyself.

verses.hebrew: וְלֹא־נָסוֹג מִמֶּךָּ תְּחַיֵּנוּ וּבְשִׁמְךָ נִקְרָא׃
verses.english: So shall we not turn back from Thee: revive us and we will call upon Thy name.

verses.hebrew: יְהוָה אֱלֹהִים צְבָאוֹת הֲשִׁיבֵנוּ הָאֵר פָּנֶיךָ וְנִוָּשֵׁעָה׃
verses.english: Restore us, O Lord God of hosts, cause Thy face to shine; and we shall be saved.

verses.hebrew: לַמְנַצֵּחַ עַל־הַגִּתִּית לְאָסָף׃
verses.english: To the chief Musician upon the Gittit, Of Asaf.

verses.hebrew: הַרְנִינוּ לֵאלֹהִים עוּזֵּנוּ הָרִיעוּ לֵאלֹהֵי יַעֲקֹב׃
verses.english: Sing aloud to God our strength: make a joyful noise to the God of Ya῾aqov.

verses.hebrew: שְׂאוּ־זִמְרָה וּתְנוּ־תֹף כִּנּוֹר נָעִים עִם־נָבֶל׃
verses.english: Raise a song, sound the timbrel, the sweet lyre, with the harp.

verses.hebrew: תִּקְעוּ בַחֹדֶשׁ שׁוֹפָר בַּכֵּסֶה לְיוֹם חַגֵּנוּ׃
verses.english: Blow a shofar at the new moon, at the full moon on our feast day.

verses.hebrew: כִּי חֹק לְיִשְׂרָאֵל הוּא מִשְׁפָּט לֵאלֹהֵי יַעֲקֹב׃
verses.english: For this is a statute for Yisra᾽el, an ordinance of the God of Ya῾aqov.

verses.hebrew: עֵדוּת בִּיהוֹסֵף שָׂמוֹ בְּצֵאתוֹ עַל־אֶרֶץ מִצְרָיִם שְׂפַת לֹא־יָדַעְתִּי אֶשְׁמָע׃
verses.english: This he ordained in Yosef for testimony, when he went out over the land of Miżrayim. I heard the language of him whom I had not known, saying,

verses.hebrew: הֲסִירוֹתִי מִסֵּבֶל שִׁכְמוֹ כַּפָּיו מִדּוּד תַּעֲבֹרְנָה׃
verses.english: I removed his shoulder from the burden: his hands are freed from the basket.

verses.hebrew: בַּצָּרָה קָרָאתָ וָאֲחַלְּצֶךָּ אֶעֶנְךָ בְּסֵתֶר רַעַם אֶבְחָנְךָ עַל־מֵי מְרִיבָה סֶלָה׃
verses.english: Thou didst call in trouble, and I delivered thee; I answered thee in the secret place of thunder: I proved thee at the waters of Meriva. (Sela.)

verses.hebrew: שְׁמַע עַמִּי וְאָעִידָה בָּךְ יִשְׂרָאֵל אִם־תִּשְׁמַע־לִי׃
verses.english: Hear, O my people, and I will testify against thee: O Yisra᾽el, if thou wilt hearken to me:

verses.hebrew: לֹא־יִהְיֶה בְךָ אֵל זָר וְלֹא תִשְׁתַּחֲוֶה לְאֵל נֵכָר׃
verses.english: there shall be no strange god among thee; nor shalt thou worship any foreign deity.

verses.hebrew: אָנֹכִי יְהוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ הַמַּעַלְךָ מֵאֶרֶץ מִצְרָיִם הַרְחֶב־פִּיךָ וַאֲמַלְאֵהוּ׃
verses.english: I am the Lord thy God who brought thee out of the land of Miżrayim: open thy mouth wide, and I will fill it.

verses.hebrew: וְלֹא־שָׁמַע עַמִּי לְקוֹלִי וְיִשְׂרָאֵל לֹא־אָבָה לִי׃
verses.english: But my people would not hearken to my voice; and Yisra᾽el would none of me.

verses.hebrew: וָאֲשַׁלְּחֵהוּ בִּשְׁרִירוּת לִבָּם יֵלְכוּ בְּמוֹעֲצוֹתֵיהֶם׃
verses.english: So I let them go after the stubbornness of their hearts, that they might follow their own counsels.

verses.hebrew: לוּ עַמִּי שֹׁמֵעַ לִי יִשְׂרָאֵל בִּדְרָכַי יְהַלֵּכוּ׃
verses.english: Oh that my people would hearken to me, and Yisra᾽el would walk in my ways!

verses.hebrew: כִּמְעַט אוֹיְבֵיהֶם אַכְנִיעַ וְעַל צָרֵיהֶם אָשִׁיב יָדִי׃
verses.english: I would soon subdue their enemies, and turn my hand against their adversaries.

verses.hebrew: מְשַׂנְאֵי יְהוָה יְכַחֲשׁוּ־לוֹ וִיהִי עִתָּם לְעוֹלָם׃
verses.english: Let the haters of the Lord cringe before him: and their punishment should last forever.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּאֲכִילֵהוּ מֵחֵלֶב חִטָּה וּמִצּוּר דְּבַשׁ אַשְׂבִּיעֶךָ׃
verses.english: But he would feed him with the finest of the wheat: and with honey out of the rock I will satisfy thee.

verses.hebrew: מִזְמוֹר לְאָסָף אֱ‍לֹהִים נִצָּב בַּעֲדַת־אֵל בְּקֶרֶב אֱלֹהִים יִשְׁפֹּט׃
verses.english: A Psalm of Asaf. God stands in the congregation of God; he judges among the judges.

verses.hebrew: עַד־מָתַי תִּשְׁפְּטוּ־עָוֶל וּפְנֵי רְשָׁעִים תִּשְׂאוּ־סֶלָה׃
verses.english: How long will you judge unjustly, and respect the persons of the wicked? (Sela.)

verses.hebrew: שִׁפְטוּ־דַל וְיָתוֹם עָנִי וָרָשׁ הַצְדִּיקוּ׃
verses.english: Judge the cause of the poor and fatherless: vindicate the afflicted and needy.

verses.hebrew: פַּלְּטוּ־דַל וְאֶבְיוֹן מִיַּד רְשָׁעִים הַצִּילוּ׃
verses.english: Deliver the poor and destitute: rescue them out of the hand of the wicked.

verses.hebrew: לֹא יָדְעוּ וְלֹא יָבִינוּ בַּחֲשֵׁכָה יִתְהַלָּכוּ יִמּוֹטוּ כָּל־מוֹסְדֵי אָרֶץ׃
verses.english: They know not, nor do they understand; they walk on in darkness: all the foundations of the earth are shaken.

verses.hebrew: אֲ‍נִי־אָמַרְתִּי אֱלֹהִים אַתֶּם וּבְנֵי עֶלְיוֹן כֻּלְּכֶם׃
verses.english: I had said, You are angels, all of you sons of the most High;

verses.hebrew: אָכֵן כְּאָדָם תְּמוּתוּן וּכְאַחַד הַשָּׂרִים תִּפֹּלוּ׃
verses.english: Nevertheless, you shall die like a man, and fall as one man, O princes.

verses.hebrew: קוּמָה אֱלֹהִים שָׁפְטָה הָאָרֶץ כִּי־אַתָּה תִנְחַל בְּכָל־הַגּוֹיִם׃
verses.english: Arise, O God, judge the earth: for Thou shalt possess all the nations.

verses.hebrew: שִׁיר מִזְמוֹר לְאָסָף׃
verses.english: A Poem, A Psalm of Asaf.

verses.hebrew: אֱלֹהִים אַל־דֳּמִי־לָךְ אַל־תֶּחֱרַשׁ וְאַל־תִּשְׁקֹט אֵל׃
verses.english: Do not keep silence, O God: do not hold Thy peace, and be still, O God.

verses.hebrew: כִּי־הִנֵּה אוֹיְבֶיךָ יֶהֱמָיוּן וּמְשַׂנְאֶיךָ נָשְׂאוּ רֹאשׁ׃
verses.english: For lo, Thy enemies make a tumult: and they who hate Thee have lifted up the head.

verses.hebrew: עַל־עַמְּךָ יַעֲרִימוּ סוֹד וְיִתְיָעֲצוּ עַל־צְפוּנֶיךָ׃
verses.english: They take crafty counsel against Thy people, and consult against Thy hidden ones.

verses.hebrew: אָמְרוּ לְכוּ וְנַכְחִידֵם מִגּוֹי וְלֹא־יִזָּכֵר שֵׁם־יִשְׂרָאֵל עוֹד׃
verses.english: They have said, Come, and let us cut them off from being a nation; that the name of Yisra᾽el may be no more in remembrance.

verses.hebrew: כִּי נוֹעֲצוּ לֵב יַחְדָּו עָלֶיךָ בְּרִית יִכְרֹתוּ׃
verses.english: For they have consulted together with one consent: they are confederate against Thee:

verses.hebrew: אָהֳלֵי אֱדוֹם וְיִשְׁמְעֵאלִים מוֹאָב וְהַגְרִים׃
verses.english: the tents of Edom, and the Yishme᾽elim; of Mo᾽av, and the Hagrim;

verses.hebrew: גְּבָל וְעַמּוֹן וַעֲמָלֵק פְּלֶשֶׁת עִם־יֹשְׁבֵי צוֹר׃
verses.english: Geval, and ῾Ammon, and ῾Amaleq; Peleshet with the inhabitants of Żor;

verses.hebrew: גַּם־אַשּׁוּר נִלְוָה עִמָּם הָיוּ זְרוֹעַ לִבְנֵי־לוֹט סֶלָה׃
verses.english: Ashshur also is joined with them: they are the strong arm of the children of Lot. (Sela.)

verses.hebrew: עֲשֵׂה־לָהֶם כְּמִדְיָן כְּסִיסְרָא כְיָבִין בְּנַחַל קִישׁוֹן׃
verses.english: Do to them as to Midyan; as to Sisera, as to Yavin, at the wadi of Qishon:

verses.hebrew: נִשְׁמְדוּ בְעֵין־דֹּאר הָיוּ דֹּמֶן לָאֲדָמָה׃
verses.english: who perished at ῾En-dor: they became like dung on the earth.

verses.hebrew: שִׁיתֵמוֹ נְדִיבֵמוֹ כְּעֹרֵב וְכִזְאֵב וּכְזֶבַח וּכְצַלְמֻנָּע כָּל־נְסִיכֵמוֹ׃
verses.english: Make their nobles like ῾Orev, and like Ze᾽ev: and all their princes like Zevaĥ, and Żalmunna:

verses.hebrew: אֲשֶׁר אָמְרוּ נִירֲשָׁה לָּנוּ אֵת נְאוֹת אֱלֹהִים׃
verses.english: who said, Let us seize for our possession the pastures of God.

verses.hebrew: אֱ‍לֹהַי שִׁיתֵמוֹ כַגַּלְגַּל כְּקַשׁ לִפְנֵי־רוּחַ׃
verses.english: O my God, make them like the whirling chaff: like the stubble before the wind.

verses.hebrew: כְּאֵשׁ תִּבְעַר־יָעַר וּכְלֶהָבָה תְּלַהֵט הָרִים׃
verses.english: As the fire burns a wood, and as the flame sets the mountains on fire;

verses.hebrew: כֵּן תִּרְדְּפֵם בְּסַעֲרֶךָ וּבְסוּפָתְךָ תְבַהֲלֵם׃
verses.english: so pursue them with thy tempest, and terrify them with thy storm.

verses.hebrew: מַלֵּא פְנֵיהֶם קָלוֹן וִיבַקְשׁוּ שִׁמְךָ יְהוָה׃
verses.english: Fill their faces with shame; that they may seek thy name, O Lord.

verses.hebrew: יֵבֹשׁוּ וְיִבָּהֲלוּ עֲדֵי־עַד וְיַחְפְּרוּ וְיֹאבֵדוּ׃
verses.english: Let them be confounded and affrighted forever; and let them be put to shame, and perish:

verses.hebrew: וְיֵדְעוּ כִּי־אַתָּה שִׁמְךָ יְהוָה לְבַדֶּךָ עֶלְיוֹן עַל־כָּל־הָאָרֶץ׃
verses.english: that men may know that thou alone, whose name is the Lord, art the most high over all the earth.

verses.hebrew: לַמְנַצֵּחַ עַל־הַגִּתִּית לִבְנֵי־קֹרַח מִזְמוֹר׃
verses.english: To the chief Musician upon the Gittit, A Psalm for the sons of Qoraĥ.

verses.hebrew: מַה־יְּדִידוֹת מִשְׁכְּנוֹתֶיךָ יְהוָה צְבָאוֹת׃
verses.english: How lovely are Thy dwelling places, O Lord of hosts!

verses.hebrew: נִכְסְפָה וְגַם־כָּלְתָה נַפְשִׁי לְחַצְרוֹת יְהוָה לִבִּי וּבְשָׂרִי יְרַנְּנוּ אֶל אֵל־חָי׃
verses.english: My soul longs, indeed, it faints for the courts of the Lord: my heart and my flesh cry out for the living God.

verses.hebrew: גַּם־צִפּוֹר מָצְאָה בַיִת וּדְרוֹר קֵן לָהּ אֲשֶׁר־שָׁתָה אֶפְרֹחֶיהָ אֶת־מִזְבְּחוֹתֶיךָ יְהוָה צְבָאוֹת מַלְכִּי וֵאלֹהָי׃
verses.english: Even the sparrow has found a home, and the swallow a nest for herself, where she may lay her young. Thy altars, O Lord of hosts, my King, and my God –

verses.hebrew: אַשְׁרֵי יוֹשְׁבֵי בֵיתֶךָ עוֹד יְהַלְלוּךָ סֶּלָה׃
verses.english: happy are they who dwell in Thy house: they are ever praising thee. (Sela.)

verses.hebrew: אַשְׁרֵי אָדָם עוֹז־לוֹ בָךְ מְסִלּוֹת בִּלְבָבָם׃
verses.english: Happy is the man whose strength is in Thee; in whose heart are Thy highways,

verses.hebrew: עֹבְרֵי בְּעֵמֶק הַבָּכָא מַעְיָן יְשִׁיתוּהוּ גַּם־בְּרָכוֹת יַעְטֶה מוֹרֶה׃
verses.english: who, passing through the valley of Bakha, turn in into a waterspring; moreover, the early rain covers it with blessings.

verses.hebrew: יֵלְכוּ מֵחַיִל אֶל־חָיִל יֵרָאֶה אֶל־אֱלֹהִים בְּצִיּוֹן׃
verses.english: They go from strength to strength, every one of them appears before God in Żiyyon.

verses.hebrew: יְהוָה אֱלֹהִים צְבָאוֹת שִׁמְעָה תְפִלָּתִי הַאֲזִינָה אֱלֹהֵי יַעֲקֹב סֶלָה׃
verses.english: O Lord God of hosts, hear my prayer: give ear, O God of Ya῾aqov. (Sela.)

verses.hebrew: מָגִנֵּנוּ רְאֵה אֱלֹהִים וְהַבֵּט פְּנֵי מְשִׁיחֶךָ׃
verses.english: Behold, O God, our shield, and look upon the face of Thy anointed.

verses.hebrew: כִּי טוֹב־יוֹם בַּחֲצֵרֶיךָ מֵאָלֶף בָּחַרְתִּי הִסְתּוֹפֵף בְּבֵית אֱלֹהַי מִדּוּר בְּאָהֳלֵי־רֶשַׁע׃
verses.english: For a day in Thy courts is better than a thousand. I had rather be at the threshold in the house of my God, than dwell in the tents of wickedness.

verses.hebrew: כִּי שֶׁמֶשׁ וּמָגֵן יְהוָה אֱלֹהִים חֵן וְכָבוֹד יִתֵּן יְהוָה לֹא יִמְנַע־טוֹב לַהֹלְכִים בְּתָמִים׃
verses.english: For the Lord God is a sun and shield: the Lord will give grace and honour: no good thing will he withhold from those who walk uprightly.

verses.hebrew: יְהוָה צְבָאוֹת אַשְׁרֵי אָדָם בֹּטֵחַ בָּךְ׃
verses.english: O Lord of hosts, happy is the man who trusts in Thee.

verses.hebrew: לַמְנַצֵּחַ לִבְנֵי־קֹרַח מִזְמוֹר׃
verses.english: To the chief Musician, A Psalm for the sons of Qoraĥ.

verses.hebrew: רָצִיתָ יְהוָה אַרְצֶךָ שַׁבְתָּ שבות [שְׁבִית] יַעֲקֹב׃
verses.english: Lord, Thou hast been favourable to Thy land: Thou hast brought back the captivity of Ya῾aqov.

verses.hebrew: נָשָׂאתָ עֲוֺן עַמֶּךָ כִּסִּיתָ כָל־חַטָּאתָם סֶלָה׃
verses.english: Thou hast forgiven the iniquity of Thy people, Thou hast pardoned all their sin. (Sela.)

verses.hebrew: אָסַפְתָּ כָל־עֶבְרָתֶךָ הֱשִׁיבוֹתָ מֵחֲרוֹן אַפֶּךָ׃
verses.english: Thou hast withdrawn all Thy wrath: Thou hast turned from the fierceness of Thy anger.

verses.hebrew: שׁוּבֵנוּ אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׁעֵנוּ וְהָפֵר כַּעַסְךָ עִמָּנוּ׃
verses.english: Restore us, O God of our salvation, and cause Thy anger towards us to cease.

verses.hebrew: הַלְעוֹלָם תֶּאֱנַף־בָּנוּ תִּמְשֹׁךְ אַפְּךָ לְדֹר וָדֹר׃
verses.english: Wilt Thou be angry with us forever? Wilt Thou draw out Thy anger to all generations?

verses.hebrew: הֲלֹא־אַתָּה תָּשׁוּב תְּחַיֵּנוּ וְעַמְּךָ יִשְׂמְחוּ־בָךְ׃
verses.english: Wilt Thou not revive us again: that Thy people may rejoice in Thee?

verses.hebrew: הַרְאֵנוּ יְהוָה חַסְדֶּךָ וְיֶשְׁעֲךָ תִּתֶּן־לָנוּ׃
verses.english: Show us thy mercy, O Lord, and grant us Thy salvation.

verses.hebrew: אֶשְׁמְעָה מַה־יְדַבֵּר הָאֵל יְהוָה כִּי יְדַבֵּר שָׁלוֹם אֶל־עַמּוֹ וְאֶל־חֲסִידָיו וְאַל־יָשׁוּבוּ לְכִסְלָה׃
verses.english: I will hear what God the Lord will speak: for he will speak peace to his people, and to his pious ones: but let them not turn back to folly.

verses.hebrew: אַךְ קָרוֹב לִירֵאָיו יִשְׁעוֹ לִשְׁכֹּן כָּבוֹד בְּאַרְצֵנוּ׃
verses.english: Surely his salvation is near to them who fear him; that glory may dwell in our land.

verses.hebrew: חֶסֶד־וֶאֱמֶת נִפְגָּשׁוּ צֶדֶק וְשָׁלוֹם נָשָׁקוּ׃
verses.english: Love and truth are met together; righteousness and peace have kissed each other.

verses.hebrew: אֱמֶת מֵאֶרֶץ תִּצְמָח וְצֶדֶק מִשָּׁמַיִם נִשְׁקָף׃
verses.english: Truth will spring out of the earth; and righteousness will look down from heaven.

verses.hebrew: גַּם־יְהוָה יִתֵּן הַטּוֹב וְאַרְצֵנוּ תִּתֵּן יְבוּלָהּ׃
verses.english: The Lord moreover shall give that which is good; and our land shall yield its increase.

verses.hebrew: צֶדֶק לְפָנָיו יְהַלֵּךְ וְיָשֵׂם לְדֶרֶךְ פְּעָמָיו׃
verses.english: Righteousness shall go before him, and walk in the way of his steps.

verses.hebrew: תְּפִלָּה לְדָוִד הַטֵּה־יְהוָה אָזְנְךָ עֲנֵנִי כִּי־עָנִי וְאֶבְיוֹן אָנִי׃
verses.english: A Prayer of David. Incline Thy ear, O Lord, hear me: for I am poor and needy.

verses.hebrew: שָׁמְרָה נַפְשִׁי כִּי־חָסִיד אָנִי הוֹשַׁע עַבְדְּךָ אַתָּה אֱלֹהַי הַבּוֹטֵחַ אֵלֶיךָ׃
verses.english: Preserve my soul; for I am godly: O Thou my God, save Thy servant who trusts in Thee.

verses.hebrew: חָנֵּנִי אֲדֹנָי כִּי אֵלֶיךָ אֶקְרָא כָּל־הַיּוֹם׃
verses.english: Be gracious to me, O Lord: for I cry to Thee daily.

verses.hebrew: שַׂמֵּחַ נֶפֶשׁ עַבְדֶּךָ כִּי אֵלֶיךָ אֲדֹנָי נַפְשִׁי אֶשָּׂא׃
verses.english: Rejoice the soul of Thy servant: for to Thee, O Lord, do I lift up my soul.

verses.hebrew: כִּי־אַתָּה אֲדֹנָי טוֹב וְסַלָּח וְרַב־חֶסֶד לְכָל־קֹרְאֶיךָ׃
verses.english: For Thou, Lord, art good, and ready to forgive; and of bountiful love towards all those who call upon Thee.

verses.hebrew: הַאֲזִינָה יְהוָה תְּפִלָּתִי וְהַקְשִׁיבָה בְּקוֹל תַּחֲנוּנוֹתָי׃
verses.english: Give ear, O Lord, to my prayer; and attend to the voice of my supplications.

verses.hebrew: בְּיוֹם צָרָתִי אֶקְרָאֶךָּ כִּי תַעֲנֵנִי׃
verses.english: On the day of my trouble I will call upon Thee: for Thou wilt answer me.

verses.hebrew: אֵין־כָּמוֹךָ בָאֱלֹהִים אֲדֹנָי וְאֵין כְּמַעֲשֶׂיךָ׃
verses.english: Among the gods there is none like Thee, O Lord; nor are there any works like Thine.

verses.hebrew: כָּל־גּוֹיִם אֲשֶׁר עָשִׂיתָ יָבוֹאוּ וְיִשְׁתַּחֲווּ לְפָנֶיךָ אֲדֹנָי וִיכַבְּדוּ לִשְׁמֶךָ׃
verses.english: All nations whom Thou hast made shall come and prostrate themselves before Thee, O Lord; and shall glorify Thy name.

verses.hebrew: כִּי־גָדוֹל אַתָּה וְעֹשֵׂה נִפְלָאוֹת אַתָּה אֱלֹהִים לְבַדֶּךָ׃
verses.english: For Thou art great, and doest wondrous things: Thou art God alone.

verses.hebrew: הוֹרֵנִי יְהוָה דַּרְכֶּךָ אֲהַלֵּךְ בַּאֲמִתֶּךָ יַחֵד לְבָבִי לְיִרְאָה שְׁמֶךָ׃
verses.english: Teach me Thy way, O Lord; I will walk in Thy truth: make my heart single to fear Thy name.

verses.hebrew: אוֹדְךָ אֲדֹנָי אֱלֹהַי בְּכָל־לְבָבִי וַאֲכַבְּדָה שִׁמְךָ לְעוֹלָם׃
verses.english: I will thank Thee, O Lord my God, with all my heart: and I will glorify Thy name for evermore.

verses.hebrew: כִּי־חַסְדְּךָ גָּדוֹל עָלָי וְהִצַּלְתָּ נַפְשִׁי מִשְּׁאוֹל תַּחְתִּיָּה׃
verses.english: For great is Thy steadfast love towards me: and Thou hast delivered my soul from the depths of She᾽ol.

verses.hebrew: אֱלֹהִים זֵדִים קָמוּ־עָלַי וַעֲדַת עָרִיצִים בִּקְשׁוּ נַפְשִׁי וְלֹא שָׂמוּךָ לְנֶגְדָּם׃
verses.english: O God, the proud are risen against me, and the assembly of violent men have sought after my soul; and have not set Thee before them.

verses.hebrew: וְאַתָּה אֲדֹנָי אֵל־רַחוּם וְחַנּוּן אֶרֶךְ אַפַּיִם וְרַב־חֶסֶד וֶאֱמֶת׃
verses.english: But Thou, O Lord, art a God full of compassion, and gracious, longsuffering, and bountiful in love and truth.

verses.hebrew: פְּנֵה אֵלַי וְחָנֵּנִי תְּנָה־עֻזְּךָ לְעַבְדֶּךָ וְהוֹשִׁיעָה לְבֶן־אֲמָתֶךָ׃
verses.english: O turn to me, and have mercy upon me; give Thy strength to Thy servant, and save the son of Thy handmaid.

verses.hebrew: עֲשֵׂה־עִמִּי אוֹת לְטוֹבָה וְיִרְאוּ שֹׂנְאַי וְיֵבֹשׁוּ כִּי־אַתָּה יְהוָה עֲזַרְתַּנִי וְנִחַמְתָּנִי׃
verses.english: Show me a sign for good; that they who hate me may see it, and be ashamed: because Thou, Lord, hast helped me, and comforted me.

verses.hebrew: לִבְנֵי־קֹרַח מִזְמוֹר שִׁיר יְסוּדָתוֹ בְּהַרְרֵי־קֹדֶשׁ׃
verses.english: A Psalm for the sons of Qoraĥ, A Poem. His foundation is in the holy mountains.

verses.hebrew: אֹהֵב יְהוָה שַׁעֲרֵי צִיּוֹן מִכֹּל מִשְׁכְּנוֹת יַעֲקֹב׃
verses.english: The Lord loves the gates of Żiyyon more than all the dwellings of Ya῾aqov.

verses.hebrew: נִכְבָּדוֹת מְדֻבָּר בָּךְ עִיר הָאֱלֹהִים סֶלָה׃
verses.english: Glorious things are spoken of thee, O city of God. (Sela.)

verses.hebrew: אַזְכִּיר רַהַב וּבָבֶל לְיֹדְעָי הִנֵּה פְלֶשֶׁת וְצוֹר עִם־כּוּשׁ זֶה יֻלַּד־שָׁם׃
verses.english: I will make mention of Rahav and Bavel to those who know me: behold Peleshet, and Żor, with Kush, saying, Such a man was born there.

verses.hebrew: וּלֲצִיּוֹן יֵאָמַר אִישׁ וְאִישׁ יֻלַּד־בָּהּ וְהוּא יְכוֹנְנֶהָ עֶלְיוֹן׃
verses.english: But of Żiyyon it shall be said, This and that man was born in her: and the highest himself shall establish her.

verses.hebrew: יְהוָה יִסְפֹּר בִּכְתוֹב עַמִּים זֶה יֻלַּד־שָׁם סֶלָה׃
verses.english: The Lord shall record, when he registers the peoples, that this man was born there. (Sela.)

verses.hebrew: וְשָׁרִים כְּחֹלְלִים כָּל־מַעְיָנַי בָּךְ׃
verses.english: And singers and dancers alike, shall say, All my springs are in Thee.

verses.hebrew: שִׁיר מִזְמוֹר לִבְנֵי קֹרַח לַמְנַצֵּחַ עַל־מָחֲלַת לְעַנּוֹת מַשְׂכִּיל לְהֵימָן הָאֶזְרָחִי׃
verses.english: A Poem, A Psalm for the sons of Qoraĥ, to the chief Musician upon Maĥalat Le῾annot, A Maskil of Heman the Ezraĥite.

verses.hebrew: יְהוָה אֱלֹהֵי יְשׁוּעָתִי יוֹם־צָעַקְתִּי בַלַּיְלָה נֶגְדֶּךָ׃
verses.english: O Lord God of my salvation, when I cry in the night before Thee:

verses.hebrew: תָּבוֹא לְפָנֶיךָ תְּפִלָּתִי הַטֵּה־אָזְנְךָ לְרִנָּתִי׃
verses.english: let my prayer come before Thee: incline Thy ear to my cry;

verses.hebrew: כִּי־שָׂבְעָה בְרָעוֹת נַפְשִׁי וְחַיַּי לִשְׁאוֹל הִגִּיעוּ׃
verses.english: for my soul is sated with evils: and my life draws near to She᾽ol.

verses.hebrew: נֶחְשַׁבְתִּי עִם־יוֹרְדֵי בוֹר הָיִיתִי כְּגֶבֶר אֵין־אֱיָל׃
verses.english: I am reckoned with those who go down into the pit: I am like a man who has no strength:

verses.hebrew: בַּמֵּתִים חָפְשִׁי כְּמוֹ חֲלָלִים שֹׁכְבֵי קֶבֶר אֲשֶׁר לֹא זְכַרְתָּם עוֹד וְהֵמָּה מִיָּדְךָ נִגְזָרוּ׃
verses.english: free among the dead, like the slain that lie in the grave, whom Thou rememberest no more: and they are cut off from Thy hand.

verses.hebrew: שַׁתַּנִי בְּבוֹר תַּחְתִּיּוֹת בְּמַחֲשַׁכִּים בִּמְצֹלוֹת׃
verses.english: Thou hast laid me in the lowest pit, in darkness, in the deeps.

verses.hebrew: עָלַי סָמְכָה חֲמָתֶךָ וְכָל־מִשְׁבָּרֶיךָ עִנִּיתָ סֶּלָה׃
verses.english: Thy wrath lies hard upon me, and Thou dost overwhelm me with all Thy waves. (Sela.)

verses.hebrew: הִרְחַקְתָּ מְיֻדָּעַי מִמֶּנִּי שַׁתַּנִי תוֹעֵבוֹת לָמוֹ כָּלֻא וְלֹא אֵצֵא׃
verses.english: Thou hast put away my acquaintances far from me; Thou hast made me an abomination to them: I am shut up, and I cannot come out.

verses.hebrew: עֵינִי דָאֲבָה מִנִּי עֹנִי קְרָאתִיךָ יְהוָה בְּכָל־יוֹם שִׁטַּחְתִּי אֵלֶיךָ כַפָּי׃
verses.english: My eye is dim by reason of affliction: Lord, I have called daily upon Thee, I have stretched out my hands to Thee.

verses.hebrew: הֲלַמֵּתִים תַּעֲשֶׂה־פֶּלֶא אִם־רְפָאִים יָקוּמוּ יוֹדוּךָ סֶּלָה׃
verses.english: Wilt Thou show wonders to the dead? shall the shades arise and praise Thee? (Sela.)

verses.hebrew: הַיְסֻפַּר בַּקֶּבֶר חַסְדֶּךָ אֱמוּנָתְךָ בָּאֲבַדּוֹן׃
verses.english: Shall Thy steadfast love be reported in the grave? or Thy faithfulness in Avaddon?

verses.hebrew: הֲיִוָּדַע בַּחֹשֶׁךְ פִּלְאֶךָ וְצִדְקָתְךָ בְּאֶרֶץ נְשִׁיָּה׃
verses.english: Shall Thy wonders be known in the dark? and Thy righteousness in the land of forgetfulness?

verses.hebrew: וַאֲנִי אֵלֶיךָ יְהוָה שִׁוַּעְתִּי וּבַבֹּקֶר תְּפִלָּתִי תְקַדְּמֶךָּ׃
verses.english: But to Thee have I cried, O Lord; and in the morning shall my prayer attend Thee.

verses.hebrew: לָמָה יְהוָה תִּזְנַח נַפְשִׁי תַּסְתִּיר פָּנֶיךָ מִמֶּנִּי׃
verses.english: Lord, why dost Thou cast off my soul? why dost Thou hide Thy face from me?

verses.hebrew: עָנִי אֲנִי וְגֹוֵעַ מִנֹּעַר נָשָׂאתִי אֵמֶיךָ אָפוּנָה׃
verses.english: I am afflicted and close to death from my youth up. I suffer Thy terrors, I am numb.

verses.hebrew: עָלַי עָבְרוּ חֲרוֹנֶיךָ בִּעוּתֶיךָ צִמְּתוּתֻנִי׃
verses.english: Thy fierce wrath goes over me; Thy terrors have cut me off.

verses.hebrew: סַבּוּנִי כַמַּיִם כָּל־הַיּוֹם הִקִּיפוּ עָלַי יָחַד׃
verses.english: They come round about me daily like water; they compass me about together.

verses.hebrew: הִרְחַקְתָּ מִמֶּנִּי אֹהֵב וָרֵעַ מְיֻדָּעַי מַחְשָׁךְ׃
verses.english: Friend and companion hast Thou put far from me, my acquaintances are in darkness.

verses.hebrew: מַשְׂכִּיל לְאֵיתָן הָאֶזְרָחִי׃
verses.english: A Maskil of Etan the Ezraĥite.

verses.hebrew: חַסְדֵי יְהוָה עוֹלָם אָשִׁירָה לְדֹר וָדֹר אוֹדִיעַ אֱמוּנָתְךָ בְּפִי׃
verses.english: I will sing of the steadfast love of the Lord for ever: with my mouth I will make known Thy faithfulness to all generations.

verses.hebrew: כִּי־אָמַרְתִּי עוֹלָם חֶסֶד יִבָּנֶה שָׁמַיִם תָּכִן אֱמוּנָתְךָ בָהֶם׃
verses.english: For I have said, The world is built by love: Thou dost establish Thy faithfulness in the very heavens.

verses.hebrew: כָּרַתִּי בְרִית לִבְחִירִי נִשְׁבַּעְתִּי לְדָוִד עַבְדִּי׃
verses.english: I have made a covenant with my chosen, I have sworn to David my servant,

verses.hebrew: עַד־עוֹלָם אָכִין זַרְעֶךָ וּבָנִיתִי לְדֹר־וָדוֹר כִּסְאֲךָ סֶלָה׃
verses.english: Thy seed will I establish for ever, and build up thy throne to all generations. (Sela.)

verses.hebrew: וְיוֹדוּ שָׁמַיִם פִּלְאֲךָ יְהוָה אַף־אֱמוּנָתְךָ בִּקְהַל קְדֹשִׁים׃
verses.english: And the heavens shall praise Thy wonders, O Lord: Thy faithfulness also in the assembly of the holy ones.

verses.hebrew: כִּי מִי בַשַּׁחַק יַעֲרֹךְ לַיהוָה יִדְמֶה לַיהוָה בִּבְנֵי אֵלִים׃
verses.english: For who in the skies can be compared to the Lord? who among the sons of the mighty can be likened to the Lord?

verses.hebrew: אֵל נַעֲרָץ בְּסוֹד־קְדֹשִׁים רַבָּה וְנוֹרָא עַל־כָּל־סְבִיבָיו׃
verses.english: A God dreaded in the great council of the holy ones, and had in reverence by all those round about him.

verses.hebrew: יְהוָה אֱלֹהֵי צְבָאוֹת מִי־כָמוֹךָ חֲסִין יָהּ וֶאֱמוּנָתְךָ סְבִיבוֹתֶיךָ׃
verses.english: O Lord God of hosts, O Lord, who is strong like Thee? and Thy faithfulness is round about Thee.

verses.hebrew: אַתָּה מוֹשֵׁל בְּגֵאוּת הַיָּם בְּשׂוֹא גַלָּיו אַתָּה תְשַׁבְּחֵם׃
verses.english: Thou rulest the raging of the sea: when the waves thereof rise up, Thou stillest them.

verses.hebrew: אַתָּה דִכִּאתָ כֶחָלָל רָהַב בִּזְרוֹעַ עֻזְּךָ פִּזַּרְתָּ אוֹיְבֶיךָ׃
verses.english: Thou hast trodden down Rahav like carrion; Thou hast scattered Thy enemies with Thy strong arm.

verses.hebrew: לְךָ שָׁמַיִם אַף־לְךָ אָרֶץ תֵּבֵל וּמְלֹאָהּ אַתָּה יְסַדְתָּם׃
verses.english: The skies are Thine, the earth also is Thine: the world and the fulness thereof, Thou hast founded them.

verses.hebrew: צָפוֹן וְיָמִין אַתָּה בְרָאתָם תָּבוֹר וְחֶרְמוֹן בְּשִׁמְךָ יְרַנֵּנוּ׃
verses.english: The north and the south, Thou hast created them: Tavor and Ḥermon shall rejoice in Thy name.

verses.hebrew: לְךָ זְרוֹעַ עִם־גְּבוּרָה תָּעֹז יָדְךָ תָּרוּם יְמִינֶךָ׃
verses.english: Thou hast a mighty arm: strong is Thy hand, and high is Thy right hand.

verses.hebrew: צֶדֶק וּמִשְׁפָּט מְכוֹן כִּסְאֶךָ חֶסֶד וֶאֱמֶת יְקַדְּמוּ פָנֶיךָ׃
verses.english: Righteousness and justice are the foundation of Thy throne: love and truth shall go before Thee.

verses.hebrew: אַשְׁרֵי הָעָם יוֹדְעֵי תְרוּעָה יְהוָה בְּאוֹר־פָּנֶיךָ יְהַלֵּכוּן׃
verses.english: Happy is the people that know the joyful note: they shall walk, O Lord, in the light of Thy countenance.

verses.hebrew: בְּשִׁמְךָ יְגִילוּן כָּל־הַיּוֹם וּבְצִדְקָתְךָ יָרוּמוּ׃
verses.english: In Thy name they rejoice all the day: and in Thy righteousness they are exalted.

verses.hebrew: כִּי־תִפְאֶרֶת עֻזָּמוֹ אָתָּה וּבִרְצֹנְךָ תרים [תָּרוּם] קַרְנֵנוּ׃
verses.english: For Thou art the glory of their strength: and in Thy favour our horn shall be exalted.

verses.hebrew: כִּי לַיהוָה מָגִנֵּנוּ וְלִקְדוֹשׁ יִשְׂרָאֵל מַלְכֵּנוּ׃
verses.english: For our shield belongs to the Lord; and our king to the Holy One of Yisra᾽el.

verses.hebrew: אָז דִּבַּרְתָּ־בְחָזוֹן לַחֲסִידֶיךָ וַתֹּאמֶר שִׁוִּיתִי עֵזֶר עַל־גִּבּוֹר הֲרִימוֹתִי בָחוּר מֵעָם׃
verses.english: Then Thou didst speak in vision to Thy pious one, and didst say, I have laid help upon one that is mighty; have exalted one chosen out of the people.

verses.hebrew: מָצָאתִי דָּוִד עַבְדִּי בְּשֶׁמֶן קָדְשִׁי מְשַׁחְתִּיו׃
verses.english: I have found David my servant; with my holy oil have I anointed him:

verses.hebrew: אֲשֶׁר יָדִי תִּכּוֹן עִמּוֹ אַף־זְרוֹעִי תְאַמְּצֶנּוּ׃
verses.english: with whom my hand shall be established: my arm also shall strengthen him.

verses.hebrew: לֹא־יַשִּׁא אוֹיֵב בּוֹ וּבֶן־עַוְלָה לֹא יְעַנֶּנּוּ׃
verses.english: The enemy shall not exact upon him; nor the son of wickedness afflict him.

verses.hebrew: וְכַתּוֹתִי מִפָּנָיו צָרָיו וּמְשַׂנְאָיו אֶגּוֹף׃
verses.english: And I will beat down his foes before his face, and strike down those who hate him.

verses.hebrew: וֶאֶמוּנָתִי וְחַסְדִּי עִמּוֹ וּבִשְׁמִי תָּרוּם קַרְנוֹ׃
verses.english: But my faithfulness and my steadfast love shall be with him: and in my name shall his horn be exalted.

verses.hebrew: וְשַׂמְתִּי בַיָּם יָדוֹ וּבַנְּהָרוֹת יְמִינוֹ׃
verses.english: I will set his hand also on the sea, and his right hand on the rivers.

verses.hebrew: הוּא יִקְרָאֵנִי אָבִי אָתָּה אֵלִי וְצוּר יְשׁוּעָתִי׃
verses.english: He shall cry to me, Thou art my father, my God, and the rock of my salvation.

verses.hebrew: אַף־אָנִי בְּכוֹר אֶתְּנֵהוּ עֶלְיוֹן לְמַלְכֵי־אָרֶץ׃
verses.english: Also I will make him firstborn, the highest of the kings of the earth.

verses.hebrew: לְעוֹלָם אשמור־[אֶשְׁמָר־] לוֹ חַסְדִּי וּבְרִיתִי נֶאֱמֶנֶת לוֹ׃
verses.english: I will keep my truth with him for evermore, and my covenant shall stand fast with him.

verses.hebrew: וְשַׂמְתִּי לָעַד זַרְעוֹ וְכִסְאוֹ כִּימֵי שָׁמָיִם׃
verses.english: His seed also will I make to endure for ever, and his throne like the days of heaven.

verses.hebrew: אִם־יַעַזְבוּ בָנָיו תּוֹרָתִי וּבְמִשְׁפָּטַי לֹא יֵלֵכוּן׃
verses.english: If his children forsake my Tora, and walk not in my judgments;

verses.hebrew: אִם־חֻקֹּתַי יְחַלֵּלוּ וּמִצְוֺתַי לֹא יִשְׁמֹרוּ׃
verses.english: if they break my statutes, and keep not my commandments;

verses.hebrew: וּפָקַדְתִּי בְשֵׁבֶט פִּשְׁעָם וּבִנְגָעִים עֲוֺנָם׃
verses.english: then I will punish their transgression with the rod, and their iniquity with strokes.

verses.hebrew: וְחַסְדִּי לֹא־אָפִיר מֵעִמּוֹ וְלֹא־אֲשַׁקֵּר בֶּאֱמוּנָתִי׃
verses.english: Nevertheless I will not utterly take my steadfast love from him, nor suffer my faithfulness to fail.

verses.hebrew: לֹא־אֲחַלֵּל בְּרִיתִי וּמוֹצָא שְׂפָתַי לֹא אֲשַׁנֶּה׃
verses.english: My covenant I will not break, nor alter that which has issued from my lips.

verses.hebrew: אַחַת נִשְׁבַּעְתִּי בְקָדְשִׁי אִם־לְדָוִד אֲכַזֵּב׃
verses.english: Once I have sworn by my holiness that I will not fail unto David.

verses.hebrew: זַרְעוֹ לְעוֹלָם יִהְיֶה וְכִסְאוֹ כַשֶּׁמֶשׁ נֶגְדִּי׃
verses.english: His seed shall endure for ever, and his throne shall be like the sun before me.

verses.hebrew: כְּיָרֵחַ יִכּוֹן עוֹלָם וְעֵד בַּשַּׁחַק נֶאֱמָן סֶלָה׃
verses.english: It shall be established for ever like the moon, and the witness in the sky is sure. (Sela.)

verses.hebrew: וְאַתָּה זָנַחְתָּ וַתִּמְאָס הִתְעַבַּרְתָּ עִם־מְשִׁיחֶךָ׃
verses.english: But Thou hast cast off and rejected, Thou hast been angry with Thy anointed.

verses.hebrew: נֵאַרְתָּה בְּרִית עַבְדֶּךָ חִלַּלְתָּ לָאָרֶץ נִזְרוֹ׃
verses.english: Thou hast renounced the covenant of Thy servant: Thou hast profaned his crown to the ground.

verses.hebrew: פָּרַצְתָּ כָל־גְּדֵרֹתָיו שַׂמְתָּ מִבְצָרָיו מְחִתָּה׃
verses.english: Thou hast broken down all his fences; Thou hast brought his strongholds to ruin.

verses.hebrew: שַׁסֻּהוּ כָּל־עֹבְרֵי דָרֶךְ הָיָה חֶרְפָּה לִשְׁכֵנָיו׃
verses.english: All that pass by the way plunder him: he is a taunt to his neighbours.

verses.hebrew: הֲרִימוֹתָ יְמִין צָרָיו הִשְׂמַחְתָּ כָּל־אוֹיְבָיו׃
verses.english: Thou hast exalted the right hand of his adversaries; Thou hast made all his enemies rejoice.

verses.hebrew: אַף־תָּשִׁיב צוּר חַרְבּוֹ וְלֹא הֲקֵימֹתוֹ בַּמִּלְחָמָה׃
verses.english: Thou hast also turned back the edge of his sword, and hast not made him to stand in the battle.

verses.hebrew: הִשְׁבַּתָּ מִטְּהָרוֹ וְכִסְאוֹ לָאָרֶץ מִגַּרְתָּה׃
verses.english: Thou hast made his brightness to cease, and cast his throne down to the ground.

verses.hebrew: הִקְצַרְתָּ יְמֵי עֲלוּמָיו הֶעֱטִיתָ עָלָיו בּוּשָׁה סֶלָה׃
verses.english: The days of his youth Thou hast shortened: Thou hast covered him with shame. (Sela.)

verses.hebrew: עַד־מָה יְהוָה תִּסָּתֵר לָנֶצַח תִּבְעַר כְּמוֹ־אֵשׁ חֲמָתֶךָ׃
verses.english: How long, Lord? wilt Thou hide Thyself forever? shall Thy wrath burn like fire?

verses.hebrew: זְכָר־אֲנִי מֶה־חָלֶד עַל־מַה־שָּׁוְא בָּרָאתָ כָל־בְּנֵי־אָדָם׃
verses.english: Remember how short my time is: for what nothingness hast Thou created all the sons of men!

verses.hebrew: מִי גֶבֶר יִחְיֶה וְלֹא יִרְאֶה־מָּוֶת יְמַלֵּט נַפְשׁוֹ מִיַּד־שְׁאוֹל סֶלָה׃
verses.english: What man is he that lives, and shall not see death, but shall deliver his soul from the power of She᾽ol? (Sela.)

verses.hebrew: אַיֵּה חֲסָדֶיךָ הָרִאשֹׁנִים אֲדֹנָי נִשְׁבַּעְתָּ לְדָוִד בֶּאֱמוּנָתֶךָ׃
verses.english: Lord, where are Thy former oaths of steadfast love which Thou didst make to David in Thy faithfulness?

verses.hebrew: זְכֹר אֲדֹנָי חֶרְפַּת עֲבָדֶיךָ שְׂאֵתִי בְחֵיקִי כָּל־רַבִּים עַמִּים׃
verses.english: Remember, Lord, the disgrace of Thy servants: how I bear in my bosom the insults of all the many peoples,

verses.hebrew: אֲשֶׁר חֵרְפוּ אוֹיְבֶיךָ יְהוָה אֲשֶׁר חֵרְפוּ עִקְּבוֹת מְשִׁיחֶךָ׃
verses.english: wherewith Thy enemies have insulted, O Lord; wherewith they have insulted the footsteps of Thy anointed.

verses.hebrew: בָּרוּךְ יְהוָה לְעוֹלָם אָמֵן וְאָמֵן׃
verses.english: Blessed be the Lord for evermore. Amen, and Amen.

verses.hebrew: תְּפִלָּה לְמֹשֶׁה אִישׁ־הָאֱלֹהִים אֲ‍דֹנָי מָעוֹן אַתָּה הָיִיתָ לָּנוּ בְּדֹר וָדֹר׃
verses.english: A Prayer of Moshe the man of God. Lord, Thou hast been our dwelling place in all generations.

verses.hebrew: בְּטֶרֶם הָרִים יֻלָּדוּ וַתְּחוֹלֵל אֶרֶץ וְתֵבֵל וּמֵעוֹלָם עַד־עוֹלָם אַתָּה אֵל׃
verses.english: Before the mountains were brought forth, and before ever Thou hadst formed the earth and the world, even from everlasting to everlasting, Thou art God.

verses.hebrew: תָּשֵׁב אֱנוֹשׁ עַד־דַּכָּא וַתֹּאמֶר שׁוּבוּ בְנֵי־אָדָם׃
verses.english: Thou turnest man back to dust; and sayst, Return, you children of men.

verses.hebrew: כִּי אֶלֶף שָׁנִים בְּעֵינֶיךָ כְּיוֹם אֶתְמוֹל כִּי יַעֲבֹר וְאַשְׁמוּרָה בַלָּיְלָה׃
verses.english: For a thousand years in Thy sight are but like yesterday when it is past, and like a watch in the night.

verses.hebrew: זְרַמְתָּם שֵׁנָה יִהְיוּ בַּבֹּקֶר כֶּחָצִיר יַחֲלֹף׃
verses.english: Thou engulfest them; they are like sleepers; they are like the short lived grass in the morning.

verses.hebrew: בַּבֹּקֶר יָצִיץ וְחָלָף לָעֶרֶב יְמוֹלֵל וְיָבֵשׁ׃
verses.english: In the morning it flourishes, and fades; by evening it is withered and dry.

verses.hebrew: כִּי־כָלִינוּ בְאַפֶּךָ וּבַחֲמָתְךָ נִבְהָלְנוּ׃
verses.english: For we are consumed by Thy anger, and by Thy wrath are we terrified.

verses.hebrew: שת [שַׁתָּה] עֲוֺנֹתֵינוּ לְנֶגְדֶּךָ עֲלֻמֵנוּ לִמְאוֹר פָּנֶיךָ׃
verses.english: Thou hast set our iniquities before Thee, our secret sins in the light of Thy countenance.

verses.hebrew: כִּי כָל־יָמֵינוּ פָּנוּ בְעֶבְרָתֶךָ כִּלִּינוּ שָׁנֵינוּ כְמוֹ־הֶגֶה׃
verses.english: For all our days are passed away in Thy wrath: we spend our years like a tale that is told.

verses.hebrew: יְמֵי־שְׁנוֹתֵינוּ בָהֶם שִׁבְעִים שָׁנָה וְאִם בִּגְבוּרֹת שְׁמוֹנִים שָׁנָה וְרָהְבָּם עָמָל וָאָוֶן כִּי־גָז חִישׁ וַנָּעֻפָה׃
verses.english: The days of our years are seventy; or if by reason of special strength, eighty years; yet their pride is but trouble and wretchedness; it is soon cut off, and we fly away.

verses.hebrew: מִי־יוֹדֵעַ עֹז אַפֶּךָ וּכְיִרְאָתְךָ עֶבְרָתֶךָ׃
verses.english: Who knows the power of Thy anger? even according to Thy fear, so is Thy wrath.

verses.hebrew: לִמְנוֹת יָמֵינוּ כֵּן הוֹדַע וְנָבִא לְבַב חָכְמָה׃
verses.english: So teach us to number our days, that we may get a heart of wisdom.

verses.hebrew: שׁוּבָה יְהוָה עַד־מָתָי וְהִנָּחֵם עַל־עֲבָדֶיךָ׃
verses.english: Return, O Lord, how long? and relent concerning Thy servants.

verses.hebrew: שַׂבְּעֵנוּ בַבֹּקֶר חַסְדֶּךָ וּנְרַנְּנָה וְנִשְׂמְחָה בְּכָל־יָמֵינוּ׃
verses.english: O satisfy us in the morning with Thy steadfast love; that we may rejoice and be glad all our days.

verses.hebrew: שַׂמְּחֵנוּ כִּימוֹת עִנִּיתָנוּ שְׁנוֹת רָאִינוּ רָעָה׃
verses.english: Make us glad according to the days wherein Thou hast afflicted us, and the years in which we have seen evil.

verses.hebrew: יֵרָאֶה אֶל־עֲבָדֶיךָ פָעֳלֶךָ וַהֲדָרְךָ עַל־בְּנֵיהֶם׃
verses.english: Let Thy work appear to Thy servants, and Thy glory to their children.

verses.hebrew: וִיהִי נֹעַם אֲדֹנָי אֱלֹהֵינוּ עָלֵינוּ וּמַעֲשֵׂה יָדֵינוּ כּוֹנְנָה עָלֵינוּ וּמַעֲשֵׂה יָדֵינוּ כּוֹנְנֵהוּ׃
verses.english: And let the beauty of the Lord our God be upon us: and establish the work of our hands upon us; O prosper it, the work of our hands.

verses.hebrew: יֹשֵׁב בְּסֵתֶר עֶלְיוֹן בְּצֵל שַׁדַּי יִתְלוֹנָן׃
verses.english: He that dwells in the secret place of the most High shall abide under the shadow of the Almighty.

verses.hebrew: אֹמַר לַיהוָה מַחְסִי וּמְצוּדָתִי אֱלֹהַי אֶבְטַח־בּוֹ׃
verses.english: I will say of the Lord, who is my refuge and my fortress: (my God; in him will I trust,)

verses.hebrew: כִּי הוּא יַצִּילְךָ מִפַּח יָקוּשׁ מִדֶּבֶר הַוּוֹת׃
verses.english: that he will deliver thee from the snare of the fowler, and from the noisome pestilence.

verses.hebrew: בְּאֶבְרָתוֹ יָסֶךְ לָךְ וְתַחַת־כְּנָפָיו תֶּחְסֶה צִנָּה וְסֹחֵרָה אֲמִתּוֹ׃
verses.english: He shall cover thee with his pinions, and under his wings shalt thou find refuge: his truth shall be thy shield and buckler.

verses.hebrew: לֹא־תִירָא מִפַּחַד לָיְלָה מֵחֵץ יָעוּף יוֹמָם׃
verses.english: Thou shalt not be afraid of the terror by night; nor of the arrow that flies by day;

verses.hebrew: מִדֶּבֶר בָּאֹפֶל יַהֲלֹךְ מִקֶּטֶב יָשׁוּד צָהֳרָיִם׃
verses.english: nor of the pestilence that walks in darkness; nor of the destruction that wastes at noonday.

verses.hebrew: יִפֹּל מִצִּדְּךָ אֶלֶף וּרְבָבָה מִימִינֶךָ אֵלֶיךָ לֹא יִגָּשׁ׃
verses.english: A thousand shall fall at thy side and ten thousand at thy right hand; but it shall not come near thee.

verses.hebrew: רַק בְּעֵינֶיךָ תַבִּיט וְשִׁלֻּמַת רְשָׁעִים תִּרְאֶה׃
verses.english: Only with thy eyes shalt thou behold and see the recompense of the wicked; because Thou O Lord, art my refuge.

verses.hebrew: כִּי־אַתָּה יְהוָה מַחְסִי עֶלְיוֹן שַׂמְתָּ מְעוֹנֶךָ׃
verses.english: Thou hast made the most High Thy habitation.

verses.hebrew: לֹא־תְאֻנֶּה אֵלֶיךָ רָעָה וְנֶגַע לֹא־יִקְרַב בְּאָהֳלֶךָ׃
verses.english: No evil shall befall thee, nor shall any plague come near thy dwelling.

verses.hebrew: כִּי מַלְאָכָיו יְצַוֶּה־לָּךְ לִשְׁמָרְךָ בְּכָל־דְּרָכֶיךָ׃
verses.english: For he shall give his angels charge over thee, to keep thee in all thy ways.

verses.hebrew: עַל־כַּפַּיִם יִשָּׂאוּנְךָ פֶּן־תִּגֹּף בָּאֶבֶן רַגְלֶךָ׃
verses.english: They shall bear thee up in their hands, lest thou dash thy foot against a stone.

verses.hebrew: עַל־שַׁחַל וָפֶתֶן תִּדְרֹךְ תִּרְמֹס כְּפִיר וְתַנִּין׃
verses.english: Thou shalt tread upon the lion and adder: the young lion and the crocodile shalt thou trample under foot.

verses.hebrew: כִּי בִי חָשַׁק וַאֲפַלְּטֵהוּ אֲשַׂגְּבֵהוּ כִּי־יָדַע שְׁמִי׃
verses.english: Because he has set his delight upon me, therefore will I deliver him: I will set him on high, because he has known my name.

verses.hebrew: יִקְרָאֵנִי וְאֶעֱנֵהוּ עִמּוֹ־אָנֹכִי בְצָרָה אֲחַלְּצֵהוּ וַאֲכַבְּדֵהוּ׃
verses.english: He shall call upon me, and I will answer him: I will be with him in trouble; I will deliver him, and honour him.

verses.hebrew: אֹרֶךְ יָמִים אַשְׂבִּיעֵהוּ וְאַרְאֵהוּ בִּישׁוּעָתִי׃
verses.english: With long life I will satisfy him, and show him my salvation.

verses.hebrew: מִזְמוֹר שִׁיר לְיוֹם הַשַּׁבָּת׃
verses.english: A Psalm, A Poem for the Sabbath day.

verses.hebrew: טוֹב לְהֹדוֹת לַיהוָה וּלְזַמֵּר לְשִׁמְךָ עֶלְיוֹן׃
verses.english: It is a good thing to give thanks to the Lord, and to sing praise to Thy name, O most High:

verses.hebrew: לְהַגִּיד בַּבֹּקֶר חַסְדֶּךָ וֶאֱמוּנָתְךָ בַּלֵּילוֹת׃
verses.english: to relate Thy steadfast love in the morning, and Thy faithfulness every night,

verses.hebrew: עֲ‍לֵי־עָשׂוֹר וַעֲלֵי־נָבֶל עֲלֵי הִגָּיוֹן בְּכִנּוֹר׃
verses.english: upon an instrument of ten strings and upon the harp; to the melody of the lyre.

verses.hebrew: כִּי שִׂמַּחְתַּנִי יְהוָה בְּפָעֳלֶךָ בְּמַעֲשֵׂי יָדֶיךָ אֲרַנֵּן׃
verses.english: For Thou, Lord, hast made me glad through Thy work: I will triumph in the works of Thy hands.

verses.hebrew: מַה־גָּדְלוּ מַעֲשֶׂיךָ יְהוָה מְאֹד עָמְקוּ מַחְשְׁבֹתֶיךָ׃
verses.english: O Lord, how great are Thy works! and Thy thoughts are very deep.

verses.hebrew: אִישׁ־בַּעַר לֹא יֵדָע וּכְסִיל לֹא־יָבִין אֶת־זֹאת׃
verses.english: A brutish man does not know; nor does a fool understand this.

verses.hebrew: בִּפְרֹחַ רְשָׁעִים כְּמוֹ עֵשֶׂב וַיָּצִיצוּ כָּל־פֹּעֲלֵי אָוֶן לְהִשָּׁמְדָם עֲדֵי־עַד׃
verses.english: When the wicked spring like grass, and when all the workers of iniquity flourish; it is that they shall be destroyed forever:

verses.hebrew: וְאַתָּה מָרוֹם לְעֹלָם יְהוָה׃
verses.english: but Thou, Lord, art most high for evermore.

verses.hebrew: כִּי הִנֵּה אֹיְבֶיךָ יְהוָה כִּי־הִנֵּה אֹיְבֶיךָ יֹאבֵדוּ יִתְפָּרְדוּ כָּל־פֹּעֲלֵי אָוֶן׃
verses.english: For, lo, Thy enemies, O Lord, for lo, Thy enemies shall perish; all the workers of iniquity shall be scattered.

verses.hebrew: וַתָּרֶם כִּרְאֵים קַרְנִי בַּלֹּתִי בְּשֶׁמֶן רַעֲנָן׃
verses.english: But my horn shalt Thou exalt like the horn of a wild ox: I shall be anointed with fresh oil.

verses.hebrew: וַתַּבֵּט עֵינִי בְּשׁוּרָי בַּקָּמִים עָלַי מְרֵעִים תִּשְׁמַעְנָה אָזְנָי׃
verses.english: My eye has seen the downfall of my enemies, and my ears have heard the doom of the wicked who rise against me.

verses.hebrew: צַדִּיק כַּתָּמָר יִפְרָח כְּאֶרֶז בַּלְּבָנוֹן יִשְׂגֶּה׃
verses.english: The righteous man flourishes like the palm tree: he grows like a cedar in the Levanon.

verses.hebrew: שְׁתוּלִים בְּבֵית יְהוָה בְּחַצְרוֹת אֱלֹהֵינוּ יַפְרִיחוּ׃
verses.english: Those that are planted in the house of the Lord shall flourish in the courts of our God.

verses.hebrew: עוֹד יְנוּבוּן בְּשֵׂיבָה דְּשֵׁנִים וְרַעֲנַנִּים יִהְיוּ׃
verses.english: They still bring forth fruit in old age; they are fat and flourishing;

verses.hebrew: לְהַגִּיד כִּי־יָשָׁר יְהוָה צוּרִי וְלֹא־עלתה [עַוְלָתָה] בּוֹ׃
verses.english: to declare that the Lord is upright: he is my rock, and there is no unrighteousness in him.

verses.hebrew: יְהוָה מָלָךְ גֵּאוּת לָבֵשׁ לָבֵשׁ יְהוָה עֹז הִתְאַזָּר אַף־תִּכּוֹן תֵּבֵל בַּל־תִּמּוֹט׃
verses.english: The Lord reigns, he is clothed with majesty; the Lord is robed; he has girded himself with strength: the world also is established, that it cannot be moved.

verses.hebrew: נָכוֹן כִּסְאֲךָ מֵאָז מֵעוֹלָם אָתָּה׃
verses.english: Thy throne is established of old: Thou art from everlasting.

verses.hebrew: נָשְׂאוּ נְהָרוֹת יְהוָה נָשְׂאוּ נְהָרוֹת קוֹלָם יִשְׂאוּ נְהָרוֹת דָּכְיָם׃
verses.english: The floods have lifted up, O Lord, the floods have lifted up their voice; the floods lift up their roaring.

verses.hebrew: מִקֹּלוֹת מַיִם רַבִּים אַדִּירִים מִשְׁבְּרֵי־יָם אַדִּיר בַּמָּרוֹם יְהוָה׃
verses.english: The Lord on high is mightier than the noise of many waters, than the mighty waves of the sea.

verses.hebrew: עֵדֹתֶיךָ נֶאֶמְנוּ מְאֹד לְבֵיתְךָ נַאֲוָה־קֹדֶשׁ יְהוָה לְאֹרֶךְ יָמִים׃
verses.english: Thy testimonies are very sure: holiness becomes Thy house, O Lord, for length of days.

verses.hebrew: אֵל־נְקָמוֹת יְהוָה אֵל נְקָמוֹת הוֹפִיַע׃
verses.english: O Lord God, to whom vengeance belongs; O God, to whom vengeance belongs, shine forth!

verses.hebrew: הִנָּשֵׂא שֹׁפֵט הָאָרֶץ הָשֵׁב גְּמוּל עַל־גֵּאִים׃
verses.english: Lift up Thyself, Thou judge of the earth: render to the proud their recompense.

verses.hebrew: עַד־מָתַי רְשָׁעִים יְהוָה עַד־מָתַי רְשָׁעִים יַעֲלֹזוּ׃
verses.english: Lord, how long shall the wicked, how long shall the wicked triumph?

verses.hebrew: יַבִּיעוּ יְדַבְּרוּ עָתָק יִתְאַמְּרוּ כָּל־פֹּעֲלֵי אָוֶן׃
verses.english: How long shall they utter and speak hard things? and all the workers of iniquity boast themselves?

verses.hebrew: עַמְּךָ יְהוָה יְדַכְּאוּ וְנַחֲלָתְךָ יְעַנּוּ׃
verses.english: They crush Thy people, O Lord, and afflict Thy heritage.

verses.hebrew: אַלְמָנָה וְגֵר יַהֲרֹגוּ וִיתוֹמִים יְרַצֵּחוּ׃
verses.english: They slay the widow and the stranger, and murder the fatherless.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמְרוּ לֹא יִרְאֶה־יָּהּ וְלֹא־יָבִין אֱלֹהֵי יַעֲקֹב׃
verses.english: Yet they say, The Lord shall not see, nor shall the God of Ya῾aqov regard it.

verses.hebrew: בִּינוּ בֹּעֲרִים בָּעָם וּכְסִילִים מָתַי תַּשְׂכִּילוּ׃
verses.english: Understand, you brutish among the people: and fools, when will you be wise?

verses.hebrew: הֲנֹטַע אֹזֶן הֲלֹא יִשְׁמָע אִם־יֹצֵר עַיִן הֲלֹא יַבִּיט׃
verses.english: He That planted the ear, shall he not hear? he That formed the eye, shall he not see?

verses.hebrew: הֲיֹסֵר גּוֹיִם הֲלֹא יוֹכִיחַ הַמְלַמֵּד אָדָם דָּעַת׃
verses.english: He That chastises nations, shall he not correct? he That teaches man knowledge?

verses.hebrew: יְהוָה יֹדֵעַ מַחְשְׁבוֹת אָדָם כִּי־הֵמָּה הָבֶל׃
verses.english: The Lord knows the thoughts of man, that they are vanity.

verses.hebrew: אַשְׁרֵי הַגֶּבֶר אֲשֶׁר־תְּיַסְּרֶנּוּ יָּהּ וּמִתּוֹרָתְךָ תְלַמְּדֶנּוּ׃
verses.english: Blessed is the man whom Thou dost chasten, O Lord, and teachest him out of Thy Tora,

verses.hebrew: לְהַשְׁקִיט לוֹ מִימֵי רָע עַד יִכָּרֶה לָרָשָׁע שָׁחַת׃
verses.english: that Thou mayst give him rest from the days of adversity, until the pit is dug for the wicked.

verses.hebrew: כִּי לֹא־יִטֹּשׁ יְהוָה עַמּוֹ וְנַחֲלָתוֹ לֹא יַעֲזֹב׃
verses.english: For the Lord will not cast off his people, nor will he forsake his inheritance.

verses.hebrew: כִּי־עַד־צֶדֶק יָשׁוּב מִשְׁפָּט וְאַחֲרָיו כָּל־יִשְׁרֵי־לֵב׃
verses.english: But judgment shall return to righteousness: and all the upright in heart shall follow it.

verses.hebrew: מִי־יָקוּם לִי עִם־מְרֵעִים מִי־יִתְיַצֵּב לִי עִם־פֹּעֲלֵי אָוֶן׃
verses.english: Who will rise up for me against the evildoers? who will stand up for me against the workers of iniquity?

verses.hebrew: לוּלֵי יְהוָה עֶזְרָתָה לִּי כִּמְעַט שָׁכְנָה דוּמָה נַפְשִׁי׃
verses.english: Unless the Lord had been my help, my soul had soon dwelt in silence.

verses.hebrew: אִם־אָמַרְתִּי מָטָה רַגְלִי חַסְדְּךָ יְהוָה יִסְעָדֵנִי׃
verses.english: When I said, My foot slips; Thy steadfast love, O Lord, held me up.

verses.hebrew: בְּרֹב שַׂרְעַפַּי בְּקִרְבִּי תַּנְחוּמֶיךָ יְשַׁעַשְׁעוּ נַפְשִׁי׃
verses.english: When my cares within me were many, Thy comforts would cheer my soul.

verses.hebrew: הַיְחָבְרְךָ כִּסֵּא הַוּוֹת יֹצֵר עָמָל עֲלֵי־חֹק׃
verses.english: Shall the seat of iniquity, framing mischief by law, have fellowship with Thee?

verses.hebrew: יָגוֹדּוּ עַל־נֶפֶשׁ צַדִּיק וְדָם נָקִי יַרְשִׁיעוּ׃
verses.english: They gather themselves together against the soul of the righteous, and condemn the innocent blood.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי יְהוָה לִי לְמִשְׂגָּב וֵאלֹהַי לְצוּר מַחְסִי׃
verses.english: But the Lord has become my defence; and my God, the rock of my refuge.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּשֶׁב עֲלֵיהֶם אֶת־אוֹנָם וּבְרָעָתָם יַצְמִיתֵם יַצְמִיתֵם יְהוָה אֱלֹהֵינוּ׃
verses.english: And he brings upon them their own iniquity, and he cuts them off in their own wickedness; the Lord our God cuts them off.

verses.hebrew: לְכוּ נְרַנְּנָה לַיהוָה נָרִיעָה לְצוּר יִשְׁעֵנוּ׃
verses.english: O Come, let us sing to the Lord: let us make a joyful noise to the rock of our salvation.

verses.hebrew: נְקַדְּמָה פָנָיו בְּתוֹדָה בִּזְמִרוֹת נָרִיעַ לוֹ׃
verses.english: Let us come before his presence with thanksgiving, and make a joyful noise to him with psalms.

verses.hebrew: כִּי אֵל גָּדוֹל יְהוָה וּמֶלֶךְ גָּדוֹל עַל־כָּל־אֱלֹהִים׃
verses.english: For the Lord is a great God, and a great King above all gods.

verses.hebrew: אֲשֶׁר בְּיָדוֹ מֶחְקְרֵי־אָרֶץ וְתוֹעֲפוֹת הָרִים לוֹ׃
verses.english: In his hand are the deep places of the earth: the mountain peaks are his also.

verses.hebrew: אֲשֶׁר־לוֹ הַיָּם וְהוּא עָשָׂהוּ וְיַבֶּשֶׁת יָדָיו יָצָרוּ׃
verses.english: The sea is his, and he made it: and his hands formed the dry land.

verses.hebrew: בֹּאוּ נִשְׁתַּחֲוֶה וְנִכְרָעָה נִבְרְכָה לִפְנֵי־יְהוָה עֹשֵׂנוּ׃
verses.english: O come, let us worship and bow down: let us kneel before the Lord our maker;

verses.hebrew: כִּי הוּא אֱלֹהֵינוּ וַאֲנַחְנוּ עַם מַרְעִיתוֹ וְצֹאן יָדוֹ הַיּוֹם אִם־בְּקֹלוֹ תִשְׁמָעוּ׃
verses.english: for he is our God; and we are the people of his pasture, and the flock of his hand: today even, if you will only hearken to his voice!

verses.hebrew: אַל־תַּקְשׁוּ לְבַבְכֶם כִּמְרִיבָה כְּיוֹם מַסָּה בַּמִּדְבָּר׃
verses.english: Do not harden your hearts as in Meriva, as in the day of Massa in the wilderness:

verses.hebrew: אֲשֶׁר נִסּוּנִי אֲבוֹתֵיכֶם בְּחָנוּנִי גַּם־רָאוּ פָעֳלִי׃
verses.english: when your fathers tempted me, proved me, even though they saw my deeds.

verses.hebrew: אַרְבָּעִים שָׁנָה אָקוּט בְּדוֹר וָאֹמַר עַם תֹּעֵי לֵבָב הֵם וְהֵם לֹא־יָדְעוּ דְרָכָי׃
verses.english: Forty years long did I loathe this generation and I said, It is a people that errs in their heart, and that do not know my ways:

verses.hebrew: אֲשֶׁר־נִשְׁבַּעְתִּי בְאַפִּי אִם־יְבֹאוּן אֶל־מְנוּחָתִי׃
verses.english: whereupon I swore in my anger that they should not enter into my rest.

verses.hebrew: שִׁירוּ לַיהוָה שִׁיר חָדָשׁ שִׁירוּ לַיהוָה כָּל־הָאָרֶץ׃
verses.english: O Sing to the Lord a new song: sing to the Lord, all the earth.

verses.hebrew: שִׁירוּ לַיהוָה בָּרֲכוּ שְׁמוֹ בַּשְּׂרוּ מִיּוֹם־לְיוֹם יְשׁוּעָתוֹ׃
verses.english: Sing to the Lord, bless his name; announce his salvation from day to day.

verses.hebrew: סַפְּרוּ בַגּוֹיִם כְּבוֹדוֹ בְּכָל־הָעַמִּים נִפְלְאוֹתָיו׃
verses.english: Declare his glory among the nations, his wonders among all the peoples.

verses.hebrew: כִּי גָדוֹל יְהוָה וּמְהֻלָּל מְאֹד נוֹרָא הוּא עַל־כָּל־אֱלֹהִים׃
verses.english: For the Lord is great, and greatly to be praised: he is to be feared above all gods.

verses.hebrew: כִּי כָּל־אֱלֹהֵי הָעַמִּים אֱלִילִים וַיהוָה שָׁמַיִם עָשָׂה׃
verses.english: For all the gods of the nations are idols: but the Lord made the heavens.

verses.hebrew: הוֹד־וְהָדָר לְפָנָיו עֹז וְתִפְאֶרֶת בְּמִקְדָּשׁוֹ׃
verses.english: Honour and majesty are before him: strength and beauty are in his sanctuary.

verses.hebrew: הָבוּ לַיהוָה מִשְׁפְּחוֹת עַמִּים הָבוּ לַיהוָה כָּבוֹד וָעֹז׃
verses.english: Ascribe to the Lord, O families of the peoples, ascribe to the Lord glory and strength.

verses.hebrew: הָבוּ לַיהוָה כְּבוֹד שְׁמוֹ שְׂאוּ־מִנְחָה וּבֹאוּ לְחַצְרוֹתָיו׃
verses.english: Ascribe to the Lord the glory due to his name: bring an offering, and come into his courts.

verses.hebrew: הִשְׁתַּחֲווּ לַיהוָה בְּהַדְרַת־קֹדֶשׁ חִילוּ מִפָּנָיו כָּל־הָאָרֶץ׃
verses.english: O worship the Lord in the beauty of holiness: tremble before him, all the earth.

verses.hebrew: אִמְרוּ בַגּוֹיִם יְהוָה מָלָךְ אַף־תִּכּוֹן תֵּבֵל בַּל־תִּמּוֹט יָדִין עַמִּים בְּמֵישָׁרִים׃
verses.english: Say among the nations that the Lord reigns: the world also is established so that it shall not be moved: he shall judge the people with equity.

verses.hebrew: יִשְׂמְחוּ הַשָּׁמַיִם וְתָגֵל הָאָרֶץ יִרְעַם הַיָּם וּמְלֹאוֹ׃
verses.english: Let the heavens rejoice, and let the earth be glad; let the sea roar, and the fulness thereof;

verses.hebrew: יַעֲלֹז שָׂדַי וְכָל־אֲשֶׁר־בּוֹ אָז יְרַנְּנוּ כָּל־עֲצֵי־יָעַר׃
verses.english: let the field be joyful, and all that is in it: then shall all the trees of the wood sing for joy.

verses.hebrew: לִפְנֵי יְהוָה כִּי בָא כִּי בָא לִשְׁפֹּט הָאָרֶץ יִשְׁפֹּט־תֵּבֵל בְּצֶדֶק וְעַמִּים בֶּאֱמוּנָתוֹ׃
verses.english: Before the Lord: for he comes, for he comes to judge the earth: he shall judge the world in righteousness, and the people in his faithfulness.

verses.hebrew: יְהוָה מָלָךְ תָּגֵל הָאָרֶץ יִשְׂמְחוּ אִיִּים רַבִּים׃
verses.english: The Lord reigns; let the earth rejoice; let the multitude of isles be glad.

verses.hebrew: עָנָן וַעֲרָפֶל סְבִיבָיו צֶדֶק וּמִשְׁפָּט מְכוֹן כִּסְאוֹ׃
verses.english: Clouds and darkness are round about him: righteousness and judgment are the foundation of his throne.

verses.hebrew: אֵשׁ לְפָנָיו תֵּלֵךְ וּתְלַהֵט סָבִיב צָרָיו׃
verses.english: A fire goes before him, and burns up his enemies round about.

verses.hebrew: הֵאִירוּ בְרָקָיו תֵּבֵל רָאֲתָה וַתָּחֵל הָאָרֶץ׃
verses.english: His lightnings lightened the world: the earth saw, and trembled.

verses.hebrew: הָרִים כַּדּוֹנַג נָמַסּוּ מִלִּפְנֵי יְהוָה מִלִּפְנֵי אֲדוֹן כָּל־הָאָרֶץ׃
verses.english: The hills melted like wax at the presence of the Lord, at the presence of the Lord of the whole earth.

verses.hebrew: הִגִּידוּ הַשָּׁמַיִם צִדְקוֹ וְרָאוּ כָל־הָעַמִּים כְּבוֹדוֹ׃
verses.english: The heavens declared his righteousness, and all the peoples saw his glory.

verses.hebrew: יֵבֹשׁוּ כָּל־עֹבְדֵי פֶסֶל הַמִּתְהַלְלִים בָּאֱלִילִים הִשְׁתַּחֲווּ־לוֹ כָּל־אֱלֹהִים׃
verses.english: Confounded be all they who serve carved idols, who boast themselves of idols: bow down before him, all you gods.

verses.hebrew: שָׁמְעָה וַתִּשְׂמַח צִיּוֹן וַתָּגֵלְנָה בְּנוֹת יְהוּדָה לְמַעַן מִשְׁפָּטֶיךָ יְהוָה׃
verses.english: Żiyyon heard, and was glad; and the daughters of Yehuda rejoiced because of Thy judgments, O Lord.

verses.hebrew: כִּי־אַתָּה יְהוָה עֶלְיוֹן עַל־כָּל־הָאָרֶץ מְאֹד נַעֲלֵיתָ עַל־כָּל־אֱלֹהִים׃
verses.english: For Thou, Lord, art high above all the earth: Thou art exalted far above all gods.

verses.hebrew: אֹהֲבֵי יְהוָה שִׂנְאוּ רָע שֹׁמֵר נַפְשׁוֹת חֲסִידָיו מִיַּד רְשָׁעִים יַצִּילֵם׃
verses.english: You that love the Lord, hate evil! he preserves the souls of his pious ones; he delivers them out of the hand of the wicked.

verses.hebrew: אוֹר זָרֻעַ לַצַּדִּיק וּלְיִשְׁרֵי־לֵב שִׂמְחָה׃
verses.english: Light is sown for the righteous, and gladness for the upright in heart.

verses.hebrew: שִׂמְחוּ צַדִּיקִים בַּיהוָה וְהוֹדוּ לְזֵכֶר קָדְשׁוֹ׃
verses.english: Rejoice in the Lord, O you righteous; and give thanks to his holy name.

verses.hebrew: מִזְמוֹר שִׁירוּ לַיהוָה שִׁיר חָדָשׁ כִּי־נִפְלָאוֹת עָשָׂה הוֹשִׁיעָה־לּוֹ יְמִינוֹ וּזְרוֹעַ קָדְשׁוֹ׃
verses.english: A Psalm. O sing to the Lord a new song; for he has done marvellous things: his right hand, and his holy arm have gained him the victory.

verses.hebrew: הוֹדִיעַ יְהוָה יְשׁוּעָתוֹ לְעֵינֵי הַגּוֹיִם גִּלָּה צִדְקָתוֹ׃
verses.english: The Lord has made known his salvation: his righteousness he has revealed in the sight of the nations.

verses.hebrew: זָכַר חַסְדּוֹ וֶאֱמוּנָתוֹ לְבֵית יִשְׂרָאֵל רָאוּ כָל־אַפְסֵי־אָרֶץ אֵת יְשׁוּעַת אֱלֹהֵינוּ׃
verses.english: He has remembered his love and his truth towards the house of Yisra᾽el: all the ends of the earth have seen the salvation of our God.

verses.hebrew: הָרִיעוּ לַיהוָה כָּל־הָאָרֶץ פִּצְחוּ וְרַנְּנוּ וְזַמֵּרוּ׃
verses.english: Make a joyful noise to the Lord, all the earth: make a loud noise, and rejoice, and sing praise.

verses.hebrew: זַמְּרוּ לַיהוָה בְּכִנּוֹר בְּכִנּוֹר וְקוֹל זִמְרָה׃
verses.english: Sing to the Lord with the lyre; with the lyre, and the voice of psalm.

verses.hebrew: בַּחֲצֹצְרוֹת וְקוֹל שׁוֹפָר הָרִיעוּ לִפְנֵי הַמֶּלֶךְ יְהוָה׃
verses.english: With trumpets and sound of a shofar make a joyful noise before the Lord, the King.

verses.hebrew: יִרְעַם הַיָּם וּמְלֹאוֹ תֵּבֵל וְיֹשְׁבֵי בָהּ׃
verses.english: Let the sea roar, and the fulness thereof; the world, and they who dwell therein.

verses.hebrew: נְהָרוֹת יִמְחֲאוּ־כָף יַחַד הָרִים יְרַנֵּנוּ׃
verses.english: Let the rivers clap their hands: let the mountains sing for joy together.

verses.hebrew: לִפְנֵי־יְהוָה כִּי בָא לִשְׁפֹּט הָאָרֶץ יִשְׁפֹּט־תֵּבֵל בְּצֶדֶק וְעַמִּים בְּמֵישָׁרִים׃
verses.english: Before the Lord; for he comes to judge the earth: with righteousness shall he judge the world, and the people with equity.

verses.hebrew: יְהוָה מָלָךְ יִרְגְּזוּ עַמִּים יֹשֵׁב כְּרוּבִים תָּנוּט הָאָרֶץ׃
verses.english: The Lord reigns; let the peoples tremble: he is enthroned upon the keruvim; let the earth be moved.

verses.hebrew: יְהוָה בְּצִיּוֹן גָּדוֹל וְרָם הוּא עַל־כָּל־הָעַמִּים׃
verses.english: The Lord is great in Żiyyon; and he is high above all the peoples.

verses.hebrew: יוֹדוּ שִׁמְךָ גָּדוֹל וְנוֹרָא קָדוֹשׁ הוּא׃
verses.english: Let them praise Thy great and terrible name; for it is holy.

verses.hebrew: וְעֹז מֶלֶךְ מִשְׁפָּט אָהֵב אַתָּה כּוֹנַנְתָּ מֵישָׁרִים מִשְׁפָּט וּצְדָקָה בְּיַעֲקֹב אַתָּה עָשִׂיתָ׃
verses.english: O mighty king, who loves justice, Thou hast established equity; Thou dost execute justice and righteousness in Ya῾aqov.

verses.hebrew: רוֹמְמוּ יְהוָה אֱלֹהֵינוּ וְהִשְׁתַּחֲווּ לַהֲדֹם רַגְלָיו קָדוֹשׁ הוּא׃
verses.english: Exalt the Lord our God, and worship at his footstool; for he is holy.

verses.hebrew: מֹשֶׁה וְאַהֲרֹן בְּכֹהֲנָיו וּשְׁמוּאֵל בְּקֹרְאֵי שְׁמוֹ קֹרִאים אֶל־יְהוָה וְהוּא יַעֲנֵם׃
verses.english: Moshe and Aharon among his priests, and Shemu᾽el among those who call upon his name; they called upon the Lord, and he answered them.

verses.hebrew: בְּעַמּוּד עָנָן יְדַבֵּר אֲלֵיהֶם שָׁמְרוּ עֵדֹתָיו וְחֹק נָתַן־לָמוֹ׃
verses.english: He spoke to them in the cloudy pillar: they kept his testimonies, and the ordinance that he gave them.

verses.hebrew: יְהוָה אֱלֹהֵינוּ אַתָּה עֲנִיתָם אֵל נֹשֵׂא הָיִיתָ לָהֶם וְנֹקֵם עַל־עֲלִילוֹתָם׃
verses.english: Thou didst answer them, O Lord our God: a forgiving God wast Thou to them, though Thou didst take vengeance for their misdeeds.

verses.hebrew: רוֹמְמוּ יְהוָה אֱלֹהֵינוּ וְהִשְׁתַּחֲווּ לְהַר קָדְשׁוֹ כִּי־קָדוֹשׁ יְהוָה אֱלֹהֵינוּ׃
verses.english: Exalt the Lord our God, and worship at his holy hill; for the Lord our God is holy.

verses.hebrew: מִזְמוֹר לְתוֹדָה הָרִיעוּ לַיהוָה כָּל־הָאָרֶץ׃
verses.english: A Psalm of thanksgiving. Make a joyful noise to the Lord, all the earth.

verses.hebrew: עִבְדוּ אֶת־יְהוָה בְּשִׂמְחָה בֹּאוּ לְפָנָיו בִּרְנָנָה׃
verses.english: Serve the Lord with gladness: come before his presence with singing.

verses.hebrew: דְּעוּ כִּי־יְהוָה הוּא אֱלֹהִים הוּא־עָשָׂנוּ ולא [וְלוֹ] אֲנַחְנוּ עַמּוֹ וְצֹאן מַרְעִיתוֹ׃
verses.english: Know that the Lord he is God: it is he who made us, and we belong to him; we are his people, and the sheep of his pasture.

verses.hebrew: בֹּאוּ שְׁעָרָיו בְּתוֹדָה חֲצֵרֹתָיו בִּתְהִלָּה הוֹדוּ־לוֹ בָּרֲכוּ שְׁמוֹ׃
verses.english: Enter into his gates with thanksgiving, and into his courts with praise: be thankful to him, and bless his name.

verses.hebrew: כִּי־טוֹב יְהֹוָה לְעוֹלָם חַסְדּוֹ וְעַד־דֹּר וָדֹר אֱמוּנָתוֹ׃
verses.english: For the Lord is good; his steadfast love endures forever; and his faithfulness to all generations.

verses.hebrew: לְדָוִד מִזְמוֹר חֶסֶד־וּמִשְׁפָּט אָשִׁירָה לְךָ יְהוָה אֲזַמֵּרָה׃
verses.english: A Psalm of David, I will sing of loyal love and justice: to Thee, O Lord, I will sing.

verses.hebrew: אַשְׂכִּילָה בְּדֶרֶךְ תָּמִים מָתַי תָּבוֹא אֵלָי אֶתְהַלֵּךְ בְּתָם־לְבָבִי בְּקֶרֶב בֵּיתִי׃
verses.english: I will celebrate with a Maskil psalm the way of integrity. O when wilt Thou come to me? I will walk within my house in the integrity of my heart.

verses.hebrew: לֹא־אָשִׁית לְנֶגֶד עֵינַי דְּבַר־בְּלִיָּעַל עֲשֹׂה־סֵטִים שָׂנֵאתִי לֹא יִדְבַּק בִּי׃
verses.english: I will set no wicked thing before my eyes: I hate the work of those who turn aside; it shall not cleave to me.

verses.hebrew: לֵבָב עִקֵּשׁ יָסוּר מִמֶּנִּי רָע לֹא אֵדָע׃
verses.english: A perverse heart shall depart from me: I will know no evil matter.

verses.hebrew: מלושני [מְלָשְׁנִי] בַסֵּתֶר רֵעֵהוּ אוֹתוֹ אַצְמִית גְּבַהּ־עֵינַיִם וּרְחַב לֵבָב אֹתוֹ לֹא אוּכָל׃
verses.english: Whoever secretly slanders his neighbour, him I will cut off: him that has a high look and a proud heart I will not suffer.

verses.hebrew: עֵינַי בְּנֶאֶמְנֵי־אֶרֶץ לָשֶׁבֶת עִמָּדִי הֹלֵךְ בְּדֶרֶךְ תָּמִים הוּא יְשָׁרְתֵנִי׃
verses.english: My eyes are upon the faithful of the land, that they may dwell with me: he that walks in the way of integrity, he shall serve me.

verses.hebrew: לֹא־יֵשֵׁב בְּקֶרֶב בֵּיתִי עֹשֵׂה רְמִיָּה דֹּבֵר שְׁקָרִים לֹא־יִכּוֹן לְנֶגֶד עֵינָי׃
verses.english: He that works deceit shall not dwell within my house: he that tells lies shall not remain in my sight.

verses.hebrew: לַבְּקָרִים אַצְמִית כָּל־רִשְׁעֵי־אָרֶץ לְהַכְרִית מֵעִיר־יְהוָה כָּל־פֹּעֲלֵי אָוֶן׃
verses.english: Morning by morning I will destroy all the wicked of the land; that I may cut off all the evildoers from the city of the Lord.

verses.hebrew: תְּפִלָּה לְעָנִי כִי־יַעֲטֹף וְלִפְנֵי יְהוָה יִשְׁפֹּךְ שִׂיחוֹ׃
verses.english: A Prayer of the afflicted, when he faints, and pours out his complaint before the Lord.

verses.hebrew: יְהוָה שִׁמְעָה תְפִלָּתִי וְשַׁוְעָתִי אֵלֶיךָ תָבוֹא׃
verses.english: Hear my prayer, O Lord, and let my cry reach Thee.

verses.hebrew: אַל־תַּסְתֵּר פָּנֶיךָ מִמֶּנִּי בְּיוֹם צַר לִי הַטֵּה־אֵלַי אָזְנֶךָ בְּיוֹם אֶקְרָא מַהֵר עֲנֵנִי׃
verses.english: Hide not Thy face from me in the day when I am in trouble; incline Thy ear to me: in the day when I call, answer me speedily.

verses.hebrew: כִּי־כָלוּ בְעָשָׁן יָמָי וְעַצְמוֹתַי כְּמוֹ־קֵד נִחָרוּ׃
verses.english: For my days are consumed like smoke, and my bones are burned like a hearth.

verses.hebrew: הוּכָּה־כָעֵשֶׂב וַיִּבַשׁ לִבִּי כִּי־שָׁכַחְתִּי מֵאֲכֹל לַחְמִי׃
verses.english: My heart is smitten like grass, and withered; so that I forget how to eat my bread.

verses.hebrew: מִקּוֹל אַנְחָתִי דָּבְקָה עַצְמִי לִבְשָׂרִי׃
verses.english: By reason of the voice of my groaning, my bones cleave to my skin.

verses.hebrew: דָּמִיתִי לִקְאַת מִדְבָּר הָיִיתִי כְּכוֹס חֳרָבוֹת׃
verses.english: I am like an owl of the wilderness: I am like a night flier of the desert.

verses.hebrew: שָׁקַדְתִּי וָאֶהְיֶה כְּצִפּוֹר בּוֹדֵד עַל־גָּג׃
verses.english: I watch, and am like a lonely sparrow upon the house top.

verses.hebrew: כָּל־הַיּוֹם חֵרְפוּנִי אוֹיְבָי מְהוֹלָלַי בִּי נִשְׁבָּעוּ׃
verses.english: My enemies insult me all the day; and they that are mad against me swear by me.

verses.hebrew: כִּי־אֵפֶר כַּלֶּחֶם אָכָלְתִּי וְשִׁקֻּוַי בִּבְכִי מָסָכְתִּי׃
verses.english: For I have eaten ashes like bread, and mingled my drink with weeping,

verses.hebrew: מִפְּנֵי־זַעַמְךָ וְקִצְפֶּךָ כִּי נְשָׂאתַנִי וַתַּשְׁלִיכֵנִי׃
verses.english: because of Thy indignation and Thy wrath: for Thou hast lifted me up, and cast me down.

verses.hebrew: יָמַי כְּצֵל נָטוּי וַאֲנִי כָּעֵשֶׂב אִיבָשׁ׃
verses.english: My days are like an evening shadow; and I am withered like grass.

verses.hebrew: וְאַתָּה יְהוָה לְעוֹלָם תֵּשֵׁב וְזִכְרְךָ לְדֹר וָדֹר׃
verses.english: But Thou, O Lord, sittest enthroned forever; and Thy name endures to all generations.

verses.hebrew: אַתָּה תָקוּם תְּרַחֵם צִיּוֹן כִּי־עֵת לְחֶנְנָהּ כִּי־בָא מוֹעֵד׃
verses.english: Thou wilt arise, and have mercy upon Żiyyon: for it is time to favour her; for the set time is come.

verses.hebrew: כִּי־רָצוּ עֲבָדֶיךָ אֶת־אֲבָנֶיהָ וְאֶת־עֲפָרָהּ יְחֹנֵנוּ׃
verses.english: For Thy servants hold her stones dear, and cherish her very dust.

verses.hebrew: וְיִירְאוּ גוֹיִם אֶת־שֵׁם יְהוָה וְכָל־מַלְכֵי הָאָרֶץ אֶת־כְּבוֹדֶךָ׃
verses.english: So the nations shall fear the name of the Lord, and all the kings of the earth Thy glory.

verses.hebrew: כִּי־בָנָה יְהוָה צִיּוֹן נִרְאָה בִּכְבוֹדוֹ׃
verses.english: For the Lord builds up Żiyyon, he appears in his glory.

verses.hebrew: פָּנָה אֶל־תְּפִלַּת הָעַרְעָר וְלֹא־בָזָה אֶת־תְּפִלָּתָם׃
verses.english: He heeds the prayer of the destitute, and does not despise their prayer.
