verses.hebrew: תִּכָּתֶב זֹאת לְדוֹר אַחֲרוֹן וְעַם נִבְרָא יְהַלֶּל־יָהּ׃
verses.english: This shall be written for the generation to come: so that a people yet unborn shall praise the Lord.

verses.hebrew: כִּי־הִשְׁקִיף מִמְּרוֹם קָדְשׁוֹ יְהוָה מִשָּׁמַיִם אֶל־אֶרֶץ הִבִּיט׃
verses.english: For he has looked down from the height of his sanctuary; from heaven did the Lord behold the earth;

verses.hebrew: לִשְׁמֹעַ אֶנְקַת אָסִיר לְפַתֵּחַ בְּנֵי תְמוּתָה׃
verses.english: to hear the groaning of the prisoner; to loose those who are appointed to death;

verses.hebrew: לְסַפֵּר בְּצִיּוֹן שֵׁם יְהוָה וּתְהִלָּתוֹ בִּירוּשָׁלִָם׃
verses.english: that men may declare the name of Lord in Żiyyon, and his praise in Yerushalayim;

verses.hebrew: בְּהִקָּבֵץ עַמִּים יַחְדָּו וּמַמְלָכוֹת לַעֲבֹד אֶת־יְהוָה׃
verses.english: when the people are gathered together, and the kingdoms, to serve the Lord.

verses.hebrew: עִנָּה בַדֶּרֶךְ כחו [כֹּחִי] קִצַּר יָמָי׃
verses.english: He weakened my strength in the way; he shortened my days.

verses.hebrew: אֹמַר אֵלִי אַל־תַּעֲלֵנִי בַּחֲצִי יָמָי בְּדוֹר דּוֹרִים שְׁנוֹתֶיךָ׃
verses.english: I say, O my God, take me not away in the midst of my days: Thou whose years endure to all generations.

verses.hebrew: לְפָנִים הָאָרֶץ יָסַדְתָּ וּמַעֲשֵׂה יָדֶיךָ שָׁמָיִם׃
verses.english: Of old Thou hast laid the foundation of the earth: and the heavens are the work of Thy hands.

verses.hebrew: הֵמָּה יֹאבֵדוּ וְאַתָּה תַעֲמֹד וְכֻלָּם כַּבֶּגֶד יִבְלוּ כַּלְּבוּשׁ תַּחֲלִיפֵם וְיַחֲלֹפוּ׃
verses.english: They shall perish, but Thou shalt endure: yea, all of them shall grow old like a garment; Thou shalt change them like a cloak, and they will pass away:

verses.hebrew: וְאַתָּה־הוּא וּשְׁנוֹתֶיךָ לֹא יִתָּמּוּ׃
verses.english: but Thou art the same, and Thy years shall have no end.

verses.hebrew: בְּנֵי־עֲבָדֶיךָ יִשְׁכּוֹנוּ וְזַרְעָם לְפָנֶיךָ יִכּוֹן׃
verses.english: The children of Thy servants shall continue, and their seed shall be established before Thee.

verses.hebrew: לְדָוִד בָּרֲכִי נַפְשִׁי אֶת־יְהוָה וְכָל־קְרָבַי אֶת־שֵׁם קָדְשׁוֹ׃
verses.english: Of David. Bless the Lord, O my soul: and all that is within me bless his holy name.

verses.hebrew: בָּרֲכִי נַפְשִׁי אֶת־יְהוָה וְאַל־תִּשְׁכְּחִי כָּל־גְּמוּלָיו׃
verses.english: Bless the Lord, O my soul, and forget not all his benefits:

verses.hebrew: הַסֹּלֵחַ לְכָל־עֲוֺנֵכִי הָרֹפֵא לְכָל־תַּחֲלֻאָיְכִי׃
verses.english: who forgives all thy iniquities; who heals all thy diseases;

verses.hebrew: הַגּוֹאֵל מִשַּׁחַת חַיָּיְכִי הַמְעַטְּרֵכִי חֶסֶד וְרַחֲמִים׃
verses.english: who redeems thy life from the pit; who encircles thee with love and compassion;

verses.hebrew: הַמַּשְׂבִּיַע בַּטּוֹב עֶדְיֵךְ תִּתְחַדֵּשׁ כַּנֶּשֶׁר נְעוּרָיְכִי׃
verses.english: who satisfies thy old age with good; so that thy youth is renewed like the eagle’s.

verses.hebrew: עֹשֵׂה צְדָקוֹת יְהוָה וּמִשְׁפָּטִים לְכָל־עֲשׁוּקִים׃
verses.english: The Lord executes righteousness, and judgment for all that are oppressed.

verses.hebrew: יוֹדִיעַ דְּרָכָיו לְמֹשֶׁה לִבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל עֲלִילוֹתָיו׃
verses.english: He made known his ways to Moshe, his acts to the children of Yisra᾽el.

verses.hebrew: רַחוּם וְחַנּוּן יְהוָה אֶרֶךְ אַפַּיִם וְרַב־חָסֶד׃
verses.english: The Lord is merciful and gracious, slow to anger, and plenteous in steadfast love.

verses.hebrew: לֹא־לָנֶצַח יָרִיב וְלֹא לְעוֹלָם יִטּוֹר׃
verses.english: He will not always chide: neither will he keep his anger forever.

verses.hebrew: לֹא כַחֲטָאֵינוּ עָשָׂה לָנוּ וְלֹא כַעֲוֺנֹתֵינוּ גָּמַל עָלֵינוּ׃
verses.english: He has not dealt with us after our sins; nor repaid us according to our iniquities.

verses.hebrew: כִּי כִגְבֹהַּ שָׁמַיִם עַל־הָאָרֶץ גָּבַר חַסְדּוֹ עַל־יְרֵאָיו׃
verses.english: For as the heaven is high above the earth, so great is his steadfast love towards those who fear him.

verses.hebrew: כִּרְחֹק מִזְרָח מִמַּעֲרָב הִרְחִיק מִמֶּנּוּ אֶת־פְּשָׁעֵינוּ׃
verses.english: As far as the east is from the west, so far has he removed our transgressions from us.

verses.hebrew: כְּרַחֵם אָב עַל־בָּנִים רִחַם יְהוָה עַל־יְרֵאָיו׃
verses.english: As a father pities his children, so the Lord pities those who fear him.

verses.hebrew: כִּי־הוּא יָדַע יִצְרֵנוּ זָכוּר כִּי־עָפָר אֲנָחְנוּ׃
verses.english: For he knows our frame; he remembers that we are dust.

verses.hebrew: אֱנוֹשׁ כֶּחָצִיר יָמָיו כְּצִיץ הַשָּׂדֶה כֵּן יָצִיץ׃
verses.english: As for man, his days are like grass: like a flower of the field, so he blooms.

verses.hebrew: כִּי רוּחַ עָבְרָה־בּוֹ וְאֵינֶנּוּ וְלֹא־יַכִּירֶנּוּ עוֹד מְקוֹמוֹ׃
verses.english: For the wind passes over it, and it is gone; and its place knows it no more.

verses.hebrew: וְחֶסֶד יְהוָה מֵעוֹלָם וְעַד־עוֹלָם עַל־יְרֵאָיו וְצִדְקָתוֹ לִבְנֵי בָנִים׃
verses.english: But the steadfast love of the Lord is from everlasting to everlasting upon those who fear him, and his righteousness to children’s children;

verses.hebrew: לְשֹׁמְרֵי בְרִיתוֹ וּלְזֹכְרֵי פִקֻּדָיו לַעֲשׂוֹתָם׃
verses.english: to such as keep his covenant, and to those who remember his commandments to do them.

verses.hebrew: יְהוָה בַּשָּׁמַיִם הֵכִין כִּסְאוֹ וּמַלְכוּתוֹ בַּכֹּל מָשָׁלָה׃
verses.english: The Lord has established his throne in the heavens; and his kingdom rules over all.

verses.hebrew: בָּרֲכוּ יְהוָה מַלְאָכָיו גִּבֹּרֵי כֹחַ עֹשֵׂי דְבָרוֹ לִשְׁמֹעַ בְּקוֹל דְּבָרוֹ׃
verses.english: Bless the Lord, you angels of his, you mighty ones who perform his bidding, hearkening to the voice of his word.

verses.hebrew: בָּרֲכוּ יְהוָה כָּל־צְבָאָיו מְשָׁרְתָיו עֹשֵׂי רְצוֹנוֹ׃
verses.english: Bless the Lord, all his hosts; you ministers of his, who do his pleasure.

verses.hebrew: בָּרֲכוּ יְהוָה כָּל־מַעֲשָׂיו בְּכָל־מְקֹמוֹת מֶמְשַׁלְתּוֹ בָּרֲכִי נַפְשִׁי אֶת־יְהוָה׃
verses.english: Bless the Lord, all his works in all places of his dominion. Bless the Lord, O my soul!

verses.hebrew: בָּרֲכִי נַפְשִׁי אֶת־יְהוָה יְהוָה אֱלֹהַי גָּדַלְתָּ מְּאֹד הוֹד וְהָדָר לָבָשְׁתָּ׃
verses.english: Bless the Lord, O my soul. O Lord my God Thou art very great, Thou art clothed with glory and majesty.

verses.hebrew: עֹטֶה־אוֹר כַּשַּׂלְמָה נוֹטֶה שָׁמַיִם כַּיְרִיעָה׃
verses.english: Who covers himself with light as with a garment: who stretches out the heavens like a curtain:

verses.hebrew: הַמְקָרֶה בַמַּיִם עֲ‍לִיּוֹתָיו הַשָּׂם־עָבִים רְכוּבוֹ הַמְהַלֵּךְ עַל־כַּנְפֵי־רוּחַ׃
verses.english: who lays the beams of his chambers in the waters: who makes the clouds his chariot: who walks upon the wings of the wind:

verses.hebrew: עֹשֶׂה מַלְאָכָיו רוּחוֹת מְשָׁרְתָיו אֵשׁ לֹהֵט׃
verses.english: who makes the winds his messengers; the flames of fire his ministers:

verses.hebrew: יָסַד־אֶרֶץ עַל־מְכוֹנֶיהָ בַּל־תִּמּוֹט עוֹלָם וָעֶד׃
verses.english: who laid the foundations of the earth, that it should not be removed forever.

verses.hebrew: תְּהוֹם כַּלְּבוּשׁ כִּסִּיתוֹ עַל־הָרִים יַעַמְדוּ־מָיִם׃
verses.english: Thou didst cover it with the deep as with a garment: the waters stood above the mountains.

verses.hebrew: מִן־גַּעֲרָתְךָ יְנוּסוּן מִן־קוֹל רַעַמְךָ יֵחָפֵזוּן׃
verses.english: At Thy rebuke they fled; at the voice of Thy thunder they hastened away;

verses.hebrew: יַעֲלוּ הָרִים יֵרְדוּ בְקָעוֹת אֶל־מְקוֹם זֶה יָסַדְתָּ לָהֶם׃
verses.english: they went up the mountains; they flowed down the valleys to the place which Thou didst found for them.

verses.hebrew: גְּבוּל־שַׂמְתָּ בַּל־יַעֲבֹרוּן בַּל־יְשׁוּבוּן לְכַסּוֹת הָאָרֶץ׃
verses.english: Thou didst set a bound that they might not pass over; that they might not turn back to cover the earth.

verses.hebrew: הַמְשַׁלֵּחַ מַעְיָנִים בַּנְּחָלִים בֵּין הָרִים יְהַלֵּכוּן׃
verses.english: He sends the springs into the valleys; they flow between the hills:

verses.hebrew: יַשְׁקוּ כָּל־חַיְתוֹ שָׂדָי יִשְׁבְּרוּ פְרָאִים צְמָאָם׃
verses.english: they give drink to every wild beast: the wild asses quench their thirst.

verses.hebrew: עֲלֵיהֶם עוֹף־הַשָּׁמַיִם יִשְׁכּוֹן מִבֵּין עֳפָאיִם יִתְּנוּ־קוֹל׃
verses.english: Beside them dwell the birds of the sky; from among the branches they sing.

verses.hebrew: מַשְׁקֶה הָרִים מֵעֲלִיּוֹתָיו מִפְּרִי מַעֲשֶׂיךָ תִּשְׂבַּע הָאָרֶץ׃
verses.english: He waters the hills from his upper chambers: the earth is satisfied with the fruit of Thy works.

verses.hebrew: מַצְמִיחַ חָצִיר לַבְּהֵמָה וְעֵשֶׂב לַעֲבֹדַת הָאָדָם לְהוֹצִיא לֶחֶם מִן־הָאָרֶץ׃
verses.english: He causes the grass to grow for the cattle, and plants for the service of man: that he may bring forth food out of the earth;

verses.hebrew: וְיַיִן יְשַׂמַּח לְבַב־אֱנוֹשׁ לְהַצְהִיל פָּנִים מִשָּׁמֶן וְלֶחֶם לְבַב־אֱנוֹשׁ יִסְעָד׃
verses.english: and wine that makes glad the heart of man; oil to brighten his face; and bread which sustains the heart of man.

verses.hebrew: יִשְׂבְּעוּ עֲצֵי יְהוָה אַרְזֵי לְבָנוֹן אֲשֶׁר נָטָע׃
verses.english: The trees of the Lord have their fill; the cedars of Levanon, which he has planted;

verses.hebrew: אֲשֶׁר־שָׁם צִפֳּרִים יְקַנֵּנוּ חֲסִידָה בְּרוֹשִׁים בֵּיתָהּ׃
verses.english: where the birds make their nests: as for the stork, the cypress trees are her house.

verses.hebrew: הָרִים הַגְּבֹהִים לַיְּעֵלִים סְלָעִים מַחְסֶה לַשְׁפַנִּים׃
verses.english: The high hills are a refuge for the wild goats; and the rocks for the badgers.

verses.hebrew: עָשָׂה יָרֵחַ לְמוֹעֲדִים שֶׁמֶשׁ יָדַע מְבוֹאוֹ׃
verses.english: He appointed the moon for seasons: the sun knows his going down.

verses.hebrew: תָּשֶׁת־חֹשֶׁךְ וִיהִי לָיְלָה בּוֹ־תִרְמֹשׂ כָּל־חַיְתוֹ־יָעַר׃
verses.english: Thou makest darkness, and it is night; when all the beasts of the forest do creep forth.

verses.hebrew: הַכְּפִירִים שֹׁאֲגִים לַטָּרֶף וּלְבַקֵּשׁ מֵאֵל אָכְלָם׃
verses.english: The young lions roar after their prey, and seek their food from God.

verses.hebrew: תִּזְרַח הַשֶּׁמֶשׁ יֵאָסֵפוּן וְאֶל־מְעוֹנֹתָם יִרְבָּצוּן׃
verses.english: The sun rises, they slink away, and lay them down in their dens.

verses.hebrew: יֵצֵא אָדָם לְפָעֳלוֹ וְלַעֲבֹדָתוֹ עֲדֵי־עָרֶב׃
verses.english: Man goes forth to his work and to his labour until the evening.

verses.hebrew: מָה־רַבּוּ מַעֲשֶׂיךָ יְהוָה כֻּלָּם בְּחָכְמָה עָשִׂיתָ מָלְאָה הָאָרֶץ קִנְיָנֶךָ׃
verses.english: O Lord, how manifold are Thy works! in wisdom hast Thou made them all: the earth is full of Thy creatures.

verses.hebrew: זֶה הַיָּם גָּדוֹל וּרְחַב יָדָיִם שָׁם־רֶמֶשׂ וְאֵין מִסְפָּר חַיּוֹת קְטַנּוֹת עִם־גְּדֹלוֹת׃
verses.english: So is this great and wide sea, wherein are creeping things innumerable, both small and great beasts.

verses.hebrew: שָׁם אֳנִיּוֹת יְהַלֵּכוּן לִוְיָתָן זֶה־יָצַרְתָּ לְשַׂחֶק־בּוֹ׃
verses.english: There go the ships: there are the dolphins, whom Thou hast made to play therein.

verses.hebrew: כֻּלָּם אֵלֶיךָ יְשַׂבֵּרוּן לָתֵת אָכְלָם בְּעִתּוֹ׃
verses.english: These wait all upon Thee; that Thou mayst give them their food in due season.

verses.hebrew: תִּתֵּן לָהֶם יִלְקֹטוּן תִּפְתַּח יָדְךָ יִשְׂבְּעוּן טוֹב׃
verses.english: Thou givest it to them; they gather it: Thou openest Thy hand, they are filled with good.

verses.hebrew: תַּסְתִּיר פָּנֶיךָ יִבָּהֵלוּן תֹּסֵף רוּחָם יִגְוָעוּן וְאֶל־עֲפָרָם יְשׁוּבוּן׃
verses.english: Thou hidest Thy face, they are troubled: Thou takest away their breath, they die, and return to their dust.

verses.hebrew: תְּשַׁלַּח רוּחֲךָ יִבָּרֵאוּן וּתְחַדֵּשׁ פְּנֵי אֲדָמָה׃
verses.english: Thou sendest forth Thy breath, they are created: and Thou renewest the face of the earth.

verses.hebrew: יְהִי כְבוֹד יְהוָה לְעוֹלָם יִשְׂמַח יְהוָה בְּמַעֲשָׂיו׃
verses.english: May the glory of the Lord endure forever: let the Lord rejoice in his works.

verses.hebrew: הַמַּבִּיט לָאָרֶץ וַתִּרְעָד יִגַּע בֶּהָרִים וְיֶעֱשָׁנוּ׃
verses.english: He looks on the earth, and it trembles: he touches the hills, and they smoke.

verses.hebrew: אָשִׁירָה לַיהוָה בְּחַיָּי אֲזַמְּרָה לֵאלֹהַי בְּעוֹדִי׃
verses.english: I will sing to the Lord as long as I live: I will sing praise to my God while I have my being.

verses.hebrew: יֶעֱרַב עָלָיו שִׂיחִי אָנֹכִי אֶשְׂמַח בַּיהוָה׃
verses.english: My meditation of him shall be sweet: I will rejoice in the Lord.

verses.hebrew: יִתַּמּוּ חַטָּאִים מִן־הָאָרֶץ וּרְשָׁעִים עוֹד אֵינָם בָּרֲכִי נַפְשִׁי אֶת־יְהוָה הַלְלוּ־יָהּ׃
verses.english: The sinners will be consumed out of the earth, and the wicked will be no more. Bless thou the Lord, O my soul. Haleluya!

verses.hebrew: הוֹדוּ לַיהוָה קִרְאוּ בִּשְׁמוֹ הוֹדִיעוּ בָעַמִּים עֲלִילוֹתָיו׃
verses.english: O Give thanks to the Lord; call upon his name: make known his deeds among the people.

verses.hebrew: שִׁירוּ־לוֹ זַמְּרוּ־לוֹ שִׂיחוּ בְּכָל־נִפְלְאוֹתָיו׃
verses.english: Sing to him, sing psalms to him: talk of all his wondrous works.

verses.hebrew: הִתְהַלְלוּ בְּשֵׁם קָדְשׁוֹ יִשְׂמַח לֵב מְבַקְשֵׁי יְהוָה׃
verses.english: Glory in his holy name: let the heart of those who seek the Lord rejoice.

verses.hebrew: דִּרְשׁוּ יְהוָה וְעֻזּוֹ בַּקְּשׁוּ פָנָיו תָּמִיד׃
verses.english: Seek the Lord, and his strength: seek his face continually.

verses.hebrew: זִכְרוּ נִפְלְאוֹתָיו אֲשֶׁר־עָשָׂה מֹפְתָיו וּמִשְׁפְּטֵי־פִיו׃
verses.english: Remember his marvellous works that he has done; his wonders, and the judgments of his mouth;

verses.hebrew: זֶרַע אַבְרָהָם עַבְדּוֹ בְּנֵי יַעֲקֹב בְּחִירָיו׃
verses.english: O seed of Avraham his servant, you children of Ya῾aqov his chosen ones.

verses.hebrew: הוּא יְהוָה אֱלֹהֵינוּ בְּכָל־הָאָרֶץ מִשְׁפָּטָיו׃
verses.english: He is the Lord our God: his judgments are over all the earth.

verses.hebrew: זָכַר לְעוֹלָם בְּרִיתוֹ דָּבָר צִוָּה לְאֶלֶף דּוֹר׃
verses.english: He has remembered his covenant forever, the word which he commanded to a thousand generations;

verses.hebrew: אֲשֶׁר כָּרַת אֶת־אַבְרָהָם וּשְׁבוּעָתוֹ לְיִשְׂחָק׃
verses.english: which he made with Avraham, and his oath to Yiżĥaq;

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעֲמִידֶהָ לְיַעֲקֹב לְחֹק לְיִשְׂרָאֵל בְּרִית עוֹלָם׃
verses.english: and confirmed the same to Ya῾aqov for a law, and to Yisra᾽el for an everlasting covenant:

verses.hebrew: לֵאמֹר לְךָ אֶתֵּן אֶת־אֶרֶץ־כְּנָעַן חֶבֶל נַחֲלַתְכֶם׃
verses.english: saying, To thee I will give the land of Kena῾an, the lot of your inheritance:

verses.hebrew: בִּהְיוֹתָם מְתֵי מִסְפָּר כִּמְעַט וְגָרִים בָּהּ׃
verses.english: when they were but a few men in number; of little account, and sojourners there:

verses.hebrew: וַיִּתְהַלְּכוּ מִגּוֹי אֶל־גּוֹי מִמַּמְלָכָה אֶל־עַם אַחֵר׃
verses.english: when they went from one nation to another, from one kingdom to another people;

verses.hebrew: לֹא־הִנִּיחַ אָדָם לְעָשְׁקָם וַיּוֹכַח עֲלֵיהֶם מְלָכִים׃
verses.english: he suffered no man to do them wrong: but he reproved kings for their sakes; saying,

verses.hebrew: אַל־תִּגְּעוּ בִמְשִׁיחָי וְלִנְבִיאַי אַל־תָּרֵעוּ׃
verses.english: Touch not my anointed, and do my prophets no harm.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּקְרָא רָעָב עַל־הָאָרֶץ כָּל־מַטֵּה־לֶחֶם שָׁבָר׃
verses.english: Moreover he called for a famine upon the land: he broke every staff of bread.

verses.hebrew: שָׁלַח לִפְנֵיהֶם אִישׁ לְעֶבֶד נִמְכַּר יוֹסֵף׃
verses.english: He sent a man before them; Yosef was sold for a servant:

verses.hebrew: עִנּוּ בַכֶּבֶל רגליו [רַגְלוֹ] בַּרְזֶל בָּאָה נַפְשׁוֹ׃
verses.english: whose foot they hurt with fetters: he was laid in iron:

verses.hebrew: עַד־עֵת בֹּא־דְבָרוֹ אִמְרַת יְהוָה צְרָפָתְהוּ׃
verses.english: until the time that his word came to pass: the word of the Lord had tested him.

verses.hebrew: שָׁלַח מֶלֶךְ וַיַּתִּירֵהוּ מֹשֵׁל עַמִּים וַיְפַתְּחֵהוּ׃
verses.english: The king sent and loosed him: and the ruler of the people let him go free.

verses.hebrew: שָׂמוֹ אָדוֹן לְבֵיתוֹ וּמֹשֵׁל בְּכָל־קִנְיָנוֹ׃
verses.english: He made him lord of his house, and ruler of all his substance:

verses.hebrew: לֶאְסֹר שָׂרָיו בְּנַפְשׁוֹ וּזְקֵנָיו יְחַכֵּם׃
verses.english: to bind his princes at his pleasure; and teach his elders wisdom.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּבֹא יִשְׂרָאֵל מִצְרָיִם וְיַעֲקֹב גָּר בְּאֶרֶץ־חָם׃
verses.english: So Yisra᾽el came into Miżrayim; and Ya῾aqov sojourned in the land of Ḥam.

verses.hebrew: וַיֶּפֶר אֶת־עַמּוֹ מְאֹד וַיַּעֲצִמֵהוּ מִצָּרָיו׃
verses.english: And he increased his people greatly; and made them stronger than their enemies.

verses.hebrew: הָפַךְ לִבָּם לִשְׂנֹא עַמּוֹ לְהִתְנַכֵּל בַּעֲבָדָיו׃
verses.english: He turned their heart to hate his people, to deal craftily with his servants.

verses.hebrew: שָׁלַח מֹשֶׁה עַבְדּוֹ אַהֲרֹן אֲשֶׁר בָּחַר־בּוֹ׃
verses.english: He sent Moshe his servant; and Aharon whom he had chosen.

verses.hebrew: שָׂמוּ־בָם דִּבְרֵי אֹתוֹתָיו וּמֹפְתִים בְּאֶרֶץ חָם׃
verses.english: They performed his signs among them, and wonders in the land of Ḥam.

verses.hebrew: שָׁלַח חֹשֶׁךְ וַיַּחְשִׁךְ וְלֹא־מָרוּ אֶת־דברוו [דְּבָרוֹ׃]
verses.english: He sent darkness, and made it dark, and they did not rebel against his word.

verses.hebrew: הָפַךְ אֶת־מֵימֵיהֶם לְדָם וַיָּמֶת אֶת־דְּגָתָם׃
verses.english: He turned their water into blood, and slew their fish.

verses.hebrew: שָׁרַץ אַרְצָם צְפַרְדְּעִים בְּחַדְרֵי מַלְכֵיהֶם׃
verses.english: Their land swarmed with frogs, in the chambers of their kings.

verses.hebrew: אָמַר וַיָּבֹא עָרֹב כִּנִּים בְּכָל־גְּבוּלָם׃
verses.english: He spoke, and there came swarms of gnats, and lice in all their borders.

verses.hebrew: נָתַן גִּשְׁמֵיהֶם בָּרָד אֵשׁ לֶהָבוֹת בְּאַרְצָם׃
verses.english: He gave them hail for rain, and flaming fire in their land.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּךְ גַּפְנָם וּתְאֵנָתָם וַיְשַׁבֵּר עֵץ גְּבוּלָם׃
verses.english: He smote their vines also and their fig trees; and broke the trees of their country.

verses.hebrew: אָמַר וַיָּבֹא אַרְבֶּה וְיֶלֶק וְאֵין מִסְפָּר׃
verses.english: He spoke, and the swarming locust came, and the hopping locust without number,

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאכַל כָּל־עֵשֶׂב בְּאַרְצָם וַיֹּאכַל פְּרִי אַדְמָתָם׃
verses.english: and they did eat up every plant in their land, and devoured the fruit of their ground.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּךְ כָּל־בְּכוֹר בְּאַרְצָם רֵאשִׁית לְכָל־אוֹנָם׃
verses.english: Then he smote all the firstborn in their land, the chief of all their strength.

verses.hebrew: וַיּוֹצִיאֵם בְּכֶסֶף וְזָהָב וְאֵין בִּשְׁבָטָיו כּוֹשֵׁל׃
verses.english: He brought them forth also with silver and gold: and there was not one who stumbled among their tribes.

verses.hebrew: שָׂמַח מִצְרַיִם בְּצֵאתָם כִּי־נָפַל פַּחְדָּם עֲלֵיהֶם׃
verses.english: Miżrayim was glad when they departed: for the fear of them had fallen on them.

verses.hebrew: פָּרַשׂ עָנָן לְמָסָךְ וְאֵשׁ לְהָאִיר לָיְלָה׃
verses.english: He spread a cloud for a covering; and fire to give light in the night.

verses.hebrew: שָׁאַל וַיָּבֵא שְׂלָו וְלֶחֶם שָׁמַיִם יַשְׂבִּיעֵם׃
verses.english: They asked, and he brought quails, and satisfied them with bread from heaven.

verses.hebrew: פָּתַח צוּר וַיָּזוּבוּ מָיִם הָלְכוּ בַּצִּיּוֹת נָהָר׃
verses.english: He opened the rock, and the water gushed out; it ran in the dry places like a river.

verses.hebrew: כִּי־זָכַר אֶת־דְּבַר קָדְשׁוֹ אֶת־אַבְרָהָם עַבְדּוֹ׃
verses.english: For he remembered his holy promise to Avraham his servant.

verses.hebrew: וַיּוֹצִא עַמּוֹ בְשָׂשׂוֹן בְּרִנָּה אֶת־בְּחִירָיו׃
verses.english: And he brought out his people with joy, and his chosen ones with gladness:

verses.hebrew: וַיִּתֵּן לָהֶם אַרְצוֹת גּוֹיִם וַעֲמַל לְאֻמִּים יִירָשׁוּ׃
verses.english: and gave them the lands of the nations: and they seized the labour of the peoples;

verses.hebrew: בַּעֲבוּר יִשְׁמְרוּ חֻקָּיו וְתוֹרֹתָיו יִנְצֹרוּ הַלְלוּ־יָהּ׃
verses.english: that they might observe his statutes, and keep his Torot. Haleluya!

verses.hebrew: הַלְלוּיָהּ הוֹדוּ לַיהוָה כִּי־טוֹב כִּי לְעוֹלָם חַסְדּוֹ׃
verses.english: Haleluya; O give thanks to the Lord; for he is good: for his steadfast love endures for ever.

verses.hebrew: מִי יְמַלֵּל גְּבוּרוֹת יְהוָה יַשְׁמִיעַ כָּל־תְּהִלָּתוֹ׃
verses.english: Who can utter the mighty acts of the Lord? who can declare all his praise?

verses.hebrew: אַשְׁרֵי שֹׁמְרֵי מִשְׁפָּט עֹשֵׂה צְדָקָה בְכָל־עֵת׃
verses.english: Happy are they who maintain justice, and do righteousness at all times.

verses.hebrew: זָכְרֵנִי יְהוָה בִּרְצוֹן עַמֶּךָ פָּקְדֵנִי בִּישׁוּעָתֶךָ׃
verses.english: Remember me, O Lord, when Thou showest favour to Thy people: O visit me with Thy salvation;

verses.hebrew: לִרְאוֹת בְּטוֹבַת בְּחִירֶיךָ לִשְׂמֹחַ בְּשִׂמְחַת גּוֹיֶךָ לְהִתְהַלֵּל עִם־נַחֲלָתֶךָ׃
verses.english: that I may see the good of Thy chosen ones, that I may rejoice in the gladness of Thy nation, that I may glory with Thy inheritance.

verses.hebrew: חָטָאנוּ עִם־אֲבוֹתֵינוּ הֶעֱוִינוּ הִרְשָׁעְנוּ׃
verses.english: We have sinned with our fathers, we have committed iniquity, we have done wickedly.

verses.hebrew: אֲבוֹתֵינוּ בְמִצְרַיִם לֹא־הִשְׂכִּילוּ נִפְלְאוֹתֶיךָ לֹא זָכְרוּ אֶת־רֹב חֲסָדֶיךָ וַיַּמְרוּ עַל־יָם בְּיַם־סוּף׃
verses.english: Our fathers in Miżrayim paid no heed to Thy wonders; they did not remember the multitude of Thy deeds of lovingkindness; and they rebelled against Thee at the Sea, at the Sea of Suf.

verses.hebrew: וַיּוֹשִׁיעֵם לְמַעַן שְׁמוֹ לְהוֹדִיעַ אֶת־גְּבוּרָתוֹ׃
verses.english: But he saved them for his name’s sake, that he might make known his mighty power.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּגְעַר בְּיַם־סוּף וַיֶּחֱרָב וַיּוֹלִיכֵם בַּתְּהֹמוֹת כַּמִּדְבָּר׃
verses.english: He rebuked the Sea of Suf also, and it was dried up: so he led them through the depths, as through the wilderness.

verses.hebrew: וַיּוֹשִׁיעֵם מִיַּד שׂוֹנֵא וַיִּגְאָלֵם מִיַּד אוֹיֵב׃
verses.english: And he saved them from the hand of him who hated them, and redeemed them from the hand of the enemy.

verses.hebrew: וַיְכַסּוּ־מַיִם צָרֵיהֶם אֶחָד מֵהֶם לֹא נוֹתָר׃
verses.english: And the waters covered their enemies: there was not one of them left.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּאֲמִינוּ בִדְבָרָיו יָשִׁירוּ תְּהִלָּתוֹ׃
verses.english: Then they believed his words; they sang his praise.

verses.hebrew: מִהֲרוּ שָׁכְחוּ מַעֲשָׂיו לֹא־חִכּוּ לַעֲצָתוֹ׃
verses.english: They soon forgot his works; they did not wait for his counsel:

verses.hebrew: וַיִּתְאַוּוּ תַאֲוָה בַּמִּדְבָּר וַיְנַסּוּ־אֵל בִּישִׁימוֹן׃
verses.english: but lusted exceedingly in the wilderness, and tried God in the desert.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּתֵּן לָהֶם שֶׁאֱלָתָם וַיְשַׁלַּח רָזוֹן בְּנַפְשָׁם׃
verses.english: And he gave them their request; but sent leanness into their soul.

verses.hebrew: וַיְקַנְאוּ לְמֹשֶׁה בַּמַּחֲנֶה לְאַהֲרֹן קְדוֹשׁ יְהוָה׃
verses.english: And they envied Moshe in the camp, Aharon the Lord’s holy one.

verses.hebrew: תִּפְתַּח־אֶרֶץ וַתִּבְלַע דָּתָן וַתְּכַס עַל־עֲדַת אֲבִירָם׃
verses.english: The earth opened and swallowed up Datan, and covered the company of Aviram.

verses.hebrew: וַתִּבְעַר־אֵשׁ בַּעֲדָתָם לֶהָבָה תְּלַהֵט רְשָׁעִים׃
verses.english: And a fire was kindled in their company; the flame burned up the wicked.

verses.hebrew: יַעֲשׂוּ־עֵגֶל בְּחֹרֵב וַיִּשְׁתַּחֲווּ לְמַסֵּכָה׃
verses.english: They made a calf in Ḥorev, and worshipped a molten image.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּמִירוּ אֶת־כְּבוֹדָם בְּתַבְנִית שׁוֹר אֹכֵל עֵשֶׂב׃
verses.english: Thus they exchanged their glory for the likeness of an ox that eats grass!

verses.hebrew: שָׁכְחוּ אֵל מוֹשִׁיעָם עֹשֶׂה גְדֹלוֹת בְּמִצְרָיִם׃
verses.english: They forgot God who had saved them, who had done great things in Miżrayim;

verses.hebrew: נִפְלָאוֹת בְּאֶרֶץ חָם נוֹרָאוֹת עַל־יַם־סוּף׃
verses.english: wondrous works in the land of Ḥam, and terrible things by the Sea of Suf.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר לְהַשְׁמִידָם לוּלֵי מֹשֶׁה בְחִירוֹ עָמַד בַּפֶּרֶץ לְפָנָיו לְהָשִׁיב חֲמָתוֹ מֵהַשְׁחִית׃
verses.english: Therefore he said that he would destroy them. had not Moshe his chosen one stood before him in the breach, to turn away his wrath, lest he should destroy them.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּמְאֲסוּ בְּאֶרֶץ חֶמְדָּה לֹא־הֶאֱמִינוּ לִדְבָרוֹ׃
verses.english: Moreover, they despised the pleasant land, they believed not his word:

verses.hebrew: וַיֵּרָגְנוּ בְאָהֳלֵיהֶם לֹא שָׁמְעוּ בְּקוֹל יְהוָה׃
verses.english: but murmured in their tents, and did not hearken to the voice of the Lord.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשָּׂא יָדוֹ לָהֶם לְהַפִּיל אוֹתָם בַּמִּדְבָּר׃
verses.english: Therefore he lifted up his hand against them, swearing to overthrow them in the wilderness:

verses.hebrew: וּלְהַפִּיל זַרְעָם בַּגּוֹיִם וּלְזָרוֹתָם בָּאֲרָצוֹת׃
verses.english: to cast out their seed also among the nations, and to scatter them in the lands.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּצָּמְדוּ לְבַעַל פְּעוֹר וַיֹּאכְלוּ זִבְחֵי מֵתִים׃
verses.english: Then they joined themselves to Ba῾al-pe῾or, and ate the sacrifices of the dead.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּכְעִיסוּ בְּמַעַלְלֵיהֶם וַתִּפְרָץ־בָּם מַגֵּפָה׃
verses.english: Thus they provoked him to anger with their deeds: and the plague broke out upon them.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעֲמֹד פִּינְחָס וַיְפַלֵּל וַתֵּעָצַר הַמַּגֵּפָה׃
verses.english: Then stood up Pineĥas, and executed judgment: and so the plague was stayed.

verses.hebrew: וַתֵּחָשֶׁב לוֹ לִצְדָקָה לְדֹר וָדֹר עַד־עוֹלָם׃
verses.english: And that was counted to him for righteousness to all generations for evermore.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּקְצִיפוּ עַל־מֵי מְרִיבָה וַיֵּרַע לְמֹשֶׁה בַּעֲבוּרָם׃
verses.english: And they angered him at the waters of Meriva, so that it went ill with Moshe for their sakes:

verses.hebrew: כִּי־הִמְרוּ אֶת־רוּחוֹ וַיְבַטֵּא בִּשְׂפָתָיו׃
verses.english: because they angered his spirit, so that he spoke rashly with his lips.

verses.hebrew: לֹא־הִשְׁמִידוּ אֶת־הָעַמִּים אֲשֶׁר אָמַר יְהוָה לָהֶם׃
verses.english: They did not destroy the nations, concerning whom the Lord commanded them:

verses.hebrew: וַיִּתְעָרְבוּ בַגּוֹיִם וַיִּלְמְדוּ מַעֲשֵׂיהֶם׃
verses.english: but were mingled among the nations, and learned their works:

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַבְדוּ אֶת־עֲצַבֵּיהֶם וַיִּהְיוּ לָהֶם לְמוֹקֵשׁ׃
verses.english: and they served their idols, which became a snare to them.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּזְבְּחוּ אֶת־בְּנֵיהֶם וְאֶת־בְּנוֹתֵיהֶם לַשֵּׁדִים׃
verses.english: And they sacrificed their sons and their daughters to idols,

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁפְּכוּ דָם נָקִי דַּם־בְּנֵיהֶם וּבְנוֹתֵיהֶם אֲשֶׁר זִבְּחוּ לַעֲצַבֵּי כְנָעַן וַתֶּחֱנַף הָאָרֶץ בַּדָּמִים׃
verses.english: and shed innocent blood, the blood of their sons and of their daughters, whom they sacrificed to the idols of Kena῾an: and the land was polluted with blood.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּטְמְאוּ בְמַעֲשֵׂיהֶם וַיִּזְנוּ בְּמַעַלְלֵיהֶם׃
verses.english: Thus they were defiled with their own works, and went astray in their doings.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּחַר־אַף יְהוָה בְּעַמּוֹ וַיְתָעֵב אֶת־נַחֲלָתוֹ׃
verses.english: Therefore was the wrath of the Lord kindled against his people, and he abhorred his inheritance.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּתְּנֵם בְּיַד־גּוֹיִם וַיִּמְשְׁלוּ בָהֶם שֹׂנְאֵיהֶם׃
verses.english: So he gave them into the hand of the nations; and they that hated them ruled over them.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּלְחָצוּם אוֹיְבֵיהֶם וַיִּכָּנְעוּ תַּחַת יָדָם׃
verses.english: Their enemies also oppressed them, and they were brought into subjection under their hand.

verses.hebrew: פְּעָמִים רַבּוֹת יַצִּילֵם וְהֵמָּה יַמְרוּ בַעֲצָתָם וַיָּמֹכּוּ בַּעֲוֺנָם׃
verses.english: Many times did he deliver them; but they were rebellious in their counsel, and were brought low through their iniquity.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּרְא בַּצַּר לָהֶם בְּשָׁמְעוֹ אֶת־רִנָּתָם׃
verses.english: Nevertheless he regarded their affliction, when he heard their cry:

verses.hebrew: וַיִּזְכֹּר לָהֶם בְּרִיתוֹ וַיִּנָּחֵם כְּרֹב חסדו [חֲסָדָיו׃]
verses.english: and he remembered for them his covenant, and relented according to the abundance of his steadfast love.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּתֵּן אוֹתָם לְרַחֲמִים לִפְנֵי כָּל־שׁוֹבֵיהֶם׃
verses.english: Moreover he caused them to be pitied by all their captors.

verses.hebrew: הוֹשִׁיעֵנוּ יְהוָה אֱלֹהֵינוּ וְקַבְּצֵנוּ מִן־הַגּוֹיִם לְהֹדוֹת לְשֵׁם קָדְשֶׁךָ לְהִשְׁתַּבֵּחַ בִּתְהִלָּתֶךָ׃
verses.english: Save us, O Lord our God, and gather us from among the nations, to give thanks to Thy holy name, and to triumph in Thy praise.

verses.hebrew: בָּרוּךְ־יְהוָה אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל מִן־הָעוֹלָם וְעַד הָעוֹלָם וְאָמַר כָּל־הָעָם אָמֵן הַלְלוּ־יָהּ׃
verses.english: Blessed be the Lord God of Yisra᾽el from everlasting to everlasting: and let all the people say, Amen. Haleluya!

verses.hebrew: הֹדוּ לַיהוָה כִּי־טוֹב כִּי לְעוֹלָם חַסְדּוֹ׃
verses.english: O Give thanks to the Lord, for he is good: for his steadfast love endures for ever.

verses.hebrew: יֹאמְרוּ גְּאוּלֵי יְהוָה אֲשֶׁר גְּאָלָם מִיַּד־צָר׃
verses.english: Let the redeemed of the Lord say so, whom he has redeemed from the hand of the enemy;

verses.hebrew: וּמֵאֲרָצוֹת קִבְּצָם מִמִּזְרָח וּמִמַּעֲרָב מִצָּפוֹן וּמִיָּם׃
verses.english: and gathered them out of the lands, from the east, and from the west, from the north, and from the south.

verses.hebrew: תָּעוּ בַמִּדְבָּר בִּישִׁימוֹן דָּרֶךְ עִיר מוֹשָׁב לֹא מָצָאוּ׃
verses.english: They wandered in the wilderness in a desert way; they found no city to dwell in.

verses.hebrew: רְעֵבִים גַּם־צְמֵאִים נַפְשָׁם בָּהֶם תִּתְעַטָּף׃
verses.english: Hungry and thirsty, their soul fainted in them.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּצְעֲקוּ אֶל־יְהוָה בַּצַּר לָהֶם מִמְּצוּקוֹתֵיהֶם יַצִּילֵם׃
verses.english: Then they cried to the Lord in their trouble; he delivered them out of their distresses.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּדְרִיכֵם בְּדֶרֶךְ יְשָׁרָה לָלֶכֶת אֶל־עִיר מוֹשָׁב׃
verses.english: And he led them forth by the right way, that they might go to a city of habitation.

verses.hebrew: יוֹדוּ לַיהוָה חַסְדּוֹ וְנִפְלְאוֹתָיו לִבְנֵי אָדָם׃
verses.english: Let them praise the Lord for his steadfast love, and for his wonderful works to the children of men!

verses.hebrew: כִּי־הִשְׂבִּיעַ נֶפֶשׁ שֹׁקֵקָה וְנֶפֶשׁ רְעֵבָה מִלֵּא־טוֹב׃
verses.english: For he has satisfied the longing soul, and filled the hungry soul with goodness.

verses.hebrew: יֹשְׁבֵי חֹשֶׁךְ וְצַלְמָוֶת אֲסִירֵי עֳנִי וּבַרְזֶל׃
verses.english: Such as sat in darkness and in the shadow of death, bound in affliction and iron;

verses.hebrew: כִּי־הִמְרוּ אִמְרֵי־אֵל וַעֲצַת עֶלְיוֹן נָאָצוּ׃
verses.english: because they had rebelled against the words of God, and rejected the counsel of the most High:

verses.hebrew: וַיַּכְנַע בֶּעָמָל לִבָּם כָּשְׁלוּ וְאֵין עֹזֵר׃
verses.english: so that he brought down their heart with labour; they fell down, and there was none to help.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּזְעֲקוּ אֶל־יְהוָה בַּצַּר לָהֶם מִמְּצֻקוֹתֵיהֶם יוֹשִׁיעֵם׃
verses.english: Then they cried to the Lord in their trouble, and he saved them out of their distresses.

verses.hebrew: יוֹצִיאֵם מֵחֹשֶׁךְ וְצַלְמָוֶת וּמוֹסְרוֹתֵיהֶם יְנַתֵּק׃
verses.english: He brought them out of darkness and the shadow of death, and broke their bands asunder.

verses.hebrew: יוֹדוּ לַיהוָה חַסְדּוֹ וְנִפְלְאוֹתָיו לִבְנֵי אָדָם׃
verses.english: Let them praise the Lord for his steadfast love, and for his wonderful works to the children of men!

verses.hebrew: כִּי־שִׁבַּר דַּלְתוֹת נְחֹשֶׁת וּבְרִיחֵי בַרְזֶל גִּדֵּעַ׃
verses.english: For he has broken the gates of brass, and cut the bars of iron asunder.

verses.hebrew: אֱוִלִים מִדֶּרֶךְ פִּשְׁעָם וּמֵעֲוֺנֹתֵיהֶם יִתְעַנּוּ׃
verses.english: The foolish were afflicted on account of their sinful way, and their iniquities.

verses.hebrew: כָּל־אֹכֶל תְּתַעֵב נַפְשָׁם וַיַּגִּיעוּ עַד־שַׁעֲרֵי מָוֶת׃
verses.english: Their soul abhorred all manner of food; for they came near the gates of death.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּזְעֲקוּ אֶל־יְהוָה בַּצַּר לָהֶם מִמְּצֻקוֹתֵיהֶם יוֹשִׁיעֵם׃
verses.english: Then they cried to the Lord in their trouble, and he saved them out of their distresses.

verses.hebrew: יִשְׁלַח דְּבָרוֹ וְיִרְפָּאֵם וִימַלֵּט מִשְּׁחִיתוֹתָם׃
verses.english: He sends his word, and heals them, and delivers them from their destructions.

verses.hebrew: יוֹדוּ לַיהוָה חַסְדּוֹ וְנִפְלְאוֹתָיו לִבְנֵי אָדָם׃
verses.english: Let them praise the Lord for his steadfast love, and for his wonderful works to the children of men!

verses.hebrew: וְיִזְבְּחוּ זִבְחֵי תוֹדָה וִיסַפְּרוּ מַעֲשָׂיו בְּרִנָּה׃
verses.english: And let them sacrifice the sacrifices of thanksgiving, and declare his works with rejoicing.

verses.hebrew: יוֹרְדֵי הַיָּם בָּאֳנִיּוֹת עֹשֵׂי מְלָאכָה בְּמַיִם רַבִּים׃
verses.english: They that go down to the sea in ships, that do business in great waters;

verses.hebrew: הֵמָּה רָאוּ מַעֲשֵׂי יְהוָה וְנִפְלְאוֹתָיו בִּמְצוּלָה׃
verses.english: these saw the works of the Lord, and his wonders in the deep.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר וַיַּעֲמֵד רוּחַ סְעָרָה וַתְּרוֹמֵם גַּלָּיו׃
verses.english: For he commanded, and raised the stormy wind, which lifted up the waves thereof.

verses.hebrew: יַעֲלוּ שָׁמַיִם יֵרְדוּ תְהוֹמוֹת נַפְשָׁם בְּרָעָה תִתְמוֹגָג׃
verses.english: They mount up to the sky, they go down again to the depths: their soul is melted away because of trouble.

verses.hebrew: יָחוֹגּוּ וְיָנוּעוּ כַּשִּׁכּוֹר וְכָל־חָכְמָתָם תִּתְבַּלָּע׃
verses.english: They reel to and fro, and stagger like a drunken man, and are at their wits’ end.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּצְעֲקוּ אֶל־יְהוָה בַּצַּר לָהֶם וּמִמְּצוּקֹתֵיהֶם יוֹצִיאֵם׃
verses.english: Then they cry to the Lord in their trouble, and he brings them out of their distresses.

verses.hebrew: יָקֵם סְעָרָה לִדְמָמָה וַיֶּחֱשׁוּ גַּלֵּיהֶם׃
verses.english: He makes the storm a calm, so that the waves thereof are still.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׂמְחוּ כִי־יִשְׁתֹּקוּ וַיַּנְחֵם אֶל־מְחוֹז חֶפְצָם׃
verses.english: Then are they glad because they are quiet; and he brings them to their desired haven.

verses.hebrew: יוֹדוּ לַיהוָה חַסְדּוֹ וְנִפְלְאוֹתָיו לִבְנֵי אָדָם׃
verses.english: Let them praise the Lord for his steadfast love, and for his wonderful works to the children of men!

verses.hebrew: וִירֹמְמוּהוּ בִּקְהַל־עָם וּבְמוֹשַׁב זְקֵנִים יְהַלְלוּהוּ׃
verses.english: Let them exalt him also in the congregation of the people, and praise him in the assembly of the elders.

verses.hebrew: יָשֵׂם נְהָרוֹת לְמִדְבָּר וּמֹצָאֵי מַיִם לְצִמָּאוֹן׃
verses.english: He turns rivers into a wilderness, and watersprings into dry ground;

verses.hebrew: אֶרֶץ פְּרִי לִמְלֵחָה מֵרָעַת יֹשְׁבֵי בָהּ׃
verses.english: a fruitful land into barrenness, because of wickedness of those who dwell therein.

verses.hebrew: יָשֵׂם מִדְבָּר לַאֲגַם־מַיִם וְאֶרֶץ צִיָּה לְמֹצָאֵי מָיִם׃
verses.english: He turned the wilderness into a pool of water, and dry ground into watersprings.

verses.hebrew: וַיּוֹשֶׁב שָׁם רְעֵבִים וַיְכוֹנְנוּ עִיר מוֹשָׁב׃
verses.english: And there he makes the hungry to dwell, and they establish a city for habitation;

verses.hebrew: וַיִּזְרְעוּ שָׂדוֹת וַיִּטְּעוּ כְרָמִים וַיַּעֲשׂוּ פְּרִי תְבוּאָה׃
verses.english: and sow fields, and plant vineyards, which yield fruits of increase.

verses.hebrew: וַיְבָרֲכֵם וַיִּרְבּוּ מְאֹד וּבְהֶמְתָּם לֹא יַמְעִיט׃
verses.english: He blesses them also, so that they are multiplied greatly; and does not let their cattle decrease.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּמְעֲטוּ וַיָּשֹׁחוּ מֵעֹצֶר רָעָה וְיָגוֹן׃
verses.english: When they are diminished and brought low through oppression, affliction, and sorrow:

verses.hebrew: שֹׁפֵךְ בּוּז עַל־נְדִיבִים וַיַּתְעֵם בְּתֹהוּ לֹא־דָרֶךְ׃
verses.english: he pours contempt upon nobles, and causes them to wander in the wilderness, where there is no way:

verses.hebrew: וַיְשַׂגֵּב אֶבְיוֹן מֵעוֹנִי וַיָּשֶׂם כַּצֹּאן מִשְׁפָּחוֹת׃
verses.english: yet he sets the poor on high from affliction, and makes his families like a flock.

verses.hebrew: יִרְאוּ יְשָׁרִים וְיִשְׂמָחוּ וְכָל־עַוְלָה קָפְצָה פִּיהָ׃
verses.english: The righteous shall see it, and rejoice: and all iniquity shall stop her mouth.

verses.hebrew: מִי־חָכָם וְיִשְׁמָר־אֵלֶּה וְיִתְבּוֹנְנוּ חַסְדֵי יְהוָה׃
verses.english: Whoever is wise, let them consider these things, and let them observe the loving acts of the Lord.

verses.hebrew: שִׁיר מִזְמוֹר לְדָוִד׃
verses.english: A Poem, A Psalm of David.

verses.hebrew: נָכוֹן לִבִּי אֱלֹהִים אָשִׁירָה וַאֲזַמְּרָה אַף־כְּבוֹדִי׃
verses.english: My heart is firm, O God; I will sing, I will give praise; my glory likewise.

verses.hebrew: עוּרָה הַנֵּבֶל וְכִנּוֹר אָעִירָה שָּׁחַר׃
verses.english: Awake the harp and the lyre: I will awaken the dawn.

verses.hebrew: אוֹדְךָ בָעַמִּים יְהוָה וַאֲזַמֶּרְךָ בַּל־אֻמִּים׃
verses.english: I will praise Thee, O Lord, among the peoples: and I will sing praises to Thee among the nations.

verses.hebrew: כִּי־גָדוֹל מֵעַל־שָׁמַיִם חַסְדֶּךָ וְעַד־שְׁחָקִים אֲמִתֶּךָ׃
verses.english: For Thy steadfast love is great above the heavens: and Thy truth reaches the clouds.

verses.hebrew: רוּמָה עַל־שָׁמַיִם אֱלֹהִים וְעַל כָּל־הָאָרֶץ כְּבוֹדֶךָ׃
verses.english: Be Thou exalted, O God, above the heavens: and Thy glory above all the earth;

verses.hebrew: לְמַעַן יֵחָלְצוּן יְדִידֶיךָ הוֹשִׁיעָה יְמִינְךָ וַעֲנֵנִי׃
verses.english: that Thy beloved ones may be delivered: save with Thy right hand, and answer me.

verses.hebrew: אֱלֹהִים דִּבֶּר בְּקָדְשׁוֹ אֶעְלֹזָה אֲחַלְּקָה שְׁכֶם וְעֵמֶק סֻכּוֹת אֲמַדֵּד׃
verses.english: God has spoken in his holiness; I will rejoice, I will divide Shekhem, and measure out the valley of Sukkot.

verses.hebrew: לִי גִלְעָד לִי מְנַשֶּׁה וְאֶפְרַיִם מָעוֹז רֹאשִׁי יְהוּדָה מְחֹקְקִי׃
verses.english: Gil῾ad is mine; Menashshe is mine; Efrayim also is the strength of my head; Yehuda is my sceptre;

verses.hebrew: מוֹאָב סִיר רַחְצִי עַל־אֱדוֹם אַשְׁלִיךְ נַעֲלִי עֲלֵי־פְלֶשֶׁת אֶתְרוֹעָע׃
verses.english: Mo᾽av is my washpot; over Edom will I cast my shoe; over Peleshet I will cry in triumph.

verses.hebrew: מִי יֹבִלֵנִי עִיר מִבְצָר מִי נָחַנִי עַד־אֱדוֹם׃
verses.english: Who will bring me into the strong city? who will lead me to Edom?

verses.hebrew: הֲלֹא־אֱלֹהִים זְנַחְתָּנוּ וְלֹא־תֵצֵא אֱלֹהִים בְּצִבְאֹתֵינוּ׃
verses.english: Hast Thou not rejected us, O God? so that Thou goest not forth, O God, with our hosts.

verses.hebrew: הָבָה־לָּנוּ עֶזְרָת מִצָּר וְשָׁוְא תְּשׁוּעַת אָדָם׃
verses.english: Give us help against the foe: for vain is the help of man.

verses.hebrew: בֵּאלֹהִים נַעֲשֶׂה־חָיִל וְהוּא יָבוּס צָרֵינוּ׃
verses.english: Through God we shall do valiantly: for he it is who will tread down our enemies.

verses.hebrew: לַמְנַצֵּחַ לְדָוִד מִזְמוֹר אֱלֹהֵי תְהִלָּתִי אַל־תֶּחֱרַשׁ׃
verses.english: To the chief Musician, A Psalm of David. Keep not silent, O God of my praise;

verses.hebrew: כִּי פִי רָשָׁע וּפִי־מִרְמָה עָלַי פָּתָחוּ דִּבְּרוּ אִתִּי לְשׁוֹן שָׁקֶר׃
verses.english: for the mouth of the wicked and the mouth of the deceitful are opened against me: they have spoken against me with a lying tongue.

verses.hebrew: וְדִבְרֵי שִׂנְאָה סְבָבוּנִי וַיִּלָּחֲמוּנִי חִנָּם׃
verses.english: For they have compassed me about with words of hatred; and fought against me without a cause.

verses.hebrew: תַּחַת־אַהֲבָתִי יִשְׂטְנוּנִי וַאֲנִי תְפִלָּה׃
verses.english: In return for my love they are my accusers; whilst I have nothing but prayer.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּשִׂימוּ עָלַי רָעָה תַּחַת טוֹבָה וְשִׂנְאָה תַּחַת אַהֲבָתִי׃
verses.english: And they have repaid me evil for good, and hatred for my love, saying:

verses.hebrew: הַפְקֵד עָלָיו רָשָׁע וְשָׂטָן יַעֲמֹד עַל־יְמִינוֹ׃
verses.english: Set a wicked man over him: and let an adversary stand at his right hand.

verses.hebrew: בְּהִשָּׁפְטוֹ יֵצֵא רָשָׁע וּתְפִלָּתוֹ תִּהְיֶה לַחֲטָאָה׃
verses.english: When he shall be judged, let him be condemned: and let his prayer be turned into sin.

verses.hebrew: יִהְיוּ־יָמָיו מְעַטִּים פְּקֻדָּתוֹ יִקַּח אַחֵר׃
verses.english: Let his days be few; and let another take his possessions.

verses.hebrew: יִהְיוּ־בָנָיו יְתוֹמִים וְאִשְׁתּוֹ אַלְמָנָה׃
verses.english: Let his children be fatherless, and his wife a widow.

verses.hebrew: וְנוֹעַ יָנוּעוּ בָנָיו וְשִׁאֵלוּ וְדָרְשׁוּ מֵחָרְבוֹתֵיהֶם׃
verses.english: Let his children be vagabonds, and beg: let them seek their bread also out of their desolate places.

verses.hebrew: יְנַקֵּשׁ נוֹשֶׁה לְכָל־אֲשֶׁר־לוֹ וְיָבֹזּוּ זָרִים יְגִיעוֹ׃
verses.english: Let the creditor seize everything that he has, and let strangers spoil his labour.

verses.hebrew: אַל־יְהִי־לוֹ מֹשֵׁךְ חָסֶד וְאַל־יְהִי חוֹנֵן לִיתוֹמָיו׃
verses.english: Let there be none to extend kindness to him: nor let there be any to favour his fatherless children.

verses.hebrew: יְהִי־אַחֲרִיתוֹ לְהַכְרִית בְּדוֹר אַחֵר יִמַּח שְׁמָם׃
verses.english: Let his posterity be cut off; and in the generation following let their name be blotted out.

verses.hebrew: יִזָּכֵר עֲוֺן אֲבֹתָיו אֶל־יְהוָה וְחַטַּאת אִמּוֹ אַל־תִּמָּח׃
verses.english: May the iniquity of his fathers be remembered by the Lord; and let not the sin of his mother be blotted out.

verses.hebrew: יִהְיוּ נֶגֶד־יְהוָה תָּמִיד וְיַכְרֵת מֵאֶרֶץ זִכְרָם׃
verses.english: Let them be before the Lord continually, that he may cut off the memory of them from the earth.

verses.hebrew: יַעַן אֲשֶׁר לֹא זָכַר עֲשׂוֹת חָסֶד וַיִּרְדֹּף אִישׁ־עָנִי וְאֶבְיוֹן וְנִכְאֵה לֵבָב לְמוֹתֵת׃
verses.english: Because he remembered not to show kindness, but pursued the poor and needy man, and the brokenhearted to their death.

verses.hebrew: וַיֶּאֱהַב קְלָלָה וַתְּבוֹאֵהוּ וְלֹא־חָפֵץ בִּבְרָכָה וַתִּרְחַק מִמֶּנּוּ׃
verses.english: For he loved cursing, and it came to him: and he delighted not in blessing, and it was far from him.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּלְבַּשׁ קְלָלָה כְּמַדּוֹ וַתָּבֹא כַמַּיִם בְּקִרְבּוֹ וְכַשֶּׁמֶן בְּעַצְמוֹתָיו׃
verses.english: And he clothed himself with cursing like his garment, and it came into his bowels like water, and like oil into his bones.

verses.hebrew: תְּהִי־לוֹ כְּבֶגֶד יַעְטֶה וּלְמֵזַח תָּמִיד יַחְגְּרֶהָ׃
verses.english: Let it be to him as the garment which he puts on, and for the girdle wherewith he is girded continually.

verses.hebrew: זֹאת פְּעֻלַּת שֹׂטְנַי מֵאֵת יְהוָה וְהַדֹּבְרִים רָע עַל־נַפְשִׁי׃
verses.english: This is what my adversaries seek to obtain from the Lord, and they who speak evil against my soul.

verses.hebrew: וְאַתָּה יְהוִה אֲדֹנָי עֲ‍שֵׂה־אִתִּי לְמַעַן שְׁמֶךָ כִּי־טוֹב חַסְדְּךָ הַצִּילֵנִי׃
verses.english: But do Thou for me, O God the Lord, for Thy name’s sake: because Thy steadfast love is good, deliver Thou me.

verses.hebrew: כִּי־עָנִי וְאֶבְיוֹן אָנֹכִי וְלִבִּי חָלַל בְּקִרְבִּי׃
verses.english: For I am poor and needy, and my heart is wounded within me.

verses.hebrew: כְּצֵל־כִּנְטוֹתוֹ נֶהֱלָכְתִּי נִנְעַרְתִּי כָּאַרְבֶּה׃
verses.english: I am gone like the shadow at evening: I am shaken off like the locust.

verses.hebrew: בִּרְכַּי כָּשְׁלוּ מִצּוֹם וּבְשָׂרִי כָּחַשׁ מִשָּׁמֶן׃
verses.english: My knees totter through fasting; and my flesh fails of fatness.

verses.hebrew: וַאֲנִי הָיִיתִי חֶרְפָּה לָהֶם יִרְאוּנִי יְנִיעוּן רֹאשָׁם׃
verses.english: I have become a taunt to them: when they see me they shake their heads.

verses.hebrew: עָזְרֵנִי יְהוָה אֱלֹהָי הוֹשִׁיעֵנִי כְחַסְדֶּךָ׃
verses.english: Help me, O Lord my God: O save me according to Thy steadfast love:

verses.hebrew: וְיֵדְעוּ כִּי־יָדְךָ זֹּאת אַתָּה יְהוָה עֲשִׂיתָהּ׃
verses.english: that they may know that this is Thy hand; that Thou, Lord, hast done it.

verses.hebrew: יְקַלְלוּ־הֵמָּה וְאַתָּה תְבָרֵךְ קָמוּ וַיֵּבֹשׁוּ וְעַבְדְּךָ יִשְׂמָח׃
verses.english: Let them curse, but bless Thou: when they arise, let them be ashamed; but let Thy servant rejoice.

verses.hebrew: יִלְבְּשׁוּ שׂוֹטְנַי כְּלִמָּה וְיַעֲטוּ כַמְעִיל בָּשְׁתָּם׃
verses.english: Let my adversaries be clothed with shame, and let them cover themselves with their own confusion, as with a robe.

verses.hebrew: אוֹדֶה יְהוָה מְאֹד בְּפִי וּבְתוֹךְ רַבִּים אֲהַלְלֶנּוּ׃
verses.english: I will greatly praise the Lord with my mouth; yea, I will praise him among the multitude.

verses.hebrew: כִּי־יַעֲמֹד לִימִין אֶבְיוֹן לְהוֹשִׁיעַ מִשֹּׁפְטֵי נַפְשׁוֹ׃
verses.english: For he stands at the right hand of the poor, to save him from those who would condemn him to death.

verses.hebrew: לְדָוִד מִזְמוֹר נְאֻם יְהוָה לַאדֹנִי שֵׁב לִימִינִי עַד־אָשִׁית אֹיְבֶיךָ הֲדֹם לְרַגְלֶיךָ׃
verses.english: A Psalm of David. The Lord says to my master, Sit thou at my right hand, until I make thy enemies thy footstool.

verses.hebrew: מַטֵּה־עֻזְּךָ יִשְׁלַח יְהוָה מִצִּיּוֹן רְדֵה בְּקֶרֶב אֹיְבֶיךָ׃
verses.english: The Lord shall send thy mighty sceptre out of Żiyyon: rule in the midst of thy enemies.

verses.hebrew: עַמְּךָ נְדָבֹת בְּיוֹם חֵילֶךָ בְּהַדְרֵי־קֹדֶשׁ מֵרֶחֶם מִשְׁחָר לְךָ טַל יַלְדֻתֶיךָ׃
verses.english: Thy people offered themselves willingly in the majesty of their holiness, on the day of thy battle; when still the dew of thy youth was upon thee, fresh from the womb of dawn.

verses.hebrew: נִשְׁבַּע יְהוָה וְלֹא יִנָּחֵם אַתָּה־כֹהֵן לְעוֹלָם עַל־דִּבְרָתִי מַלְכִּי־צֶדֶק׃
verses.english: The Lord has sworn, and will not change his mind, Thou shalt be a priest forever, after the manner of Malki-żedeq.

verses.hebrew: אֲדֹנָי עַל־יְמִינְךָ מָחַץ בְּיוֹם־אַפּוֹ מְלָכִים׃
verses.english: The Lord is at thy right hand, he crushes kings on the day of his wrath.

verses.hebrew: יָדִין בַּגּוֹיִם מָלֵא גְוִיּוֹת מָחַץ רֹאשׁ עַל־אֶרֶץ רַבָּה׃
verses.english: He judges among the nations: their land is full of dead bodies; he will shatter heads over many countries.

verses.hebrew: מִנַּחַל בַּדֶּרֶךְ יִשְׁתֶּה עַל־כֵּן יָרִים רֹאשׁ׃
verses.english: He will drink of the brook in the way: therefore will he lift up the head.

verses.hebrew: הַלְלוּ יָהּ אוֹדֶה יְהוָה בְּכָל־לֵבָב בְּסוֹד יְשָׁרִים וְעֵדָה׃
verses.english: Haleluya! I will praise the Lord with my whole heart, in the assembly of the upright, and in the congregation.

verses.hebrew: גְּדֹלִים מַעֲשֵׂי יְהוָה דְּרוּשִׁים לְכָל־חֶפְצֵיהֶם׃
verses.english: The works of the Lord are great, sought out by all who love them.

verses.hebrew: הוֹד־וְהָדָר פָּעֳלוֹ וְצִדְקָתוֹ עֹמֶדֶת לָעַד׃
verses.english: His work is honourable and glorious: and his righteousness endures for ever.

verses.hebrew: זֵכֶר עָשָׂה לְנִפְלְאֹתָיו חַנּוּן וְרַחוּם יְהוָה׃
verses.english: He has made his wonderful works to be remembered: the Lord is gracious and full of compassion.

verses.hebrew: טֶרֶף נָתַן לִירֵאָיו יִזְכֹּר לְעוֹלָם בְּרִיתוֹ׃
verses.english: He has given food to those who fear him: he will ever be mindful of his covenant.

verses.hebrew: כֹּחַ מַעֲשָׂיו הִגִּיד לְעַמּוֹ לָתֵת לָהֶם נַחֲלַת גּוֹיִם׃
verses.english: He has declared to his people the power of his works, that he may give them the heritage of the nations.

verses.hebrew: מַעֲשֵׂי יָדָיו אֱמֶת וּמִשְׁפָּט נֶאֱמָנִים כָּל־פִּקּוּדָיו׃
verses.english: The works of his hands are truth and justice; all his commandments are sure.

verses.hebrew: סְמוּכִים לָעַד לְעוֹלָם עֲשׂוּיִם בֶּאֱמֶת וְיָשָׁר׃
verses.english: They stand fast for ever and ever, done in truth and uprightness.

verses.hebrew: פְּדוּת שָׁלַח לְעַמּוֹ צִוָּה־לְעוֹלָם בְּרִיתוֹ קָדוֹשׁ וְנוֹרָא שְׁמוֹ׃
verses.english: He sent redemption to his people: he has commanded his covenant forever: holy and reverend is his name.

verses.hebrew: רֵאשִׁית חָכְמָה יִרְאַת יְהוָה שֵׂכֶל טוֹב לְכָל־עֹשֵׂיהֶם תְּהִלָּתוֹ עֹמֶדֶת לָעַד׃
verses.english: The fear of the Lord is the beginning of wisdom: a good understanding have all they who do his commandments: his praise endures forever.

verses.hebrew: הַלְלוּ יָהּ אַשְׁרֵי־אִישׁ יָרֵא אֶת־יְהוָה בְּמִצְוֺתָיו חָפֵץ מְאֹד׃
verses.english: Haleluya! Happy is the man who fears the Lord, who delights greatly in his commandments.

verses.hebrew: גִּבּוֹר בָּאָרֶץ יִהְיֶה זַרְעוֹ דּוֹר יְשָׁרִים יְבֹרָךְ׃
verses.english: His seed shall be mighty upon earth: the generation of the upright shall be blessed.

verses.hebrew: הוֹן־וָעֹשֶׁר בְּבֵיתוֹ וְצִדְקָתוֹ עֹמֶדֶת לָעַד׃
verses.english: Wealth and riches shall be in his house: and his righteousness endures for ever.

verses.hebrew: זָרַח בַּחֹשֶׁךְ אוֹר לַיְשָׁרִים חַנּוּן וְרַחוּם וְצַדִּיק׃
verses.english: Light rises in the darkness for the upright: he is gracious, and full of compassion, and just.

verses.hebrew: טוֹב־אִישׁ חוֹנֵן וּמַלְוֶה יְכַלְכֵּל דְּבָרָיו בְּמִשְׁפָּט׃
verses.english: A good man lends with a good grace: he conducts his affairs justly.

verses.hebrew: כִּי־לְעוֹלָם לֹא־יִמּוֹט לְזֵכֶר עוֹלָם יִהְיֶה צַדִּיק׃
verses.english: Surely he shall never be moved: the righteous shall be in everlasting remembrance.

verses.hebrew: מִשְּׁמוּעָה רָעָה לֹא יִירָא נָכוֹן לִבּוֹ בָּטֻחַ בַּיהוָה׃
verses.english: He shall not be afraid of evil tidings: his heart is firm, trusting in the Lord.

verses.hebrew: סָמוּךְ לִבּוֹ לֹא יִירָא עַד אֲשֶׁר־יִרְאֶה בְצָרָיו׃
verses.english: His heart is established, he shall not be afraid, until he gaze upon his enemies.

verses.hebrew: פִּזַּר נָתַן לָאֶבְיוֹנִים צִדְקָתוֹ עֹמֶדֶת לָעַד קַרְנוֹ תָּרוּם בְּכָבוֹד׃
verses.english: He has distributed freely, he has given to the poor; his righteousness endures for ever; his horn shall be exalted with honour.

verses.hebrew: רָשָׁע יִרְאֶה וְכָעָס שִׁנָּיו יַחֲרֹק וְנָמָס תַּאֲוַת רְשָׁעִים תֹּאבֵד׃
verses.english: The wicked man shall see it, and be grieved; he shall gnash his teeth, and melt away: the desire of the wicked shall come to nought.

verses.hebrew: הַלְלוּ יָהּ הַלְלוּ עַבְדֵי יְהוָה הַלְלוּ אֶת־שֵׁם יְהוָה׃
verses.english: Haleluya! Give praise, O servants of the Lord, praise the name of the Lord.

verses.hebrew: יְהִי שֵׁם יְהוָה מְבֹרָךְ מֵעַתָּה וְעַד־עוֹלָם׃
verses.english: Blessed be the name of the Lord from this time forth and for evermore.

verses.hebrew: מִמִּזְרַח־שֶׁמֶשׁ עַד־מְבוֹאוֹ מְהֻלָּל שֵׁם יְהוָה׃
verses.english: From the rising of the sun to its setting, the Lord’s name is to be praised.

verses.hebrew: רָם עַל־כָּל־גּוֹיִם יְהוָה עַל הַשָּׁמַיִם כְּבוֹדוֹ׃
verses.english: The Lord is high above all nations, and his glory is above the heavens.

verses.hebrew: מִי כַּיהוָה אֱלֹהֵינוּ הַמַּגְבִּיהִי לָשָׁבֶת׃
verses.english: Who is like the Lord our God, who is enthroned on high,

verses.hebrew: הַמַּשְׁפִּילִי לִרְאוֹת בַּשָּׁמַיִם וּבָאָרֶץ׃
verses.english: and yet looks far down to behold the things that are in heaven, and on the earth!

verses.hebrew: מְקִימִי מֵעָפָר דָּל מֵאַשְׁפֹּת יָרִים אֶבְיוֹן׃
verses.english: He raises up the poor out of the dust, and lifts the needy out of the ashheap;

verses.hebrew: לְהוֹשִׁיבִי עִם־נְדִיבִים עִם נְדִיבֵי עַמּוֹ׃
verses.english: that he may set him with nobles, with the nobles of his people.

verses.hebrew: מוֹשִׁיבִי עֲקֶרֶת הַבַּיִת אֵם־הַבָּנִים שְׂמֵחָה הַלְלוּ־יָהּ׃
verses.english: He makes the barren woman to keep house, and be a joyful mother of children. Haleluya!

verses.hebrew: בְּצֵאת יִשְׂרָאֵל מִמִּצְרָיִם בֵּית יַעֲקֹב מֵעַם לֹעֵז׃
verses.english: When Yisra᾽el went out of Miżrayim, the house of Ya῾aqov from a people of strange language;

verses.hebrew: הָיְתָה יְהוּדָה לְקָדְשׁוֹ יִשְׂרָאֵל מַמְשְׁלוֹתָיו׃
verses.english: Yehuda became his sanctuary, and Yisra᾽el his dominion.

verses.hebrew: הַיָּם רָאָה וַיָּנֹס הַיַּרְדֵּן יִסֹּב לְאָחוֹר׃
verses.english: The sea saw it, and fled: the Yarden was driven back.

verses.hebrew: הֶהָרִים רָקְדוּ כְאֵילִים גְּבָעוֹת כִּבְנֵי־צֹאן׃
verses.english: The mountains skipped like rams, the little hills like young sheep.

verses.hebrew: מַה־לְּךָ הַיָּם כִּי תָנוּס הַיַּרְדֵּן תִּסֹּב לְאָחוֹר׃
verses.english: What ails thee, O thou sea, that thou fleest? thou Yarden, that thou art driven back?

verses.hebrew: הֶהָרִים תִּרְקְדוּ כְאֵילִים גְּבָעוֹת כִּבְנֵי־צֹאן׃
verses.english: You mountains, that you skip like rams; and you little hills, like lambs?

verses.hebrew: מִלִּפְנֵי אָדוֹן חוּלִי אָרֶץ מִלִּפְנֵי אֱלוֹהַּ יַעֲקֹב׃
verses.english: Tremble, thou earth, at the presence of the Lord, at the presence of the God of Ya῾aqov;

verses.hebrew: הַהֹפְכִי הַצּוּר אֲגַם־מָיִם חַלָּמִישׁ לְמַעְיְנוֹ־מָיִם׃
verses.english: who turned the rock into a pool of water, the flint into a fountain of waters.

verses.hebrew: לֹא לָנוּ יְהוָה לֹא לָנוּ כִּי־לְשִׁמְךָ תֵּן כָּבוֹד עַל־חַסְדְּךָ עַל־אֲמִתֶּךָ׃
verses.english: Not to us, O Lord, not to us, but to Thy name give glory, for Thy steadfast love, and for Thy truth.

verses.hebrew: לָמָּה יֹאמְרוּ הַגּוֹיִם אַיֵּה־נָא אֱלֹהֵיהֶם׃
verses.english: Why should the nations say, Where is now their God?

verses.hebrew: וֵאלֹהֵינוּ בַשָּׁמָיִם כֹּל אֲשֶׁר־חָפֵץ עָשָׂה׃
verses.english: But our God is in the heavens: he has done whatever he has pleased.

verses.hebrew: עֲ‍צַבֵּיהֶם כֶּסֶף וְזָהָב מַעֲשֵׂה יְדֵי אָדָם׃
verses.english: Their idols are silver and gold, the work of men’s hands.

verses.hebrew: פֶּה־לָהֶם וְלֹא יְדַבֵּרוּ עֵינַיִם לָהֶם וְלֹא יִרְאוּ׃
verses.english: They have mouths, but they cannot speak: eyes have they, but they cannot see:

verses.hebrew: אָזְנַיִם לָהֶם וְלֹא יִשְׁמָעוּ אַף לָהֶם וְלֹא יְרִיחוּן׃
verses.english: they have ears, but they cannot hear: noses have they, but they cannot smell:

verses.hebrew: יְדֵיהֶם וְלֹא יְמִישׁוּן רַגְלֵיהֶם וְלֹא יְהַלֵּכוּ לֹא־יֶהְגּוּ בִּגְרוֹנָם׃
verses.english: they have hands, but they cannot feel: feet have they, but they cannot walk: nor can they speak through their throat.

verses.hebrew: כְּמוֹהֶם יִהְיוּ עֹשֵׂיהֶם כֹּל אֲשֶׁר־בֹּטֵחַ בָּהֶם׃
verses.english: They who make them are like them; so is everyone who trusts in them.

verses.hebrew: יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּטַח בַּיהוָה עֶזְרָם וּמָגִנָּם הוּא׃
verses.english: O Yisra᾽el, trust in the Lord: he is their help and their shield.

verses.hebrew: בֵּית אַהֲרֹן בִּטְחוּ בַיהוָה עֶזְרָם וּמָגִנָּם הוּא׃
verses.english: O house of Aharon, trust in the Lord: he is their help and their shield.

verses.hebrew: יִרְאֵי יְהוָה בִּטְחוּ בַיהוָה עֶזְרָם וּמָגִנָּם הוּא׃
verses.english: You who fear the Lord, trust in the Lord: he is their help and their shield.

verses.hebrew: יְהוָה זְכָרָנוּ יְבָרֵךְ יְבָרֵךְ אֶת־בֵּית יִשְׂרָאֵל יְבָרֵךְ אֶת־בֵּית אַהֲרֹן׃
verses.english: The Lord has been mindful of us: he will bless us; he will bless the house of Yisra᾽el; he will bless the house of Aharon.

verses.hebrew: יְבָרֵךְ יִרְאֵי יְהוָה הַקְּטַנִּים עִם־הַגְּדֹלִים׃
verses.english: He will bless those who fear the Lord, both small and great.

verses.hebrew: יֹסֵף יְהוָה עֲלֵיכֶם עֲלֵיכֶם וְעַל־בְּנֵיכֶם׃
verses.english: May the Lord increase you more and more, you and your children.

verses.hebrew: בְּרוּכִים אַתֶּם לַיהוָה עֹשֵׂה שָׁמַיִם וָאָרֶץ׃
verses.english: May you be blessed of the Lord who made heaven and earth.

verses.hebrew: הַשָּׁמַיִם שָׁמַיִם לַיהוָה וְהָאָרֶץ נָתַן לִבְנֵי־אָדָם׃
verses.english: The heavens are the heavens of the Lord: but he has given the earth to the children of men.

verses.hebrew: לֹא הַמֵּתִים יְהַלְלוּ־יָהּ וְלֹא כָּל־יֹרְדֵי דוּמָה׃
verses.english: The dead cannot praise the Lord, nor can any who go down into silence.

verses.hebrew: וַאֲנַחְנוּ נְבָרֵךְ יָהּ מֵעַתָּה וְעַד־עוֹלָם הַלְלוּ־יָהּ׃
verses.english: But we will bless the Lord from this time forth and for evermore. Haleluya!

verses.hebrew: אָהַבְתִּי כִּי־יִשְׁמַע יְהוָה אֶת־קוֹלִי תַּחֲנוּנָי׃
verses.english: I love the Lord who hears my voice and my supplications.

verses.hebrew: כִּי־הִטָּה אָזְנוֹ לִי וּבְיָמַי אֶקְרָא׃
verses.english: Because he has inclined his ear to me, therefore I will call upon him as long as I live.

verses.hebrew: אֲפָפוּנִי חֶבְלֵי־מָוֶת וּמְצָרֵי שְׁאוֹל מְצָאוּנִי צָרָה וְיָגוֹן אֶמְצָא׃
verses.english: The cords of death surrounded me, and the pains of She᾽ol seized upon me: I found trouble and sorrow.

verses.hebrew: וּבְשֵׁם־יְהוָה אֶקְרָא אָנָּה יְהוָה מַלְּטָה נַפְשִׁי׃
verses.english: Then I called upon the name of the Lord; O Lord, I beseech Thee, deliver my soul.

verses.hebrew: חַנּוּן יְהֹוָה וְצַדִּיק וֵאלֹהֵינוּ מְרַחֵם׃
verses.english: Gracious is the Lord, and just; and our God is merciful.

verses.hebrew: שֹׁמֵר פְּתָאיִם יְהֹוָה דַּלּוֹתִי וְלִי יְהוֹשִׁיעַ׃
verses.english: The Lord preserves the simple: I was brought low, and he saved me.

verses.hebrew: שׁוּבִי נַפְשִׁי לִמְנוּחָיְכִי כִּי־יְהוָה גָּמַל עָלָיְכִי׃
verses.english: Return to thy rest, O my soul; for the Lord has dealt bountifully with thee.

verses.hebrew: כִּי חִלַּצְתָּ נַפְשִׁי מִמָּוֶת אֶת־עֵינִי מִן־דִּמְעָה אֶת־רַגְלִי מִדֶּחִי׃
verses.english: For Thou hast delivered my soul from death, my eyes from tears, and my feet from falling.

verses.hebrew: אֶתְהַלֵּךְ לִפְנֵי יְהוָה בְּאַרְצוֹת הַחַיִּים׃
verses.english: I will walk before the Lord in the land of the living.

verses.hebrew: הֶאֱמַנְתִּי כִּי אֲדַבֵּר אֲנִי עָנִיתִי מְאֹד׃
verses.english: I kept faith even when I said, I am greatly afflicted.

verses.hebrew: אֲנִי אָמַרְתִּי בְחָפְזִי כָּל־הָאָדָם כֹּזֵב׃
verses.english: I said in my haste, Every man is false.

verses.hebrew: מָה־אָשִׁיב לַיהוָה כָּל־תַּגְמוּלוֹהִי עָלָי׃
verses.english: How can I repay the Lord for all his benefits toward me?

verses.hebrew: כּוֹס־יְשׁוּעוֹת אֶשָּׂא וּבְשֵׁם יְהוָה אֶקְרָא׃
verses.english: I will raise the cup of salvation, and call upon the name of the Lord.

verses.hebrew: נְדָרַי לַיהוָה אֲשַׁלֵּם נֶגְדָה־נָּא לְכָל־עַמּוֹ׃
verses.english: I will pay my vows to the Lord now in the presence of all his people.

verses.hebrew: יָקָר בְּעֵינֵי יְהוָה הַמָּוְתָה לַחֲסִידָיו׃
verses.english: Precious in the sight of the Lord is the death of his pious ones.

verses.hebrew: אָנָּה יְהוָה כִּי־אֲנִי עַבְדֶּךָ אֲ‍נִי־עַבְדְּךָ בֶּן־אֲמָתֶךָ פִּתַּחְתָּ לְמוֹסֵרָי׃
verses.english: O Lord, truly I am Thy servant; I am Thy servant, the son of Thy handmaid: Thou hast loosed my bonds.

verses.hebrew: לְךָ־אֶזְבַּח זֶבַח תּוֹדָה וּבְשֵׁם יְהוָה אֶקְרָא׃
verses.english: I will offer to Thee the sacrifice of thanksgiving, and I will call upon the name of the Lord.

verses.hebrew: נְדָרַי לַיהוָה אֲשַׁלֵּם נֶגְדָה־נָּא לְכָל־עַמּוֹ׃
verses.english: I will pay my vows to the Lord in the presence of all his people,

verses.hebrew: בְּחַצְרוֹת בֵּית יְהוָה בְּתוֹכֵכִי יְרוּשָׁלִָם הַלְלוּ־יָהּ׃
verses.english: in the courts of the Lord’s house, in the midst of thee, O Yerushalayim. Haleluya!

verses.hebrew: הַלְלוּ אֶת־יְהוָה כָּל־גּוֹיִם שַׁבְּחוּהוּ כָּל־הָאֻמִּים׃
verses.english: O Praise the Lord, all you nations: praise him all you peoples.

verses.hebrew: כִּי גָבַר עָלֵינוּ חַסְדּוֹ וֶאֱמֶת־יְהוָה לְעוֹלָם הַלְלוּ־יָהּ׃
verses.english: For his love for us is great: and the truth of the Lord endures for ever. Haleluya!

verses.hebrew: הוֹדוּ לַיהוָה כִּי־טוֹב כִּי לְעוֹלָם חַסְדּוֹ׃
verses.english: O Give thanks to the Lord; for he is good: for his steadfast love endures forever.

verses.hebrew: יֹאמַר־נָא יִשְׂרָאֵל כִּי לְעוֹלָם חַסְדּוֹ׃
verses.english: Let Yisra᾽el now say, that his steadfast love endures forever.

verses.hebrew: יֹאמְרוּ־נָא בֵית־אַהֲרֹן כִּי לְעוֹלָם חַסְדּוֹ׃
verses.english: Let the house of Aharon now say, that his steadfast love endures forever.

verses.hebrew: יֹאמְרוּ־נָא יִרְאֵי יְהוָה כִּי לְעוֹלָם חַסְדּוֹ׃
verses.english: Let those now who fear the Lord say, that his steadfast love endures forever.

verses.hebrew: מִן־הַמֵּצַר קָרָאתִי יָּהּ עָנָנִי בַמֶּרְחָב יָהּ׃
verses.english: Out of my distress I called upon the Lord: the Lord answered me with liberation.

verses.hebrew: יְהוָה לִי לֹא אִירָא מַה־יַּעֲשֶׂה לִי אָדָם׃
verses.english: The Lord is on my side; I will not fear: what can a man do to me?

verses.hebrew: יְהוָה לִי בְּעֹזְרָי וַאֲנִי אֶרְאֶה בְשֹׂנְאָי׃
verses.english: The Lord takes my part with those who help me: therefore I shall gaze upon those who hate me.

verses.hebrew: טוֹב לַחֲסוֹת בַּיהוָה מִבְּטֹחַ בָּאָדָם׃
verses.english: It is better to take refuge in the Lord than to put confidence in man.

verses.hebrew: טוֹב לַחֲסוֹת בַּיהוָה מִבְּטֹחַ בִּנְדִיבִים׃
verses.english: It is better to take refuge in the Lord than to trust in princes.

verses.hebrew: כָּל־גּוֹיִם סְבָבוּנִי בְּשֵׁם יְהוָה כִּי אֲמִילַם׃
verses.english: All nations compassed me about: but in the name of the Lord I cut them off.

verses.hebrew: סַבּוּנִי גַם־סְבָבוּנִי בְּשֵׁם יְהוָה כִּי אֲמִילַם׃
verses.english: They compassed me about; indeed, they surrounded me: but in the name of the Lord I cut them off.

verses.hebrew: סַבּוּנִי כִדְבוֹרִים דֹּעֲכוּ כְּאֵשׁ קוֹצִים בְּשֵׁם יְהוָה כִּי אֲמִילַם׃
verses.english: They compassed me about like bees; they are quenched like a fire of thorns: for in the name of the Lord I cut them off.

verses.hebrew: דַּחֹה דְחִיתַנִי לִנְפֹּל וַיהוָה עֲזָרָנִי׃
verses.english: Thou didst push me hard that I might fall: but the Lord helped me.

verses.hebrew: עָזִּי וְזִמְרָת יָהּ וַיְהִי־לִי לִישׁוּעָה׃
verses.english: The Lord is my strength and song, and is become my salvation.

verses.hebrew: קוֹל רִנָּה וִישׁוּעָה בְּאָהֳלֵי צַדִּיקִים יְמִין יְהוָה עֹשָׂה חָיִל׃
verses.english: The voice of rejoicing and salvation is in the tents of the righteous: the right hand of the Lord does valiantly.

verses.hebrew: יְמִין יְהוָה רוֹמֵמָה יְמִין יְהוָה עֹשָׂה חָיִל׃
verses.english: The right hand of the Lord is exalted: the right hand of the Lord does valiantly.

verses.hebrew: לֹא אָמוּת כִּי־אֶחְיֶה וַאֲסַפֵּר מַעֲשֵׂי יָהּ׃
verses.english: I shall not die, but live, and declare the works of the Lord.

verses.hebrew: יַסֹּר יִסְּרַנִּי יָּהּ וְלַמָּוֶת לֹא נְתָנָנִי׃
verses.english: The Lord has chastised me severely: but he has not given me up to death.

verses.hebrew: פִּתְחוּ־לִי שַׁעֲרֵי־צֶדֶק אָבֹא־בָם אוֹדֶה יָהּ׃
verses.english: Open to me the gates of righteousness: I will go in to them, and I will praise the Lord:

verses.hebrew: זֶה־הַשַּׁעַר לַיהוָה צַדִּיקִים יָבֹאוּ בוֹ׃
verses.english: this is the gate of the Lord, into which the righteous shall enter.

verses.hebrew: אוֹדְךָ כִּי עֲנִיתָנִי וַתְּהִי־לִי לִישׁוּעָה׃
verses.english: I will give Thee thanks, for Thou hast answered me, and art become my salvation.

verses.hebrew: אֶבֶן מָאֲסוּ הַבּוֹנִים הָיְתָה לְרֹאשׁ פִּנָּה׃
verses.english: The stone which the builders rejected has become the head stone of the corner.

verses.hebrew: מֵאֵת יְהוָה הָיְתָה זֹּאת הִיא נִפְלָאת בְּעֵינֵינוּ׃
verses.english: This is the Lord’s doing; it is marvellous in our eyes.

verses.hebrew: זֶה־הַיּוֹם עָשָׂה יְהוָה נָגִילָה וְנִשְׂמְחָה בוֹ׃
verses.english: This is the day which the Lord has made; we will rejoice and be glad in it.

verses.hebrew: אָנָּא יְהוָה הוֹשִׁיעָה נָּא אָנָּא יְהוָה הַצְלִיחָה נָּא׃
verses.english: Save us, O Lord, we pray Thee: we pray Thee, O Lord, prosper us.

verses.hebrew: בָּרוּךְ הַבָּא בְּשֵׁם יְהוָה בֵּרַכְנוּכֶם מִבֵּית יְהוָה׃
verses.english: Blessed is he who comes in the name of the Lord: we have blessed you out of the house of the Lord.

verses.hebrew: אֵל יְהוָה וַיָּאֶר לָנוּ אִסְרוּ־חַג בַּעֲבֹתִים עַד־קַרְנוֹת הַמִּזְבֵּחַ׃
verses.english: God is the Lord, who has shown us light: bind the sacrifice with cords, to the horns of the altar.

verses.hebrew: אֵלִי אַתָּה וְאוֹדֶךָּ אֱלֹהַי אֲרוֹמְמֶךָּ׃
verses.english: Thou art my God, and I will praise Thee: my God, I will exalt Thee.

verses.hebrew: הוֹדוּ לַיהוָה כִּי־טוֹב כִּי לְעוֹלָם חַסְדּוֹ׃
verses.english: O give thanks to the Lord; for he is good: for his steadfast love endures forever.

verses.hebrew: אַשְׁרֵי תְמִימֵי־דָרֶךְ הַהֹלְכִים בְּתוֹרַת יְהוָה׃
verses.english: Happy are those whose way is blameless, who walk in the Tora of the Lord.

verses.hebrew: אַשְׁרֵי נֹצְרֵי עֵדֹתָיו בְּכָל־לֵב יִדְרְשׁוּהוּ׃
verses.english: Happy are they who keep his testimonies and seek him with the whole heart.

verses.hebrew: אַף לֹא־פָעֲלוּ עַוְלָה בִּדְרָכָיו הָלָכוּ׃
verses.english: They also do no iniquity: they walk in his ways.

verses.hebrew: אַתָּה צִוִּיתָה פִקֻּדֶיךָ לִשְׁמֹר מְאֹד׃
verses.english: Thou hast commanded Thy precepts to be kept diligently.

verses.hebrew: אַחֲלַי יִכֹּנוּ דְרָכָי לִשְׁמֹר חֻקֶּיךָ׃
verses.english: O that my ways were directed to keep Thy statutes!

verses.hebrew: אָז לֹא־אֵבוֹשׁ בְּהַבִּיטִי אֶל־כָּל־מִצְוֺתֶיךָ׃
verses.english: Then should I not be ashamed, when I observe all Thy commandments.

verses.hebrew: אוֹדְךָ בְּיֹשֶׁר לֵבָב בְּלָמְדִי מִשְׁפְּטֵי צִדְקֶךָ׃
verses.english: I shall give Thee thanks with uprightness of heart, when I learn Thy righteous judgments.

verses.hebrew: אֶת־חֻקֶּיךָ אֶשְׁמֹר אַל־תַּעַזְבֵנִי עַד־מְאֹד׃
verses.english: I will keep Thy statutes: O do not forsake me utterly.

verses.hebrew: בַּמֶּה יְזַכֶּה־נַּעַר אֶת־אָרְחוֹ לִשְׁמֹר כִּדְבָרֶךָ׃
verses.english: Wherewith shall a young man keep his way pure? by guarding it according to Thy word.

verses.hebrew: בְּכָל־לִבִּי דְרַשְׁתִּיךָ אַל־תַּשְׁגֵּנִי מִמִּצְוֺתֶיךָ׃
verses.english: With my whole heart I have sought Thee: O let me not wander from Thy commandments.

verses.hebrew: בְּלִבִּי צָפַנְתִּי אִמְרָתֶךָ לְמַעַן לֹא אֶחֱטָא־לָךְ׃
verses.english: Thy word have I hid in my heart, that I might not sin against Thee.

verses.hebrew: בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְהוָה לַמְּדֵנִי חֻקֶּיךָ׃
verses.english: Blessed art Thou, O Lord: teach me Thy statutes.

verses.hebrew: בִּשְׂפָתַי סִפַּרְתִּי כֹּל מִשְׁפְּטֵי־פִיךָ׃
verses.english: With my lips I have declared all the judgments of Thy mouth.

verses.hebrew: בְּדֶרֶךְ עֵדְוֺתֶיךָ שַׂשְׂתִּי כְּעַל כָּל־הוֹן׃
verses.english: I have rejoiced in the way of Thy testimonies, as much as in all riches.

verses.hebrew: בְּפִקֻּדֶיךָ אָשִׂיחָה וְאַבִּיטָה אֹרְחֹתֶיךָ׃
verses.english: I will meditate in Thy precepts, and observe Thy ways.

verses.hebrew: בְּחֻקֹּתֶיךָ אֶשְׁתַּעֲשָׁע לֹא אֶשְׁכַּח דְּבָרֶךָ׃
verses.english: I will delight myself in Thy statutes: I will not forget Thy word.

verses.hebrew: גְּמֹל עַל־עַבְדְּךָ אֶחְיֶה וְאֶשְׁמְרָה דְבָרֶךָ׃
verses.english: Deal bountifully with Thy servant, that I may live, and keep Thy word.

verses.hebrew: גַּל־עֵינַי וְאַבִּיטָה נִפְלָאוֹת מִתּוֹרָתֶךָ׃
verses.english: Open Thou my eyes, that I may behold wondrous things out of Thy Tora.

verses.hebrew: גֵּר אָנֹכִי בָאָרֶץ אַל־תַּסְתֵּר מִמֶּנִּי מִצְוֺתֶיךָ׃
verses.english: I am a stranger on the earth: do not hide Thy commandments from me.

verses.hebrew: גָּרְסָה נַפְשִׁי לְתַאֲבָה אֶל־מִשְׁפָּטֶיךָ בְכָל־עֵת׃
verses.english: My soul is consumed with the longing that it has to Thy judgments at all times.

verses.hebrew: גָּעַרְתָּ זֵדִים אֲרוּרִים הַשֹּׁגִים מִמִּצְוֺתֶיךָ׃
verses.english: Thou hast rebuked the proud that are cursed, who wander from Thy commandments.

verses.hebrew: גַּל מֵעָלַי חֶרְפָּה וָבוּז כִּי עֵדֹתֶיךָ נָצָרְתִּי׃
verses.english: Remove insult and contempt from me; for I have kept Thy testimonies.

verses.hebrew: גַּם יָשְׁבוּ שָׂרִים בִּי נִדְבָּרוּ עַבְדְּךָ יָשִׂיחַ בְּחֻקֶּיךָ׃
verses.english: Princes also did sit and speak against me: but Thy servant did meditate on Thy statutes.

verses.hebrew: גַּם־עֵדֹתֶיךָ שַׁעֲשֻׁעָי אַנְשֵׁי עֲצָתִי׃
verses.english: Thy testimonies also are my delight; they are my counsellors.

verses.hebrew: דָּבְקָה לֶעָפָר נַפְשִׁי חַיֵּנִי כִּדְבָרֶךָ׃
verses.english: My soul cleaves to the dust: revive me according to Thy word.

verses.hebrew: דְּרָכַי סִפַּרְתִּי וַתַּעֲנֵנִי לַמְּדֵנִי חֻקֶּיךָ׃
verses.english: I have declared my ways, and Thou didst hear me: teach me Thy statutes.

verses.hebrew: דֶּרֶךְ־פִּקּוּדֶיךָ הֲבִינֵנִי וְאָשִׂיחָה בְּנִפְלְאוֹתֶיךָ׃
verses.english: Make me to understand the way of Thy precepts: so I shall talk of Thy wondrous works.

verses.hebrew: דָּלְפָה נַפְשִׁי מִתּוּגָה קַיְּמֵנִי כִּדְבָרֶךָ׃
verses.english: My soul melts away for heaviness: strengthen me according to Thy word.

verses.hebrew: דֶּרֶךְ־שֶׁקֶר הָסֵר מִמֶּנִּי וְתוֹרָתְךָ חָנֵּנִי׃
verses.english: Remove from me the way of falsehood: and graciously bestow Thy Tora upon me.

verses.hebrew: דֶּרֶךְ־אֱמוּנָה בָחָרְתִּי מִשְׁפָּטֶיךָ שִׁוִּיתִי׃
verses.english: I have chosen the way of truth: Thy judgments have I laid before me.

verses.hebrew: דָּבַקְתִּי בְעֵדְוֺתֶיךָ יְהוָה אַל־תְּבִישֵׁנִי׃
verses.english: I have held fast to Thy testimonies: O Lord, put me not to shame.

verses.hebrew: דֶּרֶךְ־מִצְוֺתֶיךָ אָרוּץ כִּי תַרְחִיב לִבִּי׃
verses.english: I will run the way of Thy commandments, for therein Thou dost enlarge my heart.

verses.hebrew: הוֹרֵנִי יְהוָה דֶּרֶךְ חֻקֶּיךָ וְאֶצְּרֶנָּה עֵקֶב׃
verses.english: Teach me, O Lord, the way of Thy statutes; and I shall keep it to the end.

verses.hebrew: הֲבִינֵנִי וְאֶצְּרָה תוֹרָתֶךָ וְאֶשְׁמְרֶנָּה בְכָל־לֵב׃
verses.english: Give me understanding, and I shall keep Thy Tora; and I shall observe it with my whole heart.

verses.hebrew: הַדְרִיכֵנִי בִּנְתִיב מִצְוֺתֶיךָ כִּי־בוֹ חָפָצְתִּי׃
verses.english: Make me to go in the path of Thy commandments; for therein do I delight.

verses.hebrew: הַט־לִבִּי אֶל־עֵדְוֺתֶיךָ וְאַל אֶל־בָּצַע׃
verses.english: Incline my heart to Thy testimonies, and not to unjust gain.

verses.hebrew: הַעֲבֵר עֵינַי מֵרְאוֹת שָׁוְא בִּדְרָכֶךָ חַיֵּנִי׃
verses.english: Turn away my eyes from beholding vanity; and give me life in Thy way.

verses.hebrew: הָקֵם לְעַבְדְּךָ אִמְרָתֶךָ אֲשֶׁר לְיִרְאָתֶךָ׃
verses.english: Confirm to Thy servant Thy word, which relates to the fear of Thee.

verses.hebrew: הַעֲבֵר חֶרְפָּתִי אֲשֶׁר יָגֹרְתִּי כִּי מִשְׁפָּטֶיךָ טוֹבִים׃
verses.english: Turn away my insult which I fear: for Thy judgments are good.

verses.hebrew: הִנֵּה תָּאַבְתִּי לְפִקֻּדֶיךָ בְּצִדְקָתְךָ חַיֵּנִי׃
verses.english: Behold, I have longed after Thy precepts: give me life in Thy righteousness.

verses.hebrew: וִיבֹאֻנִי חֲסָדֶךָ יְהוָה תְּשׁוּעָתְךָ כְּאִמְרָתֶךָ׃
verses.english: And let Thy promises of steadfast love come to pass for me, O Lord; even Thy salvation; according to Thy word.

verses.hebrew: וְאֶעֱנֶה חֹרְפִי דָבָר כִּי־בָטַחְתִּי בִּדְבָרֶךָ׃
verses.english: So shall I have wherewith to answer him who insults me: for I trust in Thy word.

verses.hebrew: וְאַל־תַּצֵּל מִפִּי דְבַר־אֱמֶת עַד־מְאֹד כִּי לְמִשְׁפָּטֶךָ יִחָלְתִּי׃
verses.english: And take not the word of truth utterly out of my mouth; for I have hoped in Thy judgments.

verses.hebrew: וְאֶשְׁמְרָה תוֹרָתְךָ תָמִיד לְעוֹלָם וָעֶד׃
verses.english: So shall I keep Thy Tora continually for ever and ever.

verses.hebrew: וְאֶתְהַלְּכָה בָרְחָבָה כִּי פִקֻּדֶיךָ דָרָשְׁתִּי׃
verses.english: And I will walk at liberty: for I seek Thy precepts.

verses.hebrew: וַאֲדַבְּרָה בְעֵדֹתֶיךָ נֶגֶד מְלָכִים וְלֹא אֵבוֹשׁ׃
verses.english: I will also speak of Thy testimonies before kings, and will not be ashamed.

verses.hebrew: וְאֶשְׁתַּעֲשַׁע בְּמִצְוֺתֶיךָ אֲשֶׁר אָהָבְתִּי׃
verses.english: And I will delight myself in Thy commandments, which I have loved.

verses.hebrew: וְאֶשָּׂא־כַפַּי אֶל־מִצְוֺתֶיךָ אֲשֶׁר אָהָבְתִּי וְאָשִׂיחָה בְחֻקֶּיךָ׃
verses.english: My hands also will I lift up to Thy commandments, which I have loved; and I will meditate on Thy statutes.

verses.hebrew: זְכֹר־דָּבָר לְעַבְדֶּךָ עַל אֲשֶׁר יִחַלְתָּנִי׃
verses.english: Remember the word to Thy servant, whereby Thou hast given me hope.

verses.hebrew: זֹאת נֶחָמָתִי בְעָנְיִי כִּי אִמְרָתְךָ חִיָּתְנִי׃
verses.english: This is my comfort in my affliction: for Thy word has revived me.

verses.hebrew: זֵדִים הֱלִיצֻנִי עַד־מְאֹד מִתּוֹרָתְךָ לֹא נָטִיתִי׃
verses.english: The proud have had me greatly in derision: yet I have not declined from Thy Tora.

verses.hebrew: זָכַרְתִּי מִשְׁפָּטֶיךָ מֵעוֹלָם יְהוָה וָאֶתְנֶחָם׃
verses.english: When I remembered thy judgments of old, O Lord, I took comfort.

verses.hebrew: זַלְעָפָה אֲחָזַתְנִי מֵרְשָׁעִים עֹזְבֵי תּוֹרָתֶךָ׃
verses.english: Horror has taken hold of me because of the wicked who forsake Thy Tora.

verses.hebrew: זְמִרוֹת הָיוּ־לִי חֻקֶּיךָ בְּבֵית מְגוּרָי׃
verses.english: Thy statutes have been my songs in the house of my pilgrimage.

verses.hebrew: זָכַרְתִּי בַלַּיְלָה שִׁמְךָ יְהוָה וָאֶשְׁמְרָה תּוֹרָתֶךָ׃
verses.english: I have remembered Thy name, O Lord, in the night, and have kept Thy Tora.

verses.hebrew: זֹאת הָיְתָה־לִּי כִּי פִקֻּדֶיךָ נָצָרְתִּי׃
verses.english: This was my lot, because I kept Thy precepts.

verses.hebrew: חֶלְקִי יְהוָה אָמַרְתִּי לִשְׁמֹר דְּבָרֶיךָ׃
verses.english: The Lord is my portion: I have said that I would keep Thy words.

verses.hebrew: חִלִּיתִי פָנֶיךָ בְכָל־לֵב חָנֵּנִי כְּאִמְרָתֶךָ׃
verses.english: I entreated Thy favour with my whole heart: be merciful to me according to Thy word.

verses.hebrew: חִשַּׁבְתִּי דְרָכָי וָאָשִׁיבָה רַגְלַי אֶל־עֵדֹתֶיךָ׃
verses.english: I thought on my ways, and turned my feet to Thy testimonies.

verses.hebrew: חַשְׁתִּי וְלֹא הִתְמַהְמָהְתִּי לִשְׁמֹר מִצְוֺתֶיךָ׃
verses.english: I made haste, and delayed not to keep Thy commandments.

verses.hebrew: חֶבְלֵי רְשָׁעִים עִוְּדֻנִי תּוֹרָתְךָ לֹא שָׁכָחְתִּי׃
verses.english: Bands of wicked men have robbed me: but I have not forgotten Thy Tora.

verses.hebrew: חֲצוֹת־לַיְלָה אָקוּם לְהוֹדוֹת לָךְ עַל מִשְׁפְּטֵי צִדְקֶךָ׃
verses.english: At midnight I will rise to give thanks to Thee because of Thy righteous judgments.

verses.hebrew: חָבֵר אָנִי לְכָל־אֲשֶׁר יְרֵאוּךָ וּלְשֹׁמְרֵי פִּקּוּדֶיךָ׃
verses.english: I am a companion of all those who fear Thee, and of those who keep Thy precepts.

verses.hebrew: חַסְדְּךָ יְהוָה מָלְאָה הָאָרֶץ חֻקֶּיךָ לַמְּדֵנִי׃
verses.english: The earth, O Lord, is full of Thy steadfast love: teach me Thy statutes.

verses.hebrew: טוֹב עָשִׂיתָ עִם־עַבְדְּךָ יְהוָה כִּדְבָרֶךָ׃
verses.english: Thou hast dealt well with Thy servant, O Lord, according to Thy word.

verses.hebrew: טוּב טַעַם וָדַעַת לַמְּדֵנִי כִּי בְמִצְוֺתֶיךָ הֶאֱמָנְתִּי׃
verses.english: Teach me good discernment and knowledge: for I have believed Thy commandments.

verses.hebrew: טֶרֶם אֶעֱנֶה אֲנִי שֹׁגֵג וְעַתָּה אִמְרָתְךָ שָׁמָרְתִּי׃
verses.english: Before I was afflicted I went astray: but now I observe Thy word.

verses.hebrew: טוֹב־אַתָּה וּמֵטִיב לַמְּדֵנִי חֻקֶּיךָ׃
verses.english: Thou art good, and doest good; teach me Thy statutes.

verses.hebrew: טָפְלוּ עָלַי שֶׁקֶר זֵדִים אֲנִי בְּכָל־לֵב אֱצֹּר פִּקּוּדֶיךָ׃
verses.english: The proud have smeared me with a lie: but I will keep Thy precepts with my whole heart.

verses.hebrew: טָפַשׁ כַּחֵלֶב לִבָּם אֲנִי תּוֹרָתְךָ שִׁעֲשָׁעְתִּי׃
verses.english: Their heart is gross like fat, but I delight in Thy Tora.

verses.hebrew: טוֹב־לִי כִי־עֻנֵּיתִי לְמַעַן אֶלְמַד חֻקֶּיךָ׃
verses.english: It is good for me that I have been afflicted; that I might learn Thy statutes.

verses.hebrew: טוֹב־לִי תוֹרַת־פִּיךָ מֵאַלְפֵי זָהָב וָכָסֶף׃
verses.english: The Tora of Thy mouth is better to me than thousands of gold and silver.

verses.hebrew: יָדֶיךָ עָשׂוּנִי וַיְכוֹנְנוּנִי הֲבִינֵנִי וְאֶלְמְדָה מִצְוֺתֶיךָ׃
verses.english: Thy hands have made me and fashioned me: give me understanding, that I may learn Thy commandments.

verses.hebrew: יְרֵאֶיךָ יִרְאוּנִי וְיִשְׂמָחוּ כִּי לִדְבָרְךָ יִחָלְתִּי׃
verses.english: They who fear Thee will see me and be glad, because I have hoped in Thy word.

verses.hebrew: יָדַעְתִּי יְהוָה כִּי־צֶדֶק מִשְׁפָּטֶיךָ וֶאֱמוּנָה עִנִּיתָנִי׃
verses.english: I know, O Lord, that Thy judgments are right, and that in faithfulness Thou has afflicted me.

verses.hebrew: יְהִי־נָא חַסְדְּךָ לְנַחֲמֵנִי כְּאִמְרָתְךָ לְעַבְדֶּךָ׃
verses.english: Let Thy steadfast love be my comfort, according to Thy word to Thy servant.

verses.hebrew: יְבֹאוּנִי רַחֲמֶיךָ וְאֶחְיֶה כִּי־תוֹרָתְךָ שַׁעֲשֻׁעָי׃
verses.english: Let Thy mercies come to me, that I may live: for Thy Tora is my delight.

verses.hebrew: יֵבֹשׁוּ זֵדִים כִּי־שֶׁקֶר עִוְּתוּנִי אֲנִי אָשִׂיחַ בְּפִקּוּדֶיךָ׃
verses.english: Let the proud be ashamed; for they dealt perversely with me with guile: but I will meditate on Thy precepts.

verses.hebrew: יָשׁוּבוּ לִי יְרֵאֶיךָ וידעו [וְיֹדְעֵי] עֵדֹתֶיךָ׃
verses.english: Let those who fear Thee turn to me, and those who have known Thy testimonies.

verses.hebrew: יְהִי־לִבִּי תָמִים בְּחֻקֶּיךָ לְמַעַן לֹא אֵבוֹשׁ׃
verses.english: Let my heart be sound in Thy statutes; that I be not ashamed.

verses.hebrew: כָּלְתָה לִתְשׁוּעָתְךָ נַפְשִׁי לִדְבָרְךָ יִחָלְתִּי׃
verses.english: My soul faints for Thy salvation: I hope in Thy word.

verses.hebrew: כָּלוּ עֵינַי לְאִמְרָתֶךָ לֵאמֹר מָתַי תְּנַחֲמֵנִי׃
verses.english: My eyes fail with longing for Thy word, saying, When wilt Thou comfort me?

verses.hebrew: כִּי־הָיִיתִי כְּנֹאד בְּקִיטוֹר חֻקֶּיךָ לֹא שָׁכָחְתִּי׃
verses.english: For I am become like a wineskin in the smoke; yet I do not forget Thy statutes.

verses.hebrew: כַּמָּה יְמֵי־עַבְדֶּךָ מָתַי תַּעֲשֶׂה בְרֹדְפַי מִשְׁפָּט׃
verses.english: How many are the days of Thy servant? when wilt Thou execute judgment on those who persecute me?

verses.hebrew: כָּרוּ־לִי זֵדִים שִׁיחוֹת אֲשֶׁר לֹא כְתוֹרָתֶךָ׃
verses.english: The proud have dug pits for me, which are not according to Thy Tora.

verses.hebrew: כָּל־מִצְוֺתֶיךָ אֱמוּנָה שֶׁקֶר רְדָפוּנִי עָזְרֵנִי׃
verses.english: All Thy commandments are faithful: they persecute me wrongfully; help Thou me.

verses.hebrew: כִּמְעַט כִּלּוּנִי בָאָרֶץ וַאֲנִי לֹא־עָזַבְתִּי פִקֻּודֶיךָ׃
verses.english: They had almost consumed me upon earth; but I forsook not Thy precepts.

verses.hebrew: כְּחַסְדְּךָ חַיֵּנִי וְאֶשְׁמְרָה עֵדוּת פִּיךָ׃
verses.english: In Thy steadfast love spare my life; so I shall keep the testimony of Thy mouth.

verses.hebrew: לְעוֹלָם יְהוָה דְּבָרְךָ נִצָּב בַּשָּׁמָיִם׃
verses.english: For ever, O Lord; Thy word stands fast in the heavens.

verses.hebrew: לְדֹר וָדֹר אֱמוּנָתֶךָ כּוֹנַנְתָּ אֶרֶץ וַתַּעֲמֹד׃
verses.english: Thy faithfulness endures to all generations: Thou hast established the earth, and it stands firm.

verses.hebrew: לְמִשְׁפָּטֶיךָ עָמְדוּ הַיּוֹם כִּי הַכֹּל עֲבָדֶיךָ׃
verses.english: They continue this day according to Thy ordinances: for all are Thy servants.

verses.hebrew: לוּלֵי תוֹרָתְךָ שַׁעֲשֻׁעָי אָז אָבַדְתִּי בְעָנְיִי׃
verses.english: Unless Thy Tora had been my delights, I should have perished in my affliction.

verses.hebrew: לְעוֹלָם לֹא־אֶשְׁכַּח פִּקּוּדֶיךָ כִּי בָם חִיִּיתָנִי׃
verses.english: I will never forget Thy precepts: for with them Thou hast given me life.

verses.hebrew: לְךָ־אֲנִי הוֹשִׁיעֵנִי כִּי פִקּוּדֶיךָ דָרָשְׁתִּי׃
verses.english: I am Thine, save me; for I have sought Thy precepts.

verses.hebrew: לִי קִוּוּ רְשָׁעִים לְאַבְּדֵנִי עֵדֹתֶיךָ אֶתְבּוֹנָן׃
verses.english: The wicked have waited for me to destroy me: but I will consider Thy testimonies.

verses.hebrew: לְכָל תִּכְלָה רָאִיתִי קֵץ רְחָבָה מִצְוָתְךָ מְאֹד׃
verses.english: I have seen an end of every purpose: but Thy commandment is exceedingly broad.

verses.hebrew: מָה־אָהַבְתִּי תוֹרָתֶךָ כָּל־הַיּוֹם הִיא שִׂיחָתִי׃
verses.english: O how I love Thy Tora! it is my meditation all the day.

verses.hebrew: מֵאֹיְבַי תְּחַכְּמֵנִי מִצְוֺתֶךָ כִּי לְעוֹלָם הִיא־לִי׃
verses.english: Thy commandments make me wiser than my enemies: for they are ever with me.

verses.hebrew: מִכָּל־מְלַמְּדַי הִשְׂכַּלְתִּי כִּי עֵדְוֺתֶיךָ שִׂיחָה לִי׃
verses.english: I have more understanding than all my teachers: for Thy testimonies are my meditation.

verses.hebrew: מִזְּקֵנִים אֶתְבּוֹנָן כִּי פִקּוּדֶיךָ נָצָרְתִּי׃
verses.english: I understand more than the elders, because I keep Thy precepts.

verses.hebrew: מִכָּל־אֹרַח רָע כָּלִאתִי רַגְלָי לְמַעַן אֶשְׁמֹר דְּבָרֶךָ׃
verses.english: I have restrained my feet from every evil way, that I might keep Thy word.

verses.hebrew: מִמִּשְׁפָּטֶיךָ לֹא־סָרְתִּי כִּי־אַתָּה הוֹרֵתָנִי׃
verses.english: I have not departed from Thy judgments: for Thou hast taught me.

verses.hebrew: מַה־נִּמְלְצוּ לְחִכִּי אִמְרָתֶךָ מִדְּבַשׁ לְפִי׃
verses.english: How sweet are Thy words to my palate! sweeter than honey to my mouth!

verses.hebrew: מִפִּקּוּדֶיךָ אֶתְבּוֹנָן עַל־כֵּן שָׂנֵאתִי כָּל־אֹרַח שָׁקֶר׃
verses.english: Through Thy precepts I get understanding: therefore I hate every false way.

verses.hebrew: נֵר־לְרַגְלִי דְבָרֶךָ וְאוֹר לִנְתִיבָתִי׃
