verses.english: Thy word is a lamp to my feet and a light to my path.

verses.hebrew: נִשְׁבַּעְתִּי וָאֲקַיֵּמָה לִשְׁמֹר מִשְׁפְּטֵי צִדְקֶךָ׃
verses.english: I have sworn, and I will perform it, that I will keep Thy righteous judgments.

verses.hebrew: נַעֲנֵיתִי עַד־מְאֹד יְהוָה חַיֵּנִי כִדְבָרֶךָ׃
verses.english: I am afflicted very much: revive me, O Lord, according to Thy word.

verses.hebrew: נִדְבוֹת פִּי רְצֵה־נָא יְהוָה וּמִשְׁפָּטֶיךָ לַמְּדֵנִי׃
verses.english: Accept I beseech Thee, the freewill offerings of my mouth, O Lord, and teach me Thy ordinances.

verses.hebrew: נַפְשִׁי בְכַפִּי תָמִיד וְתוֹרָתְךָ לֹא שָׁכָחְתִּי׃
verses.english: My soul is continually in my hand: yet I have not forgotten Thy Tora.

verses.hebrew: נָתְנוּ רְשָׁעִים פַּח לִי וּמִפִּקּוּדֶיךָ לֹא תָעִיתִי׃
verses.english: The wicked have laid a snare for me: yet I have not strayed from Thy precepts.

verses.hebrew: נָחַלְתִּי עֵדְוֺתֶיךָ לְעוֹלָם כִּי־שְׂשׂוֹן לִבִּי הֵמָּה׃
verses.english: Thy testimonies I have taken as a heritage for ever: for they are the rejoicing of my heart.

verses.hebrew: נָטִיתִי לִבִּי לַעֲשׂוֹת חֻקֶּיךָ לְעוֹלָם עֵקֶב׃
verses.english: I have inclined my heart to perform Thy statutes always, to the end.

verses.hebrew: סֵעֲפִים שָׂנֵאתִי וְתוֹרָתְךָ אָהָבְתִּי׃
verses.english: I hate men of vain thoughts: but Thy Tora I love.

verses.hebrew: סִתְרִי וּמָגִנִּי אָתָּה לִדְבָרְךָ יִחָלְתִּי׃
verses.english: Thou art my hiding place and my shield: I hope in Thy word.

verses.hebrew: סוּרוּ־מִמֶּנִּי מְרֵעִים וְאֶצְּרָה מִצְוֺת אֱלֹהָי׃
verses.english: Depart from me, you evildoers: for I will keep commandments of my God.

verses.hebrew: סָמְכֵנִי כְאִמְרָתְךָ וְאֶחְיֶה וְאַל־תְּבִישֵׁנִי מִשִּׂבְרִי׃
verses.english: Uphold me according to Thy word, that I may live: and let me not be ashamed of my hope.

verses.hebrew: סְעָדֵנִי וְאִוָּשֵׁעָה וְאֶשְׁעָה בְחֻקֶּיךָ תָמִיד׃
verses.english: Hold me up, and I shall be safe: and I will watch Thy statutes continually,

verses.hebrew: סָלִיתָ כָּל־שׁוֹגִים מֵחֻקֶּיךָ כִּי־שֶׁקֶר תַּרְמִיתָם׃
verses.english: Thou hast trodden down all those who stray from Thy statutes: for their deceit is vain.

verses.hebrew: סִגִים הִשְׁבַּתָּ כָל־רִשְׁעֵי־אָרֶץ לָכֵן אָהַבְתִּי עֵדֹתֶיךָ׃
verses.english: Thou puttest away all the wicked of the earth like dross: therefore I love Thy testimonies.

verses.hebrew: סָמַר מִפַּחְדְּךָ בְשָׂרִי וּמִמִּשְׁפָּטֶיךָ יָרֵאתִי׃
verses.english: My flesh shudders for fear of Thee; and I am afraid of Thy judgments.

verses.hebrew: עָשִׂיתִי מִשְׁפָּט וָצֶדֶק בַּל־תַּנִּיחֵנִי לְעֹשְׁקָי׃
verses.english: I have done justice and righteousness: leave me not to my oppressors.

verses.hebrew: עֲרֹב עַבְדְּךָ לְטוֹב אַל־יַעַשְׁקֻנִי זֵדִים׃
verses.english: Be surety for Thy servant for good: let not the proud oppress me.

verses.hebrew: עֵינַי כָּלוּ לִישׁוּעָתֶךָ וּלְאִמְרַת צִדְקֶךָ׃
verses.english: My eyes fail with watching for Thy salvation, and for the word of Thy righteousness.

verses.hebrew: עֲשֵׂה עִם־עַבְדְּךָ כְחַסְדֶּךָ וְחֻקֶּיךָ לַמְּדֵנִי׃
verses.english: Deal with Thy servant according to Thy steadfast love, and teach me Thy statutes.

verses.hebrew: עַבְדְּךָ־אָנִי הֲבִינֵנִי וְאֵדְעָה עֵדֹתֶיךָ׃
verses.english: I am Thy servant; give me understanding, that I may know Thy testimonies.

verses.hebrew: עֵת לַעֲשׂוֹת לַיהוָה הֵפֵרוּ תּוֹרָתֶךָ׃
verses.english: It is time to act for the Lord: they have made void Thy Tora.

verses.hebrew: עַל־כֵּן אָהַבְתִּי מִצְוֺתֶיךָ מִזָּהָב וּמִפָּז׃
verses.english: Therefore I love Thy commandments above gold; yea, above fine gold.

verses.hebrew: עַל־כֵּן כָּל־פִּקּוּדֵי כֹל יִשָּׁרְתִּי כָּל־אֹרַח שֶׁקֶר שָׂנֵאתִי׃
verses.english: Therefore I esteem all Thy precepts to be entirely right; and I have loathed every false way.

verses.hebrew: פְּלָאוֹת עֵדְוֺתֶיךָ עַל־כֵּן נְצָרָתַם נַפְשִׁי׃
verses.english: Thy testimonies are wonderful: therefore my soul keeps them.

verses.hebrew: פֵּתַח דְּבָרֶיךָ יָאִיר מֵבִין פְּתָיִים׃
verses.english: The unfolding of Thy words gives light; it gives understanding to the simple.

verses.hebrew: פִּי־פָעַרְתִּי וָאֶשְׁאָפָה כִּי לְמִצְוֺתֶיךָ יָאָבְתִּי׃
verses.english: With open mouth I pant: because I long for Thy commandments.

verses.hebrew: פְּנֵה־אֵלַי וְחָנֵּנִי כְּמִשְׁפָּט לְאֹהֲבֵי שְׁמֶךָ׃
verses.english: Look upon me, and be gracious unto me, as is Thy wont towards those who love Thy name.

verses.hebrew: פְּעָמַי הָכֵן בְּאִמְרָתֶךָ וְאַל־תַּשְׁלֶט־בִּי כָל־אָוֶן׃
verses.english: Order my steps in Thy word: and let not any iniquity have dominion over me.

verses.hebrew: פְּדֵנִי מֵעֹשֶׁק אָדָם וְאֶשְׁמְרָה פִּקּוּדֶיךָ׃
verses.english: Deliver me from the oppression of man: and I will keep Thy precepts.

verses.hebrew: פָּנֶיךָ הָאֵר בְּעַבְדֶּךָ וְלַמְּדֵנִי אֶת־חֻקֶּיךָ׃
verses.english: Make Thy face to shine upon Thy servant; and teach me Thy statutes.

verses.hebrew: פַּלְגֵי־מַיִם יָרְדוּ עֵינָי עַל לֹא־שָׁמְרוּ תוֹרָתֶךָ׃
verses.english: Rivers of water run down from my eyes, because they do not keep Thy Tora.

verses.hebrew: צַדִּיק אַתָּה יְהוָה וְיָשָׁר מִשְׁפָּטֶיךָ׃
verses.english: Righteous art Thou, O Lord and upright are Thy judgments.

verses.hebrew: צִוִּיתָ צֶדֶק עֵדֹתֶיךָ וֶאֱמוּנָה מְאֹד׃
verses.english: Thou hast commanded Thy testimonies in righteousness and in great faithfulness.

verses.hebrew: צִמְּתַתְנִי קִנְאָתִי כִּי־שָׁכְחוּ דְבָרֶיךָ צָרָי׃
verses.english: My zeal consumes me, because my enemies have forgotten Thy words.

verses.hebrew: צְרוּפָה אִמְרָתְךָ מְאֹד וְעַבְדְּךָ אֲהֵבָהּ׃
verses.english: Thy word is very pure: therefore Thy servant loves it.

verses.hebrew: צָעִיר אָנֹכִי וְנִבְזֶה פִּקֻּדֶיךָ לֹא שָׁכָחְתִּי׃
verses.english: I am small and despised: yet I do not forget Thy precepts.

verses.hebrew: צִדְקָתְךָ צֶדֶק לְעוֹלָם וְתוֹרָתְךָ אֱמֶת׃
verses.english: Thy righteousness is an everlasting righteousness, and Thy Tora is truth.

verses.hebrew: צַר־וּמָצוֹק מְצָאוּנִי מִצְוֺתֶיךָ שַׁעֲשֻׁעָי׃
verses.english: Trouble and anguish have taken hold of me: yet Thy commandments are my delights.

verses.hebrew: צֶדֶק עֵדְוֺתֶיךָ לְעוֹלָם הֲבִינֵנִי וְאֶחְיֶה׃
verses.english: Thy testimonies are righteous forever: give me understanding, and I shall live.

verses.hebrew: קָרָאתִי בְכָל־לֵב עֲנֵנִי יְהוָה חֻקֶּיךָ אֶצֹּרָה׃
verses.english: I cry with my whole heart; answer me, O Lord: I will keep Thy statutes.

verses.hebrew: קְרָאתִיךָ הוֹשִׁיעֵנִי וְאֶשְׁמְרָה עֵדֹתֶיךָ׃
verses.english: I cry to Thee; save me, and I shall keep Thy testimonies.

verses.hebrew: קִדַּמְתִּי בַנֶּשֶׁף וָאֲשַׁוֵּעָה לדבריך [לִדְבָרְךָ] יִחָלְתִּי׃
verses.english: I rise before dawn, and I cry out: my hope is in Thy word.

verses.hebrew: קִדְּמוּ עֵינַי אַשְׁמֻרוֹת לָשִׂיחַ בְּאִמְרָתֶךָ׃
verses.english: My eyes open before the night watches, that I may meditate on Thy saying.

verses.hebrew: קוֹלִי שִׁמְעָה כְחַסְדֶּךָ יְהוָה כְּמִשְׁפָּטֶךָ חַיֵּנִי׃
verses.english: Hear my voice according to Thy steadfast love: O Lord, revive me according to Thy judgment.

verses.hebrew: קָרְבוּ רֹדְפֵי זִמָּה מִתּוֹרָתְךָ רָחָקוּ׃
verses.english: Those who follow after mischief draw near: they are far from Thy Tora.

verses.hebrew: קָרוֹב אַתָּה יְהוָה וְכָל־מִצְוֺתֶיךָ אֱמֶת׃
verses.english: Thou art near, O Lord; and all Thy commandments are truth.

verses.hebrew: קֶדֶם יָדַעְתִּי מֵעֵדֹתֶיךָ כִּי לְעוֹלָם יְסַדְתָּם׃
verses.english: Concerning Thy testimonies, I have known of old that Thou hast founded them forever.

verses.hebrew: רְאֵה־עָנְיִי וְחַלְּצֵנִי כִּי־תוֹרָתְךָ לֹא שָׁכָחְתִּי׃
verses.english: Consider my affliction, and deliver me: for I do not forget Thy Tora.

verses.hebrew: רִיבָה רִיבִי וּגְאָלֵנִי לְאִמְרָתְךָ חַיֵּנִי׃
verses.english: Plead my cause, and deliver me: give me life according to Thy word.

verses.hebrew: רָחוֹק מֵרְשָׁעִים יְשׁוּעָה כִּי־חֻקֶּיךָ לֹא דָרָשׁוּ׃
verses.english: Salvation is far from the wicked; for they seek not Thy statutes.

verses.hebrew: רַחֲמֶיךָ רַבִּים יְהוָה כְּמִשְׁפָּטֶיךָ חַיֵּנִי׃
verses.english: Great are Thy compassions, O Lord: give me life as is Thy wont.

verses.hebrew: רַבִּים רֹדְפַי וְצָרָי מֵעֵדְוֺתֶיךָ לֹא נָטִיתִי׃
verses.english: Many are my persecutors and my enemies; yet I do not decline from Thy testimonies.

verses.hebrew: רָאִיתִי בֹגְדִים וָאֶתְקוֹטָטָה אֲשֶׁר אִמְרָתְךָ לֹא שָׁמָרוּ׃
verses.english: I behold transgressors, and I am grieved; because they keep not Thy saying,

verses.hebrew: רְאֵה כִּי־פִקּוּדֶיךָ אָהָבְתִּי יְהוָה כְּחַסְדְּךָ חַיֵּנִי׃
verses.english: Consider how I love Thy precepts: revive me, O Lord, according to Thy steadfast love.

verses.hebrew: רֹאשׁ־דְּבָרְךָ אֱמֶת וּלְעוֹלָם כָּל־מִשְׁפַּט צִדְקֶךָ׃
verses.english: The sum of Thy word is truth: and every one of Thy righteous judgments endures for ever.

verses.hebrew: שָׂרִים רְדָפוּנִי חִנָּם ומדבריך [וּמִדְּבָרְךָ] פָּחַד לִבִּי׃
verses.english: Princes have persecuted me without cause: but my heart stands in awe of Thy word.

verses.hebrew: שָׂשׂ אָנֹכִי עַל־אִמְרָתֶךָ כְּמוֹצֵא שָׁלָל רָב׃
verses.english: I rejoice at Thy word, like one who finds great spoil.

verses.hebrew: שֶׁקֶר שָׂנֵאתִי וַאֲתַעֵבָה תּוֹרָתְךָ אָהָבְתִּי׃
verses.english: I hate and abhor lying: but Thy Tora I love.

verses.hebrew: שֶׁבַע בַּיּוֹם הִלַּלְתִּיךָ עַל מִשְׁפְּטֵי צִדְקֶךָ׃
verses.english: Seven times a day I praise Thee because of Thy righteous judgments.

verses.hebrew: שָׁלוֹם רָב לְאֹהֲבֵי תוֹרָתֶךָ וְאֵין־לָמוֹ מִכְשׁוֹל׃
verses.english: Great peace have they who love Thy Tora: and nothing can make them stumble.

verses.hebrew: שִׂבַּרְתִּי לִישׁוּעָתְךָ יְהוָה וּמִצְוֺתֶיךָ עָשִׂיתִי׃
verses.english: Lord, I have hoped for Thy salvation, and I have done Thy commandments.

verses.hebrew: שָׁמְרָה נַפְשִׁי עֵדֹתֶיךָ וָאֹהֲבֵם מְאֹד׃
verses.english: My soul has kept Thy testimonies; and I love them exceedingly.

verses.hebrew: שָׁמַרְתִּי פִקּוּדֶיךָ וְעֵדֹתֶיךָ כִּי כָל־דְּרָכַי נֶגְדֶּךָ׃
verses.english: I have kept Thy precepts and Thy testimonies: for all my ways are before Thee.

verses.hebrew: תִּקְרַב רִנָּתִי לְפָנֶיךָ יְהוָה כִּדְבָרְךָ הֲבִינֵנִי׃
verses.english: Let my cry come before Thee, O Lord: give me understanding according to Thy word.

verses.hebrew: תָּבוֹא תְּחִנָּתִי לְפָנֶיךָ כְּאִמְרָתְךָ הַצִּילֵנִי׃
verses.english: Let my supplication come before Thee: deliver me according to Thy word.

verses.hebrew: תַּבַּעְנָה שְׂפָתַי תְּהִלָּה כִּי תְלַמְּדֵנִי חֻקֶּיךָ׃
verses.english: My lips shall utter praise, for Thou hast taught me Thy statutes.

verses.hebrew: תַּעַן לְשׁוֹנִי אִמְרָתֶךָ כִּי כָל־מִצְוֺתֶיךָ צֶּדֶק׃
verses.english: My tongue shall sing of Thy word: for all Thy commandments are just.

verses.hebrew: תְּהִי־יָדְךָ לְעָזְרֵנִי כִּי פִקּוּדֶיךָ בָחָרְתִּי׃
verses.english: Let Thy hand help me; for I have chosen Thy precepts.

verses.hebrew: תָּאַבְתִּי לִישׁוּעָתְךָ יְהוָה וְתוֹרָתְךָ שַׁעֲשֻׁעָי׃
verses.english: I long for Thy salvation, O Lord; and Thy law is my delight.

verses.hebrew: תְּחִי־נַפְשִׁי וּתְהַלְלֶךָּ וּמִשְׁפָּטֶךָ יַעֲזְרֻנִי׃
verses.english: Let my soul live, and it shall praise Thee; and let Thy judgment help me.

verses.hebrew: תָּעִיתִי כְּשֶׂה אֹבֵד בַּקֵּשׁ עַבְדֶּךָ כִּי מִצְוֺתֶיךָ לֹא שָׁכָחְתִּי׃
verses.english: I have gone astray like a lost sheep; seek out Thy servant; for I do not forget Thy commandments.

verses.hebrew: שִׁיר הַמַּעֲלוֹת אֶל־יְהוָה בַּצָּרָתָה לִּי קָרָאתִי וַיַּעֲנֵנִי׃
verses.english: A Ma῾alot Poem. In my distress I cried to the Lord, and he heard me.

verses.hebrew: יְהוָה הַצִּילָה נַפְשִׁי מִשְּׂפַת־שֶׁקֶר מִלָּשׁוֹן רְמִיָּה׃
verses.english: Deliver my soul, O Lord, from lying lips, from a deceitful tongue.

verses.hebrew: מַה־יִּתֵּן לְךָ וּמַה־יֹּסִיף לָךְ לָשׁוֹן רְמִיָּה׃
verses.english: What shall be given to thee? or what shall be done to thee, thou false tongue?

verses.hebrew: חִצֵּי גִבּוֹר שְׁנוּנִים עִם גַּחֲלֵי רְתָמִים׃
verses.english: Sharp arrows of the mighty, with coals of the broom tree.

verses.hebrew: אוֹיָה־לִי כִּי־גַרְתִּי מֶשֶׁךְ שָׁכַנְתִּי עִם־אָהֳלֵי קֵדָר׃
verses.english: Woe is me, that I sojourn in Meshekh, that I dwell in the tents of Qedar!

verses.hebrew: רַבַּת שָׁכְנָה־לָּהּ נַפְשִׁי עִם שׂוֹנֵא שָׁלוֹם׃
verses.english: My soul has long dwelt with haters of peace.

verses.hebrew: אֲ‍נִי־שָׁלוֹם וְכִי אֲדַבֵּר הֵמָּה לַמִּלְחָמָה׃
verses.english: I am a man of peace: but when I speak, they are for war.

verses.hebrew: שִׁיר לַמַּעֲלוֹת אֶשָּׂא עֵינַי אֶל־הֶהָרִים מֵאַיִן יָבֹא עֶזְרִי׃
verses.english: A Ma῾alot Poem. I will lift up my eyes to the hills From whence comes my help?

verses.hebrew: עֶזְרִי מֵעִם יְהוָה עֹשֵׂה שָׁמַיִם וָאָרֶץ׃
verses.english: My help comes from the Lord, who made heaven and earth.

verses.hebrew: אַל־יִתֵּן לַמּוֹט רַגְלֶךָ אַל־יָנוּם שֹׁמְרֶךָ׃
verses.english: He will not suffer thy foot to be moved: he who keeps thee will not slumber.

verses.hebrew: הִנֵּה לֹא־יָנוּם וְלֹא יִישָׁן שׁוֹמֵר יִשְׂרָאֵל׃
verses.english: Behold, he who keeps Yisra᾽el shall neither slumber nor sleep.

verses.hebrew: יְהוָה שֹׁמְרֶךָ יְהוָה צִלְּךָ עַל־יַד יְמִינֶךָ׃
verses.english: The Lord is thy keeper: the Lord is thy shade upon thy right hand.

verses.hebrew: יוֹמָם הַשֶּׁמֶשׁ לֹא־יַכֶּכָּה וְיָרֵחַ בַּלָּיְלָה׃
verses.english: The sun shall not smite thee by day, nor the moon by night.

verses.hebrew: יְהוָה יִשְׁמָרְךָ מִכָּל־רָע יִשְׁמֹר אֶת־נַפְשֶׁךָ׃
verses.english: The Lord shall preserve thee from all evil: he shall preserve thy soul.

verses.hebrew: יְהוָה יִשְׁמָר־צֵאתְךָ וּבוֹאֶךָ מֵעַתָּה וְעַד־עוֹלָם׃
verses.english: The Lord shall preserve thy going out and thy coming in from this time forth, and for evermore.

verses.hebrew: שִׁיר הַמַּעֲלוֹת לְדָוִד שָׂמַחְתִּי בְּאֹמְרִים לִי בֵּית יְהוָה נֵלֵךְ׃
verses.english: A Ma῾alot Poem of David. I was glad when they said to me, Let us go into the house of the Lord:

verses.hebrew: עֹמְדוֹת הָיוּ רַגְלֵינוּ בִּשְׁעָרַיִךְ יְרוּשָׁלִָם׃
verses.english: when our feet stood within thy gates, O Yerushalayim;

verses.hebrew: יְרוּשָׁלִַם הַבְּנוּיָה כְּעִיר שֶׁחֻבְּרָה־לָּהּ יַחְדָּו׃
verses.english: O Yerushalayim, built as a city that is compact together:

verses.hebrew: שֶׁשָּׁם עָלוּ שְׁבָטִים שִׁבְטֵי־יָהּ עֵדוּת לְיִשְׂרָאֵל לְהֹדוֹת לְשֵׁם יְהוָה׃
verses.english: there the tribes used to go up, the tribes of the Lord, an appointed practice for Yisra᾽el, to give thanks to the name of the Lord.

verses.hebrew: כִּי שָׁמָּה יָשְׁבוּ כִסְאוֹת לְמִשְׁפָּט כִּסְאוֹת לְבֵית דָּוִיד׃
verses.english: For there are set thrones of judgment, the thrones of the house of David.

verses.hebrew: שַׁאֲלוּ שְׁלוֹם יְרוּשָׁלִָם יִשְׁלָיוּ אֹהֲבָיִךְ׃
verses.english: Pray for the peace of Yerushalayim: they who love thee shall prosper:

verses.hebrew: יְהִי־שָׁלוֹם בְּחֵילֵךְ שַׁלְוָה בְּאַרְמְנוֹתָיִךְ׃
verses.english: peace be within thy walls, and prosperity within thy palaces.

verses.hebrew: לְמַעַן אַחַי וְרֵעָי אֲדַבְּרָה־נָּא שָׁלוֹם בָּךְ׃
verses.english: For my brethren and companions’ sakes, I will now say, Peace be within thee.

verses.hebrew: לְמַעַן בֵּית־יְהוָה אֱלֹהֵינוּ אֲבַקְשָׁה טוֹב לָךְ׃
verses.english: For the sake of the house of the Lord our God I will seek thy good.

verses.hebrew: שִׁיר הַמַּעֲלוֹת אֵלֶיךָ נָשָׂאתִי אֶת־עֵינַי הַיֹּשְׁבִי בַּשָּׁמָיִם׃
verses.english: A Ma῾alot Poem. To Thee I lift up my eyes, O Thou who dwellest in the heavens.

verses.hebrew: הִנֵּה כְעֵינֵי עֲבָדִים אֶל־יַד אֲ‍דוֹנֵיהֶם כְּעֵינֵי שִׁפְחָה אֶל־יַד גְּבִרְתָּהּ כֵּן עֵינֵינוּ אֶל־יְהוָה אֱלֹהֵינוּ עַד שֶׁיְּחָנֵּנוּ׃
verses.english: Behold, as the eyes of servants look to the hand of their masters, and as the eyes of a maid to the hand of her mistress; so our eyes wait upon the Lord our God, until he shall be gracious to us.

verses.hebrew: חָנֵּנוּ יְהוָה חָנֵּנוּ כִּי־רַב שָׂבַעְנוּ בוּז׃
verses.english: Be gracious to us, O Lord, be gracious to us: for we are overfilled with contempt.

verses.hebrew: רַבַּת שָׂבְעָה־לָּהּ נַפְשֵׁנוּ הַלַּעַג הַשַּׁאֲנַנִּים הַבּוּז לִגְאֵיוֹנִים׃
verses.english: Our soul is overfilled with the scorn of those who are at ease, and with the contempt of the proud.

verses.hebrew: שִׁיר הַמַּעֲלוֹת לְדָוִד לוּלֵי יְהוָה שֶׁהָיָה לָנוּ יֹאמַר־נָא יִשְׂרָאֵל׃
verses.english: A Ma῾alot Poem of David. If not for the Lord who was with us, let Yisra᾽el now say –

verses.hebrew: לוּלֵי יְהוָה שֶׁהָיָה לָנוּ בְּקוּם עָלֵינוּ אָדָם׃
verses.english: if not for the Lord who was with us, when men rose up against us:

verses.hebrew: אֲזַי חַיִּים בְּלָעוּנוּ בַּחֲרוֹת אַפָּם בָּנוּ׃
verses.english: then they would have swallowed us up alive, when their anger was kindled against us:

verses.hebrew: אֲזַי הַמַּיִם שְׁטָפוּנוּ נַחְלָה עָבַר עַל־נַפְשֵׁנוּ׃
verses.english: then the waters would have overwhelmed us, the stream would have gone over our soul:

verses.hebrew: אֲזַי עָבַר עַל־נַפְשֵׁנוּ הַמַּיִם הַזֵּידוֹנִים׃
verses.english: then the proud waters would have gone over our soul.

verses.hebrew: בָּרוּךְ יְהוָה שֶׁלֹּא נְתָנָנוּ טֶרֶף לְשִׁנֵּיהֶם׃
verses.english: Blessed be the Lord, who has not given us as a prey to their teeth.

verses.hebrew: נַפְשֵׁנוּ כְּצִפּוֹר נִמְלְטָה מִפַּח יוֹקְשִׁים הַפַּח נִשְׁבָּר וַאֲנַחְנוּ נִמְלָטְנוּ׃
verses.english: Our soul is escaped like a bird out of the snare of the fowlers: the snare is broken, and we are escaped.

verses.hebrew: עֶזְרֵנוּ בְּשֵׁם יְהוָה עֹשֵׂה שָׁמַיִם וָאָרֶץ׃
verses.english: Our help is in the name of the Lord, who made heaven and earth.

verses.hebrew: שִׁיר הַמַּעֲלוֹת הַבֹּטְחִים בַּיהוָה כְּהַר־צִיּוֹן לֹא־יִמּוֹט לְעוֹלָם יֵשֵׁב׃
verses.english: A Ma῾alot Poem. They who trust in the Lord shall be like mount Żiyyon, which cannot be removed, but abides for ever.

verses.hebrew: יְרוּשָׁלִַם הָרִים סָבִיב לָהּ וַיהוָה סָבִיב לְעַמּוֹ מֵעַתָּה וְעַד־עוֹלָם׃
verses.english: As the mountains are round about Yerushalayim, so the Lord is round about his people from henceforth and forever.

verses.hebrew: כִּי לֹא יָנוּחַ שֵׁבֶט הָרֶשַׁע עַל גּוֹרַל הַצַּדִּיקִים לְמַעַן לֹא־יִשְׁלְחוּ הַצַּדִּיקִים בְּעַוְלָתָה יְדֵיהֶם׃
verses.english: For the sceptre of wickedness shall not rest upon the share allotted to the righteous; lest the righteous put forth their hands to do wrong.

verses.hebrew: הֵיטִיבָה יְהוָה לַטּוֹבִים וְלִישָׁרִים בְּלִבּוֹתָם׃
verses.english: Do good, O Lord, to those who are good, and to those who are upright in their hearts.

verses.hebrew: וְהַמַּטִּים עַקַלְקַלּוֹתָם יוֹלִיכֵם יְהוָה אֶת־פֹּעֲלֵי הָאָוֶן שָׁלוֹם עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵל׃
verses.english: As for such as turn aside to their crooked ways, the Lord shall lead them away with the workers of iniquity: but peace shall be upon Yisra᾽el.

verses.hebrew: שִׁיר הַמַּעֲלוֹת בְּשׁוּב יְהוָה אֶת־שִׁיבַת צִיּוֹן הָיִינוּ כְּחֹלְמִים׃
verses.english: A Ma῾alot Poem. When the Lord brought back the captivity of Żiyyon, we were like men in a dream.

verses.hebrew: אָז יִמָּלֵא שְׂחוֹק פִּינוּ וּלְשׁוֹנֵנוּ רִנָּה אָז יֹאמְרוּ בַגּוֹיִם הִגְדִּיל יְהוָה לַעֲשׂוֹת עִם־אֵלֶּה׃
verses.english: Then was our mouth filled with laughter, and our tongue with singing: then they said among the nations, The Lord has done great things for them.

verses.hebrew: הִגְדִּיל יְהוָה לַעֲשׂוֹת עִמָּנוּ הָיִינוּ שְׂמֵחִים׃
verses.english: The Lord has done great things for us; we are glad.

verses.hebrew: שׁוּבָה יְהוָה אֶת־שבותנו [שְׁבִיתֵנוּ] כַּאֲפִיקִים בַּנֶּגֶב׃
verses.english: Bring back our captivity, O Lord, like the streams in the Negev.

verses.hebrew: הַזֹּרְעִים בְּדִמְעָה בְּרִנָּה יִקְצֹרוּ׃
verses.english: They who sow in tears shall reap in joy.

verses.hebrew: הָלוֹךְ יֵלֵךְ וּבָכֹה נֹשֵׂא מֶשֶׁךְ־הַזָּרַע בֹּא־יָבוֹא בְרִנָּה נֹשֵׂא אֲלֻמֹּתָיו׃
verses.english: He who goes weeping on his way, bearing a bag of seed, shall come back with a joyful shout, carrying his sheaves.

verses.hebrew: שִׁיר הַמַּעֲלוֹת לִשְׁלֹמֹה אִם־יְהוָה לֹא־יִבְנֶה בַיִת שָׁוְא עָמְלוּ בוֹנָיו בּוֹ אִם־יְהוָה לֹא־יִשְׁמָר־עִיר שָׁוְא שָׁקַד שׁוֹמֵר׃
verses.english: A Ma῾alot Poem for Shelomo. Unless the Lord builds the house, they who build it labour in vain: unless the Lord keeps the city, the watchman stays awake in vain.

verses.hebrew: שָׁוְא לָכֶם מַשְׁכִּימֵי קוּם מְאַחֲרֵי־שֶׁבֶת אֹכְלֵי לֶחֶם הָעֲצָבִים כֵּן יִתֵּן לִידִידוֹ שֵׁנָא׃
verses.english: It is vain for you to rise up early, to sit up late, to eat the bread of toil: for truly to his beloved he gives tranquillity.

verses.hebrew: הִנֵּה נַחֲלַת יְהוָה בָּנִים שָׂכָר פְּרִי הַבָּטֶן׃
verses.english: Lo, children are a heritage of the Lord: and the fruit of the womb is a reward.

verses.hebrew: כְּחִצִּים בְּיַד־גִּבּוֹר כֵּן בְּנֵי הַנְּעוּרִים׃
verses.english: As arrows in the hand of a mighty man; so are the children of one’s youth.

verses.hebrew: אַשְׁרֵי הַגֶּבֶר אֲשֶׁר מִלֵּא אֶת־אַשְׁפָּתוֹ מֵהֶם לֹא־יֵבֹשׁוּ כִּי־יְדַבְּרוּ אֶת־אוֹיְבִים בַּשָּׁעַר׃
verses.english: Happy is the man that has his quiver full of them: they shall not be put to shame, but they shall speak with their enemies in the gate.

verses.hebrew: שִׁיר הַמַּעֲלוֹת אַשְׁרֵי כָּל־יְרֵא יְהוָה הַהֹלֵךְ בִּדְרָכָיו׃
verses.english: A Ma῾alot Poem. Happy is everyone who fears the Lord; who walks in his ways.

verses.hebrew: יְגִיעַ כַּפֶּיךָ כִּי תֹאכֵל אַשְׁרֶיךָ וְטוֹב לָךְ׃
verses.english: For thou shalt eat the labour of thy hands: happy shalt thou be, and it shall be well with thee.

verses.hebrew: אֶשְׁתְּךָ כְּגֶפֶן פֹּרִיָּה בְּיַרְכְּתֵי בֵיתֶךָ בָּנֶיךָ כִּשְׁתִלֵי זֵיתִים סָבִיב לְשֻׁלְחָנֶךָ׃
verses.english: Thy wife shall be like a fruitful vine in the recesses of thy house: thy children like olive plants round about thy table.

verses.hebrew: הִנֵּה כִי־כֵן יְבֹרַךְ גָּבֶר יְרֵא יְהוָה׃
verses.english: Behold, thus shall the man be blessed who fears the Lord.

verses.hebrew: יְבָרֶכְךָ יְהוָה מִצִּיּוֹן וּרְאֵה בְּטוּב יְרוּשָׁלִָם כֹּל יְמֵי חַיֶּיךָ׃
verses.english: The Lord shall bless thee out of Żiyyon: and thou shalt see the good of Yerushalayim all the days of thy life.

verses.hebrew: וּרְאֵה־בָנִים לְבָנֶיךָ שָׁלוֹם עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵל׃
verses.english: And thou shalt see thy children’s children, and peace upon Yisra᾽el.

verses.hebrew: שִׁיר הַמַּעֲלוֹת רַבַּת צְרָרוּנִי מִנְּעוּרַי יֹאמַר־נָא יִשְׂרָאֵל׃
verses.english: A Ma῾alot Poem. Many a time have they afflicted me from my youth, may Yisra᾽el now say:

verses.hebrew: רַבַּת צְרָרוּנִי מִנְּעוּרָי גַּם לֹא־יָכְלוּ לִי׃
verses.english: many a time have they afflicted me from my youth: yet they have not prevailed against me.

verses.hebrew: עַל־גַּבִּי חָרְשׁוּ חֹרְשִׁים הֶאֱרִיכוּ למענותם [לְמַעֲנִיתָם׃]
verses.english: The ploughers ploughed upon my back: they made long their furrows.

verses.hebrew: יְהוָה צַדִּיק קִצֵּץ עֲבוֹת רְשָׁעִים׃
verses.english: The Lord is righteous: he has cut asunder the cord of the wicked.

verses.hebrew: יֵבֹשׁוּ וְיִסֹּגוּ אָחוֹר כֹּל שֹׂנְאֵי צִיּוֹן׃
verses.english: Let them be confounded and turned back, all who hate Żiyyon.

verses.hebrew: יִהְיוּ כַּחֲצִיר גַּגּוֹת שֶׁקַּדְמַת שָׁלַף יָבֵשׁ׃
verses.english: Let them be like the grass upon the housetops, which withers before it is plucked:

verses.hebrew: שֶׁלֹּא מִלֵּא כַפּוֹ קוֹצֵר וְחִצְנוֹ מְעַמֵּר׃
verses.english: wherewith the mower fills not his hand; nor he who binds sheaves his bosom.

verses.hebrew: וְלֹא אָמְרוּ הָעֹבְרִים בִּרְכַּת־יְהוָה אֲלֵיכֶם בֵּרַכְנוּ אֶתְכֶם בְּשֵׁם יְהוָה׃
verses.english: Nor do they who go by say, The blessing of the Lord be upon you: we bless you in the name of the Lord.

verses.hebrew: שִׁיר הַמַּעֲלוֹת מִמַּעֲמַקִּים קְרָאתִיךָ יְהוָה׃
verses.english: A Ma῾alot Poem. Out of the depths I have cried to Thee, O Lord.

verses.hebrew: אֲדֹנָי שִׁמְעָה בְקוֹלִי תִּהְיֶינָה אָזְנֶיךָ קַשֻּׁבוֹת לְקוֹל תַּחֲנוּנָי׃
verses.english: Lord, hear my voice: let Thy ears be attentive to the voice of my supplications.

verses.hebrew: אִם־עֲוֺנוֹת תִּשְׁמָר־יָהּ אֲדֹנָי מִי יַעֲמֹד׃
verses.english: If Thou, Lord, shouldst mark iniquities, O Lord, who could stand?

verses.hebrew: כִּי־עִמְּךָ הַסְּלִיחָה לְמַעַן תִּוָּרֵא׃
verses.english: But there is forgiveness with Thee, that Thou mayst be feared.

verses.hebrew: קִוִּיתִי יְהוָה קִוְּתָה נַפְשִׁי וְלִדְבָרוֹ הוֹחָלְתִּי׃
verses.english: I wait for the Lord, my soul waits, and in his word I hope.

verses.hebrew: נַפְשִׁי לַאדֹנָי מִשֹּׁמְרִים לַבֹּקֶר שֹׁמְרִים לַבֹּקֶר׃
verses.english: My soul waits for the Lord more than they who watch for the morning: more than watchmen for the morning.

verses.hebrew: יַחֵל יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶל־יְהוָה כִּי־עִם־יְהוָה הַחֶסֶד וְהַרְבֵּה עִמּוֹ פְדוּת׃
verses.english: Let Yisra᾽el hope in the Lord: for with the Lord there is steadfast love, and with him is plenteous redemption.

verses.hebrew: וְהוּא יִפְדֶּה אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל מִכֹּל עֲוֺנֹתָיו׃
verses.english: And he shall redeem Yisra᾽el from all his iniquities.

verses.hebrew: שִׁיר הַמַּעֲלוֹת לְדָוִד יְהוָה לֹא־גָבַהּ לִבִּי וְלֹא־רָמוּ עֵינַי וְלֹא־הִלַּכְתִּי בִּגְדֹלוֹת וּבְנִפְלָאוֹת מִמֶּנִּי׃
verses.english: A Ma῾alot Poem of David. Lord, my heart is not haughty, nor my eyes lofty: nor do I exercise myself in great matters, or in things too high for me.

verses.hebrew: אִם־לֹא שִׁוִּיתִי וְדוֹמַמְתִּי נַפְשִׁי כְּגָמֻל עֲלֵי אִמּוֹ כַּגָּמֻל עָלַי נַפְשִׁי׃
verses.english: Surely I have stilled and quieted myself, like a weaned child beside his mother: my soul within me is like a weaned child.

verses.hebrew: יַחֵל יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶל־יְהוָה מֵעַתָּה וְעַד־עוֹלָם׃
verses.english: Let Yisra᾽el hope in the Lord from henceforth and for ever.

verses.hebrew: שִׁיר הַמַּעֲלוֹת זְכוֹר־יְהוָה לְדָוִד אֵת כָּל־עֻנּוֹתוֹ׃
verses.english: A Ma῾alot Poem. Lord, remember to David’s favour all his afflictions:

verses.hebrew: אֲשֶׁר נִשְׁבַּע לַיהוָה נָדַר לַאֲבִיר יַעֲקֹב׃
verses.english: how he swore to the Lord, and vowed to the mighty God of Ya῾aqov:

verses.hebrew: אִם־אָבֹא בְּאֹהֶל בֵּיתִי אִם־אֶעֱלֶה עַל־עֶרֶשׂ יְצוּעָי׃
verses.english: Surely I will not come into the tabernacle of my house, nor go up into my bed;

verses.hebrew: אִם־אֶתֵּן שְׁנַת לְעֵינָי לְעַפְעַפַּי תְּנוּמָה׃
verses.english: I will not give sleep to my eyes, slumber to my eyelids,

verses.hebrew: עַד־אֶמְצָא מָקוֹם לַיהוָה מִשְׁכָּנוֹת לַאֲבִיר יַעֲקֹב׃
verses.english: until I find out a place for the Lord, a habitation for the mighty One of Ya῾aqov.

verses.hebrew: הִנֵּה־שְׁמַעֲנוּהָ בְאֶפְרָתָה מְצָאנוּהָ בִּשְׂדֵי־יָעַר׃
verses.english: Lo, we heard of it at Efrat: we found it in Sede-ya῾ar.

verses.hebrew: נָבוֹאָה לְמִשְׁכְּנוֹתָיו נִשְׁתַּחֲוֶה לַהֲדֹם רַגְלָיו׃
verses.english: We will go into his dwelling places: we will worship at his footstool.

verses.hebrew: קוּמָה יְהוָה לִמְנוּחָתֶךָ אַתָּה וַאֲרוֹן עֻזֶּךָ׃
verses.english: Arise, O Lord, to Thy resting place; Thou, and the ark of Thy strength.

verses.hebrew: כֹּהֲנֶיךָ יִלְבְּשׁוּ־צֶדֶק וַחֲסִידֶיךָ יְרַנֵּנוּ׃
verses.english: Let Thy priests be clothed with righteousness; and let Thy pious ones shout for joy.

verses.hebrew: בַּעֲבוּר דָּוִד עַבְדֶּךָ אַל־תָּשֵׁב פְּנֵי מְשִׁיחֶךָ׃
verses.english: For Thy servant David’s sake do not turn away the face of Thy anointed.

verses.hebrew: נִשְׁבַּע־יְהוָה לְדָוִד אֱמֶת לֹא־יָשׁוּב מִמֶּנָּה מִפְּרִי בִטְנְךָ אָשִׁית לְכִסֵּא־לָךְ׃
verses.english: The Lord has sworn in truth to David; he will not turn from it; One of the sons of thy body will I set upon thy throne.

verses.hebrew: אִם־יִשְׁמְרוּ בָנֶיךָ בְּרִיתִי וְעֵדֹתִי זוֹ אֲלַמְּדֵם גַּם־בְּנֵיהֶם עֲדֵי־עַד יֵשְׁבוּ לְכִסֵּא־לָךְ׃
verses.english: If thy children will keep my covenant and my Testimony that I shall teach them, their children shall also sit upon thy throne for evermore.

verses.hebrew: כִּי־בָחַר יְהוָה בְּצִיּוֹן אִוָּהּ לְמוֹשָׁב לוֹ׃
verses.english: For the Lord has chosen Żiyyon: he has desired it for his habitation.

verses.hebrew: זֹאת־מְנוּחָתִי עֲדֵי־עַד פֹּה־אֵשֵׁב כִּי אִוִּתִיהָ׃
verses.english: This is my resting place forever: here will I dwell; for I have desired it.

verses.hebrew: צֵידָהּ בָּרֵךְ אֲבָרֵךְ אֶבְיוֹנֶיהָ אַשְׂבִּיעַ לָחֶם׃
verses.english: I will abundantly bless her provisions: I will satisfy her poor with bread.

verses.hebrew: וְכֹהֲנֶיהָ אַלְבִּישׁ יֶשַׁע וַחֲסִידֶיהָ רַנֵּן יְרַנֵּנוּ׃
verses.english: I will also clothe her priests with salvation: and her pious ones shall shout aloud for joy.

verses.hebrew: שָׁם אַצְמִיחַ קֶרֶן לְדָוִד עָרַכְתִּי נֵר לִמְשִׁיחִי׃
verses.english: There will I make the horn of David to shoot up: I have set up a lamp for my anointed.

verses.hebrew: אוֹיְבָיו אַלְבִּישׁ בֹּשֶׁת וְעָלָיו יָצִיץ נִזְרוֹ׃
verses.english: His enemies I will clothe with shame: but upon himself his crown will flourish.

verses.hebrew: שִׁיר הַמַּעֲלוֹת לְדָוִד הִנֵּה מַה־טּוֹב וּמַה־נָּעִים שֶׁבֶת אַחִים גַּם־יָחַד׃
verses.english: A Ma῾alot Poem of David. Behold, how good and how pleasant it is for brothers to dwell together in unity!

verses.hebrew: כַּשֶּׁמֶן הַטּוֹב עַל־הָרֹאשׁ יֹרֵד עַל־הַזָּקָן זְקַן־אַהֲרֹן שֶׁיֹּרֵד עַל־פִּי מִדּוֹתָיו׃
verses.english: It is like the precious ointment upon the head, running down upon the beard, the beard of Aharon: running down over the hem of his garments:

verses.hebrew: כְּטַל־חֶרְמוֹן שֶׁיֹּרֵד עַל־הַרְרֵי צִיּוֹן כִּי שָׁם צִוָּה יְהוָה אֶת־הַבְּרָכָה חַיִּים עַד־הָעוֹלָם׃
verses.english: like the dew of Ḥermon descending upon the mountains of Żiyyon: for there the Lord has commanded the blessing, even life for evermore.

verses.hebrew: שִׁיר הַמַּעֲלוֹת הִנֵּה בָּרֲכוּ אֶת־יְהוָה כָּל־עַבְדֵי יְהוָה הָעֹמְדִים בְּבֵית־יְהוָה בַּלֵּילוֹת׃
verses.english: A Ma῾alot Poem. Behold, bless the Lord, all you servants of the Lord, who stand by night in the house of the Lord.

verses.hebrew: שְׂאוּ־יְדֵכֶם קֹדֶשׁ וּבָרֲכוּ אֶת־יְהוָה׃
verses.english: Lift up your hands in the sanctuary, and bless the Lord.

verses.hebrew: יְבָרֶכְךָ יְהוָה מִצִּיּוֹן עֹשֵׂה שָׁמַיִם וָאָרֶץ׃
verses.english: May the Lord who made heaven and earth bless thee out of Żiyyon.

verses.hebrew: הַלְלוּ יָהּ הַלְלוּ אֶת־שֵׁם יְהוָה הַלְלוּ עַבְדֵי יְהוָה׃
verses.english: Haleluya! Praise the name of the Lord; praise him, O servants of the Lord.

verses.hebrew: שֶׁעֹמְדִים בְּבֵית יְהוָה בְּחַצְרוֹת בֵּית אֱלֹהֵינוּ׃
verses.english: You who stand in the house of the Lord, in the courts of the house of our God,

verses.hebrew: הַלְלוּ־יָהּ כִּי־טוֹב יְהוָה זַמְּרוּ לִשְׁמוֹ כִּי נָעִים׃
verses.english: Haleluya! for the Lord is good: sing praises to his name; for it is pleasant.

verses.hebrew: כִּי־יַעֲקֹב בָּחַר לוֹ יָהּ יִשְׂרָאֵל לִסְגֻלָּתוֹ׃
verses.english: For the Lord has chosen Ya῾aqov to himself, Yisra᾽el for his peculiar possession.

verses.hebrew: כִּי אֲנִי יָדַעְתִּי כִּי־גָדוֹל יְהוָה וַאֲדֹנֵינוּ מִכָּל־אֱלֹהִים׃
verses.english: For I know that the Lord is great, and that our Lord is above all gods.

verses.hebrew: כֹּל אֲשֶׁר־חָפֵץ יְהוָה עָשָׂה בַּשָּׁמַיִם וּבָאָרֶץ בַּיַּמִּים וְכָל־תְּהוֹמוֹת׃
verses.english: Whatever the Lord wishes, he has done in heaven, and in earth, in the seas, and all deep places.

verses.hebrew: מַעֲלֶה נְשִׂאִים מִקְצֵה הָאָרֶץ בְּרָקִים לַמָּטָר עָשָׂה מוֹצֵא־רוּחַ מֵאוֹצְרוֹתָיו׃
verses.english: He causes vapours to ascend from the ends of the earth; he makes lightnings for the rain; he brings the wind out of the treasuries.

verses.hebrew: שֶׁהִכָּה בְּכוֹרֵי מִצְרָיִם מֵאָדָם עַד־בְּהֵמָה׃
verses.english: It was he who smote the firstborn of Miżrayim, both of man and beast;

verses.hebrew: שָׁלַח אֹתוֹת וּמֹפְתִים בְּתוֹכֵכִי מִצְרָיִם בְּפַרְעֹה וּבְכָל־עֲבָדָיו׃
verses.english: who sent signs and wonders into the midst of thee, O Miżrayim, upon Par῾o, and upon all his servants;

verses.hebrew: שֶׁהִכָּה גּוֹיִם רַבִּים וְהָרַג מְלָכִים עֲצוּמִים׃
verses.english: who smote great nations, and slew mighty kings;

verses.hebrew: לְסִיחוֹן מֶלֶךְ הָאֱמֹרִי וּלְעוֹג מֶלֶךְ הַבָּשָׁן וּלְכֹל מַמְלְכוֹת כְּנָעַן׃
verses.english: Siĥon king of the Emori, and ῾Og king of Bashan, and all the kingdoms of Kena῾an;

verses.hebrew: וְנָתַן אַרְצָם נַחֲלָה נַחֲלָה לְיִשְׂרָאֵל עַמּוֹ׃
verses.english: and gave their land for a heritage, a heritage to Yisra᾽el his people.

verses.hebrew: יְהוָה שִׁמְךָ לְעוֹלָם יְהוָה זִכְרְךָ לְדֹר־וָדֹר׃
verses.english: Thy name, O Lord, endures forever; and Thy renown, O Lord, throughout all generations.

verses.hebrew: כִּי־יָדִין יְהוָה עַמּוֹ וְעַל־עֲבָדָיו יִתְנֶחָם׃
verses.english: For the Lord will judge the cause of his people, and he will relent concerning his servants.

verses.hebrew: עֲצַבֵּי הַגּוֹיִם כֶּסֶף וְזָהָב מַעֲשֵׂה יְדֵי אָדָם׃
verses.english: The idols of the nations are silver and gold, the work of men’s hands.

verses.hebrew: פֶּה־לָהֶם וְלֹא יְדַבֵּרוּ עֵינַיִם לָהֶם וְלֹא יִרְאוּ׃
verses.english: They have mouths, but they cannot speak; eyes have they, but they cannot see;

verses.hebrew: אָזְנַיִם לָהֶם וְלֹא יַאֲזִינוּ אַף אֵין־יֶשׁ־רוּחַ בְּפִיהֶם׃
verses.english: they have ears, but they cannot hear; nor is there any breath in their mouths.

verses.hebrew: כְּמוֹהֶם יִהְיוּ עֹשֵׂיהֶם כֹּל אֲשֶׁר־בֹּטֵחַ בָּהֶם׃
verses.english: May they who make them become like them; and everyone who trusts in them.

verses.hebrew: בֵּית יִשְׂרָאֵל בָּרֲכוּ אֶת־יְהוָה בֵּית אַהֲרֹן בָּרֲכוּ אֶת־יְהוָה׃
verses.english: Bless the Lord, O house of Yisra᾽el: bless the Lord, O house of Aharon:

verses.hebrew: בֵּית הַלֵּוִי בָּרֲכוּ אֶת־יְהוָה יִרְאֵי יְהוָה בָּרֲכוּ אֶת־יְהוָה׃
verses.english: Bless the Lord, O house of Levi: you who fear the Lord, bless the Lord.

verses.hebrew: בָּרוּךְ יְהוָה מִצִּיּוֹן שֹׁכֵן יְרוּשָׁלִָם הַלְלוּ־יָהּ׃
verses.english: Blessed be the Lord out of Żiyyon, he who dwells at Yerushalayim. Haleluya!

verses.hebrew: הוֹדוּ לַיהוָה כִּי־טוֹב כִּי לְעוֹלָם חַסְדּוֹ׃
verses.english: O Give thanks to the Lord; for he is good: for his steadfast love endures forever.

verses.hebrew: הוֹדוּ לֵאלֹהֵי הָאֱלֹהִים כִּי לְעוֹלָם חַסְדּוֹ׃
verses.english: O give thanks to the God of gods: for his steadfast love endures forever.

verses.hebrew: הוֹדוּ לַאֲדֹנֵי הָאֲדֹנִים כִּי לְעֹלָם חַסְדּוֹ׃
verses.english: O give thanks to the Lord of lords: for his steadfast love endures forever.

verses.hebrew: לְעֹשֵׂה נִפְלָאוֹת גְּדֹלוֹת לְבַדּוֹ כִּי לְעוֹלָם חַסְדּוֹ׃
verses.english: To him who alone does great wonders: for his steadfast love endures forever.

verses.hebrew: לְעֹשֵׂה הַשָּׁמַיִם בִּתְבוּנָה כִּי לְעוֹלָם חַסְדּוֹ׃
verses.english: To him who by understanding made the heavens: for his steadfast love endures forever.

verses.hebrew: לְרֹקַע הָאָרֶץ עַל־הַמָּיִם כִּי לְעוֹלָם חַסְדּוֹ׃
verses.english: To him who stretched out the earth above the waters: for his steadfast love endures forever.

verses.hebrew: לְעֹשֵׂה אוֹרִים גְּדֹלִים כִּי לְעוֹלָם חַסְדּוֹ׃
verses.english: To him who made great lights: for his steadfast love endures forever:

verses.hebrew: אֶת־הַשֶּׁמֶשׁ לְמֶמְשֶׁלֶת בַּיּוֹם כִּי לְעוֹלָם חַסְדּוֹ׃
verses.english: the sun to rule by day: for his steadfast love endures forever:

verses.hebrew: אֶת־הַיָּרֵחַ וְכוֹכָבִים לְמֶמְשְׁלוֹת בַּלָּיְלָה כִּי לְעוֹלָם חַסְדּוֹ׃
verses.english: the moon and stars to rule by night: for his steadfast love endures forever.

verses.hebrew: לְמַכֵּה מִצְרַיִם בִּבְכוֹרֵיהֶם כִּי לְעוֹלָם חַסְדּוֹ׃
verses.english: To him who smote Miżrayim in their firstborn: for his steadfast love endures forever:

verses.hebrew: וַיּוֹצֵא יִשְׂרָאֵל מִתּוֹכָם כִּי לְעוֹלָם חַסְדּוֹ׃
verses.english: and brought out Yisra᾽el from among them: for his steadfast love endures forever:

verses.hebrew: בְּיָד חֲזָקָה וּבִזְרוֹעַ נְטוּיָה כִּי לְעוֹלָם חַסְדּוֹ׃
verses.english: with a strong hand, and with a stretched out arm: for his steadfast love endures forever.

verses.hebrew: לְגֹזֵר יַם־סוּף לִגְזָרִים כִּי לְעוֹלָם חַסְדּוֹ׃
verses.english: To him who divided the Sea of Suf asunder: for his steadfast love endures forever:

verses.hebrew: וְהֶעֱבִיר יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּתוֹכוֹ כִּי לְעוֹלָם חַסְדּוֹ׃
verses.english: and made Yisra᾽el pass through the midst of it: for his steadfast love endures forever:

verses.hebrew: וְנִעֵר פַּרְעֹה וְחֵילוֹ בְיַם־סוּף כִּי לְעוֹלָם חַסְדּוֹ׃
verses.english: but overthrew Par῾o and his host in the Sea of Suf: for his steadfast love endures forever.

verses.hebrew: לְמוֹלִיךְ עַמּוֹ בַּמִּדְבָּר כִּי לְעוֹלָם חַסְדּוֹ׃
verses.english: To him who led his people through the wilderness: for his steadfast love endures forever.

verses.hebrew: לְמַכֵּה מְלָכִים גְּדֹלִים כִּי לְעוֹלָם חַסְדּוֹ׃
verses.english: To him who smote great kings: for his steadfast love endures forever:

verses.hebrew: וַיַּהֲרֹג מְלָכִים אַדִּירִים כִּי לְעוֹלָם חַסְדּוֹ׃
verses.english: and slew mighty kings: for his steadfast love endures forever:

verses.hebrew: לְסִיחוֹן מֶלֶךְ הָאֱמֹרִי כִּי לְעוֹלָם חַסְדּוֹ׃
verses.english: Siĥon king of the Emori: for his steadfast love endures forever:

verses.hebrew: וּלְעוֹג מֶלֶךְ הַבָּשָׁן כִּי לְעוֹלָם חַסְדּוֹ׃
verses.english: and ῾Og the king of Bashan: for his steadfast love endures forever:

verses.hebrew: וְנָתַן אַרְצָם לְנַחֲלָה כִּי לְעוֹלָם חַסְדּוֹ׃
verses.english: and gave their land for a heritage: for his steadfast love endures forever:

verses.hebrew: נַחֲלָה לְיִשְׂרָאֵל עַבְדּוֹ כִּי לְעוֹלָם חַסְדּוֹ׃
verses.english: a heritage to Yisra᾽el his servant: for his steadfast love endures forever.

verses.hebrew: שֶׁבְּשִׁפְלֵנוּ זָכַר לָנוּ כִּי לְעוֹלָם חַסְדּוֹ׃
verses.english: Who remembered us in our low estate: for his steadfast love endures forever:

verses.hebrew: וַיִּפְרְקֵנוּ מִצָּרֵינוּ כִּי לְעוֹלָם חַסְדּוֹ׃
verses.english: and has delivered us from our enemies: for his steadfast love endures forever.

verses.hebrew: נֹתֵן לֶחֶם לְכָל־בָּשָׂר כִּי לְעוֹלָם חַסְדּוֹ׃
verses.english: Who gives bread to all flesh: for his steadfast love endures forever.

verses.hebrew: הוֹדוּ לְאֵל הַשָּׁמָיִם כִּי לְעוֹלָם חַסְדּוֹ׃
verses.english: O give thanks to the God of heaven: for his steadfast love endures forever.

verses.hebrew: עַל נַהֲרוֹת בָּבֶל שָׁם יָשַׁבְנוּ גַּם־בָּכִינוּ בְּזָכְרֵנוּ אֶת־צִיּוֹן׃
verses.english: By the rivers of Bavel, there we sat down, yea, we wept, when we remembered Żiyyon.

verses.hebrew: עַל־עֲרָבִים בְּתוֹכָהּ תָּלִינוּ כִּנֹּרוֹתֵינוּ׃
verses.english: We hung our lyres upon the willows in its midst.

verses.hebrew: כִּי שָׁם שְׁאֵלוּנוּ שׁוֹבֵינוּ דִּבְרֵי־שִׁיר וְתוֹלָלֵינוּ שִׂמְחָה שִׁירוּ לָנוּ מִשִּׁיר צִיּוֹן׃
verses.english: For there they who carried us away captive asked us for a song; and they who spoiled us asked us for mirth, saying, Sing us one of the songs of Żiyyon.

verses.hebrew: אֵיךְ נָשִׁיר אֶת־שִׁיר־יְהוָה עַל אַדְמַת נֵכָר׃
verses.english: How shall we sing the Lord’s song in a foreign land?

verses.hebrew: אִם־אֶשְׁכָּחֵךְ יְרוּשָׁלִָם תִּשְׁכַּח יְמִינִי׃
verses.english: If I forget thee, O Yerushalayim, let my right hand forget her cunning.

verses.hebrew: תִּדְבַּק־לְשׁוֹנִי לְחִכִּי אִם־לֹא אֶזְכְּרֵכִי אִם־לֹא אַעֲלֶה אֶת־יְרוּשָׁלִַם עַל רֹאשׁ שִׂמְחָתִי׃
verses.english: If I do not remember thee, let my tongue cleave to the roof of my mouth; if I do not set Yerushalayim above my highest joy.

verses.hebrew: זְכֹר יְהוָה לִבְנֵי אֱדוֹם אֵת יוֹם יְרוּשָׁלִָם הָאֹמְרִים עָרוּ עָרוּ עַד הַיְסוֹד בָּהּ׃
verses.english: Remember, O Lord, against the children of Edom the day of Yerushalayim, when they said, Rase it, rase it, to its very foundations.

verses.hebrew: בַּת־בָּבֶל הַשְּׁדוּדָה אַשְׁרֵי שֶׁיְשַׁלֶּם־לָךְ אֶת־גְּמוּלֵךְ שֶׁגָּמַלְתְּ לָנוּ׃
verses.english: O daughter of Bavel, marked for devastation; happy is he who shall repay thee thy recompense for what thou hast done to us.

verses.hebrew: אַשְׁרֵי שֶׁיֹּאחֵז וְנִפֵּץ אֶת־עֹלָלַיִךְ אֶל־הַסָּלַע׃
verses.english: Happy is he who shall seize and dash thy little ones against the rock.

verses.hebrew: לְדָוִד אוֹדְךָ בְכָל־לִבִּי נֶגֶד אֱלֹהִים אֲזַמְּרֶךָּ׃
verses.english: Of David. I will praise Thee with my whole heart: before princes I will sing praise to Thee.

verses.hebrew: אֶשְׁתַּחֲוֶה אֶל־הֵיכַל קָדְשְׁךָ וְאוֹדֶה אֶת־שְׁמֶךָ עַל־חַסְדְּךָ וְעַל־אֲמִתֶּךָ כִּי־הִגְדַּלְתָּ עַל־כָּל־שִׁמְךָ אִמְרָתֶךָ׃
verses.english: I will bow down towards Thy holy temple, and praise Thy name for Thy steadfast love, and for Thy truth: for Thou hast magnified Thy word above all Thy name.

verses.hebrew: בְּיוֹם קָרָאתִי וַתַּעֲנֵנִי תַּרְהִבֵנִי בְנַפְשִׁי עֹז׃
verses.english: In the day when I cried Thou didst answer me, and didst strengthen me with strength in my soul.

verses.hebrew: יוֹדוּךָ יְהוָה כָּל־מַלְכֵי־אָרֶץ כִּי שָׁמְעוּ אִמְרֵי־פִיךָ׃
verses.english: All the kings of the earth shall give Thee thanks, O Lord, when they hear the words of Thy mouth.

verses.hebrew: וְיָשִׁירוּ בְּדַרְכֵי יְהוָה כִּי גָדוֹל כְּבוֹד יְהוָה׃
verses.english: Yea, they shall sing of the ways of the Lord: for great is the glory of the Lord.

verses.hebrew: כִּי־רָם יְהוָה וְשָׁפָל יִרְאֶה וְגָבֹהַּ מִמֶּרְחָק יְיֵדָע׃
verses.english: Though the Lord be high, yet he takes note of the lowly: but the haughty he knows from afar.

verses.hebrew: אִם־אֵלֵךְ בְּקֶרֶב צָרָה תְּחַיֵּנִי עַל אַף אֹיְבַי תִּשְׁלַח יָדֶךָ וְתוֹשִׁיעֵנִי יְמִינֶךָ׃
verses.english: Though I walk in the midst of trouble, Thou wilt revive me: Thou shalt stretch out Thy hand against the wrath of my enemies, and Thy right hand shall save me.

verses.hebrew: יְהוָה יִגְמֹר בַּעֲדִי יְהוָה חַסְדְּךָ לְעוֹלָם מַעֲשֵׂי יָדֶיךָ אַל־תֶּרֶף׃
verses.english: May the Lord accomplish his purpose concerning me: Thy steadfast love, O Lord, endures forever: do not forsake the works of Thy own hands.

verses.hebrew: לַמְנַצֵּחַ לְדָוִד מִזְמוֹר יְהוָה חֲקַרְתַּנִי וַתֵּדָע׃
verses.english: To the chief Musician, A Psalm of David. O Lord, Thou hast searched me, and known me.

verses.hebrew: אַתָּה יָדַעְתָּ שִׁבְתִּי וְקוּמִי בַּנְתָּה לְרֵעִי מֵרָחוֹק׃
verses.english: Thou knowst my sitting down and my rising up, Thou understandest my thought afar off.

verses.hebrew: אָרְחִי וְרִבְעִי זֵרִיתָ וְכָל־דְּרָכַי הִסְכַּנְתָּה׃
verses.english: Thou hast measured my going and my lying down, and Thou art acquainted with all my ways.

verses.hebrew: כִּי אֵין מִלָּה בִּלְשׁוֹנִי הֵן יְהוָה יָדַעְתָּ כֻלָּהּ׃
verses.english: For no word is yet on my tongue, and lo, O Lord, Thou knowst it all.

verses.hebrew: אָחוֹר וָקֶדֶם צַרְתָּנִי וַתָּשֶׁת עָלַי כַּפֶּכָה׃
verses.english: Thou hast beset me behind and before, and laid Thy hand upon me.

verses.hebrew: פלאיה [פְּלִיאָה] דַעַת מִמֶּנִּי נִשְׂגְּבָה לֹא־אוּכַל לָהּ׃
verses.english: Such knowledge is too wonderful for me; it is high, I cannot attain unto it.

verses.hebrew: אָנָה אֵלֵךְ מֵרוּחֶךָ וְאָנָה מִפָּנֶיךָ אֶבְרָח׃
verses.english: Where shall I go from Thy spirit? or where shall I flee from Thy presence?

verses.hebrew: אִם־אֶסַּק שָׁמַיִם שָׁם אָתָּה וְאַצִּיעָה שְּׁאוֹל הִנֶּךָּ׃
verses.english: If I ascend up into heaven, Thou art there: if I make my bed in She᾽ol, behold, Thou art there.

verses.hebrew: אֶשָּׂא כַנְפֵי־שָׁחַר אֶשְׁכְּנָה בְּאַחֲרִית יָם׃
verses.english: If I take the wings of the morning, and dwell in the uttermost parts of the sea;

verses.hebrew: גַּם־שָׁם יָדְךָ תַנְחֵנִי וְתֹאחֲזֵנִי יְמִינֶךָ׃
verses.english: even there shall Thy hand lead me, and Thy right hand shall hold me.

verses.hebrew: וָאֹמַר אַךְ־חֹשֶׁךְ יְשׁוּפֵנִי וְלַיְלָה אוֹר בַּעֲדֵנִי׃
verses.english: If I say, Surely only darkness shall cover me; and the light be night about me,

verses.hebrew: גַּם־חֹשֶׁךְ לֹא־יַחְשִׁיךְ מִמֶּךָ וְלַיְלָה כַּיּוֹם יָאִיר כַּחֲשֵׁיכָה כָּאוֹרָה׃
verses.english: even the darkness is not dark for Thee, but the night shines like the day: the darkness and the light are both alike to Thee.

verses.hebrew: כִּי־אַתָּה קָנִיתָ כִלְיֹתָי תְּסֻכֵּנִי בְּבֶטֶן אִמִּי׃
verses.english: For Thou hast formed my reins: Thou hast knit me together in my mother’s womb.

verses.hebrew: אוֹדְךָ עַל כִּי נוֹרָאוֹת נִפְלֵיתִי נִפְלָאִים מַעֲשֶׂיךָ וְנַפְשִׁי יֹדַעַת מְאֹד׃
verses.english: I will praise Thee; for I am fearfully and wonderfully made: marvellous are Thy works; and my soul knows that right well.

verses.hebrew: לֹא־נִכְחַד עָצְמִי מִמֶּךָּ אֲשֶׁר־עֻשֵּׂיתִי בַסֵּתֶר רֻקַּמְתִּי בְּתַחְתִּיּוֹת אָרֶץ׃
verses.english: My frame was not hidden from Thee, when I was made in secret, and curiously wrought in the lowest parts of the earth.

verses.hebrew: גָּלְמִי רָאוּ עֵינֶיךָ וְעַל־סִפְרְךָ כֻּלָּם יִכָּתֵבוּ יָמִים יֻצָּרוּ ולא [וְלוֹ] אֶחָד בָּהֶם׃
verses.english: Thy eyes did see my unshaped flesh; for in Thy book all things are written: the days also in which they are to be fashioned, and for it too there was one of them.

verses.hebrew: וְלִי מַה־יָּקְרוּ רֵעֶיךָ אֵל מֶה עָצְמוּ רָאשֵׁיהֶם׃
verses.english: How precious also are Thy thoughts to me, O God! how great is the sum of them!

verses.hebrew: אֶסְפְּרֵם מֵחוֹל יִרְבּוּן הֱקִיצֹתִי וְעוֹדִי עִמָּךְ׃
verses.english: If I should count them, they are more in number than the sand. When I awake, I am still with Thee.

verses.hebrew: אִם־תִּקְטֹל אֱלוֹהַּ רָשָׁע וְאַנְשֵׁי דָמִים סוּרוּ מֶנִּי׃
verses.english: Surely Thou wilt slay the wicked, O God: depart from me therefore, you bloody men,

verses.hebrew: אֲשֶׁר יֹאמְרֻךָ לִמְזִמָּה נָשֻׂא לַשָּׁוְא עָרֶיךָ׃
verses.english: who speak against Thee wickedly, and Thy enemies, who take Thy name in vain.

verses.hebrew: הֲלוֹא־מְשַׂנְאֶיךָ יְהוָה אֶשְׂנָא וּבִתְקוֹמְמֶיךָ אֶתְקוֹטָט׃
verses.english: Do I not hate, O Lord, those who hate Thee? and do I not strive with those who rise up against Thee?

verses.hebrew: תַּכְלִית שִׂנְאָה שְׂנֵאתִים לְאוֹיְבִים הָיוּ לִי׃
verses.english: I hate them with the utmost hatred: I count them my enemies.

verses.hebrew: חָקְרֵנִי אֵל וְדַע לְבָבִי בְּחָנֵנִי וְדַע שַׂרְעַפָּי׃
verses.english: Search me, O God, and know my heart: try me, and know my thoughts:

verses.hebrew: וּרְאֵה אִם־דֶּרֶךְ־עֹצֶב בִּי וּנְחֵנִי בְּדֶרֶךְ עוֹלָם׃
verses.english: and see if there is any wicked way in me, and lead me in the way everlasting.

verses.hebrew: לַמְנַצֵּחַ מִזְמוֹר לְדָוִד׃
verses.english: To the chief Musician, A Psalm of David.

verses.hebrew: חַלְּצֵנִי יְהוָה מֵאָדָם רָע מֵאִישׁ חֲמָסִים תִּנְצְרֵנִי׃
verses.english: Deliver me, O Lord, from the evil man: preserve me from the violent man;

verses.hebrew: אֲשֶׁר חָשְׁבוּ רָעוֹת בְּלֵב כָּל־יוֹם יָגוּרוּ מִלְחָמוֹת׃
verses.english: who devise mischiefs in their heart; continually they stir up wars.

verses.hebrew: שָׁנֲנוּ לְשׁוֹנָם כְּמוֹ־נָחָשׁ חֲמַת עַכְשׁוּב תַּחַת שְׂפָתֵימוֹ סֶלָה׃
verses.english: They have sharpened their tongues like a serpent; a spider’s venom is under their lips. (Sela.)

verses.hebrew: שָׁמְרֵנִי יְהוָה מִידֵי רָשָׁע מֵאִישׁ חֲמָסִים תִּנְצְרֵנִי אֲשֶׁר חָשְׁבוּ לִדְחוֹת פְּעָמָי׃
verses.english: Keep me, O Lord, from the hands of the wicked; preserve me from the violent man: who have purposed to trip up my feet.

verses.hebrew: טָמְנוּ־גֵאִים פַּח לִי וַחֲבָלִים פָּרְשׂוּ רֶשֶׁת לְיַד־מַעְגָּל מֹקְשִׁים שָׁתוּ־לִי סֶלָה׃
verses.english: The proud have hidden a snare for me, and cords; they have spread a net by the wayside; they have set traps for me. (Sela.)

verses.hebrew: אָמַרְתִּי לַיהוָה אֵלִי אָתָּה הַאֲזִינָה יְהוָה קוֹל תַּחֲנוּנָי׃
verses.english: I said to the Lord, Thou art my God: hear the voice of my supplications, O Lord.

verses.hebrew: יְהֹוִה אֲדֹנָי עֹז יְשׁוּעָתִי סַכֹּתָה לְרֹאשִׁי בְּיוֹם נָשֶׁק׃
verses.english: O God the Lord, the strength of my salvation, Thou hast screened my head in the day of battle;

verses.hebrew: אַל־תִּתֵּן יְהוָה מַאֲוַיֵּי רָשָׁע זְמָמוֹ אַל־תָּפֵק יָרוּמוּ סֶלָה׃
verses.english: grant not, O Lord, the desires of the wicked man: further not his wicked device; lest they exalt themselves. (Sela.)

verses.hebrew: רֹאשׁ מְסִבָּי עֲמַל שְׂפָתֵימוֹ יכסומו [יְכַסֵּמוֹ׃]
verses.english: As for the head of those who compass me about, let the mischief of their own lips cover them.

verses.hebrew: ימיטו [יִמּוֹטוּ] עֲלֵיהֶם גֶּחָלִים בָּאֵשׁ יַפִּלֵם בְּמַהֲמֹרוֹת בַּל־יָקוּמוּ׃
verses.english: Let burning coals fall upon them: let them be cast into the fire; into deep pits, so that they do not rise up again.

verses.hebrew: אִישׁ לָשׁוֹן בַּל־יִכּוֹן בָּאָרֶץ אִישׁ־חָמָס רָע יְצוּדֶנּוּ לְמַדְחֵפֹת׃
verses.english: Let not a slanderer be established in the earth: let evil hunt the violent man to his overthrow.

verses.hebrew: ידעת [יָדַעְתִּי] כִּי־יַעֲשֶׂה יְהוָה דִּין עָנִי מִשְׁפַּט אֶבְיֹנִים׃
verses.english: I know that the Lord will maintain the cause of the afflicted, and the right of the poor.

verses.hebrew: אַךְ צַדִּיקִים יוֹדוּ לִשְׁמֶךָ יֵשְׁבוּ יְשָׁרִים אֶת־פָּנֶיךָ׃
verses.english: Surely the righteous shall give thanks to Thy name: the upright shall dwell in Thy presence.

verses.hebrew: מִזְמוֹר לְדָוִד יְהוָה קְרָאתִיךָ חוּשָׁה לִּי הַאֲזִינָה קוֹלִי בְּקָרְאִי־לָךְ׃
verses.english: A Psalm of David. Lord, I cry to Thee: make haste to me; give ear to my voice, when I cry to Thee.

verses.hebrew: תִּכּוֹן תְּפִלָּתִי קְטֹרֶת לְפָנֶיךָ מַשְׂאַת כַּפַּי מִנְחַת־עָרֶב׃
verses.english: Let my prayer be set forth before Thee like incense; and the lifting up of my hands like the evening sacrifice.

verses.hebrew: שִׁיתָה יְהוָה שָׁמְרָה לְפִי נִצְּרָה עַל־דַּל שְׂפָתָי׃
verses.english: Set a guard, O Lord, to my mouth; keep watch over the door of my lips.

verses.hebrew: אַל־תַּט־לִבִּי לְדָבָר רָע לְהִתְעוֹלֵל עֲלִלוֹת בְּרֶשַׁע אֶת־אִישִׁים פֹּעֲלֵי־אָוֶן וּבַל־אֶלְחַם בְּמַנְעַמֵּיהֶם׃
verses.english: Incline not my heart to any evil thing, to practise wicked deeds with men who work iniquity: and let me not eat of their dainties.

verses.hebrew: יֶהֶלְמֵנִי־צַדִּיק חֶסֶד וְיוֹכִיחֵנִי שֶׁמֶן רֹאשׁ אַל־יָנִי רֹאשִׁי כִּי־עוֹד וּתְפִלָּתִי בְּרָעוֹתֵיהֶם׃
verses.english: Let the righteous strike me in kindness: and let him rebuke me; it shall be as oil for my head: let not my head refuse it: but still shall my prayer be against their evil plight.

verses.hebrew: נִשְׁמְטוּ בִידֵי־סֶלַע שֹׁפְטֵיהֶם וְשָׁמְעוּ אֲמָרַי כִּי נָעֵמוּ׃
verses.english: When their judges are thrown down upon the rocks, then they will hear how sweet were my words.

verses.hebrew: כְּמוֹ פֹלֵחַ וּבֹקֵעַ בָּאָרֶץ נִפְזְרוּ עֲצָמֵינוּ לְפִי שְׁאוֹל׃
verses.english: As when one cuts and breaks up wood on the earth, so are our bones strewn at the mouth of She᾽ol.

verses.hebrew: כִּי אֵלֶיךָ יְהֹוִה אֲדֹנָי עֵינָי בְּכָה חָסִיתִי אַל־תְּעַר נַפְשִׁי׃
verses.english: But my eyes are towards Thee, O God the Lord: in Thee I seek refuge; do not pour away my life.

verses.hebrew: שָׁמְרֵנִי מִידֵי פַח יָקְשׁוּ לִי וּמֹקְשׁוֹת פֹּעֲלֵי אָוֶן׃
verses.english: Keep me from the snare which they have laid for me, and the traps of the workers of iniquity.

verses.hebrew: יִפְּלוּ בְמַכְמֹרָיו רְשָׁעִים יַחַד אָנֹכִי עַד־אֶעֱבוֹר׃
verses.english: Let the wicked fall together into their own nets, whilst I escape.

verses.hebrew: מַשְׂכִּיל לְדָוִד בִּהְיוֹתוֹ בַמְּעָרָה תְפִלָּה׃
verses.english: A Maskil of David; A Prayer when he was in the cave.

verses.hebrew: קוֹלִי אֶל־יְהוָה אֶזְעָק קוֹלִי אֶל־יְהוָה אֶתְחַנָּן׃
verses.english: I cry to the Lord with my voice; with my voice I make my supplication to the Lord.

verses.hebrew: אֶשְׁפֹּךְ לְפָנָיו שִׂיחִי צָרָתִי לְפָנָיו אַגִּיד׃
verses.english: I pour out my complaint before him; I declare my trouble before him.

verses.hebrew: בְּהִתְעַטֵּף עָלַי רוּחִי וְאַתָּה יָדַעְתָּ נְתִיבָתִי בְּאֹרַח־זוּ אֲהַלֵּךְ טָמְנוּ פַח לִי׃
verses.english: When my spirit faints within me, then Thou knowst my path. In the way wherein I walk they have hidden a snare for me.

verses.hebrew: הַבֵּיט יָמִין וּרְאֵה וְאֵין־לִי מַכִּיר אָבַד מָנוֹס מִמֶּנִּי אֵין דּוֹרֵשׁ לְנַפְשִׁי׃
verses.english: I look on my right hand, and behold, but there is no man that knows me: I have nowhere to flee; no man cares for my soul.

verses.hebrew: זָעַקְתִּי אֵלֶיךָ יְהוָה אָמַרְתִּי אַתָּה מַחְסִי חֶלְקִי בְּאֶרֶץ הַחַיִּים׃
verses.english: I cried to Thee, O Lord: I said, Thou art my refuge and my portion in the land of the living.

verses.hebrew: הַקְשִׁיבָה אֶל־רִנָּתִי כִּי־דַלּוֹתִי מְאֹד הַצִּילֵנִי מֵרֹדְפַי כִּי אָמְצוּ מִמֶּנִּי׃
verses.english: Attend to my cry; for I am brought very low: deliver me from my persecutors; for they are stronger than I.

verses.hebrew: הוֹצִיאָה מִמַּסְגֵּר נַפְשִׁי לְהוֹדוֹת אֶת־שְׁמֶךָ בִּי יַכְתִּרוּ צַדִּיקִים כִּי תִגְמֹל עָלָי׃
verses.english: Bring my soul out of prison, that I may give thanks to Thy name: the righteous shall crown themselves in me; for Thou shalt deal bountifully with me.

verses.hebrew: מִזְמוֹר לְדָוִד יְהוָה שְׁמַע תְּפִלָּתִי הַאֲזִינָה אֶל־תַּחֲנוּנַי בֶּאֱמֻנָתְךָ עֲנֵנִי בְּצִדְקָתֶךָ׃
verses.english: A Psalm of David. Hear my prayer, O Lord, give ear to my supplications: in Thy faithfulness answer me, in thy righteousness.

verses.hebrew: וְאַל־תָּבוֹא בְמִשְׁפָּט אֶת־עַבְדֶּךָ כִּי לֹא־יִצְדַּק לְפָנֶיךָ כָל־חָי׃
verses.english: And enter not into judgment with Thy servant: for in Thy sight shall no man living be justified.

verses.hebrew: כִּי רָדַף אוֹיֵב נַפְשִׁי דִּכָּא לָאָרֶץ חַיָּתִי הוֹשִׁיבַנִי בְמַחֲשַׁכִּים כְּמֵתֵי עוֹלָם׃
verses.english: For the enemy has persecuted my soul; he has trodden my life down to the ground; he has made me to dwell in darkness, as those that have been long dead.

verses.hebrew: וַתִּתְעַטֵּף עָלַי רוּחִי בְּתוֹכִי יִשְׁתּוֹמֵם לִבִּי׃
verses.english: Therefore my spirit faints within me; my heart within me is appalled.

verses.hebrew: זָכַרְתִּי יָמִים מִקֶּדֶם הָגִיתִי בְכָל־פָּעֳלֶךָ בְּמַעֲשֵׂה יָדֶיךָ אֲשׂוֹחֵחַ׃
verses.english: I remember the days of old; I meditate on all Thy works; I muse on the work of Thy hands.

verses.hebrew: פֵּרַשְׂתִּי יָדַי אֵלֶיךָ נַפְשִׁי כְּאֶרֶץ־עֲיֵפָה לְךָ סֶלָה׃
verses.english: I stretch forth my hands to Thee: my soul thirsts after Thee, like a thirsty land. (Sela.)

verses.hebrew: מַהֵר עֲנֵנִי יְהוָה כָּלְתָה רוּחִי אַל־תַּסְתֵּר פָּנֶיךָ מִמֶּנִּי וְנִמְשַׁלְתִּי עִם־יֹרְדֵי בוֹר׃
verses.english: Answer me speedily, O Lord: my spirit fails: do not hide Thy face from me, lest I be like those who go down into the pit.

verses.hebrew: הַשְׁמִיעֵנִי בַבֹּקֶר חַסְדֶּךָ כִּי־בְךָ בָטָחְתִּי הוֹדִיעֵנִי דֶּרֶךְ־זוּ אֵלֵךְ כִּי־אֵלֶיךָ נָשָׂאתִי נַפְשִׁי׃
verses.english: Cause me to hear Thy words of steadfast love in the morning; for in Thee do I trust: cause me to know the way in which I should walk; for I lift up my soul to Thee.

verses.hebrew: הַצִּילֵנִי מֵאֹיְבַי יְהוָה אֵלֶיךָ כִסִּתִי׃
verses.english: Deliver me, O Lord, from my enemies: I flee to Thee to hide me.

verses.hebrew: לַמְּדֵנִי לַעֲשׂוֹת רְצוֹנֶךָ כִּי־אַתָּה אֱלוֹהָי רוּחֲךָ טוֹבָה תַּנְחֵנִי בְּאֶרֶץ מִישׁוֹר׃
verses.english: Teach me to do Thy will; for Thou art my God: let Thy good spirit lead me into a level land.

verses.hebrew: לְמַעַן־שִׁמְךָ יְהוָה תְּחַיֵּנִי בְּצִדְקָתְךָ תוֹצִיא מִצָּרָה נַפְשִׁי׃
verses.english: Revive me, O Lord, for Thy name’s sake: for Thy righteousness’ sake bring my soul out of trouble.

verses.hebrew: וּבְחַסְדְּךָ תַּצְמִית אֹיְבָי וְהַאֲבַדְתָּ כָּל־צֹרֲרֵי נַפְשִׁי כִּי אֲנִי עַבְדֶּךָ׃
verses.english: And in Thy mercy cut off my enemies, and destroy all those who afflict my soul: for I am Thy servant.

verses.hebrew: לְדָוִד בָּרוּךְ יְהוָה צוּרִי הַמְלַמֵּד יָדַי לַקְרָב אֶצְבְּעוֹתַי לַמִּלְחָמָה׃
verses.english: Of David. Blessed be the Lord my rock, who teaches my hands to war, and my fingers to fight:

verses.hebrew: חַסְדִּי וּמְצוּדָתִי מִשְׂגַּבִּי וּמְפַלְטִי לִי מָגִנִּי וּבוֹ חָסִיתִי הָרוֹדֵד עַמִּי תַחְתָּי׃
verses.english: my gracious one, and my fortress; my high tower, and my deliverer; my shield, and he in whom I trust; who subdues my people under me.

verses.hebrew: יְהוָה מָה־אָדָם וַתֵּדָעֵהוּ בֶּן־אֱנוֹשׁ וַתְּחַשְּׁבֵהוּ׃
verses.english: Lord, what is man, that Thou takest knowledge of him! or the son of man, that Thou makest account of him!

verses.hebrew: אָדָם לַהֶבֶל דָּמָה יָמָיו כְּצֵל עוֹבֵר׃
verses.english: Man is like a breath: his days are like a shadow that passes away.

verses.hebrew: יְהוָה הַט־שָׁמֶיךָ וְתֵרֵד גַּע בֶּהָרִים וְיֶעֱשָׁנוּ׃
verses.english: Bow Thy heavens, O Lord, and come down: touch the mountains, that they may smoke.

verses.hebrew: בְּרוֹק בָּרָק וּתְפִיצֵם שְׁלַח חִצֶּיךָ וּתְהֻמֵּם׃
verses.english: Cast forth lightning, and scatter them: shoot out Thy arrows, and destroy them.

verses.hebrew: שְׁלַח יָדֶיךָ מִמָּרוֹם פְּצֵנִי וְהַצִּילֵנִי מִמַּיִם רַבִּים מִיַּד בְּנֵי נֵכָר׃
verses.english: Send Thy hand from above; rescue me, and deliver me out of many waters, from the hand of strangers;

verses.hebrew: אֲשֶׁר פִּיהֶם דִּבֶּר־שָׁוְא וִימִינָם יְמִין שָׁקֶר׃
verses.english: whose mouth speaks vanity, and their right hand is a right hand of falsehood.

verses.hebrew: אֱ‍לֹהִים שִׁיר חָדָשׁ אָשִׁירָה לָּךְ בְּנֵבֶל עָשׂוֹר אֲזַמְּרָה־לָּךְ׃
verses.english: I will sing a new song to Thee, O God: upon a harp of ten strings I will sing praises to Thee.

verses.hebrew: הַנּוֹתֵן תְּשׁוּעָה לַמְּלָכִים הַפּוֹצֶה אֶת־דָּוִד עַבְדּוֹ מֵחֶרֶב רָעָה׃
verses.english: It is he who gives salvation to kings: who delivers David his servant from the hurtful sword.

verses.hebrew: פְּצֵנִי וְהַצִּילֵנִי מִיַּד בְּנֵי־נֵכָר אֲשֶׁר פִּיהֶם דִּבֶּר־שָׁוְא וִימִינָם יְמִין שָׁקֶר׃
verses.english: Rescue me, and deliver me from the hand of strangers, whose mouth speaks vanity, and their right hand is a right hand of falsehood.

verses.hebrew: אֲשֶׁר בָּנֵינוּ כִּנְטִעִים מְגֻדָּלִים בִּנְעוּרֵיהֶם בְּנוֹתֵינוּ כְזָוִיֹּת מְחֻטָּבוֹת תַּבְנִית הֵיכָל׃
verses.english: For our sons are as plants grown up in their youth; our daughters as corner stones, polished after the fashion of a palace:

verses.hebrew: מְזָוֵינוּ מְלֵאִים מְפִיקִים מִזַּן אֶל־זַן צֹאונֵנוּ מַאֲלִיפוֹת מְרֻבָּבוֹת בְּחוּצוֹתֵינוּ׃
verses.english: our garners are full, affording all manner of store: our sheep bring forth thousands and ten thousands in our streets:

verses.hebrew: אַלּוּפֵינוּ מְסֻבָּלִים אֵין־פֶּרֶץ וְאֵין יוֹצֵאת וְאֵין צְוָחָה בִּרְחֹבֹתֵינוּ׃
verses.english: our oxen are heavy laden: there is no breach or migration: and there is no loud cry in our streets.

verses.hebrew: אַשְׁרֵי הָעָם שֶׁכָּכָה לּוֹ אַשְׁרֵי הָעָם שֶׁיֲהוָה אֱלֹהָיו׃
verses.english: Happy is that people, that is in such a case: happy is that people, whose God is the Lord.

verses.hebrew: תְּהִלָּה לְדָוִד אֲרוֹמִמְךָ אֱלוֹהַי הַמֶּלֶךְ וַאֲבָרֲכָה שִׁמְךָ לְעוֹלָם וָעֶד׃
verses.english: A Praise of David. I will extol Thee, my God, O king; and I will bless Thy name for ever and ever.

verses.hebrew: בְּכָל־יוֹם אֲבָרֲכֶךָּ וַאֲהַלְלָה שִׁמְךָ לְעוֹלָם וָעֶד׃
verses.english: Every day I will bless Thee; and I will praise Thy name for ever and ever.

verses.hebrew: גָּדוֹל יְהוָה וּמְהֻלָּל מְאֹד וְלִגְדֻלָּתוֹ אֵין חֵקֶר׃
verses.english: Great is the Lord, and greatly to be praised; and his greatness is unsearchable.

verses.hebrew: דּוֹר לְדוֹר יְשַׁבַּח מַעֲשֶׂיךָ וּגְבוּרֹתֶיךָ יַגִּידוּ׃
verses.english: One generation shall praise Thy works to another, and shall declare Thy mighty acts.

verses.hebrew: הֲדַר כְּבוֹד הוֹדֶךָ וְדִבְרֵי נִפְלְאוֹתֶיךָ אָשִׂיחָה׃
verses.english: I will speak of the glorious splendour of Thy majesty, and of Thy wondrous works.

verses.hebrew: וֶעֱזוּז נוֹרְאֹתֶיךָ יֹאמֵרוּ וגדולתיך [וּגְדוּלָּתְךָ] אֲסַפְּרֶנָּה׃
verses.english: And men shall speak of the might of Thy terrible acts: and I will declare Thy greatness.

verses.hebrew: זֵכֶר רַב־טוּבְךָ יַבִּיעוּ וְצִדְקָתְךָ יְרַנֵּנוּ׃
verses.english: They shall utter the fame of Thy great goodness, and shall sing of Thy righteousness.

verses.hebrew: חַנּוּן וְרַחוּם יְהוָה אֶרֶךְ אַפַּיִם וּגְדָל־חָסֶד׃
verses.english: The Lord is gracious, and full of compassion; slow to anger, and of abundant love.

verses.hebrew: טוֹב־יְהוָה לַכֹּל וְרַחֲמָיו עַל־כָּל־מַעֲשָׂיו׃
verses.english: The Lord is good to all: and his tender mercies are over all his works.

verses.hebrew: יוֹדוּךָ יְהוָה כָּל־מַעֲשֶׂיךָ וַחֲסִידֶיךָ יְבָרֲכוּכָה׃
verses.english: All Thy works shall praise Thee, O Lord; and Thy pious ones shall bless Thee.

verses.hebrew: כְּבוֹד מַלְכוּתְךָ יֹאמֵרוּ וּגְבוּרָתְךָ יְדַבֵּרוּ׃
verses.english: They shall speak of the glory of Thy kingdom, and talk of Thy power;

verses.hebrew: לְהוֹדִיעַ לִבְנֵי הָאָדָם גְּבוּרֹתָיו וּכְבוֹד הֲדַר מַלְכוּתוֹ׃
verses.english: to make known to the sons of men his mighty acts, and the glorious majesty of his kingdom.

verses.hebrew: מַלְכוּתְךָ מַלְכוּת כָּל־עֹלָמִים וּמֶמְשֶׁלְתְּךָ בְּכָל־דּוֹר וָדוֹר׃
verses.english: Thy kingdom is an everlasting kingdom, and Thy dominion endures throughout all generations.

verses.hebrew: סוֹמֵךְ יְהוָה לְכָל־הַנֹּפְלִים וְזוֹקֵף לְכָל־הַכְּפוּפִים׃
verses.english: The Lord upholds all that fall, and raises up all those who are bowed down.

verses.hebrew: עֵינֵי־כֹל אֵלֶיךָ יְשַׂבֵּרוּ וְאַתָּה נוֹתֵן־לָהֶם אֶת־אָכְלָם בְּעִתּוֹ׃
verses.english: The eyes of all wait upon Thee; and Thou givest them their food in due season.

verses.hebrew: פּוֹתֵחַ אֶת־יָדֶךָ וּמַשְׂבִּיעַ לְכָל־חַי רָצוֹן׃
verses.english: Thou openest Thy hand, and satisfiest the desire of every living thing.

verses.hebrew: צַדִּיק יְהוָה בְּכָל־דְּרָכָיו וְחָסִיד בְּכָל־מַעֲשָׂיו׃
verses.english: The Lord is righteous in all his ways, and gracious in all his works.

verses.hebrew: קָרוֹב יְהוָה לְכָל־קֹרְאָיו לְכֹל אֲשֶׁר יִקְרָאֻהוּ בֶאֱמֶת׃
verses.english: The Lord is near to all those who call upon him, to all who call upon him in truth.

verses.hebrew: רְצוֹן־יְרֵאָיו יַעֲשֶׂה וְאֶת־שַׁוְעָתָם יִשְׁמַע וְיוֹשִׁיעֵם׃
verses.english: He will fulfil the desire of those who fear him: he also will hear their cry, and will save them.

verses.hebrew: שׁוֹמֵר יְהוָה אֶת־כָּל־אֹהֲבָיו וְאֵת כָּל־הָרְשָׁעִים יַשְׁמִיד׃
verses.english: The Lord preserves all those who love him: but all the wicked he will destroy.

verses.hebrew: תְּהִלַּת יְהוָה יְדַבֶּר־פִּי וִיבָרֵךְ כָּל־בָּשָׂר שֵׁם קָדְשׁוֹ לְעוֹלָם וָעֶד׃
verses.english: My mouth shall speak the praise of the Lord: and let all flesh bless his holy name for ever and ever.

verses.hebrew: הַלְלוּ־יָהּ הַלְלִי נַפְשִׁי אֶת־יְהוָה׃
verses.english: Haleluya! Praise the Lord, O my soul.

verses.hebrew: אֲהַלְלָה יְהוָה בְּחַיָּי אֲזַמְּרָה לֵאלֹהַי בְּעוֹדִי׃
verses.english: While I live I will praise the Lord: I will sing praises to my God while I have my being.

verses.hebrew: אַל־תִּבְטְחוּ בִנְדִיבִים בְּבֶן־אָדָם שֶׁאֵין לוֹ תְשׁוּעָה׃
verses.english: Put not your trust in princes, nor in the son of man, in whom there is no help.

verses.hebrew: תֵּצֵא רוּחוֹ יָשֻׁב לְאַדְמָתוֹ בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא אָבְדוּ עֶשְׁתֹּנֹתָיו׃
verses.english: His breath goes forth, he returns to his earth; in that very day his thoughts perish.

verses.hebrew: אַשְׁרֵי שֶׁאֵל יַעֲקֹב בְּעֶזְרוֹ שִׂבְרוֹ עַל־יְהוָה אֱלֹהָיו׃
verses.english: Happy is he who has the God of Ya῾aqov for his help, whose hope is in the Lord his God:

verses.hebrew: עֹשֶׂה שָׁמַיִם וָאָרֶץ אֶת־הַיָּם וְאֶת־כָּל־אֲשֶׁר־בָּם הַשֹּׁמֵר אֱמֶת לְעוֹלָם׃
verses.english: who made heaven, and earth, the sea, and all that is in them: who keeps truth forever.

verses.hebrew: עֹשֶׂה מִשְׁפָּט לָעֲשׁוּקִים נֹתֵן לֶחֶם לָרְעֵבִים יְהוָה מַתִּיר אֲסוּרִים׃
verses.english: Who executes judgment for the oppressed: who gives bread to the hungry. The Lord looses the prisoners:

verses.hebrew: יְהוָה פֹּקֵחַ עִוְרִים יְהוָה זֹקֵף כְּפוּפִים יְהוָה אֹהֵב צַדִּיקִים׃
verses.english: the Lord opens the eyes of the blind: the Lord raises those who are bowed down: the Lord loves the righteous:

verses.hebrew: יְהוָה שֹׁמֵר אֶת־גֵּרִים יָתוֹם וְאַלְמָנָה יְעוֹדֵד וְדֶרֶךְ רְשָׁעִים יְעַוֵּת׃
verses.english: the Lord preserves the strangers; he relieves the fatherless and widow: but the way of the wicked he makes crooked.

verses.hebrew: יִמְלֹךְ יְהוָה לְעוֹלָם אֱלֹהַיִךְ צִיּוֹן לְדֹר וָדֹר הַלְלוּ־יָהּ׃
verses.english: The Lord shall reign forever, thy God, O Żiyyon, to all generations. Haleluya!

verses.hebrew: הַלְלוּ יָהּ כִּי־טוֹב זַמְּרָה אֱלֹהֵינוּ כִּי־נָעִים נָאוָה תְהִלָּה׃
verses.english: Praise the Lord: for it is good to sing praises to our God; for it is pleasant; praise is comely.

verses.hebrew: בּוֹנֵה יְרוּשָׁלִַם יְהוָה נִדְחֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל יְכַנֵּס׃
verses.english: The Lord builds Yerushalayim: he gathers together the outcasts of Yisra᾽el.

verses.hebrew: הָרֹפֵא לִשְׁבוּרֵי לֵב וּמְחַבֵּשׁ לְעַצְּבוֹתָם׃
verses.english: He heals the brokenhearted, and binds up their wounds.

verses.hebrew: מוֹנֶה מִסְפָּר לַכּוֹכָבִים לְכֻלָּם שֵׁמוֹת יִקְרָא׃
verses.english: He counts the number of the stars; he calls them all by their names.

verses.hebrew: גָּדוֹל אֲדוֹנֵינוּ וְרַב־כֹּחַ לִתְבוּנָתוֹ אֵין מִסְפָּר׃
verses.english: Great is our Lord, and of great power: his understanding is infinite.

verses.hebrew: מְעוֹדֵד עֲנָוִים יְהוָה מַשְׁפִּיל רְשָׁעִים עֲדֵי־אָרֶץ׃
verses.english: The Lord upholds the humble: he casts the wicked down to the ground.

verses.hebrew: עֱנוּ לַיהוָה בְּתוֹדָה זַמְּרוּ לֵאלֹהֵינוּ בְכִנּוֹר׃
verses.english: Sing to the Lord with thanksgiving; sing praise upon the lyre to our God:

verses.hebrew: הַמְכַסֶּה שָׁמַיִם בְּעָבִים הַמֵּכִין לָאָרֶץ מָטָר הַמַּצְמִיחַ הָרִים חָצִיר׃
verses.english: who covers the heaven with clouds, who prepares rain for the earth, who makes grass to grow upon the mountains.

verses.hebrew: נוֹתֵן לִבְהֵמָה לַחְמָהּ לִבְנֵי עֹרֵב אֲשֶׁר יִקְרָאוּ׃
verses.english: He gives to the beast its food, and to the young ravens which cry.

verses.hebrew: לֹא בִגְבוּרַת הַסּוּס יֶחְפָּץ לֹא־בְשׁוֹקֵי הָאִישׁ יִרְצֶה׃
verses.english: He delights not in the strength of the horse: he takes no pleasure in the legs of a man.

verses.hebrew: רוֹצֶה יְהוָה אֶת־יְרֵאָיו אֶת־הַמְיַחֲלִים לְחַסְדּוֹ׃
verses.english: The Lord takes pleasure in those who fear him, in those who hope in his steadfast love.

verses.hebrew: שַׁבְּחִי יְרוּשָׁלִַם אֶת־יְהוָה הַלְלִי אֱלֹהַיִךְ צִיּוֹן׃
verses.english: Praise the Lord, O Yerushalayim; praise Thy God, O Żiyyon.

verses.hebrew: כִּי־חִזַּק בְּרִיחֵי שְׁעָרָיִךְ בֵּרַךְ בָּנַיִךְ בְּקִרְבֵּךְ׃
verses.english: For he has strengthened the bars of thy gates; he has blessed thy children within thee.

verses.hebrew: הַשָּׂם־גְּבוּלֵךְ שָׁלוֹם חֵלֶב חִטִּים יַשְׂבִּיעֵךְ׃
verses.english: He makes peace in Thy borders, and fills thee with the finest of the wheat.

verses.hebrew: הַשֹּׁלֵחַ אִמְרָתוֹ אָרֶץ עַד־מְהֵרָה יָרוּץ דְּבָרוֹ׃
verses.english: He sends forth his commandment upon the earth: his word runs very swiftly.

verses.hebrew: הַנֹּתֵן שֶׁלֶג כַּצָּמֶר כְּפוֹר כָּאֵפֶר יְפַזֵּר׃
verses.english: He gives snow like wool: he scatters the hoar frost like ashes.

verses.hebrew: מַשְׁלִיךְ קַרְחוֹ כְפִתִּים לִפְנֵי קָרָתוֹ מִי יַעֲמֹד׃
verses.english: He casts forth his ice like morsels: who can stand before his cold?

verses.hebrew: יִשְׁלַח דְּבָרוֹ וְיַמְסֵם יַשֵּׁב רוּחוֹ יִזְּלוּ־מָיִם׃
verses.english: He sends out his word, and melts them: he causes his wind to blow: they run as water.

verses.hebrew: מַגִּיד דברו [דְּבָרָיו] לְיַעֲקֹב חֻקָּיו וּמִשְׁפָּטָיו לְיִשְׂרָאֵל׃
verses.english: He declares his Word to Ya῾aqov, his statutes and his judgments to Yisra᾽el.

verses.hebrew: לֹא עָשָׂה כֵן לְכָל־גּוֹי וּמִשְׁפָּטִים בַּל־יְדָעוּם הַלְלוּ־יָהּ׃
verses.english: He has not dealt so with any other nation: and as for his ordinances they have not known them. Haleluya!

verses.hebrew: הַלְלוּ יָהּ הַלְלוּ אֶת־יְהוָה מִן־הַשָּׁמַיִם הַלְלוּהוּ בַּמְּרוֹמִים׃
verses.english: Haleluya! Praise the Lord from the heavens: praise him in the heights.

verses.hebrew: הַלְלוּהוּ כָל־מַלְאָכָיו הַלְלוּהוּ כָּל־צבאו [צְבָאָיו׃]
verses.english: Praise him, all his angels: praise him, all his hosts.

verses.hebrew: הַלְלוּהוּ שֶׁמֶשׁ וְיָרֵחַ הַלְלוּהוּ כָּל־כּוֹכְבֵי אוֹר׃
verses.english: Praise him, sun and moon: praise him, all you stars of light.

verses.hebrew: הַלְלוּהוּ שְׁמֵי הַשָּׁמָיִם וְהַמַּיִם אֲשֶׁר מֵעַל הַשָּׁמָיִם׃
verses.english: Praise him, heavens of heavens, and you waters that are above the heavens.

verses.hebrew: יְהַלְלוּ אֶת־שֵׁם יְהוָה כִּי הוּא צִוָּה וְנִבְרָאוּ׃
verses.english: Let them praise the name of the Lord: for he gave command, and they were created.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעֲמִידֵם לָעַד לְעוֹלָם חָק־נָתַן וְלֹא יַעֲבוֹר׃
verses.english: And he established them for ever and ever: he has made a decree which shall not pass.

verses.hebrew: הַלְלוּ אֶת־יְהוָה מִן־הָאָרֶץ תַּנִּינִים וְכָל־תְּהֹמוֹת׃
verses.english: Praise the Lord from the earth, O monsters, and all deeps:

verses.hebrew: אֵשׁ וּבָרָד שֶׁלֶג וְקִיטוֹר רוּחַ סְעָרָה עֹשָׂה דְבָרוֹ׃
verses.english: fire, and hail; snow, and vapours; stormy wind fulfilling his word:

verses.hebrew: הֶהָרִים וְכָל־גְּבָעוֹת עֵץ פְּרִי וְכָל־אֲרָזִים׃
verses.english: mountains, and all hills; fruitful trees, and all cedars:

verses.hebrew: הַחַיָּה וְכָל־בְּהֵמָה רֶמֶשׂ וְצִפּוֹר כָּנָף׃
verses.english: beasts, and all cattle; creeping things, and winged birds:

verses.hebrew: מַלְכֵי־אֶרֶץ וְכָל־לְאֻמִּים שָׂרִים וְכָל־שֹׁפְטֵי אָרֶץ׃
verses.english: kings of the earth, and all peoples; princes, and all judges of the earth:

verses.hebrew: בַּחוּרִים וְגַם־בְּתוּלוֹת זְקֵנִים עִם־נְעָרִים׃
verses.english: both young men, and girls; old men, and children:

verses.hebrew: יְהַלְלוּ אֶת־שֵׁם יְהוָה כִּי־נִשְׂגָּב שְׁמוֹ לְבַדּוֹ הוֹדוֹ עַל־אֶרֶץ וְשָׁמָיִם׃
verses.english: let them praise the name of the Lord: for his name alone is exalted; his glory is above the earth and heaven.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּרֶם קֶרֶן לְעַמּוֹ תְּהִלָּה לְכָל־חֲסִידָיו לִבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל עַם־קְרֹבוֹ הַלְלוּ־יָהּ׃
verses.english: He also has exalted the horn of his people, a praise for all his pious ones; even for the children of Yisra᾽el, a people near to him. Haleluya!

verses.hebrew: הַלְלוּ יָהּ שִׁירוּ לַיהוָה שִׁיר חָדָשׁ תְּהִלָּתוֹ בִּקְהַל חֲסִידִים׃
verses.english: Haleluya! Sing to the Lord a new song, his praise is sounded in the congregation of the pious.

verses.hebrew: יִשְׂמַח יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּעֹשָׂיו בְּנֵי־צִיּוֹן יָגִילוּ בְמַלְכָּם׃
verses.english: Let Yisra᾽el rejoice in him who made him: let the children of Żiyyon be joyful in their King.

verses.hebrew: יְהַלְלוּ שְׁמוֹ בְמָחוֹל בְּתֹף וְכִנּוֹר יְזַמְּרוּ־לוֹ׃
verses.english: Let them praise his name in the dance: let them sing praises to him with the timbrel and lyre.

verses.hebrew: כִּי־רוֹצֶה יְהוָה בְּעַמּוֹ יְפָאֵר עֲנָוִים בִּישׁוּעָה׃
verses.english: For the Lord takes pleasure in his people: he will beautify the humble with salvation.

verses.hebrew: יַעְלְזוּ חֲסִידִים בְּכָבוֹד יְרַנְּנוּ עַל־מִשְׁכְּבוֹתָם׃
verses.english: Let the pious be joyful in glory: let them sing aloud upon their beds.

verses.hebrew: רוֹמְמוֹת אֵל בִּגְרוֹנָם וְחֶרֶב פִּיפִיּוֹת בְּיָדָם׃
verses.english: The high praises of God are in their mouth, and a two edged sword in their hand;

verses.hebrew: לַעֲשׂוֹת נְקָמָה בַּגּוֹיִם תּוֹכֵחֹת בַּל־אֻמִּים׃
verses.english: to execute vengeance upon the nations, chastisements upon the peoples;

verses.hebrew: לֶאְסֹר מַלְכֵיהֶם בְּזִקִּים וְנִכְבְּדֵיהֶם בְּכַבְלֵי בַרְזֶל׃
verses.english: to bind their kings with chains, and their nobles with fetters of iron;

verses.hebrew: לַעֲשׂוֹת בָּהֶם מִשְׁפָּט כָּתוּב הָדָר הוּא לְכָל־חֲסִידָיו הַלְלוּ־יָהּ׃
verses.english: to execute upon them the judgment written: it is an honour to all his pious ones. Haleluya!

verses.hebrew: הַלְלוּ יָהּ הַלְלוּ־אֵל בְּקָדְשׁוֹ הַלְלוּהוּ בִּרְקִיעַ עֻזּוֹ׃
verses.english: Haleluya! Praise God in his sanctuary: praise him in the firmament of his power.

verses.hebrew: הַלְלוּהוּ בִגְבוּרֹתָיו הַלְלוּהוּ כְּרֹב גֻּדְלוֹ׃
verses.english: Praise him for his mighty acts: praise him according to his exceeding greatness.

verses.hebrew: הַלְלוּהוּ בְּתֵקַע שׁוֹפָר הַלְלוּהוּ בְּנֵבֶל וְכִנּוֹר׃
verses.english: Praise him with the sound of the shofar: praise him with the harp and lyre.

verses.hebrew: הַלְלוּהוּ בְתֹף וּמָחוֹל הַלְלוּהוּ בְּמִנִּים וְעוּגָב׃
verses.english: Praise him with the timbrel and dance: praise him with stringed instruments and the pipe.

verses.hebrew: הַלְלוּהוּ בְצִלְצְלֵי־שָׁמַע הַלְלוּהוּ בְּצִלְצְלֵי תְרוּעָה׃
verses.english: Praise him upon sounding cymbals: praise him upon loud clashing cymbals.

verses.hebrew: כֹּל הַנְּשָׁמָה תְּהַלֵּל יָהּ הַלְלוּ־יָהּ׃
verses.english: Let everything that has breath praise the Lord. Haleluya!
